Key drivers of our success have been the breadth and tenure of our talent, as well as a unique culture and a set of values that guide our employees. We view Morgan Stanley’s talent and culture as a key competitive advantage enabling the Firm to achieve its potential and drive future success.

Our ability to do so is grounded in four pillars that define Morgan Stanley: a clear and consistent strategy to help clients raise, manage and allocate capital; a culture grounded in rigor, humility and partnership; financial strength through capital, earnings power and durability; and growth driven by smart, strategic investment globally.

These pillars enable Morgan Stanley to provide trusted advice, operate with resilience across market cycles and deliver long-term value to our clients and shareholders.

About Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what is important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

About The Role

The Senior Analyst, Client Reporting is primarily responsible for client reporting, qualitative and quantitative analysis for the Institutional and Wealth Management sales organizations. The position will require teamwork and collaboration with multiple departments. Although interactions with the end client are limited, the role is focused on providing exceptional client service through timely and accurate analysis and reporting.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare quarterly, monthly and ad hoc analysis and client reporting for institutional and\or wealth management clients.
  • Perform detailed review of client deliverables.
  • Design, prepare and review custom institutional client reports utilizing Factset, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Assist with designing tactical reporting solutions for new products.
  • Manage the timely and accurate delivery of all requests.
  • Ability to train, coach and educate new staff members on processes and systems.
  • Ability to lead projects/initiatives with limited direction: Exhibits clear project management skills: managing deadlines, keeping all stakeholders informed, anticipating roadblocks, preparing back-up plans, etc.
  • Investigate portfolio specific inquiries.
  • Develop a specialized knowledge of all relevant Parametric products and strategies.
  • Uphold department reputation through professionalism, accuracy, responsiveness and commitment to client service.
  • Develop a full working knowledge of the firm's structure, key personnel and organizational policies and procedures, in addition to a functional knowledge of a professional services environment.
  • Act as a back-up for the Supervisor when needed.
  • Assume other responsibilities as required.

Job Requirements

  • 4-year degree, preferably in related discipline such as economics or finance.
  • 3-5 years of industry experience.
  • Strong math/quantitative skills and analytical writing ability.
  • Proficient in Excel including using V-Lookup and PivotTables.
  • Ability to excel independently and in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to maintain productivity and strong work ethic under minimal supervision.
  • Working knowledge of statistics and familiarity with the principles of portfolio management.
  • Possess excellent communication and organizational skills and be able to handle a heavy, deadline-oriented workload.
  • Ability to successfully manage and coordinate simultaneous multiple-level projects and tasks with internal departments.
  • High attention to detail and strong sense of urgency.
  • Must possess a high level of initiative.
  • Familiarity with Factset, Bloomberg and other analysis tools is a plus.
  • Proficiency in macro and code writing is a plus.
  • Completion of Level I or higher of the CFA program a plus.

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Salary range for the position: $70,000-$140,000/Yr. The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary incentive compensation award. The successful candidate may be eligible to participate in the relevant business unit's incentive compensation plan, which also may include a discretionary bonus component. Morgan Stanley offers a full spectrum of benefits, including Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Dependent Day Care Savings Account, Life Insurance, Disability and Other Insurance Plans, Paid Time Off (including Sick Leave consistent with state and local law, Parental Leave and 20 Vacation Days annually), 10 Paid Holidays, 401(k), and Short/Long Term Disability, in addition to other special perks reserved for our employees. Please visit mybenefits.morganstanley.com to learn more about our benefit offerings.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $70,000 and $140,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

Description

The Finance Data Analyst will play a critical role in supporting finance, executive, and operational teams by ensuring data integrity, delivering actionable insights, and driving financial reporting and operational excellence. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across departments to build business intelligence dashboards and enhance reporting capabilities. The Finance Data Analyst will also interpret data, identify trends, and visualize findings to communicate insights effectively.

This is a full-time, in-office position based at our Westfield, Indiana location. The successful candidate will be expected to work on-site in the Westfield office.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Extract and process data from various sources, including databases, APIs, and reports generated from a variety of internal programs, external sources and software providers
  • Design and optimize enterprise-level reporting data workflows to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency by cleaning data, identifying and correcting any errors, troubleshooting missing values and understanding the business to ensure data aligns with and validates business results & KPI’s
  • Analyze and interpret datasets using statistical analysis, focusing on trends and patterns
  • Develop and create reports and dashboards to present findings to stakeholders
  • Communicate visual representations of data using tools such as Tableau or Power BI to make insights understandable
  • Write and optimize SQL queries against large-scale datasets
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and provide support for consolidated reporting and data driven decision-making.
  • Develop and deliver ad hoc analysis projects to address urgent business concerns as they develop utilizing data in real time
  • Support strategic objectives by establishing KPIs, refining key performance indicators and other quantifiable business objectives to measure the effectiveness of business initiatives
  • Partner with leadership and act as a business intelligence consultant to executives and other functional leaders to identify improvement opportunities and guide strategic planning

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related)
  • 3+ years of data analysis / business intelligence experience
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, R, and Excel
  • Experience in machine learning, predictive modeling, or statistical analysis
  • Experience with NetSuite ERP, Power BI, Tableau or other visualization tools
  • Demonstrated ability to understand manufacturing business needs and speak to technical and non-technical operational business groups
  • Strong communication skills, with demonstrated ability to present and explain the significance of data to business stakeholders
  • Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, etc.); NetSuite experience; Web proficiency.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily works in an office environment in Westfield, IN with frequent interaction on the manufacturing floor.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and work at a desk for long periods of time
  • Ability to perform close visual work for prolonged periods of time

descriptionHtml:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

Client Reporting Analyst

What is the Global Client Group responsible for?

Franklin Templeton's Global Client Group connects investment capabilities with clients through coordinated service, reporting, analytics, and sales support. The Client Reporting team transforms portfolio and market data into accurate, meaningful reporting across equity, fixed income, and other investment strategies. You will join a collaborative, evolving global function focused on consistent delivery, scalable processes, and stronger use of data, automation, and technology. The role offers exposure to investment teams, client needs, and reporting transformation, with opportunities to build knowledge applicable to product, portfolio analytics, investments, and client service.

What are the ongoing responsibilities of a Client Reporting Analyst?

As a Client Reporting Analyst, your focus will be analyzing portfolio and benchmark data to produce insightful reporting that best support our clients’ unique investment needs and objectives. Working in an increasingly automated environment, you’ll deliver proactive analytical and organizational support to our clients and other stakeholders around the firm. You’ll learn about our data model and our business from the ground up by working closely with every department at the organization including Technology, Product Management, Investment Management and Operations. You will play a key role in supporting our clients and participating in departmental initiatives.

How You Will Add Value

Core Responsibilities

  • You will produce recurring and ad hoc client portfolio reports.
  • You will analyze portfolio, benchmark, and market data.
  • You will validate outputs and investigate data discrepancies.
  • You will build reporting solutions using Excel, SQL and other tools.
  • You will support client requests, presentations, commentaries, and special projects.
  • You will maintain accurate, timely reporting across investment strategies.

Strategic Responsibilities

  • You will translate complex data into clear client-focused insights.
  • You will improve reporting workflows through automation and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • You will evaluate processes across investment groups and identify alignment opportunities.
  • You will support scalable data standards, controls, and reporting practices.

Teams & Collaboration

  • You will partner with Client Service, Relationship Management, and Sales teams.
  • You will collaborate with Investment, Product, Operations, Risk, and Technology Teams.
  • You will support stakeholders across regions and investment groups.

What You Will Bring

Experience, Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, accounting, or related field.
  • Experience in investment management, client reporting, analytics, or financial services.
  • Knowledge of equity, fixed income, or multi-asset investments preferred.
  • Progress toward Chartered Financial Analyst designation is a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong SQL querying and data analysis capabilities are required.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, and data validation.
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar data platforms strong preferred.
  • FactSet experience preferred; Aladdin familiarity is a plus.
  • Python, automation, machine learning, or related experience are advantageous.

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional attention to detail and investigative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to connect data with meaningful client and business narratives.
  • Strong listening, communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Adaptability within evolving processes and an integrated global environment.

This role works from our Pasadena, California office 4 days per week (Monday - Thursday).

Franklin Templeton offers employees a competitive and valuable range of total rewards, monetary and non-monetary — designed to support their well-being and recognize their time, talents, and results. Along with base compensation, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, a 401(k) plan with a generous match, and recognition rewards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which includes a range of competitive healthcare options, insurance, and disability benefits, employee stock investment program, learning resources, career development programs, reimbursement for certain education expenses, paid time off (vacation / holidays / sick / leave / parental & caregiving leave / bereavement / volunteering / floating holidays) and a motivational wellbeing program. We expect the annual salary for this position to range between $103,000 - $130,000, depending on location and level of relevant experience, plus a discretionary bonus.

#ASSOCIATE

At Franklin Templeton, we believe your benefits should support your life, your goals, and your future. That’s why we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Highlights Of Our Benefits Include

  • Paid Time Off: Three weeks of PTO in your first year
  • Health Coverage: Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance to support your well-being
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with an 85% company match on pre-tax and/or Roth contributions, up to IRS limits
  • Equity & Investing: Employee Stock Investment Plan (ESIP) with discounted share purchase opportunities
  • Learning Education Assistance Program (LEAP): To support your ongoing growth and career advancement
  • Employee Investment Benefits: Opportunity to purchase company funds with no sales charge

Franklin Templeton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees, and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to ancestry, age, color, disability, genetic information, gender, gender identity, or gender expression, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.

Artificial intelligence or automated tools may be used to assist in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position.

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a highly analytical Business Analyst who enjoys turning complex data into clear, actionable business insights.

Filling a pivotal role in translating workflow processes into actionable, clear, and concise business requirements and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive automation, quality control, and application enhancements. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with large datasets, Power BI, data validation, and analytical problem-solving, with some experience writing SQL queries. Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis and improve business processes is a strong plus.

This is a remote position.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Job Type

Full-time

Description

Come Smile with Us!

Turn data into insights that make a difference! As a Data Analyst with Delta Dental of Iowa, you will transform data from multiple sources into meaningful dashboards, reports, and recommendations that help teams make informed decisions. Primarily supporting our Professional Relations team, you will also partner with Sales and other areas of the organization to provide insights that support operational, quality, contractual, and business objectives.

Learn why Karmin enjoys working for Delta Dental of Iowa.

Why Delta Dental of Iowa?

For your smile. For your health. For your community.

At Delta Dental of Iowa, we’re more than just a dental and vision insurance company. Improving health and wellness is at the center of everything we do. As a not-for-profit, we aim to build stronger communities by investing in actions that promote and improve health. Delta Dental of Iowa invests 40% of our dollars directly back into the communities we serve.

Come see why we are passionate about "Bringing Smiles" to our customers. Our team enjoys competitive pay and benefits, an awesome "One Team" approach, and a company culture that fosters "Exceptional Quality Service" and "Leadership at All Levels." Together, we can make a difference – not only in Iowa but across the country.

Essential Functions And Principal Accountabilities

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of business areas supported by role.
  • Collaboratively work with internal stakeholders to identify informatics, reporting requirements, and desired outcomes measurement.
  • Develop, analyze and distribute, and manage reporting and analysis related to requested deliverables, including ad hoc data requests.
  • Generate and analyze reports to identify statistical aberrant treatment profiles; evaluate targeted claims for utilization review, appropriateness, and adherence to national processing policies; work with appropriate staff to educate dentists and dental office staff to appropriate treatment reporting and compliance to Delta Dental of Iowa processing policy.
  • Perform annual fee schedule analysis and update fee schedule documentation for all lines of business.
  • Lead quality assurance and management checks to confirm compliance and accuracy with data and department operations
  • Perform deep dive analysis to effectively translate broad data sets into performance insight; present findings and recommendations to multiple levels of management.
  • Report, analyze and summarize data for cost containment reports, dental consultant activity and other required department reporting.
  • Utilize SQL, Power BI, Network360, geoaccess mapping, and other tools to mine database(s) for analytic data.
  • Advise on data policies and data process best practice standards.
  • Be the go-to person for data definitions, data flows, and troubleshooting data issues, and support data dictionary enhancement.
  • Work with internal and external audit and project teams to provide complete and accurate audit documentation for initial requests and any required follow-up activities including corrective action plans.
  • Effectively and clearly communicate results to stakeholders.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Data Analytics, Business, Finance, Mathematics, or related field.
  • Three to five years of relevant work experience.
  • Must possess superior math and impact analysis skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Ability to work as an analytical, problem solver who can make high-quality judgments and decisions quickly with excellent organization skills to work across functions, with internal leadership, and external customers.
  • Ability to interpret and develop data reporting and monitoring requirements.
  • Experience using critical thinking skills working with results, metrics and data management and desire to create and build new processes.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively on project teams, as well as independently.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills working with all levels of employees, including Leadership.
  • High level of proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong working knowledge of database environments.
  • Strong understanding of analytical SQL scripting.
  • Understanding of Power BI with applicable experience.
  • Strong ability to organize, analyze and solve complex problems with attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred

  • Experience in health, financial, or operational data analysis.
  • Experience in Insurance or dental.

Delta Dental of Iowa is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, national origin, religion, age, disability and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. It is also the policy of Delta Dental of Iowa to take affirmative action to employ and to advance in employment, all persons regardless of their status as individuals with disabilities or protected veterans, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements.

We are seeking a talented Business Intelligence Analyst to join our dynamic team. This role will focus on designing and delivering high-quality dashboards and data solutions that provide actionable insights across the organization. While today’s reporting leverages on-premises data sources, we will be transitioning to Microsoft Fabric in 2026, moving our data warehouse into the Fabric Data Lake. The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a key role in ensuring a smooth transition by building reporting solutions that align with both current practices and future architecture. Embrace the opportunity to innovate, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact.

This position is 100% on-site Monday through Friday from 800am to 500pm in Stevens Point, WI.

This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the U.S.A. without the need for visa sponsorship.

Application Deadline (Estimated) Applications will be accepted through December 9th, 2026, however, this timeline may be adjusted based on business needs and candidate volume.

What to Expect

  • Develop, manage, and maintain data solutions and interactive dashboards using Power BI.
  • Collaborate with business units to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights that address key challenges.
  • Build and adapt data models to support evolving reporting needs, optimizing for both performance and usability.
  • Partner with BI developers and analysts to design efficient data flows and ensure high-quality report outputs.
  • Write clear specifications and documentation for new and updated reports, ensuring accuracy through thorough testing.
  • Support the transition of reporting from on-premises sources to Microsoft Fabric, leveraging the Fabric Data Lake as the primary data source.
  • Seek opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process improvements.
  • Stay current with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related BI technologies to bring forward best practices and innovative solutions.


What You Will Contribute

  • Bachelor’s degree or 3 - 4 years of data analyst experience in a related field.
  • Strong understanding of Power BI and dashboarding tools.
  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Excel, SQL, Data warehouse.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of creating/improving business processes.
  • Ability to understand and perform business and functional requirement analysis.
  • Strong mathematical skills for writing Excel formulas and applying statistical concepts.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
  • Experience with SQL, DataMarts, PowerQuery, and PowerAutomate.
  • Strong analytical and logical skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Certifications related to Microsoft Fabric are preferred.
  • Character qualities thoroughness, dependability, orderliness, persistence and responsibility


What You Will Receive

  • The salary range for this position is $70,000 - $80,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life, 401(k) with matching, HSA with company contribution.
  • Earn up to 15 paid days off annually.
  • Paid Holidays on business workdays.
  • Company-paid on-site wellness meals.
  • Gym membership reimbursement.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Voluntary benefits short-term disability, whole/term life, hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident expense.
  • Opportunities for growth and development such as company university and tuition reimbursement options.
  • On-staff health coach, one-on-one or group coaching.
  • Health and wellness initiatives walking challenge, weight loss challenge, health risk assessment and more!


Why Work at Ortho Molecular Products

Simply put, our healthcare system is broken. It is expensive, complicated, and dysfunctional. At Ortho Molecular Products, our vision is to transform the practice of medicine. Every day, across America and the world, we help health care providers implement better solutions for health challenges that include lifestyle medicine and nutritional therapies proven to improve patient outcomes. We do this by manufacturing science-based products and developing innovative clinical programs for doctors that help their patients get better faster.

We are looking for people who align with our mission and want to invest their lifework and passion into transforming the practice of medicine. Our team is purpose-driven, values-based, and service-focused. We are looking for like-minded people who want to join the movement that is changing the way healthcare is being delivered.

Description

The Analyst II provides mid-level analytical, data management, and operational support to the organization. This role performs more complex analysis, supports program evaluations, develops reports and dashboards, and contributes to data-driven decision-making across operational units.

  • Collect, review, and validate data from multiple systems and sources.
  • Assist in preparing routine and ad-hoc reports, dashboards, and data summaries.
  • Conduct basic trend analysis, data comparisons, and correlation reviews.
  • Support the development and maintenance of reporting tools and templates.
  • Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with government standards.
  • Maintain and update databases, spreadsheets, and tracking systems.
  • Support data entry, data cleanup, and data normalization efforts.
  • Assist with managing user roles, permissions, and access controls as directed.
  • Document processes, workflows, and data procedures for internal use.
  • Assist staff with research, information gathering, and administrative analysis.
  • Support program evaluations, performance tracking, and operational reviews.
  • Help identify inconsistencies or issues in data and escalate findings appropriately.
  • Participate in meetings, briefings, and working groups as required.
  • Troubleshoot basic reporting or data issues and coordinate with senior analysts for resolution.
  • Assist in evaluating system updates or changes that may impact reporting or data integrity.
  • Provide end-user support for reports, dashboards, and data tools.

The salary for this position is between $80,000 - $85,000 a year.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 3-5 years of relevant analytical experience
  • Ability to successfully complete corporate background investigation to include credit and criminal check
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Government suitability determination/clearance

Additional Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams) and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ability to learn and effectively use government systems, databases, and digital record platforms.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to read, write, understand, in English.
  • Ability to follow detailed written and oral instructions and complete tasks to standard.
  • Capable of performing repetitive tasks independently while maintaining consistency and quality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and collaborate well with others.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Skilled in organizing work, establishing priorities, and maintaining accuracy under strict timelines.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, you may occasionally be required to stand; walk; sit; lift up to 20 lbs.; bend; reach; carry; stoop; kneel; use hands and fingers to handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; use fingers and hands to type or write; speak; or hear. Specific vision abilities may be required to perform this job, which may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, or the ability to adjust focus.

Work Location: In person (onsite)

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join a growing team responsible for transforming business data into actionable insights.   • 1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.

descriptionHtml:
Michael Best is seeking a Financial Data Analyst to work in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee or Waukesha offices! The Financial Data Analyst supports the Firm’s financial reporting, budgeting, and analytical functions while helping develop and maintain the technical reporting solutions used by Finance & Accounting. Reporting to the Financial Reporting & Analysis Supervisor, this role prepares recurring and ad hoc financial reports, assists with the annual budget, analyzes financial and operational data, writes SQL queries, supports Power BI and other reporting tools, validates data, and helps improve reporting processes. The position combines foundational accounting and financial analysis with hands-on data and reporting work and is suited for an early-career professional with practical experience who wants to grow both financial and technical expertise.


Core responsibilities:

  • Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages used to evaluate Firm, practice group, client, department, and individual performance.
  • Produce recurring and customized financial and operational reports for internal stakeholders and external requests.
  • Support development of the annual budget by gathering assumptions, building and maintaining budget schedules and models, consolidating submissions, and analyzing proposed results.
  • Assist with forecasts, budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, and follow-up with budget owners.
  • Analyze general ledger, revenue, expense, productivity, and other financial data; investigate variances and reconcile reporting results to source systems.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to extract, combine, validate, troubleshoot, and analyze financial data. SQL knowledge is required for this role.
  • Gather and summarize information for surveys, RFP responses, client reporting requests, peer benchmarking, and ad hoc business questions.


Stakeholder partnership:

  • Collaborate with Accounting, Billing, Financial Applications, Legal Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver accurate reporting solutions.
  • Work with department leaders and budget owners to collect budget information, explain report results, and resolve data or reporting questions.
  • Maintain a responsive, service-oriented approach and communicate financial and technical information clearly to non-technical users.


Programs/initiatives:

  • Participate in testing, data validation, documentation, and implementation of reporting enhancements, system changes, and integrations.


Process, tools, and reporting:

  • Use SQL, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and financial systems to develop, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, budget models, and analytical tools.
  • Create and maintain SQL queries, data extracts, reporting datasets, and recurring processes with appropriate validation and documentation.
  • Support data imports, exports, interfaces, reconciliations, reporting structures, account and expense coding, and other data-quality processes.
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues, identify root causes, test corrections, and help users understand results.


Continuous improvement / strategy:

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, budgeting, reconciliation, and data-preparation activities.
  • Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, financial models, and reporting processes that increase accuracy, efficiency, and usability.
  • Build knowledge of the Firm’s financial systems, data structures, accounting processes, and business intelligence tools.


Job Requirements:


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a comparable business or applied sciences discipline required.


Experience:

  • One to three years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, reporting, data analysis, or financial systems work preferred. Relevant internships combined with post-graduate professional experience may be considered.
  • Working knowledge of accounting concepts, financial statements, general ledger data, reconciliations, and budget development.
  • Required experience writing and executing SQL queries against relational databases. Candidates must be able to use SQL to retrieve, join, filter, validate, and analyze data.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, charts, and analysis of large data sets.
  • Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or a similar reporting or business intelligence platform preferred.
  • Experience with Aderant Expert or another financial, accounting, billing, or ERP system preferred.
  • Law firm or professional services experience preferred but not required.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect financial results to underlying data.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accurate, well-documented work.
  • Ability to manage recurring deadlines while responding to ad hoc requests and changing priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data and financial information to varied audiences.
  • Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in accounting, budgeting, SQL, reporting tools, and financial systems.
  • Collaborative, service-oriented approach and sound judgment about when to resolve an issue independently or escalate it.
  • Required: Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively to improve quality, efficiency, and decision-making, consistent with organizational policies, confidentiality, and applicable laws.


The Company

This is an opportunity to work with the Best. We are Michael Best & Friedrich, LLP. We are a full-service law firm with more than 350 lawyers and technical professionals who work in collaborative, interdisciplinary practices to serve clients around the world.


We work with companies in all kinds of industries, as well as trade associations, nonprofits, educational institutions, governments, family trusts, and high-net-worth individuals. Since our firm’s founding in 1848, we’ve continuously evolved to meet our clients’ changing needs and expectations. One thing remains the same: For generations, clients have relied on Michael Best for exceptional legal service and business acumen.


The Location

We have offices in Wisconsin (Green Bay, Madison, Milwaukee, Waukesha); Illinois (Chicago); Utah (Salt Lake City); Colorado (Denver, Broomfield); Texas (Austin); North Carolina (Charlotte, Durham, Raleigh, Wilmington); California (Los Angeles); Nebraska (Lincoln); New York (New York City); and Washington DC. Our contemporary office spaces are ideal for concentration and collaboration; supporting our culture of working together to make great things happen for our Clients. This position can be based in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee, or Waukesha offices.

Michael Best is seeking a Financial Data Analyst to work in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee or Waukesha offices! The Financial Data Analyst supports the Firm’s financial reporting, budgeting, and analytical functions while helping develop and maintain the technical reporting solutions used by Finance & Accounting. Reporting to the Financial Reporting & Analysis Supervisor, this role prepares recurring and ad hoc financial reports, assists with the annual budget, analyzes financial and operational data, writes SQL queries, supports Power BI and other reporting tools, validates data, and helps improve reporting processes. The position combines foundational accounting and financial analysis with hands-on data and reporting work and is suited for an early-career professional with practical experience who wants to grow both financial and technical expertise.


Core responsibilities:

- Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages used to evaluate Firm, practice group, client, department, and individual performance.
- Produce recurring and customized financial and operational reports for internal stakeholders and external requests.
- Support development of the annual budget by gathering assumptions, building and maintaining budget schedules and models, consolidating submissions, and analyzing proposed results.
- Assist with forecasts, budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, and follow-up with budget owners.
- Analyze general ledger, revenue, expense, productivity, and other financial data; investigate variances and reconcile reporting results to source systems.
- Write and execute SQL queries to extract, combine, validate, troubleshoot, and analyze financial data. SQL knowledge is required for this role.
- Gather and summarize information for surveys, RFP responses, client reporting requests, peer benchmarking, and ad hoc business questions.


Stakeholder partnership:

- Collaborate with Accounting, Billing, Financial Applications, Legal Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver accurate reporting solutions.
- Work with department leaders and budget owners to collect budget information, explain report results, and resolve data or reporting questions.
- Maintain a responsive, service-oriented approach and communicate financial and technical information clearly to non-technical users.


Programs/initiatives:

- Participate in testing, data validation, documentation, and implementation of reporting enhancements, system changes, and integrations.


Process, tools, and reporting:

- Use SQL, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and financial systems to develop, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, budget models, and analytical tools.
- Create and maintain SQL queries, data extracts, reporting datasets, and recurring processes with appropriate validation and documentation.
- Support data imports, exports, interfaces, reconciliations, reporting structures, account and expense coding, and other data-quality processes.
- Troubleshoot reporting issues, identify root causes, test corrections, and help users understand results.


Continuous improvement / strategy:

- Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, budgeting, reconciliation, and data-preparation activities.
- Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, financial models, and reporting processes that increase accuracy, efficiency, and usability.
- Build knowledge of the Firm’s financial systems, data structures, accounting processes, and business intelligence tools.


Job Requirements:


Education: 

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a comparable business or applied sciences discipline required.


Experience:

- One to three years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, reporting, data analysis, or financial systems work preferred. Relevant internships combined with post-graduate professional experience may be considered.
- Working knowledge of accounting concepts, financial statements, general ledger data, reconciliations, and budget development.
- Required experience writing and executing SQL queries against relational databases. Candidates must be able to use SQL to retrieve, join, filter, validate, and analyze data.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, charts, and analysis of large data sets.
- Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or a similar reporting or business intelligence platform preferred.
- Experience with Aderant Expert or another financial, accounting, billing, or ERP system preferred.
- Law firm or professional services experience preferred but not required.


Skills & Competencies:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect financial results to underlying data.
- High attention to detail and commitment to accurate, well-documented work.
- Ability to manage recurring deadlines while responding to ad hoc requests and changing priorities.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data and financial information to varied audiences.
- Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in accounting, budgeting, SQL, reporting tools, and financial systems.
- Collaborative, service-oriented approach and sound judgment about when to resolve an issue independently or escalate it.
- Required: Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively to improve quality, efficiency, and decision-making, consistent with organizational policies, confidentiality, and applicable laws.

Job Description


The Strategic Data Analyst will serve as a critical link between operational data and Program Management decision-making. This role is responsible for collaborating with internal key stakeholders and the Services team to design, develop, and implement the metrics, tools, and reporting systems necessary to monitor program performance. The ideal candidate will not only manage data but will translate complex datasets into strategic insights that drive KPI achievement, process optimization, and organizational growth.



Key Responsibilities

2. Strategic Growth & Process Improvement
3. Workforce & Skills Enhancement

  • Performance Monitoring & KPI Development
  • Collaborate with the Programs Team(s) and internal stakeholders to define and establish Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that align with organizational goals.
  • Lead the full-lifecycle development of executive and operational dashboards, transforming raw data into intuitive, visual interfaces that provide real-time visibility into program health.
  • Design and implement automated data pipelines to ensure dashboards are updated accurately and timely without manual intervention.
  • Analyze trends within these dashboards to provide early warnings of performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses of operational data to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for strategic growth.
  • Partner with Customer Service Managers (CSM) and Customer Compliance Review (CCR) teams to map current workflows and propose data-driven process improvements.
  • Partner with CSM and CCR teams to identify value-added service opportunities and operational enhancements that improve customer experience and streamline delivery.
  • Develop metrics to track team member skill levels and certifications.
  • Identify "skills gaps" within the organization and provide data-backed recommendations for training and professional development initiatives.
  • Create performance scorecards to help leadership objectively evaluate and enhance team capabilities.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Services organization and IT/Data teams to ensure data integrity and tool functionality.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Advanced formulas, Power Query, VBA).
    • Strong experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
    • Experience with SQL or other database query languages is highly preferred.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing, aerospace, or MRO environment.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Proven ability to collaborate across different functional levels (from shop floor to executive).
    • Strong storytelling ability—the capacity to turn raw data into a compelling narrative for stakeholders.
    • Analytical mindset with a relentless focus on continuous improvement.


Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills


  • Experience with Lean Six Sigma or other process improvement methodologies.
  • Experience managing joint venture reporting or multi-organizational data sets.


Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $79370 - $134929

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Job Description

The Mainframe Software Division (MSD) at Broadcom is seeking a detail-oriented Operations Analyst to join our operations team and support our mission of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

You will work closely with Business Operations personnel and department managers to collect, analyze, and interpret operational data. You will create reports, dashboards, and presentations that communicate insights to stakeholders at various levels of the organization. This position offers excellent opportunities for professional development and exposure to diverse business operations.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and effective communication skills.

General Responsibilities:


  • Collect, analyze, and interpret operational data from multiple sources and systems
  • Report on progress toward attainment of headcount targets. Work with finance, as well as the individual disciplines in the MSD organization, to forecast headcount by organization and location. Drive the integrity of our headcount management systems.
  • Regular review of customers submitting telemetry reports and reminders when they are not submitted to ensure we have access to where our IP is being used. Escalate to management, as required, for those customers who are non-responsive.
  • Work specifically with our product licensing and customer compliance teams to ensure all updates are happening on a timely basis to ensure data integrity.
  • Track and report on operational execution against goals for our licensing and compliance teams through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Monitor historic performance and identify bottlenecks. Identify of impact and business risk.
  • Contribute to the definition of enhancements to current dashboards and support the development of new metrics and dashboards for business operations.
  • With all metrics, perform data clean-up and quality checks to ensure metrics remain accurate and reliable.
  • Assist in Root cause analysis for operational issues and performance gaps


Sills Required


  • Advanced Excel and / or Google Sheet skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects at once
  • Strong emotional intelligence skills


Job-Specific Authority and Scope


  • Work is independent and collaborative in nature
  • Provides regular updates to manager on project status


Business Travel and Physical Demands


  • Business travel of approximately 10 or less percent yearly is expected for this position.


Physical demands:


  • Office environment.
  • No special physical demands are required.


Preferred Education:


  • Bachelors and 5+ years of related experience; at this level postgraduate coursework may be desirable or Masters degree and 3+ years of related experience


Compensation And Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is USD 90,000.00 To USD 144,000.00

POSITION DETAILS

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens , LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017) and the Brookings Institution (2020). Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.

Under the direction of the Assistant Vice President of Finance and Business, the Finance Data Analyst will support strategic, data-informed financial and operational decision-making across the Finance and Business Office, including Budget, Accounting, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, Bursar, and ACE Finance.

The Finance Data Analyst will serve as an analytical resource to the Assistant Vice President, Directors, and Finance and Business Office staff by collecting, analyzing, and translating financial and operational data into actionable information. The position will assist in developing dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), benchmarks, forecasts, and analytical tools that help leadership identify trends, evaluate performance, improve processes, and make informed decisions.

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Finance and Business, the Finance Data Analyst is responsible for:

  • Coordinate and maintain financial and operational dashboards in collaboration with Finance and Business Office leadership, incorporating relevant KPIs, benchmarks, trends, and performance measures;
  • Work with Directors and managers to identify meaningful performance measures and establish benchmarks that support the evaluation of operations, service delivery, workload, and efficiency;
  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, patterns, variances, and areas requiring further review, and provide information to leadership to support decision-making and appropriate action; analyze tuition and fee collections, outstanding receivables, payment activity, and related student financial data to identify trends and support strategies to strengthen collections;
  • Collaborate with Enrollment Management and other college offices to gather and analyze enrollment and student data that may affect tuition revenue, collections, and financial forecasting;
  • Support budget, revenue, expenditure, and collections forecasting through historical analysis, trend analysis, and development of financial models;
  • Analyze operational processes and turnaround times in collaboration with area leadership, including measures such as requisition-to-purchase-order processing, invoice-to-payment timelines, transaction volumes, workloads, and other indicators of operational performance; conduct comparative and trend analyses to help leadership assess performance over time and, where appropriate, against internal or external benchmarks;
  • Assist Directors and managers with ad hoc financial and operational analyses to evaluate issues, identify potential causes, and support management decisions; identify opportunities to automate recurring reports, data collection, reconciliations, and other manual processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness;
  • Review and reconcile data from multiple systems and sources, identify inconsistencies or gaps, and collaborate with appropriate staff to improve data quality, consistency, and reliability;
  • Provide training, guidance, and hands-on support to Finance and Business Office staff in the effective use of Excel, Access, and other data analysis, reporting, and visualization tools to improve operational efficiency and data literacy;

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data analysis, financial analysis, institutional research, business analytics, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, data modeling, and the development of reports and analytical tools.
  • Experience with data visualization and dashboard development using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, Power Query, Access, or other database and data analysis tools.
  • Experience working with large datasets, including combining, cleaning, validating, and analyzing data from multiple sources.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify trends and develop key performance indicators (KPIs), benchmarks, operational metrics, and other measures of organizational performance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear and actionable information for management.
  • Experience identifying opportunities to automate, standardize, or streamline recurring reports and manual business processes.
  • Ability to prepare and effectively communicate reports, presentations, charts, and data visualizations to management and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and provide training, technical assistance, or hands-on guidance to staff in the use of Excel and other data analysis and reporting tools.
  • Experience working in higher education, government, or another complex organization; knowledge of CUNY systems, operations, and data sources is a plus.

Cuny Title Overview

Administers program and unit budgets and related functions.

  • Processes and maintains data in budget systems
  • Prepares budgets, projections and financial reports
  • Collects and reports fiscal information as required, and assists in analyzing financial information
  • Coordinates with various departments on budget and accounting matters
  • Monitors systems and operational issues to improve overall workflows
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Job Title Name: Finance Budget Coordinator

CUNY TITLE

Assistant to HEO

FLSA

Non-exempt

Compensation And Benefits

$74,764 - $87,784

Salary commensurate with education and experience.

CUNY's benefits contribute significantly to total compensation, supporting health and wellness, financial well-being, and professional development. We offer a range of health plans, competitive retirement/pension benefits and savings plans, tuition waivers for CUNY graduate study and generous paid time off. Our staff also benefits from the extensive academic, arts, and athletic programs on our campuses and the opportunity to participate in a lively, diverse academic community in one of the greatest cities in the world.

descriptionHtml:
This position is onsite at the Corporate Headquarters located in Kenosha, WI.

The Business Intelligence Analyst I designs, builds, and supports reporting and analytics solutions of moderate complexity. This role works with business partners to clarify needs, develops Power BI reports and data models, and helps ensure that data used for decision-making is accurate, timely, and well-documented. The position works with some independence but still receives guidance from more senior analysts on design, standards, and priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements into clear report specifications, including metrics, filters, and visual layouts.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, paginated reports, and reusable datasets following BI team standards.
  • Create and optimize basic to moderately complex data models and DAX measures to support reporting needs.
  • Write and maintain SQL queries or use existing curated data models to retrieve and transform data for reporting.
  • Perform thorough testing and validation of all new and updated reports, including data reconciliation to source systems.
  • Monitor report refreshes and usage; assist in troubleshooting performance or data quality issues.
  • Maintain documentation for owned reports, datasets, and data transformations, including data definitions and lineage.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, application, and business teams to resolve data issues and improve data readiness.
  • Contribute to the BI team’s standards, templates, and best practices; participate in peer reviews.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Management Information Systems, or a closely related field.
  • A bachelor’s degree in a specifically related field is preferred; equivalent work experience is acceptable in place of this requirement.
  • 1–4 years of professional experience in business intelligence, reporting, data analysis, or application development.
  • Hands-on experience building reports or dashboards in Power BI or a similar enterprise BI platform.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying and validating data.
  • Understanding of basic data modeling concepts (tables, joins, keys, measures, dimensions).
  • Ability to organize work, manage multiple requests, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power BI semantic models, row-level security, and performance optimization.
  • Exposure to enterprise data warehouse or cloud data platforms.
  • Experience working within a structured SDLC, using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar.
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts and the use of shared or certified datasets.

Core Competencies

  • Technical Proficiency – Builds reliable BI solutions using standard tools, patterns, and practices.
  • Ownership – Takes responsibility for the quality and timeliness of assigned work and follows through on commitments.
  • Customer Focus – Engages with stakeholders to understand needs, clarify requirements, and provide helpful support.
  • Communication – Explains data and reporting concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Continuous Improvement – Looks for opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve existing reports and processes

descriptionHtml:
Your Responsibilities

Lockton is seeking an Employee Benefits Financial Analyst to support the Analytics & Insights team by providing accurate financial data analysis and reporting for client programs. You will prepare and maintain routine financial reports, assist in developing pricing and trend models, and contribute to cost management strategies that help optimize employee health benefits. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality results.

Position Responsibilities

 Prepare routine financial and statistical reports for internal use, ensuring accuracy and clarity.

 Maintain and update data templates, spreadsheets, and databases to support team reporting needs.

 Assist in the development and application of standard financial models and formulas under supervision.

 Analyze internal data to identify trends and support decision-making for client initiatives.

 Support the benchmarking process by gathering and organizing relevant data.

 Collaborate with team members to ensure timely completion of deliverables.

 Stay informed on relevant industry developments and internal policies.

 Protect the confidentiality of company and employee information at all times.

 Participate in team meetings and training sessions as required.

Qualifications

Position Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field or equivalent education and/or experience, with emphasis in math, statistics, or finance required.

 1–3 years of relevant experience in data analysis, financial reporting, or a related field

 Basic understanding of financial and statistical concepts; willingness to learn more advanced modeling.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with PowerBI/SQL/Python is a plus.

 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 Effective written and verbal communication skills for internal collaboration.

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

 Willingness and ability to expand knowledge through extended insurance education and other appropriate training.

 Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods and outside normal business hours as needed.

 Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft.

 Ability to comply with all company policies and procedures, proactively protecting the confidentiality of client and company information.

 Legally authorized to work in the United States.

 Ability to attend company, department, and staff meetings as required and perform other work-related duties as assigned.

descriptionHtml:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:

  • State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
  • State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
  • State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
  • State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
  • State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
  • State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
  • State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
  • State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
  • Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
  • State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
  • State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
  • State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
  • State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
  • Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000

The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.
