descriptionHtml:
CHAMP Titles modernizes the technology Motor Vehicle Agencies rely on. Our cloud-native platforms replace legacy processes for titling, registration, and licensing, and the data behind them supports decisions for agencies and the people they serve.


Location: Cleveland, OH (Hybrid, 4 days onsite)

Department: Data Product and Analytics

Reports To: Manager, Data Product and Analytics

Travel: Less than 5%

Visa Sponsorship: Not available

Relocation: Not available

Your Impact


CHAMP Titles is hiring a Data Analyst to join the Data Product and Analytics team. You'll write the reports and build the dashboards that internal teams and Motor Vehicle Agency clients rely on, working from our Operational Data Store, Data Warehouse, and Data Marts. The right candidate writes strong SQL, uses Python to automate reporting, and understands how warehouse data is modeled well enough to query it correctly and spot when something's off.


What You'll Do


  • Define report requirements with the Product team, internal teams, and Motor Vehicle Agency clients. Explain results to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop SQL to build reports from agreed specs. Keep queries accurate, performant, and consistent with team standards.
  • Data Validation: Make sure each report answers the question the requestor actually asked and that the results make sense. Check output against source data and raise data quality issues with the Data Engineering group.
  • Use Python to automate recurring reports and produce clear charts and summaries.
  • Document report logic, metric definitions, and data sources so reports are repeatable and easy to support.
  • Build and maintain dashboards in our business intelligence tool.
  • Take part in sprint planning and help improve how report requests are taken in and delivered.


We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. If you meet most of the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every single one.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years writing SQL for reporting or analytics.
  • Strong SQL, including joins, aggregations, window functions, and query tuning against relational databases.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants, with the judgment to verify their output.
  • Experience using Python for data manipulation and visualization (e.g., Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Experience building dashboards in a business intelligence tool.
  • Working knowledge of data warehouse concepts such as fact and dimension tables.
  • Ability to find trends, patterns, and anomalies in complex data sets.
  • Clear verbal and written communication, including explaining technical results to non-technical audiences.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with government, motor vehicle, or other regulated-industry data
  • Experience with AWS data services
  • Familiarity with Git


Perks + Benefits

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus Potential
  • Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Unlimited PTO Policy
  • Matching 401K with immediate vesting
  • Subsidized Lunches at our Cleveland Headquarters
  • Fast Paced work environment in a growth company
  • Newly Renovated Office Space


Salary Range

The expected salary range for this position is $65,000 - $90,000 annually. This is a good faith estimate, and final compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and geographic location.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We're here to help.


By joining CHAMP, you will be an integral member of our team with many opportunities for personal growth and upward mobility in a growing organization. We have a great culture that is flexible, collaborative and welcoming.

At the State of Minnesota, employees play a critical role in developing policies, providing essential services, and working to improve the well-being and quality of life for all Minnesotans. The State of Minnesota is committed to equity and inclusion, and invests in employees by providing benefits, support resources, and training and development opportunities.

Join PERA and turn data into insights that support critical decisions and strengthen retirement services for Minnesota's public employees!

As a Data Analyst at PERA, you will collect, validate, analyze, and report on data used across the organization to support business operations, strategic planning, and decision-making. This role works closely with staff, management, and business partners to develop reports and dashboards, research complex data issues, ensure data quality and integrity, and provide meaningful analysis and recommendations.

You'll play a key role in maintaining accurate information, identifying trends and opportunities, supporting actuarial reporting, and helping PERA leverage data to better serve more than 435,000 members and 2,100 participating public employers.

This position is telework eligible and offers a hybrid work schedule, based on agency and department needs. Scheduled in-office workdays will be at the PERA office, 60 Empire Drive, Suite 200, St. Paul, Minnesota.

  • Candidates residing in Minnesota within 50 miles of our St Paul office may be eligible to telework up to 50%.
  • Candidates residing in Minnesota and more than 50 miles from our office may be eligible to telework more than 50%.
  • Candidates residing in a bordering state within 50 miles of our office may be eligible to telework up to 50%.
  • Candidates who do not reside in Minnesota or within 50 miles of the office in a state bordering Minnesota are not eligible to be hired, unless planning to relocate within 50 miles of the office or report to the office full time.

Minimum Qualifications

To facilitate proper crediting, please ensure your resume clearly describes your experience in the areas listed below and indicates the beginning and ending day, month, and year for each job held. Only applicants whose resumes clearly demonstrate fulfillment of each of the minimum qualifications will be considered for this position.

Two (2) years experience writing SQL queries and developing reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI, including:

  • Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting reports, data extracts, dashboards, or other business intelligence tools.
  • Experience collecting, validating, analyzing, and interpreting data to identify trends, resolve data discrepancies, and support business operations and decision-making.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel and other reporting or data analysis tools to organize, reconcile, maintain, and present data for business users and management.

Minimum qualifications that will be assessed during the interview process:

  • Experience collaborating with business users, technical staff, and external stakeholders to develop reporting solutions, improve data quality, and support business objectives.
  • Experience using analytical and problem-solving skills sufficient to research data issues, evaluate impacts, identify root causes, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with individuals with a wide range of backgrounds, who do not share your same culture, ethnicity, language, or other common experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Two (2) or more years of experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or data management.
  • Experience using SQL, Power BI, Python, or similar tools to analyze data, develop reports and dashboards, validate data quality, and support business decision-making.
  • Experience working with large relational databases, data warehouses, and data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of pension administration, governmental operations, or experience supporting financial, actuarial, audit, or regulatory reporting.

It is the policy of the Retirement Systems of MN that all employees submit to a background investigation prior to employment. The background check may consist of the following components:

  • Criminal History Check

  • Driver's License Check

Select “Apply for Job” at the top of this page. If you have questions about applying for jobs, contact the Careers Help Desk at 651-259-3637 or email careers@state.mn.us. For additional information about the application process, go to http://www.mn.gov/careers.

  • You have questions about this position
  • You are an individual with a disability and need to request an accommodation for a scheduled interview
  • You wish to receive consideration as a Connect 700 Program applicant, apply online, e-mail the Job ID#, the Working Title and your valid Proof of Eligibility Certificate by the closing date to PERAHR@mnpera.org.

JOB Summary

This position will be responsible for the development of Business Intelligence dashboards and analysis using Snowflake & Power BI . He/she will work closely with the Director of business Intelligence and functional leadership to deliver on the design, development, programming, meta data, maintenance, and publication of reports that play a key role in driving business decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Create data visualizations and transform data into innovative dashboard designs
  • Maintain large sets of data that require validation, cleansing, and troubleshooting
  • Create and maintain online automated reports using Power BI; update and maintain Excel, SQL sources as well as semantic models & metadata to ensure data quality
  • Debug technical issues when they arise
  • Respond to ad hoc requests for analysis and reports from internal stakeholders including Sales, Operations, Marketing, Underwriting, Legal, Actuarial, Training, and IT
  • Develop skills and leverage Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI & Snowflake to drive functional efficiencies and deliver high-quality information solutions
  • Analyze and integrate data from multiple sources
  • Leverage a foundational understanding of AI tools to support personal productivity

Skills And Experience

  • Three to five years experience. Knowledge of insurance/claim industry plus
  • Excellent technical skills including advanced knowledge of Excel
  • Excellent knowledge of SQL programming language
  • Business Intelligence and/or dashboard experience; DAX programming knowledge and Power BI a plus!
  • Creative design experience a plus!
  • Experience working with large databases in Snowflake or Azure a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and multi-tasking skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to self-start and work independently to complete assignments in a timely manner
  • Novice to intermediate ability to leverage AI tools (Claude code) to tune reports/code

Education

  • BA required, preferably in IT, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Finance

Location: Chicago, IL (near Rosemont, IL Triangle Plaza).

The pay range for the role is $61,000 to $89,000. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. EMPLOYMENT DATE: Until Filled

AC Way Requirement: Every member of the Angelina College community is required to exhibit the “AC Way” as fundamental standards of performance, ensuring daily actions align with the values of the College.

  • Demonstrates a student-centered mindset in all aspects of work, placing students at the core of decisions and actions.
  • Acts with honesty, integrity, and professionalism while holding oneself to high standards.
  • Treats all students, colleagues, and community members with dignity, empathy, fairness, and kindness.
  • Collaborates effectively with colleagues across departments to support student and institutional success.

  • Champions the mission, vision, and values of Angelina College by exemplifying the “AC Way” in daily work.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in computer, technical, or other analytical fields such as Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Business, etc.
  • Experience:
  • 2 years of relational database experience.
  • 2 years of experience with SQL.
  • Working with large and complex data sets.
  • Training or Technical Skills:
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills needed to complete complex tasks.
  • Understanding of and experience using relational databases (e.g., Oracle, MS SQL Server).
  • Advanced knowledge of and experience with Microsoft Excel, including functions, formulas, and pivot tables.
  • Professional communication skills to work with other offices across campus.
  • Organization and time management skills needed to complete multiple tasks simultaneously,
  • Willingness to develop new knowledge, skills, and abilities in a changing environment.
  • Computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (including Word, Excel, Publisher, and PowerPoint).

Preferred

  • Experience:
  • With higher education student information systems (e.g., Jenzabar, Colleague, Banner, etc.),
  • With data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Basic statistical analytics.
  • Training or Technical Skills: Proficient with Google Workspace tools like Docs, Sheets, and Drive to create, share, and manage work.

Expectations

  • Interact with a diverse student population
  • Promote a positive work environment among colleagues

Special Demands

The position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, bending, reaching, lifting, and carrying, depending on the specific duties of the position. The employee must be able to communicate effectively, maintain attention to detail, and perform the essential functions of the position. Specific physical and environmental requirements will vary by position.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws.

It is the intent of the basic job requirements, duties, and responsibilities that these minimum requirements should therefore, be referred to as a guide for, rather than a limitation to the services required.

Job Description

The position will report to the Executive Director of Institutional Effectiveness for job responsibilities and other College related activities as outlined in the Policies and Procedures Manual. Essential duties include but are not limited to the following:

  • Responds to ad-hoc query requests for information from internal and external entities.
  • Uses SQL tools to manipulate, analyze, clean, and transform data.
  • Develops and maintains portal and database reports.
  • Works directly with College personnel to support data gathering, analysis, visualizations, and summary feedback in a manner that is efficient, timely, and professional.
  • Creates visualizations of data for presentations.
  • Manages multiple projects, sets priorities, meets deadlines, and works independently.
  • Evaluates procedures to ensure validity, applicability, efficiency, and accuracy.
  • Disseminates information clearly and concisely in verbal and written form.
  • Presents ideas to individuals or groups to ensure that they understand the information.
  • Demonstrates commitment to continuous learning by completing all required training, compliance courses, and professional development activities promptly and within established deadlines.

Visa Information

In compliance with current state executive directives and the Texas Workforce Commission guidelines regarding foreign worker visa programs, Angelina College has implemented a freeze on the processing of new H-1B visa petitions. At this time, we are only accepting applications from candidates who are currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for new visa sponsorship.

Contract & Salary

$55,000.00 per year in addition to excellent employee benefits. Proof of identify and eligibility to work in the United States must be verified for the successful candidate.

Schedule

A completed application form, a cover letter, a resume, and college transcripts are required for an applicant to be considered. Please visit the Angelina College portal at https://myac.angelina.edu/ICS/AC_Employment/ to apply. Screening of qualified applicants will begin and continue until the position is filled. This is a security sensitive position and an appropriate background investigation will be made on applicants being strongly considered for the position.

Angelina College is a comprehensive community college of 5,200 students located in Lufkin, Angelina County, Texas, and serving twelve counties of East Texas. Lufkin is a city of 38,000 people, situated about 120 miles northeast of Houston, 112 miles southwest of Shreveport, Louisiana, and 165 miles southeast of Dallas.

Angelina College reserves the right to extend search or not offer position advertised.

Angelina College provides education and employment opportunities without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. Angelina College complies with the Americans with Disabilities and Veterans Act.

Senior Reporting Analyst

Legatis a subsidiary of Obra Capital Inc. runs on data: claims metrics, financial results, and portfolio analytics that drive board, investor, and sponsor decisions. We are hiring an Associate, Reporting Analytics to own the production of that reporting turning prepared data into clean, reliable, repeatable exhibits and dashboards.

You will work directly with our Chief Actuary, Controller, and Claims leadership, who own what the numbers mean. The underlying data pipelines and semantic models are maintained by our data-engineering resource. Your job is the reporting and validation layer in between: making sure every exhibit is accurate, on time, and formatted to a professional standard. This is a core production role, not an add-on — it should represent a substantial portion of your day.

Responsibilities

  • Own monthly and quarterly reporting packages — claims, financial, and board exhibits — end to end
  • Build, maintain, and refresh Power BI dashboards
  • Validate and reconcile data: confirm every exhibit ties to source and flag discrepancies clearly
  • Format board and sponsor decks to a professional standard
  • Automate recurring reports using Power Query, Power BI, and Excel

Requirements

  • 4–7 years in a reporting, analyst, or FP&A role
  • Expert Excel: Power Query, complex formulas, structured model-building
  • Functional Power BI
  • BS. in Finance, Accounting, Actuarial Science, Math, or Statistics
  • Insurance or financial-services domain knowledge
  • Experience with insurance billing, claim data reconciliation, or claims coordination

Compensation

Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Details will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

descriptionHtml:
The Medpace Analytics and Business Intelligence team is growing rapidly and is focused on building a data driven culture across the enterprise. The BI team uses data and insights to drive increased strategic and operational efficiencies across the organization. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will hold a highly visible analytical role that requires interaction and partnership with leadership across the Medpace organization.

What’s in this for you?

  • Work in a collaborative, fast paced, entrepreneurial, and innovative workplace;
  • Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from visualization to data warehousing;
  • Grow business knowledge by working with leadership across all aspects of Medpace’s business.

Responsibilities

What’s involved?

We are looking for a Junior Business Intelligence Analyst to add additional depth to our growing Analytical team in a variety of areas – from Visualization and Storytelling to SQL, Data Modeling, and Data Warehousing. This role will work in close partnership with leadership, product management, operations, finance, and other technical teams to find opportunities to improve and expand our business.

An ideal candidate in this role will apply great analytical skills, communication skills, and problem-solving skills to continue developing our analytics & BI capabilities. We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long-term solutions.

What you bring to the table – and why we need you!

  • Data Visualization skills - Designing and developing key metrics, reports, and dashboards to drive insights and business decisions to improve performance and reduce costs;
  • Technical Skills – either experience in, or strong desire to learn fundamental technical skills needed to drive BI initiatives (SQL, DAX, Data Modeling, etc.);
  • Communication Skills - Partner with leadership and collaborate with software engineers to implement data architecture and design, to support complex analysis;
  • Analytical Skills - Conduct complex analysis and proactively identify key business insights to assist departmental decision making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Life Science, Computer Science, or Related Degree;
  • 0-3 years of experience in business intelligence or analytics – Power BI and advanced SQL preferred;
  • Strong analytical and communication skills;
  • Excellent organization skills and the ability to multitask while efficiently completing high quality work.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence
Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports
Cincinnati Headquarters Experience

    • A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Job Summary

The Justice Services Division of the Community Resources Department is on the hunt for our next "Data Dominator" — a new Data Analyst role!

This isn't a "request comes in, report goes out" job — it's a chance to build something from the ground up. We're bringing data work in-house to strengthen our infrastructure, close longstanding reporting gaps, and turn metrics into real tools for decision-making.

You'll have a hand in it all: building division-wide dashboards from scratch, shaping reporting standards that don't fully exist yet, contributing to a new database management system, and supporting high-stakes work like CJC extended-custody reviews and EPSO quarterly reporting. It's a foundational, division-wide scope that'll only grow as the role matures.

We're looking for 3+ years of experience in data collection, synthesis, or analysis — hands-on with databases, queries, and visualization tools (SQL, BI tools, and beyond). Just as important: the ability to tell a story with data, translate numbers for courts, boards, and the public, and stay steady across stakeholders who each see the data differently.

 If you're curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and as driven by mission as by mechanics — this role was built for you. Apply today!

Hiring Range: $70,000.00 - $79,140.00 Annually

This position has an anticipated work schedule of Monday – Friday 8:00AM – 4:30PM; Hybrid schedule available upon successful completion of the probationary period

 Please be advised this position may close without advance notice, should we receive a sufficient number of qualified applications.

This position analyzes, evaluates, and documents data requirements. Develops a comprehensive data collection and analysis strategy based on functional assignment to evaluate the quality of services, performance, or other business indicators. Identifies and utilizes data solutions to implement data collection; performs data extraction and analysis and presents data. Employment is subject to the terms, conditions, and policies detailed in the Personnel Policies Manual (PPM). This position requires regular in-person presence as an essential job function. This position may be subject to grant funding.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Performs a variety of complex activities involved in the collection, analysis, documentation, and interpretation of data and information related to applicable requirements, initiatives, services, and other activities. Independently draws reasonable and sound conclusions consistent with findings and provides presentations.
  • Develops data solutions, tools, and capabilities to improve data-driven efforts, frameworks, data delivery, or dashboards.
  • Conducts research, compiles data, and uses statistical tools to identify, analyze, and interpret patterns and trends. Isolates potential root causes, projects consequences, draws conclusions from analyzed data, organizes and explains data and assumptions, and provides solutions or recommendations.
  • Designs, validates, and assesses methods of data collection and analysis; develops and implements protocols for data extraction and analysis. Monitors data collection methods and audits data to ensure data collection methodologies and protocols are followed.
  • Works collaboratively with cross-functional teams to produce qualitative and quantitative data analysis that supports organizational objectives and processes, aligning with the strategic plan and associated efforts.
  • Conducts comprehensive and special purpose data analysis, audits, and/or examinations; reviews, evaluates, and measures compliance of programs and processes for quality, effectiveness, and outcomes; assesses adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and other legal mandates. Recommends and implements practices/processes to support data analytics and program
  • Identifies, recommends, and helps to implement process improvement opportunities. Proposes system modifications and devises data management strategies for the organization to improve the quality and usability of data.
  • Serves as the organization’s subject matter expert for function/assignment-specific systems, databases, and data integrity. Develops and oversees training and development of staff on the use of data collection systems and quality assurance, ensuring alignment with policies, procedures, and best practices. Provides technical assistance, troubleshooting, and user support for databases and systems.
  • Leads or participates in data-driven work groups or committees; collaborates with internal and external partners to improve the efficiency of databases and systems; provides recommendations.
  • Utilizes function/assignment knowledge to provide guidance and recommendations to leadership, staff, and external sources regarding department data, policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Maintains a highly technical working knowledge of industry standards and best practices, as well as relevant regulations, policies, standards, and procedures to improve the organization's operations.
  • Contributes to unified efforts to measure organizational and departmental performance; participates in supporting initiatives, services, and other activities.
  • Gathers, organizes, and prepares data and presentations; provides data-driven presentations at leadership meetings, conferences, or other forums as needed.
  • Performs other duties as required.


Supervision Exercised: This classification does not have supervisory authority; however, may be required to provide expertise or limited guidance or direction to employees, such as overseeing work quality, training, and guidance. Typically serves as a subject matter expert on the scope of functional area.

Supervision Received: Receives general supervision. This classification typically performs job duties by following established standard operating procedures and/or policies. Regular direction, guidance, and coaching from supervisor may be expected. There is a choice of the appropriate procedure or policy to apply to duties. Performance reviewed periodically.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Extensive knowledge and proficiency in the use of automated data systems to perform a variety of complex tasks. Must be receptive to the adoption and application of new and innovative technologies and technological platforms.
  • Working knowledge of office and data analytic software, databases, and business applications.
  • Working knowledge of research methodology, principles, and procedures.
  • Proficiency in Toad, Crystal Reports, Microsoft Power BI, SPSS, and SQL preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to quickly and accurately wrangle, analyze, and interpret data, as well as identify and define data integrity issues and make recommendations for resolution. Ability to collect, synthesize, and analyze data. Ability to develop sound and valid recommendations.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Must possess exceptional interpersonal communication skills. Ability to communicate and work effectively with co-workers, clients, other agencies, and the public. Ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Must possess a high level of professionalism and integrity to handle sensitive and confidential situations and information.
  • Ability to build strong working relationships, internal and external to the organization. Ability to work cross-functionally with teams and key stakeholders, utilizing analytical skills in understanding data flows, dissecting problems, and delivering clear recommendations and guidance.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of proficiency related to research and analysis of a variety of data and systems used by the organization and in conjunction with applicable laws, regulations, and policies.
  • Ability to articulate data findings using both technical and non-technical language.
  • Ability to prepare reports and proposals to meet leadership objectives. Ability to write clearly and concisely and with proper respect to spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
  • Ability to assess situations and make prudent and appropriate decisions; ability to apply conflict resolution and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to respond in a flexible manner and reprioritize work as situations change.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.


Required Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent education.
  • Three years of data collection, synthesis, or analysis experience, including working with databases or statistical software.
    • Associate’s degree in a related field may substitute for one year of the required experience.
    • Bachelor’s degree in a related field may substitute for two years of the required experience.
    • Education substitutions are not cumulative; only the highest qualifying degree will be considered.


Preferred Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, information systems, or related field.
  • Experience with writing SQL and other data queries and with managing databases.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, such as Power BI.

The Justice Services Division of the Community Resources Department is on the hunt for our next "Data Dominator" — a new Data Analyst role!

Job Summary

 JOB DESCRIPTION

The Data Analytics Senior Analyst is responsible for analyzing, preparing, and presenting data to support executive decision-making, project reporting, and operational performance tracking. This role focuses on developing structured reporting, dashboards, and data solutions while continuously improving data collection, quality, and efficiency. The position collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality insights and scalable reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse, prepare data, and create reports for executive and project-level stakeholders
  • Prepare data, KPIs, and metrics for executive reports and presentations
  • Create various reports and dashboards for project management and executive reporting
  • Design report layouts with clear, high-level summaries, KPIs, and graphical presentations
  • Review existing data collection methods and identify continuous improvement opportunities
  • Develop and maintain tables, templates, trackers, and structured data models
  • Implement automation in data collection and reporting processes
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and readiness for reporting
  • Identify trends, patterns, and insights from structured and unstructured data
  • Support cross-functional teams with reporting and analytical needs
  • Develop and enhance business intelligence solutions and dashboards
  • Apply data transformation, cleansing, and standardization techniques
  • Continuously improve reporting processes for speed, quality, and efficiency

Qualifications

  • Minimum 8–10+ years of experience in data management and analysis
  • Strong experience with databases; relational databases preferred
  • Strong ability to summarize and interpret data and recognize trends and patterns
  • Experience with project reporting and executive-level reporting
  • Advanced user of Excel and Office tools
  • Experience with PowerQuery, Power BI, and similar reporting tools
  • Experience designing reports with strong visualization and presentation capabilities
  • Proficiency in SQL; knowledge of M and DAX is a plus
  • Programming experience (e.g., VBA or other languages) is a plus
  • Experience working with data structures, templates, and tracking tools
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to present complex data to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

  • Customer Focus

  • Innovation

descriptionHtml:
ABS Group is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program. In this role, you will use business intelligence and visualization tools to turn complex data into clear, decision-ready dashboards, reports, and analytical products.

You will work with stakeholders across technical and operational teams to provide reporting, insight, and performance visibility that supports better decision-making in a large-scale federal environment. The scope of responsibility, degree of technical leadership, and level of independence expected will reflect the level at which this position is filled.

What You Will Do
- Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and other business intelligence products
- Analyze, interpret, and visualize data to support operational, technical, and stakeholder decision-making
- Develop reproducible reports and analyses, including trend analysis, benchmarking, and performance reporting
- Translate stakeholder needs into effective reporting structures, visualizations, and dashboard requirements
- Integrate data from multiple sources to support accurate and consistent reporting outputs
- Present findings and business intelligence products to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and program stakeholders to improve reporting data structures and insight generation
- Support validation, refresh accuracy, usability, and quality of reporting products
- Produce presentation materials, reporting guidance, and supporting documentation as needed

Level and Compensation: This position may be filled at multiple career levels based on business need and the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capability. Typical leveling for this role is as follows:

- Junior (0 to 4 years)

- Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)

- Senior (10 to 14 years)

- Principal (15 or more years)


These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.

Education and Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Relevant professional experience in business intelligence, dashboard development, reporting, or analytical visualization roles; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled

- Experience delivering reporting and visualization products for operational, executive, or stakeholder audiences preferred

- Experience in a complex enterprise, consulting, or government environment a plus


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI and dashboarding tools
- Working knowledge of SQL and experience with structured data sources
- Familiarity with data visualization, dashboard design, reporting concepts, and analytics
- Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and create clear, useful visual products
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Understanding of validation practices, reporting quality controls, and data governance considerations

Nice to Have
- Experience supporting executive or stakeholder reporting in a large program environment
- Familiarity with survey, demographic, statistical, or public sector reporting environments
- Experience with geospatial or map-based visualizations
- Knowledge of accessibility considerations for dashboards and reports

Location
This position is based in the Washington, D.C. metro area, with primary work performed in Suitland, Maryland. Remote or hybrid arrangements may be available for eligible work, subject to government approval.

Notice: This role has been opened for a future need expected within three months of the original posting date of this position. Potential candidates may not receive communication until the open headcount is confirmed.

descriptionHtml:
As a Data Analyst, you will be part of a small and dynamic technology team that is bringing cutting-edge technology solutions to a fast-growing company. You will collaborate closely with our business stakeholders and within the Technology team to create and maintain insights that are delivered either through PowerBI visualizations or via custom applications that the team builds. In this role you should be able to solve problems quickly, but you should also strive to understand the business reasons behind the ask, find root causes and prevent issues from recurring. You shouldn’t accept “that’s the way things are done”, but instead you should work to understand the reasons why things are done and identify ways to improve. You should value documenting your successes and solutions, helping to track challenges and build a knowledgebase to share with the team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights.
  • Develop and maintain PowerBI dashboards and reports to support business decision-making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
  • Perform data cleaning, validation, and transformation to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data to drive business improvements.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analysis and visualization.
  • Provide training and support to team members on PowerBI and data analysis tools.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Curiosity and a passion for continuous learning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and other data analysis tools.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting using PowerBI.
  • Working knowledge of medallion architecture.
  • Skills in MS Fabric and Azure Data Factory a plus.
  • Experience with Snowflake a plus.
  • Knowledge of the mortgage lending industry is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in data analysis and PowerBI development.

Physical and Mental Demands

  • Hearing: Ability to listen and communicate effectively in meetings, calls and daily interactions – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Seeing: Ability to read reports, documents, and data on screens or in print – Continuous (over 75%)
  • Sitting or Standing: Prolonged periods of sitting or standing (based on preference of the individual) at a desk. Physical participation in meetings, often working on a computer – Continuous (over 75%)
  • Standing/Walking: Moving around the office, attending meetings, and events – Occasional (15-45%)
  • Manual Dexterity: Regular use of hands for typing, writing, and handling documents – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Communication: Speaking with employees, executives, partners, and vendors – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Attention to Detail: Ensuring accuracy in operational processes – Continuous (over 75%)

Working Environment

This position operates in a fast-paced, dynamic office environment that fosters creativity and collaboration among team members in order to meet deadlines.

Employees are expected to work both independently and as part of diverse teams to meet the organization’s goals.

The in-office work setting is highly digital, requiring proficiency with various online tools and platforms to communicate and manage tasks effectively.

We emphasize a culture of respect and inclusion, where all employees are encouraged to share their ideas and contributions are valued.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

descriptionHtml:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:

  • State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
  • State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
  • State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
  • State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
  • State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
  • State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
  • State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
  • State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
  • Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
  • State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
  • State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
  • State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
  • State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
  • Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000

The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.

EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Vet. Principal Applicants Only.

The Opportunity – Why Join

  • On purpose: a leading professional services firm found that the commitment, empathy and dedication of employees at AAA Life was the highest across a benchmark of top US companies.
  • On growth: we have the privilege to offer our products to tens of millions of Americans who are proud members of AAA.
  • On making a difference: we serve Americans by delivering life insurance products that make a true difference for families during their hardest times, not wealth management instruments.
  • On culture: USA Today named us a 2025 top workplace nationwide. We believe the job of an insurance company is to do good, and our mission is to help our members during what is often the hardest times in their lives. We pick up the phone to people who have lost loved ones and offer our genuine support. That is why we will always put human connection at the heart of what we do – being there to talk to our members person-to-person. Most of our members have real life policies that bring peace of mind during life, and genuine support in the event of death. We are not here to chase the super-rich with annuities and wealth management products. AAA has been one of the most trusted names in America because it believes in providing the services that middle class Americans need.

The Next Phase

Our mission is to provide these services for as many people as we can. To achieve that, we need to continue to grow and evolve. We need to boldly embrace innovation and technology, and your leadership will help us deliver on our mission together and achieve our transformation. At AAA Life, empathy and progress go hand in hand, creating a culture where bright ideas flourish and meaningful impact grows. If you are drawn to an environment that values purpose as much as potential, we invite you to join us. Because here, being there for people isn’t just a promise—it is our driving force.

Responsibilities

The Business Intelligence Analyst II helps AAA Life Insurance make informed business and operational decisions through data analysis, reporting, and business insights. This role partners with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, analyze operational performance, identify trends, and develop solutions that support strategic and operational objectives.

This position works closely with internal teams and customers in the areas of operational and financial analysis. It requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and effective communication skills. The ideal candidate is curious, results-oriented, and passionate about leveraging data to solve business problems and improve processes. Responsibilities include analyzing data, developing reports and dashboards, supporting business initiatives with actionable insights, and contributing to the design and enhancement of data solutions that provide accurate and meaningful information to decision makers.

Position Responsibilities

  • Access, analyze, and interpret data from multiple sources to develop reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses that support business and operational decision making.
  • Monitor and evaluate operational performance metrics, identify trends, and recommend opportunities for process improvement and increased efficiency.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards that translate complex data into meaningful and actionable insights for business users.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define reporting needs, and deliver solutions that address business objectives.
  • Conduct analyses of business processes, operational performance, and key metrics to support department initiatives and strategic goals.
  • Support the development and maintenance of automated reporting and data processes that improve consistency, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Present findings and recommendations to business partners and department leadership in a clear and concise manner.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve business outcomes through data-driven decision making and process improvements.
  • Participate in data governance and data stewardship activities by helping define, document, and maintain key performance indicators, metrics, and reporting standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support ongoing reporting, analytics, and data transformation initiatives.
  • Perform quality assurance and validation activities to ensure the accuracy and reliability of reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs.
  • Maintain documentation related to reporting processes, data sources, business rules, and analytical methodologies.
  • Stay current on analytics tools, reporting technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve capabilities and effectiveness.

Core Competencies

  • Achieves Results/Has Bias for Action : Demonstrates accountability for delivering high-quality work within established timelines. Takes initiative to solve problems, follows through on commitments, and effectively manages multiple priorities with moderate supervision.
  • Customer Focus : Understands the needs of internal and external customers and delivers solutions that support their objectives. Builds credibility by providing accurate, timely, and actionable information.
  • Uses Effective Communication Skills : Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally with technical and non-technical audiences. Effectively presents analytical findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.
  • Relationship Building : Develops productive working relationships across teams and departments. Collaborates effectively with colleagues and business partners to achieve shared goals.
  • Business Acumen : Demonstrates a growing understanding of business operations, organizational goals, and performance drivers. Applies business knowledge to interpret data and provide relevant insights.
  • Technical/Professional Skills : Possesses strong analytical and reporting skills and demonstrates proficiency with business intelligence tools and technologies. Continuously expands technical capabilities and applies best practices to analytical work.
  • Creativity and Innovation : Identifies opportunities for improvement and contributes ideas for enhancing processes, reports, dashboards, and analytical approaches. Uses critical thinking to solve business problems.
  • Attention to Detail : Produces accurate, reliable work by carefully validating data, reports, and analyses. Demonstrates strong organizational skills and commitment to quality.

Qualifications

Required Education/Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of experience analyzing and interpreting data and communicating insights to business stakeholders.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
  • Experience working with large datasets and combining information from multiple data sources.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Experience Preferred

  • At least 3-5 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, finance, operations, or a related field.
  • Experience using SQL to query, transform, and analyze data.
  • Experience with Python, R, or other analytical tools.
  • Experience supporting operational, financial, customer service, underwriting, or claims-related analytics.
  • Experience creating automated reporting solutions and improving reporting processes.
  • Familiarity with data governance, KPI development, and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Experience participating in cross-functional projects that leverage analytics to improve business outcomes.
  • Experience within the life insurance, financial services, or insurance industry.

How You’ll Work

  • Work Solution: Hybrid (non-regular cadence) or Remote (USA)

What We Bring To The Table

  • Hybrid or remote work environment that promotes work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting from your first day
  • Employer 401k match and employer contribution to a pension plan
  • Generous PTO and paid parental leave to support your family needs
  • Various associate resource groups and community involvement initiatives

Essential Job Functions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

This job requires the ability to perform duties contained in the job description for this position, including, but not limited to, the above requirements. Reasonable accommodations will be made for otherwise qualified applicants as needed to enable them to fulfill these requirements.

AAA Life Insurance Company does not offer immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes visa types such as H-1B, TN, and STEM OPT. Please do not apply if you currently require or may require employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides analyst support for data analysis and reporting activities. Responsible for organizing data from multiple sources to produce reports, dashboards, and analyses related to utilization, cost-containment, and business performance. Generates data-related insights that support decision-making and cost-containment. Designs and delivers reporting, analytics, and data solutions across business and healthcare domains, including claims, utilization, finance, and other business areas. Partners with stakeholders to define requirements, develop scalable reporting and data processes, and apply analytical techniques to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and drive business performance. Supports projects, regulatory requests, and initiatives that improve data quality, reporting workflows, and process efficiencies.

Essential Job Duties

  • Analyzes datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  • Designs, develops, and maintains reports, dashboards, and data solutions using tools such as Structured Query Language (SQL), Microsoft Excel, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), that support utilization analysis, cost-containment, and operational performance.
  • Translates business needs into reporting and analytical requirements; partners with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
  • Facilitates healthcare data analysis, including data related to claims, pharmacy, lab, utilization, cost, and other areas.
  • Develops and maintains data processes for extraction, transformation, validation, and integration.
  • Ensures data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through quality assurance and validation processes.
  • Creates forecasts, models, and recommendations based on statistical analysis and business context.
  • Organizes, documents, and maintains datasets and reporting workflows across multiple business areas.
  • Consolidates research and analysis into clear summaries and recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Supports regulatory, contractual, and enterprise reporting requirements, including state mandated submissions.
  • Identifies and implements enhancements or fixes to existing reports and reporting processes.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to define reporting requirements and maintain project/report timelines.
  • Documents methodologies, reporting processes, and business requirements.
  • Identifies and drives process improvements, standardization, and automation opportunities.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Supports projects, including timeline management, requirements gathering, and deliverable execution.
  • Supports regulatory, audit, and ad hoc data requests as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare analytics, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to interpret datasets, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Technical proficiency with SQL, Excel, and reporting/analytics tools, and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy in data validation, report development, and documentation.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, present data-related findings and solutions.
  • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Crystal Reports, MedInsight, Power BI, relational databases or similar tools.
  • Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) systems (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tools such as SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure data lakes) and business intelligence (BI) tools.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting and healthcare payer systems (e.g., QNXT or similar platforms).
  • Knowledge of healthcare utilization metrics, medical cost analysis, and performance indicators.
  • Familiarity with predictive modeling concepts and trend forecasting.
  • Experience working with healthcare claims, pharmacy, or utilization data.
  • Project management experience.
  • Microsoft certification or similar technical credentials.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

The Office of the District Attorney, Bronx County (“BXDA”) is charged with the twin goals of ensuring public safety and striving for equal justice for the over 1.4 million members of the Bronx County community. By “Pursuing Justice with Integrity,” the BXDA places a focus on assistance for crime victims while simultaneously ensuring fairness to defendants. Moreover, the BXDA aims to balance the need to seek appropriate punishment for certain crimes while recognizing when punitive measures do not adequately advance justice. By recognizing these significant distinctions and acting accordingly, BXDA has established a standard of excellence in the representation of the Bronx community at large, which continues to grow stronger every day.

In furtherance of this mission, the BXDA seeks an experienced and enthusiastic Data Visualization Analyst Level to join the Strategic Planning & Analytics Bureau.

Strategic Planning & Analytics uses data, research, and analytics to support evidence-based decision-making, measure performance, evaluate policies and initiatives, and promote transparency.

The Data Visualization Analyst will develop and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and other data products that translate complex criminal justice data into clear, actionable information for Office leadership, staff, policymakers, and external audiences. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and technical skills, including querying, analyzing, and preparing data for analysis and presentation.

Job Responsibilities

Specific duties includes but not limited to the following:

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and other data visualization products.
  • Translate complex data and analytic findings into clear dashboards, charts, tables, reports, and presentations for non-technical audiences.
  • Apply data visualization and storytelling principles to communicate trends, performance measures, and policy-relevant findings.
  • Work with analysts, data engineers, and Office stakeholders to identify reporting needs, define measures, and develop useful data products.
  • Query, clean, transform, validate, and analyze data using SQL, R, Stata, and related tools.
  • Develop and maintain automated and reproducible processes for dashboards, recurring reports, and data extracts.
  • Assess data quality and suitability for analysis and reporting.
  • Support ad hoc analyses and recurring reporting on Office performance, caseloads, case processing, programs, and strategic priorities.
  • Perform other related analytic and data visualization projects as assigned.

Please Note

  • This is a hybrid position: 4 days in the office, 1 remote day after 2 years of service.
  • BXDA does not support H1B Visas.
  • Must reside in NYC and surrounding counties.

COMMUNITY COORDINATOR - 56058

Minimum Qualifications

  • A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or
  • High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Blue Cross Blue Shield Global Solutions ℠ (BCBS Global Solutions ℠ ), we make it easy for people and organizations to access and pay for healthcare abroad. By combining digital innovation with human-centered care, we go above and beyond for our customers and deliver an international healthcare experience that's simple, efficient and human.

Whether our customers live, work, travel or study abroad, we give them the confidence and peace of mind to say "yes" to new possibilities.

What We're Looking for in Our Data & Reporting Analyst

We’re looking for a Data & Reporting Analyst who enjoys digging into data, solving problems and turning complex information into clear, useful insights.

In this role, you’ll gather and analyze data from multiple sources, create reports and dashboards and help ensure our regulatory reporting is accurate and complete. You’ll work with teams across the company to answer business questions, investigate data quality issues and make information easier to understand and use.

Would your friends describe you as curious, detail-oriented and someone who likes figuring out how things work? This might be the role for you! Bonus points if you’re comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently, while still applying your own judgment and checking the accuracy of the results.

Why This Role Matters

Accurate data helps us meet important regulatory requirements and make better business decisions. You’ll turn complex information into meaningful reporting and give teams the insights they need to solve problems and improve how work gets done.

What You'll Do As a Data & Reporting Analyst

Gather and Prepare Data

  • Gather, clean and validate data from SQL Server, Snowflake, Excel and other sources.
  • Combine internal data with information from vendors and partners.
  • Investigate data quality issues and help ensure reporting is accurate and reliable.


Create Reports and Dashboards

  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or similar tools.
  • Create calculated fields, measures and formulas to support KPIs, trends and other business needs.
  • Develop reporting that answers questions and helps teams understand and use their data.


Analyze and Explain the Data

  • Write SQL queries to support both ad hoc and recurring analysis.
  • Analyze claims and other business data to identify trends, issues and useful insights.
  • Turn complex findings into clear information for technical and non-technical audiences.


Use AI Thoughtfully

  • Use tools such as Copilot or similar AI assistants to support query drafting, data exploration, documentation and summarization.
  • Review and validate AI-generated work, using your own judgment to make sure it’s accurate.


Improve Processes and Support Change

  • Work with cross-functional partners to develop business requirements and support key projects.
  • Review and document workflows and recommend practical improvements.
  • Help implement and measure new processes and procedures, including changes required by state or federal regulations.


This Might Be the Right Fit for You If...

  • You have 2+ years of experience as a data analyst, reporting analyst or in a similar role.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, economics, information systems or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • You’re comfortable using SQL to query, join and analyze data.
  • You have experience creating reports and dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or a similar tool.
  • You can create calculated fields and measures to turn data into meaningful metrics.
  • You’re comfortable using Excel and AI tools to support your day-to-day work.
  • You’re analytical, detail-oriented and able to explain data clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Bonus points ! You have experience working with insurance or medical claims data.


What you’ll get in return:

  • Competitive base pay + annual bonus
  • Competitive medical plans
  • Telemedicine available
  • Paid parental leave
  • Employee assistance and wellness support 24/7
  • Free international healthcare coverage


Other Great Perks:

  • Hybrid work model
  • Work abroad arrangements available
  • Generous PTO accrual program with carry-over option
  • 9 paid holidays in addition to one floating holiday and one volunteer day
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Career/Learning and development opportunities
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Pet insurance offerings
  • Identify theft and legal coverages available
  • Emphasis on well-being (Virtual well-being platform, monthly mindfulness events, and giveaways)
