Newport offers comprehensive plan solutions and consulting expertise to plan sponsors and the advisors who serve them. As a provider and partner, Newport is independent, experienced, and responsive.

The Reporting & KPI Analyst will play a key role in monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on the organization’s key performance indicators (KPIs) to support data-driven decision-making. This individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining performance dashboards, generating insights, and creating standardized reports to help stakeholders understand trends and measure progress against targets. This role ensures data integrity, timely reporting, and the accuracy of various performance indicators. The Reporting and KPI analyst will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide clear insights that support strategic decision-making.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Data Collection & Analysis: Gather, process, and analyze data from various sources to produce insights on KPIs and performance metrics.
  • KPI Monitoring: Track and report on KPIs regularly, highlighting variances from targets and identifying areas of opportunity or concern.
  • Reporting & Dashboard Development: Create, maintain, and improve dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations that present KPIs and trends in a clear, actionable format.
  • Collaborative Insights: Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., Consulting, Client Services, Accounting, Plan Administration, Operations) to understand their KPI needs and provide insights to guide strategic decisions.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data by conducting regular audits and identifying potential data quality issues.
  • Performance Evaluation: Analyze performance against benchmarks, forecasting future performance trends, and providing recommendations for improvement.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements to streamline reporting, enhance data accuracy, and improve KPI tracking systems.
  • Documentation & Training: Document reporting processes and provide training to users on accessing and interpreting reports.
  • Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
  • Our I-Client service philosophy and our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always® should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day basis showing your support of our organizational culture.

Supervision

  • N/A

Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Statistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of KPI frameworks, data analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills to present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of experience in a data analysis or reporting role.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Excel).
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and data modeling is a plus.
  • Experience in a similar industry or domain (e.g., finance, e-commerce, healthcare).
  • Familiarity with ERP or CRM systems and data extraction processes.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages like Python or R.

For all virtual remote positions, in order to ensure associates can effectively perform their job duties with no distractions, we require an uninterrupted virtual workspace and there is also an expectation of family care being in place during business hours. Additionally, there is an internet work speed requirement of 25 Mbps or better for individual use. If more than one person is utilizing the same internet connection in the same household or building, then a stronger connection is required. If you are unsure of your internet speed, please check with your service provider. Note: For call center roles specifically, it is a requirement to either hardwire your equipment directly to the internet router or ensure your workstation is in close proximity to the router. Please ensure that you are able to meet these expectations before applying.

We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

Description

The Jr. Reporting Analyst supports reporting, analytics, and data activities for internal teams and external clients. This role assists with preparing, validating, and analyzing data; maintaining recurring reports and dashboards; modifying existing SQL queries; and communicating results in a clear, client-ready format. The Jr. Reporting Analyst works under the guidance of the Analytics Director and senior team members to ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and aligned with stakeholder needs.

  • Use intermediate Excel skills to organize, validate, analyze, and summarize data from multiple sources.

Position type

  • Full time

  • 1–2 years of experience in reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related role; equivalent training or education may be considered.

Preferred Experience

  • Working knowledge of querying relational databases or demonstrated aptitude for learning query tools.
  • Exposure to business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or dashboard support.
  • Power BI dashboard development, maintenance, data visualization, or report refresh experience preferred.
  • Experience working with client-facing reports, operational data, web portals, warehouse management systems, or ERP systems preferred.
  • Previous Telecom, Retail, Customer Success, or operations support experience preferred.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills used for data organization, validation, analysis, and summarization.
  • Ability to explain reporting results, trends, and variances in a concise and easily understood manner.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional, service-oriented approach to client and stakeholder interactions.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and task management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and manage assigned work accurately.
  • Curiosity, problem-solving ability, willingness to learn, and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Skills And Qualifications

Position Summary: The 529 Services Data & Reporting Analyst supports reporting, data analysis, operational processes, and technology initiatives within UBT 529 Services. This position develops and maintains reports and Power BI dashboards, assists with data validation and reconciliation, supports department projects, and identifies opportunities to improve reporting and operational efficiency. The position works closely with 529 Services to ensure accurate reporting and compliance with applicable 529 plan requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards and reports used to monitor operational activity, trends, volumes, and key performance indicators.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and queries using Power BI, SQL, Excel, and SSRS, with an emphasis on data accuracy and usability.
  • Assist with analyzing data from PowerAgent, PAWorx, PA Port, and other systems supporting 529 Services.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality-control reviews to ensure the accuracy and completeness of internal and external reporting. Ensuring 100% accuracy.
  • Create recurring and ad hoc reports for management, advisors, broker-dealers, state partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with department projects, including requirements gathering, testing, documentation, implementation, and post-implementation review.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve operational processes through Power BI, Power Query, SQL, Excel, and other available technology.
  • Assist with testing system enhancements, upgrades, reports, and operational changes.
  • Assist with data compilation and reporting for internal audits, external audits, due diligence requests, and state partner requests.
  • Operational liaison with Morgan Stanley home office. Responsible for high level Omnibus reconciliation process with $1 Billion Morgan Stanley key relationship with limited oversight.
  • Operational liaison with State Farm home office. Design, develop, trouble shoot State Farm daily reports and operational relationship management. $750 Million relationship with high level of attention required with high visibility client.
  • Support the preparation and validation of tax reporting files, including 1099-Q and other state partner reporting.
  • Assist with semiannual EMMA/MSRB reporting, including gathering and validating applicable money movement, benchmark, and fee information.
  • Support the State Farm operational relationship, including the development, maintenance, validation, and troubleshooting of daily reports. Assist with researching and resolving reporting and operational issues to support this high-visibility relationship.
  • Support the Morgan Stanley omnibus relationship by assisting with reconciliation, reporting, research, and resolution of discrepancies. Work with senior 529 Services staff to ensure accurate and timely processing and reporting.
  • Develop documentation for reports, dashboards, procedures, queries, and operational processes.
  • Support quarterly account mapping and reporting for the Nebraska Meadowlark program.
  • Assist with quarterly analysis and account creation related to the Illinois First Steps program.
  • Support 529 account fee processing and related reconciliation.
  • Assist with quarterly National Change of Address processing prior to statement generation.
  • Work with internal team members and external vendors to research and resolve reporting, data, and system-related issues.
  • Develop an understanding of 529 plan operations, state partner requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Crosstrain on key 529 Services operational functions and provide backup support as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with 529 Laws and contracts with UBT 529 Services State Partners
  • Understand and adhere to all bank policies, laws, and regulations applicable to their role. Complete compliance training: follow internal processes and controls as required.
  • Report all compliance issues, violations of law or regulations in accordance with the steps defined in bank policies.
  • Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of this position.
  • Performs other job-related duties or special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience required.
  • Three years’ experience with Microsoft Power BI, including developing reports, dashboards, data visualizations, and working with data models required.
  • Three years of experience with SQL, SSRS, and database querying required.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify discrepancies, troubleshoot issues, and communicate findings.
  • Experience within financial services, investment products, or 529 college savings plans preferred.
  • Expert in Microsoft Office (Excel and Access) and in working with other financial software.

Preferred Talents

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Self-motivated with good judgement and takes initiative.
  • Ability to translate business needs into useful reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
  • Curious and interested in using data and technology to improve processes.
  • Ability to communicate and interact professionally and effectively through written and oral communication
  • Organized and able to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Ability to recognize opportunities for process improvement and automation.
  • Analytical and problem solver

Working Environment

Sedentary work, occasional lifting and/or carrying up to 20 pounds.

Indoor work not exposed to outdoor elements or hazards.

This role is eligible for hybrid work from home opportunity under the work from home guidelines upon completion of onboarding.

The Portfolio Data Analyst prepares reports and data extracts from various sources to provide to internal customers and approved vendors to support business functions and processes while maintaining data security.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop new reports and update existing reports to support business lines by utilizing Business Intelligence tools. Validate reports to assure accuracy.
  • Summarize key findings from reports and analysis for presentation to internal customers.
  • Support Data Governance by identifying and researching potential data quality issues.
  • Responsible to interact with all levels of staff across the organization and regulators in a prompt and professional manner.
  • Work closely with Director of MIS & Credit Analytics on other projects and responsibilities as business needs arise.

Essential Functions:

  • Sitting for extended periods of time.
  • Sufficient dexterity of hands and fingers to efficiently operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and other computer components.
  • Ability to converse and exchange information with all levels of staff within organization.
  • Ability to observe, perceive, identify, and translate data

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field, such as data analytics, mathematics, statistics, MIS or related field, or a minimum of (3) three years of data analysis work in a professional setting environment required
  • Ability to present deliverables in a concise, complete and professional format-demonstrating research, analysis and conclusion.

  • Experience working with relational databases and performing complex queries.

The role requires hands-on report development experience, strong attention to report design and presentation, and the ability to understand the data and calculations behind the reports.

The Contributions You Will Make

  • Design, build, and maintain client reports using SimCorp Coric and other reporting platforms.
  • Create professional, client-ready reports that present investment information clearly and consistently.
  • Build report templates, layouts, variables, calculations, conditional content, and other report logic.

Safety National is a leading specialty commercial insurance and reinsurance provider. Providing uninterrupted service to thousands of customers nationwide for over 85 years, the company offers specialized expertise, flexible program and placement design, and unique claims proficiency.

Safety National exists as the market leader in excess workers’ compensation for self-insured employers and groups nationwide and is a leading multi-line provider of risk solutions for large commercial and public entity clients. The company’s reinsurance division, Safety National Re, offers lead market terms for a full range of workers' compensation and professional liability programs.

Since 1942, the company has offered a long-term commitment to its broker partners and insureds, striving to provide top industry expertise, consistency in decision making, exemplary service, and superior outcomes. This approach has led to a broad and loyal customer base, resulting in an extremely high annual customer retention rate. 

Safety National is rated A++ (Superior) by A.M. Best, which is the highest achievable financial strength rating an insurance company can attain. Less than 3% of all insurance providers have achieved this rating.

Safety National is a member of the Tokio Marine Group, which consists of Tokio Marine Holdings, 365 subsidiaries, and approximately 51,000 employees across 57 countries. With assets exceeding $200 billion, the Tokio Marine Group ranks among the top 10 insurance groups globally, and its companies are recognized among the highest-rated in the industry.

Safety National is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, with additional remote offices in major cities throughout the United States. 

The company is a multi-year Best Places to Work in Insurance honoree, ranking in in both the insurance providers category and the medium-size employers category.

descriptionHtml:
At Safety National, we don’t just offer jobs – we build careers with purpose! Since 1942, we’ve been an industry leader, valuing integrity, teamwork, and stability while providing competitive rewards, top-tier benefits, career growth opportunities, and flexible work options that promote balance. With tuition reimbursement, wellness perks, and a strong community impact, we invest in your success—both personally and professionally. Ready to grow with us? Apply today!

Follow this link to view all of our available careers and apply: https://www.safetynational.com/careers-page/

This opportunity is in the Business Intelligence & Planning department.

The Business Intelligence & Planning Department is dedicated to empowering informed decision-making and driving strategic growth through comprehensive financial planning, data-driven insights, and governance excellence. Our mission is to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable intelligence to all stakeholders around the company by leveraging the strengths of our integrated teams, including Planning & Reserving, Portfolio Management, BI Analysis, BI Data Analysis, Data Quality and Data Governance. Together, we support a culture of data excellence and financial foresight.

Role Description:

As a Business Intelligence Data Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming data into meaningful insights that drive business decisions across the organization. You will work closely with business partners to understand reporting needs and translate them into technical solutions, building and maintaining reports and dashboards using tools like Power BI and SSRS.

In this role, you will leverage your SQL expertise to query and manage data across multiple systems, ensuring accuracy and consistency in reporting outputs. You will also support data validation, assist in refining reporting processes, and contribute to documentation that enhances transparency and usability.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving business problems, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver impactful analytics solutions in a dynamic and growing environment.

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field is preferred

Required Qualifications:

  • 1 or more years of experience in reporting, data analysis, or analytics within a business environment
  • Prior experience interpreting business requirements and translating to technical requirements
  • Ability to read, write, and modify moderately complex SQL queries
  • Prior experience managing data tables and strong knowledge of common data structures and table joins
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills including proficiency in vlookups, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and writing moderately complex formulas
  • Prior hands-on experience providing reporting and/or data visualization using Power BI or SSRS / Visual Studio
  • Must be presently authorized to work in the U.S. without a requirement for work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future
  • This position allows for a hybrid work schedule which includes a minimum of 3 days per week in our St. Louis Corporate Office, located at 1832 Schuetz Rd. Saint Louis, MO. All employees are required to submit work from home requests and follow our Work From Home policy, which will be provided to all candidates selected to interview.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field
  • Prior experience with Snowflake data cloud
  • Exposure to data warehousing concepts or working with large, complex datasets


Protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and technology assets against unauthorized disclosure, destruction and/or alteration, in accordance with Safety National policies, standards, and procedures.

Safety National is a leading specialty insurance and reinsurance provider. Our culture is built upon relationships, which allow us to demonstrate our expertise gained through our rich 80-year history. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tokio Marine, Inc., we appreciate the benefits and support provided by our affiliation with one of the top 10 insurance companies in the world.

Total Rewards That Put Employees First

In our vision to be First with Co-Workers, compensation that includes base salary, holiday bonus, and incentive awards is only a small portion of the comprehensive total rewards package we offer. Our total rewards approach recognizes and rewards the time, talents, efforts, and results of our valued employees. Highlights of our exceptional benefits include generous health, dental, and vision coverage, health savings accounts, a 401(k)-retirement savings match and an annual profit sharing contribution. We proudly offer family forming benefits for adoption, fertility, and surrogacy, generous paid time off and paid holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave, a hybrid work environment, and company-paid life insurance and disability. To support employees in their career journeys, we provide professional growth and development opportunities in addition to employee recognition and well-being programs. Apply today to learn more.

Safety National is committed to fair, transparent pay and we strive to provide competitive, market-based compensation. In our vision to be First with Co-Workers, compensation is only one piece of the comprehensive total rewards package we offer. The target base salary range for this position is $66,500 to $86,000. Compensation for the successful candidate will consider the candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies, experience and geographic location.

descriptionHtml:
DISH Business requires streamlined, high-quality data reporting to empower key stakeholders, including executive leadership, sales, and marketing, with actionable insights. This role addresses the challenge of consolidating diverse data streams from multiple sources into cohesive, automated dashboards that highlight critical business trends and financial performance. By identifying reporting gaps and establishing robust quality assurance measures, this position ensures absolute data integrity across the department and drives proactive business decisions.

What Success Looks Like (Objectives)

  • Build, improve, and maintain meaningful dashboards for upper management, sales, and supporting teams to drive strategic decision-making
  • Collaborate cross-departmentally to identify emerging reporting needs and translate stakeholder requirements into scalable data solutions
  • Automate recurring and ad-hoc reporting processes, utilizing modern tools to reduce manual processing time and enhance department efficiency
  • Analyze complex queries and scripts to uncover trends, investigate outliers, and provide actionable business impact suggestions
  • Coordinate department quality assurance efforts, identifying and correcting account or data errors to maintain high-quality outputs
  • Leverage AI-driven tools and automation techniques to streamline repetitive data querying and reporting tasks

Core Skills, Competencies, and Key Experiences (What you’ll bring)

  • Strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to manage competing stakeholder requests and synthesize complex datasets
  • Critical experiences in executing advanced SQL queries and developing insightful Tableau dashboards
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, allowing for seamless cross-functional interactions with all levels of management
  • Strong attention to detail combined with a problem-solving mindset to identify data trends, discrepancies, and immediate business impacts
  • Adaptability and curiosity, featuring a willingness to take risks, learn from failures, and adopt innovative reporting methodologies
  • Foundational AI literacy, including the ability to apply AI tools for data exploration and prompt engineering to optimize workflows

Additional Qualifications

  • Proficiency in or knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS to support advanced data initiatives

Candidates must be willing to participate in at least one in-person interview.

Visa sponsorship not available for this role.

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Minimum Experience: 2-4 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting
  • Required Technical Skills:
    • SQL, Tableau, Microsoft Excel, and G-Suite
Salary Range

Compensation: $63,150.00/Year - $90,000.00/Year

EchoStar is reimagining the future of connectivity. Our business reach spans satellite television service, live-streaming and on-demand programming, smart home installation services, mobile plans and products.

Summary Statement

The City of Boise is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst I to support Facilities Services and Operations (FSO). This role collects, maintains and analyzes facility, asset, maintenance, work order and utility data while developing reports, dashboards and other tools that help teams make informed decisions and deliver reliable services.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career analyst who wants to build practical experience while contributing to the facilities and systems that support City operations. You’ll collaborate with operational, analytical and technical staff, help improve data quality and business processes and provide basic system support and training.

To ensure internal equity and alignment with the approved budget for this position, offers are made within the posted hiring range. Although the hiring range is fixed, employees receive an exceptional benefits and total rewards package that enhances the overall value of employment with the City of Boise.

Required Knowledge, Experience, And Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, public administration, information systems, business, environmental science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • General office practices, procedures and essential equipment
  • Basic data collection, research, validation, and reporting methods
  • Computer usage including related software, database, spreadsheet, reporting, and data visualization applications
  • Basic reporting and data visualization principal
  • Records management and process documentation practices

Essential Functions

Performs routine or repetitive tasks with specific instructions and set procedures. Handles basic issues and problems and refers more complex issues to higher-level staff.

Collects, organizes, validates, and analyzes information from operational systems, databases, spreadsheets, and other sources. Develops and maintains standard reports, dashboards, and datasets; identifies trends, discrepancies, and data-quality issues; and communicates findings to appropriate staff.

Maintains accurate and current facility, location, building-system, equipment, preventive maintenance, work order, utility, and related asset data in database. Processes documented asset additions, replacements, relocations, updates, and deactivations; monitors established data-quality controls; corrects routine discrepancies; and coordinates issues requiring operational or technical review.

Works with FSO staff and other assigned users to understand routine reporting, data, and system needs. Documents business processes and user requirements and maintains data dictionaries, procedures, report documentation, user guides, and training resources. Provides first-line assistance and basic training on approved system processes, data entry, reports, and dashboards, and coordinates assigned technical issues with Information Technology, vendors, consultants, and internal subject-matter experts.

Supports assigned projects and process-improvement efforts through data collection, validation, testing, analysis, reporting, and documentation. Work may include asset inventories, preventive maintenance data analysis and reporting, work order reporting improvements, utility and performance reporting, facility condition assessment data, customer surveys, and operational system implementations. Recommends improvements and implements approved changes within established procedures and assigned authority.

Collaborates with other department data analysts to apply shared reporting, documentation, data-quality, and analytical practices. Participates in peer review and knowledge sharing and provides analytical or system support for special projects and short-term departmental priorities. Primarily supports FSO and may assist fleet services or other department programs as assigned.

Performs other duties as assigned. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this position at any time.

Requirements

Additional Required Knowledge, Experience, And Training

Ability To

  • Gather, organize, analyze, interpret, and report operational and project data using established methods and procedures
  • Develop and maintain routine reports, dashboards, datasets, documentation, and written procedures
  • Identify and investigate data-quality, reporting, and system issues and refer complex or unresolved issues for additional review
  • Apply logical problem-solving methods, distinguish findings from assumptions, and exercise sound judgment within assigned responsibilities
  • Produce accurate, organized work while maintaining attention to detail
  • Consistently apply established data, information security, privacy, and data-handling standards and procedures
  • Communicate analytical results and technical information effectively to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge
  • Work collaboratively with operational, analytical, and technical staff
  • Communicate effectively in the English language at a level necessary for efficient job performance
  • Perform all essential functions as assigned by an authorized employee, supervisor and/or manager with or without reasonable accommodation

Preferred Knowledge, Experience, And Training

Two years of experience providing data collection, validation, reporting, analysis, system support, or related services.

Experience with Excel, Power BI, SQL, databases, or operational information systems.

Familiarity with computerized maintenance or enterprise asset management systems, including VueWorks or a comparable platform, and with facilities, fleet, public works, utility, work order, maintenance, or asset data.

Special Requirements

Applicants must be able to pass:

City of Boise background check processes which includes a criminal history check and reference checks in accordance with the City of Boise Hiring Process Regulation

Hybrid Work Eligible

Working Conditions

The physical effort characteristics and working environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Efforts

While performing the duties of this job the employee is occasionally lifting/carrying up to 10 pounds and rarely lifting/carrying up to 35 pounds. Also, the employee is rarely pushing/pulling up to 35 pounds. Work includes sensory ability to talk, hear and touch. Work in this position also includes close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision and depth perception. Employees will sit, stand and walk.

Working Environment

The work environment will include inside conditions.

Under limited supervision, this position is responsible for gathering, extracting, compiling, and analyzing data to create comprehensive reports that will be used to support decision making. Specifically, this position will conduct analysis using data from internal and external sources, prepare reports and research briefs, present findings through oral presentations at meetings and conferences. Further, will assist in data validation and play a vital role in building and maintaining data dictionaries and glossaries, and documenting data related processes. Performs related duties as assigned.

Associate’s degree. Bachelor’s degree in an analytical field, such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering, or social sciences strongly preferred.

An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Four years of experience in data extraction and validation, statistical analysis, reporting writing, and making presentations in related field, preferably in a higher education setting in which conducting data analysis and reporting findings is/was the primary function; the experience includes software, i.e. Power BI, Power Query, DAX formulas, or SQL database management platforms like SSMS or pgAdmin and/or other statistical software (not including spreadsheet packages); and, experience with database software, i.e. SAS, Access, SQL, Paradox, dBase and/or other database software.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Arrive Logistics is a leading transportation and technology company in North America with plans to grow significantly year over year. Our success is a testament to our remarkable team and what we’re building together. We’re committed to providing employees with a meaningful work experience and have established an award-winning culture that supports personal and career development in a fun, casual, and collaborative environment.


Who We Want

Arrive Logistics is seeking a highly-motivated Reporting Analyst I to join our team. Our strong data-driven culture offers a unique opportunity for an analyst looking to make an immediate impact across all functions and at all levels of the organization. As the fastest growing logistics brokerage in history, we are seeking someone who will thrive in a fast paced and evolving environment.


What You'll Do

  • Develop reports, dashboards and interactive visualizations using different components of Microsoft Power BI.
  • Create ad-hoc analysis in support of department leadership using Snowflake SQL queries
  • Continuously monitor performance to identify improvements in models and do related work as required.
  • Create and interpret analytics to share findings and recommendations with the internal team and other stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to understand priorities, business needs, and functions.
  • Collaborate with the Analytics Engineering team to determine and address data and reporting needs for various company projects.
  • Handle sensitive information in a confidential manner.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree or 2 years of equivalent experience.
  • Basic knowledge of database, table, and dataset design is desired.
  • Experience using data analytics tools including Excel, Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, SSRS, MS Report Builder.
  • Detail oriented with strong independent critical thinking, organization, and time management skills to meet strict deadlines in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Ability to learn and understand a business model and fully comprehend operational concepts, relationships between those concepts and data being utilized.


The Perks of Working With Us

  • Take advantage of our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental coverage.
  • Invest in your future with our matching 401(k) program.
  • Build relationships and take part in learning opportunities through our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Enjoy office wide engagement activities, team events, happy hours and more!
  • Leave the suit and tie at home; our dress code is casual.
  • Work in the heart of downtown Chicago, IL!
  • Sweat it out at the LifeStart gym in our office building that includes brand new Peloton bikes, top-of-the-line equipment and personal training options.
  • Maximize your wellness with free counseling sessions through our Employee Assistance Program
  • Take time to manage your physical and mental health - we offer company paid holidays, paid vacation time and wellness days.
  • Receive 100% paid parental leave when you become a new parent.
  • Get paid to work with your friends through our Referral Program!
  • Get relocation assistance! If you are not local to the area, we offer relocation packages.


$62,000 - $78,000 a year

The base salary range for this position is $62,000 - $78,000, plus bonus and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on work location, job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training.


Your Arrive Experience

When we say “award-winning culture,” we mean it. We’ve been recognized as a top workplace by Inc. Fast Company, Fortune, and earned Top Workplaces and Great Place to Work, to name a few. We intend on topping many more of those lists in the years to come, but we’re not in it for the trophies. We’re committed to culture because it keeps us connected to each other and invested in our shared success while having a blast along the way. Our employee-founded resource groups create communities within Arrive’s walls, including Women in Logistics, Emerging Professionals, Prisms, Black Logistics Group, Salute and Unidos.


Notice:

To ensure a safe and transparent interview process, we want to note that Arrive Logistics adheres to strict recruitment practices. Candidates undergo an interview process, and Arrive Logistics does not provide unsolicited job offers. If you have concerns about receiving a fraudulent offer, please contact talentacquisition@arrivelogistics.com for verification.

Chevron is accepting online applications for the position Communications Data Analyst through 11/20/2026 at 11:59 p.m. Central Time.  

About The Role

The Communications Data Analyst makes Chevron’s communications data reliable, accessible, and useful for decision-making.

You will use SQL to query and prepare data from our communications data lake, build and maintain dashboards, investigate data quality issues, and manage the taxonomy that supports consistent reporting across channels. You will help communicators understand the data available to them and turn their questions into reporting requirements and practical analysis.

Our IT and data engineering partners build and maintain the pipelines. You will work closely with them to define requirements, validate new data sources and fields, and resolve issues that affect reporting.

About The Team

Corporate Affairs manages social, political, and reputational risks for Chevron and engages the workforce to advance the business. Within Global Communications, the AI, Data & Insights team brings together research, intelligence, measurement, and insights to help communicators set priorities, sharpen strategy, anticipate issues, and understand how their work contributes to Corporate Affairs objectives.

We ground communications strategy in a deeper understanding of audiences and issues, provide intelligence to help teams anticipate and navigate the broader public affairs environment, and use measurement and insights to assess where communications are making a difference. Working across owned, earned, paid, and internal communications, we help teams make informed decisions, evaluate effectiveness, and focus their efforts where they can have the greatest impact.

What You Will Do

  • Query and prepare data. Write SQL to pull, join, filter, and aggregate data from the data lake for recurring reports and ad hoc questions. Know where each source lives and how tables relate across owned, earned, paid, and internal channels.
  • Build dashboards and reports.Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports in Power BI or Tableau that show performance against KPIs, using approved metric definitions. Document reporting calculations, source dependencies, and known data limitations.
  • Check data quality. Review data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness before it reaches reporting. Investigate discrepancies, identify their cause, and coordinate resolution with channel owners, agency partners, and engineering teams.
  • Own the taxonomy workflow.Manage the operation and continuous improvement of the Chevron Taxonomy across owned, earned, paid, and internal communications. Develop and maintain classification, naming, and tracking standards through the agreed governance process. Oversee tracking code generation, validation, audits, and training, and coordinate cross-platform mapping and corrections with channel owners, agency partners, and data engineering teams.
  • Translate needs into requirements.Turn communicators’ reporting needs into clear requirements for IT and data engineering partners, then test new data sources and fields against those requirements once they are delivered.
  • Analyze communications performance. Identify and explain trends, anomalies, and changes in campaign and channel performance. Prepare analysis for campaign readouts and partner with research and measurement colleagues on deeper evaluation and impact assessment.
  • Help teams use data. Show communicators where to find data and how to use dashboards, so more questions get answered through self-service.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of analytics or business intelligence experience, including work with communications, marketing, or public affairs data
  • Proficiency in SQL, including joining multiple tables, filtering and aggregating data, and validating query results
  • Experience working in a data lake or data warehouse: navigating schemas, finding the right tables, and understanding how fields, metrics, and dimensions connect
  • Experience managing content or campaign taxonomies, naming conventions, and tracking standards, including governance, implementation, and data audits
  • Hands-on experience with data from communications and marketing platforms such as Sprinklr, Meltwater, Google Analytics, and social media analytics tools
  • Proven ability to build dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI or Tableau
  • Strong attention to data quality, with a habit of checking numbers and chasing down discrepancies
  • Ability to explain data issues to non-technical colleagues and describe reporting needs clearly to technical teams
  • Advanced Excel skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience querying data in Databricks, Azure Synapse, or a similar platform
  • Familiarity with how ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Adverity feed reporting data
  • Experience with taxonomy or naming-convention management platforms
  • Experience working with data from internal communications platforms such as Staffbase or Viva Engage
  • Python or R for analysis
  • Use of AI-assisted tools for analysis, data checks, or documentation

Relocation Options

Relocation will be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

Regulatory Disclosure for US Positions

  • The compensation and reference to benefits for this role is listed on this posting in compliance with applicable law. Please note that the compensation and benefits listed below are only applicable for U.S. payroll offers.
  • The anticipated salary range for this position is $137,600 - $206,400. The selected candidate’s compensation will be determined based on their skills, experience, and qualifications.
  • Chevron offers competitive compensation and benefits programs which includes, but is not limited to, variable pay, health care coverage, retirement plan, protection coverage, time off and leave programs, training and development opportunities and a range of allowances connected to specific work situations. Details are available at http://hr2.chevron.com/.

This position is responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring/maintaining operational performance metrics, reports, and dashboards that support both regulatory compliance and informed business decision-making.

Additionally, this role contributes to the collaborative development of strategic frameworks, roadmaps, and project plans aimed at continuously improving performance accuracy, efficiency, and overall operational effectiveness.

Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications.   • Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.

  • Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

  • Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
  • Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.

  • Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

About Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what is important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

About The Role

The Senior Analyst, Client Reporting is primarily responsible for client reporting, qualitative and quantitative analysis for the Institutional and Wealth Management sales organizations. The position will require teamwork and collaboration with multiple departments. Although interactions with the end client are limited, the role is focused on providing exceptional client service through timely and accurate analysis and reporting.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare quarterly, monthly and ad hoc analysis and client reporting for institutional and\or wealth management clients.
  • Perform detailed review of client deliverables.
  • Design, prepare and review custom institutional client reports utilizing Factset, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Assist with designing tactical reporting solutions for new products.
  • Manage the timely and accurate delivery of all requests.
  • Ability to train, coach and educate new staff members on processes and systems.
  • Ability to lead projects/initiatives with limited direction: Exhibits clear project management skills: managing deadlines, keeping all stakeholders informed, anticipating roadblocks, preparing back-up plans, etc.
  • Investigate portfolio specific inquiries.
  • Develop a specialized knowledge of all relevant Parametric products and strategies.
  • Uphold department reputation through professionalism, accuracy, responsiveness and commitment to client service.
  • Develop a full working knowledge of the firm's structure, key personnel and organizational policies and procedures, in addition to a functional knowledge of a professional services environment.
  • Act as a back-up for the Supervisor when needed.
  • Assume other responsibilities as required.

Job Requirements

  • 4-year degree, preferably in related discipline such as economics or finance.
  • 3-5 years of industry experience.
  • Strong math/quantitative skills and analytical writing ability.
  • Proficient in Excel including using V-Lookup and PivotTables.
  • Ability to excel independently and in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to maintain productivity and strong work ethic under minimal supervision.
  • Working knowledge of statistics and familiarity with the principles of portfolio management.
  • Possess excellent communication and organizational skills and be able to handle a heavy, deadline-oriented workload.
  • Ability to successfully manage and coordinate simultaneous multiple-level projects and tasks with internal departments.
  • High attention to detail and strong sense of urgency.
  • Must possess a high level of initiative.
  • Familiarity with Factset, Bloomberg and other analysis tools is a plus.
  • Proficiency in macro and code writing is a plus.
  • Completion of Level I or higher of the CFA program a plus.

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Salary range for the position: $70,000-$140,000/Yr. The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary incentive compensation award. The successful candidate may be eligible to participate in the relevant business unit's incentive compensation plan, which also may include a discretionary bonus component. Morgan Stanley offers a full spectrum of benefits, including Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Dependent Day Care Savings Account, Life Insurance, Disability and Other Insurance Plans, Paid Time Off (including Sick Leave consistent with state and local law, Parental Leave and 20 Vacation Days annually), 10 Paid Holidays, 401(k), and Short/Long Term Disability, in addition to other special perks reserved for our employees. Please visit mybenefits.morganstanley.com to learn more about our benefit offerings.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $70,000 and $140,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

The Reporting & KPI Analyst will play a key role in monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on the organization’s key performance indicators (KPIs) to support data-driven decision-making. This individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining performance dashboards, generating insights, and creating standardized reports to help stakeholders understand trends and measure progress against targets. This role ensures data integrity, timely reporting, and the accuracy of various performance indicators. The Reporting and KPI analyst will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide clear insights that support strategic decision-making.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Data Collection & Analysis: Gather, process, and analyze data from various sources to produce insights on KPIs and performance metrics.
  • KPI Monitoring: Track and report on KPIs regularly, highlighting variances from targets and identifying areas of opportunity or concern.
  • Reporting & Dashboard Development: Create, maintain, and improve dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations that present KPIs and trends in a clear, actionable format.
  • Collaborative Insights: Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., Consulting, Client Services, Accounting, Plan Administration, Operations) to understand their KPI needs and provide insights to guide strategic decisions.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data by conducting regular audits and identifying potential data quality issues.
  • Performance Evaluation: Analyze performance against benchmarks, forecasting future performance trends, and providing recommendations for improvement.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements to streamline reporting, enhance data accuracy, and improve KPI tracking systems.
  • Documentation & Training: Document reporting processes and provide training to users on accessing and interpreting reports.
  • Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
  • Our I-Client service philosophy and our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always® should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day basis showing your support of our organizational culture.

Supervision

  • N/A

Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Statistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of KPI frameworks, data analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills to present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of experience in a data analysis or reporting role.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Excel).
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and data modeling is a plus.
  • Experience in a similar industry or domain (e.g., finance, e-commerce, healthcare).
  • Familiarity with ERP or CRM systems and data extraction processes.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages like Python or R.

For all virtual remote positions, in order to ensure associates can effectively perform their job duties with no distractions, we require an uninterrupted virtual workspace and there is also an expectation of family care being in place during business hours. Additionally, there is an internet work speed requirement of 25 Mbps or better for individual use. If more than one person is utilizing the same internet connection in the same household or building, then a stronger connection is required. If you are unsure of your internet speed, please check with your service provider. Note: For call center roles specifically, it is a requirement to either hardwire your equipment directly to the internet router or ensure your workstation is in close proximity to the router. Please ensure that you are able to meet these expectations before applying.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

descriptionHtml:
Michael Best is seeking a Financial Data Analyst to work in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee or Waukesha offices! The Financial Data Analyst supports the Firm’s financial reporting, budgeting, and analytical functions while helping develop and maintain the technical reporting solutions used by Finance & Accounting. Reporting to the Financial Reporting & Analysis Supervisor, this role prepares recurring and ad hoc financial reports, assists with the annual budget, analyzes financial and operational data, writes SQL queries, supports Power BI and other reporting tools, validates data, and helps improve reporting processes. The position combines foundational accounting and financial analysis with hands-on data and reporting work and is suited for an early-career professional with practical experience who wants to grow both financial and technical expertise.


Core responsibilities:

  • Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages used to evaluate Firm, practice group, client, department, and individual performance.
  • Produce recurring and customized financial and operational reports for internal stakeholders and external requests.
  • Support development of the annual budget by gathering assumptions, building and maintaining budget schedules and models, consolidating submissions, and analyzing proposed results.
  • Assist with forecasts, budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, and follow-up with budget owners.
  • Analyze general ledger, revenue, expense, productivity, and other financial data; investigate variances and reconcile reporting results to source systems.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to extract, combine, validate, troubleshoot, and analyze financial data. SQL knowledge is required for this role.
  • Gather and summarize information for surveys, RFP responses, client reporting requests, peer benchmarking, and ad hoc business questions.


Stakeholder partnership:

  • Collaborate with Accounting, Billing, Financial Applications, Legal Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver accurate reporting solutions.
  • Work with department leaders and budget owners to collect budget information, explain report results, and resolve data or reporting questions.
  • Maintain a responsive, service-oriented approach and communicate financial and technical information clearly to non-technical users.


Programs/initiatives:

  • Participate in testing, data validation, documentation, and implementation of reporting enhancements, system changes, and integrations.


Process, tools, and reporting:

  • Use SQL, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and financial systems to develop, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, budget models, and analytical tools.
  • Create and maintain SQL queries, data extracts, reporting datasets, and recurring processes with appropriate validation and documentation.
  • Support data imports, exports, interfaces, reconciliations, reporting structures, account and expense coding, and other data-quality processes.
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues, identify root causes, test corrections, and help users understand results.


Continuous improvement / strategy:

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, budgeting, reconciliation, and data-preparation activities.
  • Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, financial models, and reporting processes that increase accuracy, efficiency, and usability.
  • Build knowledge of the Firm’s financial systems, data structures, accounting processes, and business intelligence tools.


Job Requirements:


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a comparable business or applied sciences discipline required.


Experience:

  • One to three years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, reporting, data analysis, or financial systems work preferred. Relevant internships combined with post-graduate professional experience may be considered.
  • Working knowledge of accounting concepts, financial statements, general ledger data, reconciliations, and budget development.
  • Required experience writing and executing SQL queries against relational databases. Candidates must be able to use SQL to retrieve, join, filter, validate, and analyze data.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, charts, and analysis of large data sets.
  • Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or a similar reporting or business intelligence platform preferred.
  • Experience with Aderant Expert or another financial, accounting, billing, or ERP system preferred.
  • Law firm or professional services experience preferred but not required.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect financial results to underlying data.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accurate, well-documented work.
  • Ability to manage recurring deadlines while responding to ad hoc requests and changing priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data and financial information to varied audiences.
  • Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in accounting, budgeting, SQL, reporting tools, and financial systems.
  • Collaborative, service-oriented approach and sound judgment about when to resolve an issue independently or escalate it.
  • Required: Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively to improve quality, efficiency, and decision-making, consistent with organizational policies, confidentiality, and applicable laws.


The Company

This is an opportunity to work with the Best. We are Michael Best & Friedrich, LLP. We are a full-service law firm with more than 350 lawyers and technical professionals who work in collaborative, interdisciplinary practices to serve clients around the world.


We work with companies in all kinds of industries, as well as trade associations, nonprofits, educational institutions, governments, family trusts, and high-net-worth individuals. Since our firm’s founding in 1848, we’ve continuously evolved to meet our clients’ changing needs and expectations. One thing remains the same: For generations, clients have relied on Michael Best for exceptional legal service and business acumen.


The Location

We have offices in Wisconsin (Green Bay, Madison, Milwaukee, Waukesha); Illinois (Chicago); Utah (Salt Lake City); Colorado (Denver, Broomfield); Texas (Austin); North Carolina (Charlotte, Durham, Raleigh, Wilmington); California (Los Angeles); Nebraska (Lincoln); New York (New York City); and Washington DC. Our contemporary office spaces are ideal for concentration and collaboration; supporting our culture of working together to make great things happen for our Clients. This position can be based in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee, or Waukesha offices.


Why You Should Apply

At Michael Best, we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards package that provides a variety of resources designed to enhance its employees’ overall well-being, both at work and at home. Competitive base pay, outstanding benefits, opportunities for learning and growth, programs designed to help you plan for the future, and perks that inspire your downtime are all part of our total compensation package.

As well as our three offices in the US, we have three offices in the UK and another in Australia. Further expansion is planned for 2027 and beyond which means global career opportunities for you, with plenty of potential to explore new markets.

When you join our Team, you will have the opportunity to contribute and make an impact every single day.

Overview

The Reporting Analyst is responsible for producing complete, accurate, and timely financial and executive reporting that supports business decision-making, financial performance monitoring, and operational effectiveness. The role delivers meaningful performance insights while enhancing reporting solutions, data quality, and processes.

The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Commercial, Risk, and other business teams to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and aligned with organizational objectives.

This position is eligible for a hybrid working arrangement, requiring a minimum of 2-3 days per week worked in-office.

The anticipated salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000 annually. This position is eligible to participate in our company bonus.

In this role, you will be involved with the following:

Reporting & Data Analysis

  • Produce monthly and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders.
  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and performance drivers.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Ensure data integrity through validation, reconciliation, and quality control processes.
  • Present findings and recommendations in a clear and concise manner.

Business Performance Reporting

  • Assist in the preparation of monthly reporting packages and supporting analysis.
  • Analyze actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Provide commentary and insights on significant variances and business drivers.
  • Assist in the preparation of executive and board-level reporting materials.

Data Management & Systems

  • Extract, transform, and analyze data from various systems and databases.
  • Maintain reporting models and automate recurring reporting processes where possible.
  • Partner with IT and business teams to improve reporting tools, processes, and data availability.
  • Document reporting methodologies, assumptions, and data sources.

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, accuracy, and automation.
  • Support implementation of new reporting tools and business intelligence solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across reporting and analytics functions.

Governance & Controls

  • Ensure reporting complies with internal controls, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain traceable support and audit trails for key reports.
  • Support audit requests and provide reporting-related information as required.

To be successful in this role, you are likely to have the following skills/experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in reporting, financial analysis, business intelligence, or data analytics.
  • Experience preparing management or board packs with written commentary.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and complex formulas.
  • Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the energy, utilities, or commodities sectors.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Workday, QuickBooks or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of financial reporting and budgeting processes.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking
  • Attention to detail
  • Data interpretation
  • Problem-solving
  • Communication and presentation skills
  • Stakeholder management
  • Time management and prioritization
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Diversity

Celebrating our inclusive and diverse culture is core to what we do. We value everybody irrespective of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability and genetic information (including family medical history). EOE.

We know that for our business to thrive we need diverse talent with a range of backgrounds, skills and capabilities in each of the countries in which we operate. We view diversity as one of the key enablers that helps our business to grow.

We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As such, if a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please reach out to the HR & People Team via email us-hrssc@smartestenergy.com so we can discuss with you further.

descriptionHtml:
As a BI analyst, you will play a key role in creating effective reports and dashboards, recommending decisions based on detailed analysis, market forecasts and analysis internally as well as for our shipper and carrier partners.


Role & Responsibilities:

  • Leverage data to provide consultation to sales and operations to meet shipper and carrier requirements
  • Create dashboards and reports to measure performance, automate operational processes, and drive revenue and business decisions
  • Create detailed analysis, outlining problems, opportunities, and solutions for the business
  • Assist in effectively using and maintaining both internal and external data sources
  • Take ownership of organizational initiatives and projects
  • Partner with key internal stakeholders to ensure project success
  • Lead ad-hoc analysis to provide actionable insights to the business
  • Ensure that all departmental deadlines are met
  • Escalate known issues and highlight areas for process improvement


Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field of study, such as finance, accounting, engineering, operations research, math, or statistics
  • 1-2 years data analytics experience


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Solid understanding of data structures and SQL
  • Considerable experience with visualization tools such as Tableau, SSRS, or Power BI
  • Intermediate Excel skills
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines simultaneously
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate with stakeholders
  • Strong time management skills


**MAY PERFORM OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED**


WORK ENVIRONMENT


Standard office environment, usually indoors away from the elements with moderate noise. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


PHYSICAL EFFORT


Maintain a stationary position for extended periods; move about the office, operate computers and files, as needed; and frequently communicate with others. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. Occasionally, the employee is required to lift boxes up to 20 pounds.


SCHEDULING

This is a full-time benefits-eligible position, working Monday through Friday; 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. An employee in this position must be available to work occasionally on weekends and evenings, during peak periods.


TRAVEL

Local travel is required. Out of state travel is limited, but may be required for special training/conferences.


DISCLAIMER

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.


EEOC/ADA STATEMENT:

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, veteran, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law. In an effort to recruit, develop and retain top talent, we are committed to a policy of nondiscrimination in all personnel practices to ensure equal opportunity for employment, promotion, and training for a more inclusive workforce.


RECRUITMENT SCAM NOTICE:

Transportation Insight/Nolan Transportation Group is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Our hiring process includes a formal interview with a member of our recruitment team. We do not conduct interviews exclusively through text or instant messaging platforms. TI/NTG does not require candidates to pay for training, equipment, or any other fees as a condition of employment. Any request for payment is a scam. Official communication from our recruitment team about your application will only come from emails ending in ‘@ntgfreight.com’ or from ‘transportationinsight@myworkday.com.'
