descriptionHtml:
Job Family

Business Intelligence

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Responsible for the measurement, analysis and reporting of key performance indicators and operational performance for the Legal and Corporate Affairs team. Prepares recurring and ad hoc reports and assists with analysis and presentations to support management and compliance reporting, inform business decisions and identify process improvements.

Responsibilities

Job Description

  • Prepare recurring reports on key performance indicators and operational performance for the Legal and Administrative Affairs team.
  • Develop insights and understanding of business performance based on data and statistical methods, identifying trends, variances and opportunities for improvement.
  • Compile, validate and analyze data on executive expenses and use of corporate resources; maintain supporting documentation and prepare timely, accurate reports for management and compliance reporting purposes.
  • Conduct ad hoc reporting and in-depth analysis; communicate findings and recommendations through reports and presentations to support process efficiencies and business decisions.
  • Maintain a thorough knowledge of the business and systems within the supported group; partner with stakeholders to clarify reporting needs, reconcile data and improve reporting processes.
  • Assist in resolving technical issues, such as report/query malfunctions, data discrepancies and lapses in visualization stability or functionality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field or equivalent experience.
  • Three years of experience in data analytics, process improvement or other relevant work.
  • Understanding of data tools for visualization, extraction, modeling, CRM solutions and SQL.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to analyze and create reports.
  • Communication and presentation skills for delivery of reports and analysis.
  • Ability to multi-task and work as part of a team in a dynamic and complex environment.
  • Proficiency using MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in the insurance/financial services industry.
  • Experience using Tableau, SQL and Power BI.

Working Conditions

  • Hybrid Office Environment
    • Occasional Travel
  • Travel to meet with internal and external stakeholders.

    • This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

    Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

    What We Offer

    For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well-being of our employees.

    Compensation Benefits

    • Competitive Pay
    • Bonus for Eligible Employees

    Benefits Package

    • Pension Plan
    • 401k Match
    • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
    • Tuition Reimbursement
    • Disability Insurance
    • Medical Insurance
    • Dental Insurance
    • Vision Insurance
    • Employee Discounts
    • Career Training & Development Opportunities

    Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits

    • Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service.
    • Ten (10) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays).
    • Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars
    • Parental Leave – fifteen (15) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child.
    • Adoption Assistance
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Back-Up Care Program
    • PTO for Volunteer Hours
    • Employee Matching Gifts Program
    • Employee Resource Groups
    • Inclusion and Diversity Programs
    • Employee Recognition Program
    • Referral Bonus Programs

    Inclusion & Diversity 

     

    We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

     

    To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

      

    Giving Back 

     

    We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.   

     

    Transamerica’s Parent Company 

    Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23.9 million people across the globe.* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: Helping people live their best lives. As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity.  

    • As of December 31, 2023

This Senior Data Analyst, Institutional Reporting reports to the Manager of Data Analytics and Data Governance. This position is responsible for preparing, analyzing, validating, and coordinating institutional reports required by state and federal agencies, accrediting bodies, and other external entities. It provides technical expertise in institutional data reporting, supports data quality and integrity, and collaborates with College departments to ensure accurate and timely reporting.

Prepare, validate, and coordinate institutional data reports required by state, federal, and other external agencies, including the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS), Illinois Community College Board (ICCB), and other required reporting entities.

Develop and maintain institutional reporting schedules, reporting specifications, and documentation to support accurate and timely completion of required submissions.

Extract, analyze, and reconcile data from Banner and other institutional information systems to support regulatory reporting and institutional information needs.

Develop, maintain, and validate SQL queries, datasets, recurring reports, and other reporting tools to support institutional reporting requirements.

Identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies in collaboration with College departments, Information Technology, and designated data owners.

Monitor changes to institutional reporting requirements and recommend updates to reporting processes, documentation, and data collection procedures.

Prepare institutional data, reports, and supporting documentation for accreditation, institutional assessment, grant reporting, and other accountability activities.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, including reporting methodologies, data definitions, business rules, and validation procedures.

Collaborate with College departments to identify reporting needs, clarify data requirements, and develop appropriate reporting solutions.

Analyze institutional data and prepare reports, summaries, and visualizations aligned with institutional priorities and strategic planning to support data-informed decision-making.

Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, accuracy, and consistency through process improvements, automation, and standardized reporting practices.

Support institutional data governance initiatives by participating in the development and implementation of data definitions, quality standards, and validation procedures.

Provide technical assistance, documentation, and training to College employees regarding institutional reports, reporting tools, and data interpretation.

Maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and security of institutional information in accordance with College policies and applicable regulations.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Higher Education, Public Administration, Statistics, Information Systems, Business, Social Sciences, or a related field; master's degree preferred.

Three years of progressively responsible experience in data analysis, institutional reporting, business intelligence, or a related field required.

Experience with SQL, relational databases, and reporting or business intelligence tools required.

Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets, validate information, identify discrepancies, and prepare accurate reports required.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills required.

Ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines, work independently, and collaborate effectively with employees across organizational levels required.

Master's degree in a related field preferred.

Experience in higher education institutional research, institutional reporting, or regulatory reporting preferred.

Experience with Banner, Argos, Power BI, or similar enterprise reporting tools preferred.

Experience preparing IPEDS, ICCB, or other state and federal higher education reports preferred.

Knowledge of Higher Learning Commission accreditation, institutional assessment, and data governance practices preferred.

Experience with reporting automation, data quality assurance, and continuous improvement initiatives preferred.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are looking for a customer-centric and detail-oriented Data Analyst II to join the Customer Reporting team. Reporting to the Manager, Customer Reporting, you will be responsible for delivering custom and standard reporting that demonstrates the impact of Spring Health to its customers. You will collaborate closely with Customer Success and Subject Matter Experts to refine Spring’s storytelling strategy and data artifacts. This role is expected to support a combination of ad hoc requests and dashboard development.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 44 Montgomery Street location. Candidates must be based in the San Francisco metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites. Periodic travel of up to 25% is expected for team collaboration and company events. If you are passionate about using data to create meaningful impact and thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Delivering analyses and dashboards to customers and internal stakeholders they need to tell compelling stories about Spring Health’s impact
  • Diving into different data sources, quickly building expertise on what is possible, and developing creative solutions based on your stakeholder’s needs
  • Developing a deep understanding of our products and how we tell the story of their impact to customers
  • Collaborate with Product to inform how we evolve our customer data story and expand our standard suite of reporting
  • Surface opportunities to automate and scale commonly requested reports and data sets
  • Become an expert working with our data stack including Snowflake, Looker, dbt, and Hex

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers and internal stakeholders are highly satisfied with the quality of work produced
  • Customers and internal stakeholders trust the data provided to them; reports and data sets are reviewed for data consistency and data quality
  • Requests are completed in a timely manner while still prioritizing a high standard of quality
  • Bring ideas forward that can reduce the amount of time spent manually pulling data to inform decisions
  • Dashboards and analyses deliver ongoing value to stakeholders

What You’ll Bring

  • You are strong with SQL and are able to effectively query data across many sources
  • You have 3+ years of working experience working with data, data visualization, and dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.
  • Strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail
  • You focus on impact, finding the things you can deliver that deliver the most value for your stakeholders
  • You have exceptional communication skills, are comfortable explaining technical concepts to a non-technical audience
  • You are humble, highly motivated, and thrive in fast-paced environments
  • You have a passion for successfully navigating ambiguous problem areas and learning new approaches
  • Prior experience with R is nice to have
  • Prior experience with dbt is nice to have

descriptionHtml:
Chubb Benefits, is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our fast-paced, high energy, growing company. We are proud of our tradition of success in the insurance industry of over 100 years. Come join our team of hard-working, talented professionals!


Job Summary

This position will be responsible for the development of Business Intelligence dashboards and analysis using Snowflake & Power BI . He/she will work closely with the Director of business Intelligence and functional leadership to deliver on the design, development, programming, meta data, maintenance, and publication of reports that play a key role in driving business decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Create data visualizations and transform data into innovative dashboard designs
  • Maintain large sets of data that require validation, cleansing, and troubleshooting
  • Create and maintain online automated reports using Power BI; update and maintain Excel, SQL sources as well as semantic models & metadata to ensure data quality
  • Debug technical issues when they arise
  • Respond to ad hoc requests for analysis and reports from internal stakeholders including Sales, Operations, Marketing, Underwriting, Legal, Actuarial, Training, and IT
  • Develop skills and leverage Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI & Snowflake to drive functional efficiencies and deliver high-quality information solutions
  • Analyze and integrate data from multiple sources
  • Leverage a foundational understanding of AI tools to support personal productivity


Skills and Experience

  • Three to five years experience. Knowledge of insurance/claim industry plus
  • Excellent technical skills including advanced knowledge of Excel
  • Excellent knowledge of SQL programming language
  • Business Intelligence and/or dashboard experience; DAX programming knowledge and Power BI a plus!
  • Creative design experience a plus!
  • Experience working with large databases in Snowflake or Azure a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and multi-tasking skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to self-start and work independently to complete assignments in a timely manner
  • Novice to intermediate ability to leverage AI tools (Claude code) to tune reports/code


Education

  • BA required, preferably in IT, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Finance


Location: Chicago, IL (near Rosemont, IL Triangle Plaza) and or other potential locations: Columbia, SC, Chattanooga, TN, Portland, ME


In-Office Expectation: 4 days in office, 1 day remote.


The pay range for the role is $61,000 to $89,000. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled."

Job Overview

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to support organizational decision-making by producing data insights and reports that inform real estate portfolio performance and strategies. It involves collecting and analyzing data on competitive landscapes, pricing comparisons, and content audits to generate analytical reports. The role differentiates itself by synthesizing diverse metrics and industry information to provide actionable intelligence to multiple departments. The work impacts the organization by enabling informed strategic planning and enhancing competitive positioning through data-driven insights.

** This is a hybrid role (3 days/week) in the office and is based in Bellevue, WA **

Job Responsibilities:

  • Collect and analyze portfolio data to produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly analytical reports.
  • Synthesize real estate portfolio metrics and news to generate actionable insights for cross-departmental teams.
  • Build automations using Power-Apps to support business intelligence activities. Compare competitive pricing and audit content to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Respond to and fulfill ad hoc reporting and analysis requests from business partners.
  • Data Validation and/or data quality reviews for new and incoming datasets.
  • Conduct ongoing research on Portfolio trends to support business intelligence activities.
  • Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
  • 2-4 years experience related to business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, or related functions.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate, including building automated workflows, streamlining manual processes, and improving operational efficiency.
  • Experience conducting A/B testing, ad hoc analysis, and data mining to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and deliver actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases, including extracting, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI and/or Tableau to track business performance and support decision-making.
  • Experience with data quality and validation, including identifying discrepancies, fixing data issues, and ensuring accuracy and integrity across reports and datasets.
  • Good business acumen, critical thinking, and analytical skills, with the ability to define business metrics, track benchmarks, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Good communication and partner management skills, with experience gathering business requirements, collaborating with multi-functional teams, and presenting insights to partners.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using Python for data analysis, manipulation, or process automation.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to support data analysis, reporting, automation, and productivity.
  • At least 18 years of age
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States

descriptionHtml:
Join the Duro-Last team, a brand of Amrize Building Envelope and the world’s largest manufacturer of custom-fabricated commercial roofing solutions.

Were seeking a Finance Analyst who's ready to be part of an innovative, people-first brand shaping the future of the roofing industry.

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Financial Analyst to support financial reporting, business intelligence, and accounting activities. This role will assist with maintaining Power BI reports, analyzing financial data, preparing monthly sales commission reports, and supporting month-end close processes and SOX compliance.

The position provides an opportunity to further develop financial and analytical skills while collaborating with Finance, Sales, and Operations teams.

This is an in-office role. After 90 days of training, the role will be 4 days in office and 1 day remote.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Business Intelligence: Maintain and update Power BI dashboards and recurring business reports.
  • Financial Analysis: Assist with data collection, reporting, and financial analysis to support business decisions.
  • Data Accuracy: Validate financial and operational data and help resolve reporting discrepancies.
  • Month-End Close: Prepare routine journal entries and general ledger reconciliations.
  • Sales Commission Reporting: Prepare monthly sales commission reports, validate supporting data, and assist with resolving reporting discrepancies.
  • SOX Compliance: Maintain supporting documentation and follow established internal control procedures.
  • Accounting Support: Assist with customer credits, rebills, and invoicing adjustments.
  • Process Improvement: Support enhancements to existing reports and routine financial processes.
  • Cross-Functional Support: Collaborate with Finance, Sales, and Operations on reporting and data requests.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree
  • Field of Study Preferred: Accounting, Finance, or Business Management
  • Required Work Experience: Accounting, Finance, and/or Data Analytics
  • 3+ years of related experience required.
  • Required Computer and Software Skills: Power BI, MS Office, Gmail, Infor Mapics ERP (not required, but beneficial)
  • Travel Requirements: No Travel

Additional Requirements

  • Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
  • Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
  • Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
  • Holistic Health & Well-being programs
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
  • Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
  • Paid time off & paid holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
  • Educational Assistance Program
  • Dress for your day

#Duro-Last

- Onsite

Amrize is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Company

NICO National Indemnity Company

Want to work for a company with unparalleled financial strength and stability that offers “large company” benefits with an exciting, friendly, and “small company” atmosphere? Our companies, as members of the Berkshire Hathaway group of Insurance Companies, provides opportunities for professionals interested in just that.

The Insurance Finance Data Analyst, prepares, analyzes, and communicates financial working papers, statistical data, and management information related to insurance and reinsurance operations and contracted insurance programs in support of the Insurance Data Unit (IDU). This role supports financial, accounting, data management, and reporting activities to ensure accurate and timely insurance program analysis and compliance.

This position will be with National Indemnity Company in Omaha, NE and is eligible for Hybrid work after a period of in‑office training. This position is NOT eligible for employer visa sponsorship.

What Will You Do?

  • Analyze, reconcile, and interpret financial and insurance data from multiple sources
  • Prepare working papers, schedules, and financial or statutory reports for assigned programs
  • Process funding and loss payment requests and maintain cash controls, reconciliations, and intercompany settlements
  • Coordinate daily, monthly, and year‑end financial and program information between operating locations and the Omaha office
  • Support maintenance and accuracy of Financial Database systems in coordination with IT and Finance
  • Assist with calculating supplemental reserves and IBNR allocations according to guidelines
  • Develop and maintain spreadsheet and database tools to support reporting and processing needs
  • Compile data and prepare reports for management, regulators, auditors, and other internal partners
  • Stay current on insurance accounting and financial reporting practices
  • Respond to internal and external audit inquiries related to financial data and controls

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
  • One or more years of work experience
  • Knowledge of general accounting principles
  • Personal computer proficiency and experience with basic applications such as Excel and Word

Preferred Knowledge

  • Life or property casualty insurance accounting experience
  • Knowledge of financial reporting
  • Familiarity with company and department practices and procedures
  • Knowledge of statutory accounting principles
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Access

Who Would Excel in This Role?

  • Someone who communicates clearly and professionally and enjoys working with a variety of teams and stakeholders
  • A detail‑oriented individual who takes pride in producing accurate, high‑quality work
  • An organized self‑starter who can manage priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt as needs evolve
  • A collaborative teammate who is also comfortable working independently when needed
  • A curious, analytical thinker who enjoys solving problems and understanding the story behind the data
  • A dependable professional who is flexible during peak periods and supports team success
  • A trusted team member who handles sensitive information with care and discretion

descriptionHtml:
NREIG is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team in the Oklahoma City or Kansas City metropolitan areas. This entry-level role is ideal for professionals looking to grow their analytical skills in a dynamic, data-driven environment. You will support business decisions by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to uncover trends, patterns, and insights.


Essential Functions

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from internal and external sources.
  • Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver insights.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining data documentation and reporting standards.
  • Support ad hoc analysis and contribute to ongoing data initiatives.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends and anomalies.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Power BI for data visualization and reporting.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL for querying and data manipulation.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
  • Strong communication skills to present findings clearly and effectively.
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, and/or Python
  • Understanding of data modeling and ETL processes.
  • Exposure to business intelligence or analytics projects.


Please note that candidates outside of the Oklahoma City or Kansas City metropolitan areas will not be considered at this time. We will only consider candidates who are eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship at this time.

We believe NREIG is for everyone - we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a Business Intelligence Analyst at TQL, you will help transform complex data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making across our Enterprise Sales organization. In this role, you'll partner with sales leaders, compliance teams, and business stakeholders to develop reporting solutions, analyze business performance, and deliver data-driven recommendations that support company growth.


What’s in it for you:

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based rewards 
  • Opportunity to work with industry-leading data and analytics tools 
  • Collaborative team environment with strong mentorship and career growth opportunities
  • Hybrid work environment with the ability to work remotely 40 hours per month


What you’ll be doing:

  • Analyze business data to identify trends, opportunities, and performance insights
  • Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills 
  • Ability to learn quickly and thrive in a fast-paced environment

descriptionHtml:
Haymarket’s Medical Communication Group is looking for a talented Data Analyst, Client Reporting and Insights to join our growing team. We recognize individual talent and skill; we encourage personal and professional development; and we reward success. If you believe that you have the talent, enthusiasm, and spirit and can match the exacting standards set by our employees, then we’d be delighted to welcome you to the team. This position is located in our New York, NY office on a hybrid work schedule; three (3) days in office depending on business needs.


Job Overview:

The Data Analyst, who will report to the Director, Client Reporting and Insights, will be responsible for delivering client-facing insights and reports for Medical Communication custom digital programs for our clients. In the short term, this role will be focused on transitioning existing report generation in-house with an eye towards enhanced automation. Over time, working with the larger Insights and Reporting team, there will be an opportunity to inform and evolve the offering based on changing client needs and enhanced technology. Data, Analytics and Reporting are high profile areas within Haymarket. This is an opportunity for the right candidate to contribute to a high growth area of the business.


Responsibilities:

  • Production of several types of formatted weekly / monthly reports for clients based on specifications provided by client
  • Work with Business Intelligence / Development teams as needed to facilitate addition of new data points to existing reports as requested by clients
  • Work collaboratively with other members of the Client Insights and Reporting team to maintain consistent SOPs across different business units
  • Identify points in workflow that would be best served through automation
  • Define requirements needed to automate reports or steps in the report generation workflow
  • Collect and interpret data from multiple sources, analyze results, and provide ongoing insights
  • Define and develop reporting insights considering client KPI’s
  • Use dashboards within data visualization tools to provide actionable data for marketing and sales teams


Skills and Requirements:

  • BS/MS degree in related field
  • Ideally three (3) years of relevant experience in a data role: business analytics or product analytics (software)
  • Advanced Google Sheets / Excel skills: Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, SumIf, CountIfs, etc; Power Query
  • Experience in creating and maintaining reports and dashboards (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, etc)
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience with Google Big Query, Google Analytics
  • End-to-end experience with data, including querying, formatting, aggregation, and analysis
  • Experience in combining data of various formats into a single format
  • Strong reporting and QA skills with the ability to collect and organize data with attention to detail and accuracy, such as the ability to identify extreme outliers and understand their cause
  • Yearn to ask questions to gain a better understanding of a concept or the data
  • Ability to think creatively about challenging problems
  • Must be a strong collaborator and communicator


What We Offer:

  • A competitive compensation package
  • The salary range for this position is $70K–$90K. Compensation will be commensurate with experience, skill level, functional and/or industry knowledge, education level, certifications, as well as other qualifications.
  • Paid annual vacation, holiday and sick time off
  • Comprehensive health plans including medical, dental and vision
  • Competitive 401(k) investment options and generous company matching program
  • Life insurance
  • Commuter benefits
  • Employee referral awards
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Work from anywhere option to ensure work life balance
  • Training opportunities through industry-recognized programs
  • A creative and passionate workplace and a fun, collaborative team environment
  • Three Week “Work from Anywhere” benefit, to ensure work life balance

Haymarket Media, Inc. is an award-winning specialist content and information company. With more than 30 market-leading media brands, Haymarket offers unmatched expertise and insight through balanced, relevant, original content across a spectrum of media channels. Haymarket is home to highly regarded health care professional brands such as The Clinical Advisor, Dermatology Advisor, and MPR (Medical Professionals Reference) among a portfolio of HCP-focused, specialty-specific websites, as well as the esteemed business media titles including PRWeek, MM+M (Medical Marketing and Media), Campaign and McKnight’s Long-Term Care News.


Haymarket Media, Inc. is the US division of Haymarket Media Group. Haymarket Media Group is a privately-owned media, data and information company, shaping a better future with remarkable content for specialist audiences across the world. The company has 1,300 employees across offices in the UK, US, Canada, Hong Kong, Singapore, India, Germany and the Netherlands. Haymarket’s portfolio consists of more than 70 market-leading brands including Campaign, Third Sector, What Car?, MyCME and Asian Investor. Through live, digital, print, education, data, tech services, video and audio, Haymarket’s brands inspire, inform and empower clients and communities internationally. As a Certified B Corporation, we’re proud to be part of a community of companies working together for change, and taking part in collective action to advocate for a shared goal of a global economy that benefits people and the planet.

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications. The Analyst will work with several databases to pull and integrate data, statistical analysis and data modeling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.
  • Determine, write and present report results with key findings and trends to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Complete multiple concurrent ad-hoc analyses, provide corresponding reports based on customer specifications, determine and communicate analytical conclusions and recommendations.
  • Develop beginner to intermediate level reports and ad-hoc analysis based on specifications outlined by department management. Automate such reports and ensure that they are performed and delivered on schedule.
  • Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
  • Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to converse and write fluently in English.
  • Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree Required. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred.
  • Demonstrated use of analytical software. SAS or SQL preferred.
  • Experience in Power BI, Tableau or similar software preferred.1-2 years of related experience preferred.

CommunityCare is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin

This position is 100% on-site Monday through Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm in Stevens Point, WI.

This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the U.S.A. without the need for visa sponsorship.

 Application Deadline (Estimated): Applications will be accepted through December 9th, 2026, however, this timeline may be adjusted based on business needs and candidate volume.

What To Expect

  • Develop, manage, and maintain data solutions and interactive dashboards using Power BI.
  • Collaborate with business units to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights that address key challenges.
  • Build and adapt data models to support evolving reporting needs, optimizing for both performance and usability.
  • Partner with BI developers and analysts to design efficient data flows and ensure high-quality report outputs.
  • Write clear specifications and documentation for new and updated reports, ensuring accuracy through thorough testing.
  • Support the transition of reporting from on-premises sources to Microsoft Fabric, leveraging the Fabric Data Lake as the primary data source.
  • Seek opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process improvements.
  • Stay current with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related BI technologies to bring forward best practices and innovative solutions.

What You Will Contribute

  • Bachelor’s degree or 3 - 4 years of data analyst experience in a related field.
  • Strong understanding of Power BI and dashboarding tools.
  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Excel, SQL, Data warehouse.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of creating/improving business processes.
  • Ability to understand and perform business and functional requirement analysis.
  • Strong mathematical skills for writing Excel formulas and applying statistical concepts.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
  • Experience with SQL, DataMarts, PowerQuery, and PowerAutomate.
  • Strong analytical and logical skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Certifications related to Microsoft Fabric are preferred.
  • Character qualities: thoroughness, dependability, orderliness, persistence and responsibility

What You Will Receive

  • The salary range for this position is $70,000 - $80,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life, 401(k) with matching, HSA with company contribution.
  • Earn up to 15 paid days off annually.
  • Paid Holidays on business workdays.
  • Company-paid on-site wellness meals.
  • Gym membership reimbursement.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Voluntary benefits: short-term disability, whole/term life, hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident expense.

  • On-staff health coach, one-on-one or group coaching.

Our team is purpose-driven, values-based, and service-focused. We are looking for like-minded people who want to join the movement that is changing the way healthcare is being delivered.

At Wilson Elser, we are redefining what it means to work at a national law firm. With more than 1,400 attorneys across 46 offices nationwide, we are recognized among the top 100 law firms by The American Lawyer and ranked #30 in the National Law Journal’s survey of the nation’s largest law firms.

Summary

Data Analyst opportunity focused on turning raw data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will collect, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, uncover trends and patterns and present your findings in ways that help leadership make informed business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with proficiency in data visualization tools and excellent communication skills – able to make complex data clear and actionable in support of the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI,
    Tableau, or Excel.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and provide
    actionable insights.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements to data collection and management
    processes.
  • Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning through data analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics or related field.
  • 1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing databases.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence tools.

Description

Location: Only in Minnesota - Remote or within commutable distance to the Bloomington, MN office.

Why Work for Us?

As a company, we are dedicated to treating each other and our employees with compassion, respect, and care. This has contributed to our ability to help others and to proudly say we have been named one of the nation’s Best and Brightest Companies to work for eight years in a row.

R3 firmly believes that working together to achieve greatness is imperative to positively impacting the lives of others. This collaborative spirit is part of everything we do. Our leadership and diverse team members all embrace this truth: when we join forces, we are unstoppable when it comes to making tomorrow better than today for people.

R3 Continuum provides eligible full-time employees with a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, paid time off, paid parental leave, bonus program, and more.

Join a company dedicated to helping people and organizations thrive.

Data Analyst I Essential Functions

  • Process report or data requests from various departments using probing questions to get to root need and fully understand how the data will be used to make business decisions
  • Complete the report documentation and update the document library as the tasks and projects are completed
  • Interpret data requests to create reports and determine appropriate method of data analysis required
  • Design and build reports from existing databases in easy to read format for daily, weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly use that include helpful report definitions or excel formulas for user analysis as needed
  • Work closely with users and management to establish requirements for new reports or modifications and ensure proper testing and validation of completed reports
  • Interpret data and analyze results using statistical techniques as needed to meet data report request
  • Advise requestor on how to interpret the data, what data is included/excluded, and how to translate numbers or data into understandable terms.
  • Collaborate with other teams to identify reporting needs and recommend innovative ideas such as automation, report improvement, efficiency improvement etc.
  • Responsible for timely implementation of data requests and provide a high level of service to all internal users and external customers
  • Repair and update existing reports as needed due to reported bugs or developmental changes
  • Resolve complaints with reports and respond to suggestions for improvements and enhancements
  • Attend huddle(s) of the support area on a monthly basis to assess needs and opportunities for improvement
  • Play a key role for testing the Analytics Database to ensure results are accurate and writing user stories
  • Audit critical reports as needed (monthly, quarterly)
  • Schedule and provide on-going PBI training to the PBI users
  • Review the report usage metrics to track the user engagement and follow up with the stakeholders to determine the next steps to improve the functionality of the reports.
  • Attend planning sessions with the Project Manager to determine the timelines and task names
  • Responsible for updating the Planner or the other project management tool as the tasks are completed

Secondary Functions

  • Participate in department and company meetings, as requested
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Overtime/Additional Hours – There are times in which overtime/additional hours will be mandatory due to an increase in work and the need to meet turnaround time frames

Requirements

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • 3+ years of experience
  • Ability to build SSRS reports
  • Ability to write SQL queries.
  • Ability to use Power BI including DAX and M language.
  • Proficiency with SharePoint, Excel, and Power Platform (or other automation tools)
  • Strong understand of RDBMS and data modeling.
  • Strong data consistency and results logic check.
  • Deductive and inductive reasoning
  • Problem sensitivity, ability to recognize the existence of problems
  • Ability to ask probing questions and willingness to experiment in order to learn
  • Ability to resolve data issues, and make recommendations as needed
  • Proven ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive business information
  • Ability to manage and prioritize workload
  • Ability to give consistent and concise direction/communication
  • Excellent skills in English usage, grammar, punctuation and style
  • Ability to operate successfully with strategic and tactical level issues and to effectively manage multiple and diverse issues; good judgment with the ability to make timely and sound decisions based on data and business acumen
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

Physical Work Requirements

Work is generally sedentary in nature but may require standing and walking for up to 10% of the time. Lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous or unpleasant conditions caused by noise, dust, etc. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available.

The starting pay range for this position is $30.00- 35.00 per hour. The position’s pay range represents the national average pay for similar roles. R3 considers factors such as (but not limited to) experience, internal pay equity and other business considerations when extending an offer.

All applicants must reside in the United States. Employment contingent on a successful background check, work history verification, reference checks, and signing a non-disclosure agreement.

R3 Continuum is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact our Human Resources department at hr@r3c.com.

Salary Description

$$30.00- 35.00 per hour

Job Description

NOTE: Fidelity will not be providing immigration sponsorship for this role.

The Role

Skills

We are seeking an Analyst on the Equity Investment Services (EQIS) team at Fidelity Investments, who will play a critical role partnering with the Equity Leadership Team, EQIS colleagues, and cross-functional partners to develop analytics and insights that support management decision-making across the Equity organization. You will use digital and programming skills, including Python and SQL, to conduct analyses, generate reports, develop scalable solutions, and respond to requests from senior management. This is an outstanding opportunity to apply your analytical, project management, and interpersonal skills to deliver data-driven insights that strengthen management decision-making across the Equity organization. The individual must:

  • Demonstrate knowledge of Equity markets, investment management, securities, data, and workflows
  • Demonstrate a passion for leveraging technology to deliver scalable, long-lasting solutions to complex business challenges
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and problem-solving skills when faced with uncertainty or shifting priorities
  • Communicate effectively with all levels of management, providing trusted information and insights that support leadership decision-making

This position provides analytical and organizational support to the business unit operations/management in KPIs reporting, compensation/incentives, forecasting and budget updates. The position performs all related duties in support of goals and objectives, as well as developing processes and proposals to increase the effectiveness of the operations. In addition, the position fosters continued program development and growth by conducting research and audits, as well as by producing statistical reports and analyses. The position coordinates project implementation across all facilities as needed

Responsibilities

  • Develop and administer new and existing programs impacting service delivery and quality, member benefits, employee performance, internal and external performance management and service provider compensation/incentive payments.
  • Assist with development and preparation of annual budget, goals, and objectives. Provide monthly forecasting and effective budget updates. Implement individual portions of the strategic business plan. Assess, evaluate and recommend alterations to the business plan as needed.
  • Under close guidance, design, build, and maintain reporting that measures key operational KPIs. Develop internal reports on expenses, incentive programs, initiatives, and performance goals and results, including ad-hoc reports as needed.
  • Provide ad hoc data analysis in a variety of source systems and using a variety of data analysis tools/ languages (SQL, Teradata, Tableau, Excel, Access). Identify and analyze trends with root cause analysis while providing solutions.
  • Assist with designing, building, and maintaining data tables in Teradata for query optimization.
  • Collaborate with other Business Units such as Business Intelligence and Market Research to accomplish common goals and objectives.
  • Recognize, design, and integrate continuous improvement components to meet redesign needs.
  • Develop, implement, conduct, document and report result of program audit techniques required to ensure accuracy and adherence to policies, practices and operating procedures.
  • This position requires extensive knowledge in Teradata and SQL databases with data mining knowledge as well as data visualization through Tableau. Work regularly requires the exercise of discretion and independent judgment in areas such as:
  • Querying large data sets, validating data,
  • Developing specialized reports/dashboards
  • Troubleshooting data issues
  • Developing solutions to complex data issues
  • Formulation of calculations to compute incentives, goals, forecasts

Qualifications

  • Bachelors’ Equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 4-6 years Business operations and data analytics.
  • Professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong SQL skills with data mining knowledge.
  • Advanced Excel skills (incl. VBA, macros, complex calculations, etc.).
  • Tableau preferred, Python a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office software products, including Outlook, Word, Excel and Access required. Additional computer software skills such MS Project and Publisher desired.
  • Professional organizational and time management skills, as well as the ability to multitask and meet project deadlines as set by management.

The starting pay range for this position is:

$80,100.00 - $107,000.00

Additionally, for full time positions, you will be eligible to participate in our incentive program based upon the achievement of organization, team and personal performance.

Remarkable benefits:

  • Health coverage for medical, dental, vision
  • 401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension
  • Tuition assistance
  • Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs
  • Paid parental leave
  • Wellness programs
  • Employee discounts (membership, insurance,

travel, entertainment, services and more!)

When we embrace our diversity – we win. All of Us! With our national brand recognition, long-standing reputation since 1900, and constantly growing membership, we are seeking career-minded, service-driven professionals to join our team.

“Through dedicated employees we proudly deliver legendary service and beneficial products that provide members peace of mind and value.”

descriptionHtml:
Firm Overview

Star Mountain is a rapidly growing, specialized private investment firm focused on the large and less competitive lower middle-market (“LMM”), comprised of businesses that generally have between $5 million and $50 million in annual EBITDA. Star Mountain employs three complementary strategies: (i) private credit, (ii) private equity and (iii) secondary private credit and private equity fund investing, all focused within the U.S. LMM. Star Mountain’s track record, business model, growth trajectory and award-winning culture provide compelling career opportunities for driven and talented individuals. Culture is a core principle which includes long-term alignment of interest with 100% of U.S. employees participating in investment profits. Star Mountain has ~$4.5 billion in assets under management (committed capital including debt facilities as of 10/31/25) and expects strong continued growth based on its performance, distinctive investment approach and its diversified investor base of domestic and global institutions (including public pensions, corporate pensions, insurance companies, commercial banks, endowments, foundations and family offices) and individuals. Star Mountain values team players with positive, solutions-based attitudes complemented by a strong work ethic and is heavily committed to long-term training and career development. Star Mountain is employee-owned with material long-term wealth creation opportunity for dedicated, entrepreneurial professionals. Dynamic team of 120+ full-time people and 40+ Senior Advisors / Operating Partners. The senior team has an average of 30 years of investment experience including prior leadership experience at Blackstone / GSO, Fortress, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan and Merrill Lynch.


Position Overview

Star Mountain Capital is seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented Portfolio Reporting Analyst to support the firm's portfolio monitoring, financial reporting, and investment data management activities. This individual will play an important role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of portfolio-level reporting across the firm's investment strategies.


The ideal candidate will possess strong financial and analytical skills, advanced Excel capabilities, and the ability to work with large datasets while maintaining a high degree of accuracy. This position requires collaboration across Portfolio Management, Investments, Finance, Operations, and Investor Relations to support internal decision-making, investor reporting, and ongoing portfolio oversight.


Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and maintain recurring monthly, quarterly, and annual portfolio reporting packages.
  • Track portfolio performance, investment valuations, and relevant portfolio-level KPIs.
  • Support the preparation of portfolio dashboards, performance summaries, and management presentations.
  • Identify reporting discrepancies, unusual trends, and potential data integrity issues, escalating findings as appropriate.
  • Assist with ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from senior management and investment professionals.

Data Management & Reporting Systems

  • Ensure consistency of portfolio information across reporting systems and deliverables.
  • Support ongoing improvements to data collection, reporting processes, and system integrations.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support Investor Relations with accurate portfolio-level information for investor presentations, reporting, and due diligence requests.
  • Assist in preparing materials for internal portfolio reviews, investment committee meetings, and senior leadership discussions.
  • Respond to internal reporting requests while maintaining data accuracy and confidentiality.

Process Improvement & Reporting Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to streamline reporting workflows and reduce manual processes.
  • Develop and enhance reporting templates, dashboards, and analytical tools.
  • Assist in implementing standardized reporting procedures and data quality controls.
  • Leverage technology, automation, and analytical tools to improve the scalability and effectiveness of portfolio reporting.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, portfolio analytics, investment operations, accounting, or financial analysis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, lookups, and financial data analysis.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools, including Claude or similar platforms, to automate workflows, streamline financial reporting, enhance data analysis, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, financial metrics, and accounting fundamentals.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies across financial datasets.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within private credit, private equity, asset management, investment banking, or financial services.
  • Understanding of private investment performance metrics, including IRR, MOIC, NAV, and investment-level returns.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or other data visualization and analytical tools.
  • Exposure to debt investments, credit agreements, and portfolio company financial reporting.
  • Experience improving or automating financial reporting processes.


Compensation

The exact salary will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and performance during the selection process. Employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and other economics. Total compensation may vary by role, location, department, and individual performance. The firm is 100% employee owned providing for material economic wealth creation opportunity.


Benefits

Star Mountain Capital is committed to a healthy and engaged workforce. Our benefits are constantly evolving to support our employees’ needs today and in the future. We offer a highly competitive medical, dental, and vision package. Select other benefits include: 50% coverage on monthly gym memberships, a cell phone stipend, tuition support of job-related designations and learning and development opportunities, and other bespoke benefits.


Interview Process

Thank you for your interest in a role at Star Mountain Capital. Please note that due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to respond to each one individually. If your resume is a match for the role you’ve applied for or other potential opportunities, we will reach out to start the conversation. If you do not hear from us immediately, please understand that we are carefully reviewing all applications and will keep your resume on file for future opportunities that align with your experience and qualifications.


Investing in the Growth Engine of America ®

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Position Summary

What you will do

Deliver trusted reporting, dashboards, and practical analysis while partnering across Talent Acquisition, People Growth, Inclusion, Total Rewards, People Operations, Payroll, and business leaders to strengthen enterprise People Analytics capabilities that improve organizational performance, workforce planning, and talent outcomes. Translates defined business questions into useful measures and insights, monitors people-process and service performance, and supports decisions about priorities and improvements. Partners with data and system owners on definitions, access, and quality; does not own source systems, enterprise data architecture, or P&C-wide analytics strategy.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and scorecards for internal P&C US priorities; validate accuracy, timeliness, and fitness for use.
  • Work with stakeholders to clarify questions, define measures, document requirements, and explain limitations of available data.
  • Partner across Talent Acquisition, People Growth, Inclusion, Total Rewards, People Operations, Payroll, and business leaders to build an enterprise People Analytics capability that improves organizational performance, workforce planning, and talent outcomes.
  • Analyze workforce, service, process, and experience data to identify trends, exceptions, and practical improvement opportunities.
  • Present findings through clear visuals and concise narratives that distinguish observed results from interpretation and recommendations.
  • Support measurement of employee experience, solution adoption, operational performance, and improvement outcomes with the relevant PES capability owners.
  • Document metric definitions and reporting procedures; reconcile discrepancies and escalate data-quality or access issues to People Information & Systems and other accountable data owners.
  • Improve repeatability and appropriate self-service use of approved reporting tools while protecting confidential employee information.

Who are you?

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, business, human resources, information systems, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; HR to confirm formal minimum.
  • Approximately 5+ years of relevant reporting, business intelligence, or data-analysis experience; proposed threshold for HR validation.
  • Experience creating dashboards and repeatable reports, analyzing trends, and explaining results to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience handling sensitive information and applying access, privacy, and data-quality controls.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Knowledge

  • Business intelligence and KPI definitions in a P&C or comparable service environment.
  • Basic statistical reasoning, data-quality practices, and confidentiality requirements.

Skills

  • Data preparation, validation, visualization, dashboard development, and analytical storytelling.
  • Proficiency in BI and visualization platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik Sense.
  • Experience with reporting automation, workflow improvement, customer segmentation, retention analytics, predictive methods, or AI-enabled analytics.

Requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, and documentation.

Abilities

  • Work independently on an assigned analytics portfolio and manage competing requests.
  • Translate business questions into measurable outputs while identifying limitations and escalation needs.
  • Collaborate with data, system, process, experience, and change partners without assuming ownership of their disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with P&C data, employee experience measures, and service or process performance reporting.
  • Experience enabling self-service reporting using approved enterprise tools.

Key Competencies

Accountability; Customer Focus; Collaboration; Continuous Improvement; Results Orientation; Adaptability; Analytical Judgment.

Ready for the next move?

At the Volvo Group, we strive for a clear, transparent, and straightforward compensation approach, motivating you to contribute to the company’s growth. For this position, the base pay is set at $96,000 - $118,500 annually, and where applicable, bonus eligible.  The range for this role, as well as final salary offered, is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, work-related knowledge, certifications, skills, education, and experience. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as part of any final offer.

In addition to a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy:  

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision insurance.
  • Generous paid time off.
  • Competitive matching retirement savings plans.
  • Working environment where your safety, health and wellbeing come first.
  • Focus on professional and personal development through Volvo Group University.
  • Programs that make today’s challenging reality of combining work and personal life easier.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Who We Are And What We Believe In

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

At Group People & Culture, a part of Volvo Group, we create the foundation and frameworks for people growth and organizational development, to drive the people agenda that enables the realization of the Volvo Group aspirations through people strategy and commitment. You will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

Position Summary

The Data Analyst - Safety will manage, organize, analyze, and report on operational and safety data received from Waymo and other TAS accounts. This position will help ensure that client data is accurate, secure, accessible, and converted into useful insights for the TAS Safety team.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with Safety, Operations, Account Management, and other stakeholders to identify trends, monitor performance, support investigations, and improve safety outcomes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, and able to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Transdev Is Proud To Offer

  • Competitive compensation package of minimum $60,320 – maximum $70,720

Benefits Include

  • Vacation: minimum of two (2) weeks
  • Sick days: 5 days
  • Holidays: 12 days; 8 standard and 4 floating
  • Other standard benefits: 401(k) retirement plan, medical, dental and vision, life insurance, short-term disability, voluntary long-term disability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage safety and operational data received from Waymo and other TAS accounts.
  • Collect, clean, validate, standardize, and maintain data from multiple client systems and sources.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and recurring performance summaries.
  • Monitor safety trends, incidents, leading indicators, and key performance metrics.
  • Identify data inconsistencies, missing information, unusual patterns, and emerging areas of risk.
  • Support incident investigations and root-cause analyses by providing accurate and timely data.
  • Produce account-specific reporting while maintaining consistent definitions and standards across the TAS organization.
  • Partner with Safety and Operations leaders to define reporting requirements and performance measures.
  • Translate complex data into clear findings, visualizations, and recommendations.
  • Automate recurring reports and improve data-management processes where practical.
  • Maintain documentation for data sources, definitions, calculations, reporting procedures, and quality-control practices.
  • Protect confidential client, employee, operational, and safety information in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.
  • Respond to approved requests for data and analysis within established timelines.
  • Assist with client reviews, internal audits, compliance reporting, and leadership presentations.
  • Perform additional data analysis and safety-support responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, business, safety, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience working with operational, safety, transportation, logistics, or client-account data.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Experience using data-visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Ability to clean, reconcile, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and reporting requirements.
  • Sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience analyzing vehicle, fleet, autonomous-vehicle, transportation, or workplace-safety data.
  • Familiarity with incident reporting, risk analysis, root-cause analysis, and safety-performance indicators.
  • Experience with Python, R, or another analytical programming language.
  • Experience automating dashboards, reports, or data-quality checks.
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, access controls, and client-specific reporting requirements.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

Core Competencies

  • Data accuracy and quality control
  • Analytical and critical thinking
  • Safety and risk awareness
  • Confidentiality and professional judgment
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Process improvement
  • Client service
  • Accountability and reliability

Measures of Success

Success In This Role May Be Measured By

  • Accuracy and completeness of safety and account data.
  • Timeliness of dashboards and recurring reports.
  • Reduction in manual reporting work and data errors.
  • Quality and usefulness of insights provided to Safety and Operations leaders.
  • Consistency of definitions and reporting standards across TAS accounts.
  • Responsiveness to investigations, audits, and approved client requests.
  • Compliance with data-security and confidentiality requirements.
  • Demonstrated contribution to improved safety performance and risk reduction.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office-based or remote work involving extended periods at a computer.
  • May require occasional participation in operational meetings, incident reviews, or client presentations.
  • May require flexibility to support time-sensitive safety incidents or reporting deadlines.

Pre-Employment Requirements

  • All Transdev employees must satisfactorily complete a pre-employment drug screen and background check. Safety Sensitive Positions will also be subject to a physical screening
  • Transdev reserves the right to perform ongoing background checks for all employees except in states where this is prohibited by state law. Transdev will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Transdev complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodation for applicants and candidates with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact us.HR.TalentAcquisition@transdev.com

Drug-free Workplace

Transdev maintains a drug-free workplace. Applicants must:

  • Be eligible to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship now or in the future (if based in the U.S.).
  • Successfully pass a pre-employment drug screen.
