At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

The team is focused on providing Financial Performance Management reporting of Enterprise financial and operating metrics. The team is responsible for delivering accurate, insightful, and actionable reporting that enables leadership to assess business performance, product profitability, and operational efficiency.

This role supports financial decision-making by producing and maintaining recurring reports and assisting in analysis processes. It involves analyzing key performance indicators, monitoring trends, and communicating results to leadership and internal partners. The role differentiates itself by combining routine reporting with ad hoc financial analysis and variance identification. Success is measured by the accuracy and timeliness of reports, the identification of financial risks and opportunities, and effective communication of insights. Job Description

At National Church Residences, we believe every senior should lead a vibrant, healthy, and independent life. Since 1961, our mission has been to provide quality housing that meets the diverse and evolving needs of seniors.

With over 340 communities across 25 states, we are the nation’s largest not-for-profit provider of affordable senior housing and the leading employer of service coordinators. In addition to residential senior communities, we offer home and community-based services and permanent supportive housing for formerly homeless and disabled individuals.

PURPOSE

According to the prescribed policies and procedures of the organization including all applicable federal, state and local regulations and under the general supervision of the Director of Data Analytics, this position is responsible for managing, analyzing, and visualizing health data to support organizational decision-making. This position will focus on leveraging SQL, report automation, and data visualization tools such as Power BI to ensure data accuracy, streamline reporting processes, and provide actionable insights for various stakeholders.

Essential Functions

Responsible for maintaining data analysis and reporting policies, support strategic goals, and foster collaboration with stakeholders.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Design and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze health data from diverse sources.
  • Create, manage, and enhance databases, tables, views, and stored procedures to fulfill health data reporting requirements.
  • Automate recurring reports to streamline processes and minimize manual effort, utilizing tools like SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or other reporting frameworks.
  • Conduct manual data entry and generate reports from various third-party platforms.
  • Deliver market intelligence analysis to compare and benchmark organizational service lines against competitors.
  • Perform ad hoc analysis to assist operations in addressing business challenges.
  • Contribute to strategic growth initiatives aimed at expanding organizational services.

Data Visualization & Dashboarding

  • Design and create interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI and other BI applications to effectively communicate data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to gather reporting requirements and develop custom visualizations that enhance health outcomes and operational performance.
  • Optimize reports and dashboards in Power BI or other BI applications for improved performance and usability.

Quality Assurance & Data Governance

  • Ensure data quality through rigorous validation and testing of data extracts and reports.
  • Uphold and implement data governance standards and practices to maintain the consistency, accuracy, and security of health data.
  • Facilitate coordination efforts for establishing data connections and extractions from vendor systems.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with clinical, operational, and IT teams to support data-driven initiatives and projects.
  • Deliver training and support to end-users on Power BI, report interpretation, and data literacy.
  • Transform complex data concepts into actionable insights and recommendations.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Stay current on industry trends and best practices in healthcare, health informatics, data analytics, and reporting technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance existing processes, tools, and methodologies to improve data accessibility and usability.

EXPECTATIONS

  • Demonstrates and maintains a positive, professional manner, manages time efficiently and effectively, provides leadership as a role model to promote a team approach, collaborates and participates in policy creation and appropriate problem-solving methods.
  • Must adhere to all policies, procedures, terms and conditions set forth in the National Church Residences’ Employee Information Guide (EIG), the Code of Conduct, as well as any facility handbook, including but not limited to, corporate compliance, drug free workplace, safe work practices, all federal, state, local regulations and laws.
  • With respect to Resident Rights, ensures all care is provided with respect and dignity for the residents/clients, their families and the staff. Reports all complaints made by residents/clients and/or families to the appropriate supervisors, reports all allegations of abuse, misappropriation of funds/resident property and/or any other corporate compliance, drug free workplace, safe work practices, all federal, state and local regulations and laws.
  • Completes all annual education requirements timely, including but not limited to Compliance, Privacy, Security and HIPAA training and exhibits behavior as set forth by the Code of Conduct in the performance of their duties.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Public Health, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in health informatics or data analytics.
  • Proven experience with SQL (e.g., complex queries, stored procedures).
  • Hands-on experience with data visualization tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Experience in report automation and working with large health data sets. Knowledge in the health information field and working with healthcare data.
  • Experience in working with Electronic Health Records (EHR) data.

Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (e.g., querying, database management).
  • Strong experience with Power BI or other BI applications and Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience in report automation (e.g., SSRS, SQL).
  • Familiarity with data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., ICD, CPT, HL7) and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Must have good working computer skills with basic professional computer software (Microsoft Office suite, Windows, etc.) and the capacity for learning new software systems quickly.
  • Must be self-directed with excellent organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to manage tasks and assignments concurrently.
  • Must have excellent communication, comprehension, and interpersonal skills. Must have the ability to speak, read, write and understand English, as well as the ability to make self-understood.
  • Must have strong motivational skills and a high emotional intelligence quotient (EQ)

Travel: Rare, up to 10% with overnight stays

In return, National Church Residences offers an excellent total reward package that includes:

  • Medical & Rx – 3 plan options to fit your budget; choose from coverage offered through a Nationwide network for you and your family
  • Complimented with a Healthcare Flexible Spending Account or Employer funded Health Savings Account
  • Includes Fertility & Family Building Support, Weight Management, and Chronic Condition Support
  • Parental Leave paid at 100% for four weeks
  • Coverage begins first of the month following your date of hire!
  • Dental & Vision coverage for you and your family with Nationwide providers.
  • Company provided Life & ADD insurance and Disability coverage.
  • Supplemental benefits such as Life and AD&D for you and your family, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Dependent Care and Transportation & Parking
  • Well-being Programs including an enhanced EAP with mental health and work-life support, tobacco cessation, and Well-Being Your Way which offers up to $1000/year in rewards & reimbursements!
  • Retirement Savings Plan offering immediate company funding at 3%, increasing up to 5% over time and an additional company match up to 5% when you contribute your own funds!
  • Reimbursement for Tuition expenses
  • Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 paid Holidays and Parental Paid Leave at 100%

(Programs vary depending on Full Time, Part Time or Contingent Status)

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, military status, disability, genetic information and/or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

The City of Atlanta remains a transportation hub, not just for the country but also for the world: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is one of the nations busiest in daily passenger flights.  Direct flights to Europe, South America, and Asia have made metro Atlanta easily accessible to the more than 1,000 international businesses that operate here and the more than 50 countries that have representation in the city through consulates, trade offices, and chambers of commerce.  The city has emerged as a banking center and is the world headquarters for 13 Fortune 500 companies.

Atlanta is the Capital city of the southeast, a city of the future with strong ties to its past.  The old in new Atlanta is the soul of the city, the heritage that enhances the quality of life in a contemporary city.  In the turbulent 60's, Atlanta was "the city too busy to hate."​  And today, in the 21st Century, Atlanta is the "city not too busy to care"​.

For more than four decades Atlanta has been linked to the civil rights movement.  Civil Rights leaders moved forward, they were the visionaries who saw a new south, a new Atlanta.  They believed in peace. They made monumental sacrifices for that peace.  And because of them Atlanta became a fast-pace modern city which opened its doors to the 1996 Olympics.

Die-hard Southerners view Atlanta as the heart of the Old Confederacy; Atlanta has become the best example of the New South, a fast-paced modern city proud of its heritage.

In the past two decades Atlanta has experienced unprecedented growth -- the official city population remains steady, at about 420,000, but the metro population has grown in the past decade by nearly 40%, from 2.9 million to 4.1 million people.  A good measure of this growth is the ever-changing downtown skyline, along with skyscrapers constructed in the Midtown, Buckhead, and outer perimeter (fringing I-285) business districts.

Job Description

Posting expires: November 20, 2026

Salary range: $47,474 - $66,000

General Description and Classification Standards:

Performs seasoned-level reporting and analysis work in support of departmental research, performance reporting, operations management, and departmental operations. Plans and executes projects to study operations effectiveness or trends. Designs and prepares reports by accessing databases or by consolidating data from multiple sources. Lays out report formats and produces reports. Summarizes data and provides commentary or observations based on analysis. Position does not perform data entry. Sources of data may be enterprise systems, complex spreadsheets, databases, etc., requiring specialized expertise or training. Note: positions in this class may also lead other related administrative or operations processes within the organization provided they have a similar level of professional challenge.

Supervision Received:

Direction received is very general and focuses on end results and is typically collaborative in nature. Position plans own work and project schedules and sequences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

 These are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.

  • Receives assignments and plans for data collection and analysis for assigned departmental functions or activities.
  • Designs custom reports and data displays for projects and standard report formats for ongoing functions based on organizational needs for information.
  • Reviews assigned operating records and/or databases for quality. Identifies processes or reporting functions that do not provide the necessary level of completeness, detail or accuracy.
  • Designs standard report formats based on organizational needs for information.
  • Retrieves and summarizes data from various information systems for inclusion into research or operating reports.
  • Writes queries in the appropriate reporting language.
  • Reviews monthly operating statistics and operating data and prepares operating reports.
  • Leads or participates in internal and external research projects by collecting, reviewing, and summarizing results.
  • Generates reports, presentations, graphics, forms and other documents to demonstrate information flow and project results.
  • Presents periodic reports or special projects to organizational management.
  • Interacts with line staff, managers and supervisors when conducting studies, surveys, or audits.
  • Performs other duties related to the maintenance and operation of administrative and information systems related to the area of assignment.
  • May interpret organizational policies and recommend exceptions; establishes work methods, timetables, performance standards, etc.
  • May provide leadership to lower level, interns, temporary employees, etc.
  • Serves as a technical resource or mentor to other employees.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. COA may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities:

 This is a partial listing of necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job successfully, it is not an exhaustive list.

  • Thorough knowledge of databases, reporting methods and formats, and appropriate reporting languages.
  • Skill in operation of computers to retrieve data and prepare reports and presentations; in writing narrative reports; in communicating.
  • Skill in leading groups and in speaking to groups.
  • Ability to organize and present data in presentations and narrative reports.
  • Ability to review data and identify data trends and/or inconsistencies.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education and Experience -

  • Bachelor’s degree in business/public administration, accounting, finance, information technology, statistics, human resources, or a related field ( Additional years of experience may be considered as a substitute for the required degree on an exceptional basis, with a minimum of eight (8) years of professional related experience in creation, reporting, and/or management of data),
  • with a minimum of four (4) years of professional related experience in creation, reporting, and/or management of data or closely related tasks (not including data entry).
  • Required Skills: SQL, Microsoft Access, Microsoft Excel.

Licensures and Certifications - No specific certifications or licensures required. Individual positions may require completion of training in specific reporting languages or software.

Preferred Requirements - Bachelor’s degree as described above, plus 5 years data analysis experience. Experience with R, Python, Visual Basic is preferred.

Work Environment:

Required physical, lifting, and sensory capabilities are requirements to perform the job successfully. Typical environmental conditions associated with the job.

Lifting Requirements:

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.

Work Schedule:

This position follows the City’s hybrid work schedule policy as assigned by the Department of Human Resources Commissioner and requires in-person work at City worksites/facilities at least four (4) days per week, with the option to work remotely one (1) day per week, based on eligibility, departmental needs, and supervisor approval. Internet Brands is looking for an Associate Data Analyst to join our El Segundo based data analytics team.

The Ideal Candidate: You are an organized self-starter with a keen business sense who loves digging into data to understand trends and performance. You have a passion for manipulating large volumes of data, building dashboards, and have a consistent focus on efficiency. You easily understand requirements and communicate the progress and status of your work. You have a bias for action and know when to apply the 80/20 rule. You’re also a great teammate who likes a rapidly changing environment and wants to join a company that offers a ton of opportunities to build your skills.

This position requires an ability to understand the key metrics of a business and to develop reporting based on business requirements. The analyst will work in a project team-oriented and dynamic environment which will require working closely with other teams and adjusting to new developments as they arise. Various software packages and tools will be utilized in order to collect, mine, and report on this data. Strong analytical and communication skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines is critical for this

position.

In this role, you will:

  • Create insightful, easy to understand visualizations that provide performance, trending and benchmarking analysis to meet business needs.
  • Simplify and automate reporting, audits, and other data-driven activities; build solutions to have maximum scale and self-service ability by partners.
  • Support the business with time-critical data analyses.
  • Performing analysis of web traffic, email engagement, and app engagement data to understand and measure the success of programs, including click through analysis, retention, re-engagement and A/B testing.

  • Degree in Statistics or Business or equivalent work experience
  • Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong communication skills.

  • 1-2 years of equivalent work experience
  • Experience accessing data from data bases.
  • Proficient with creating, maintaining, and optimizing data visualizations dashboards

At Internet Brands, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. Position Purpose

The Data Analyst will be responsible for the development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of Health Hub data and recurring reports as well as dashboards and other business intelligence applications that utilize the underlying data stores for internal and external use under the Health Hub Program. This includes tracking encounter and quality outcome data from electronic health records (NextGen), i2i, HMIS, Microsoft Office platforms, and health plan reports.

The Data Analyst will also support multidisciplinary teams, including medical providers, nursing, behavioral health, case management, and administrative staff with data reporting needs. Reporting includes Capitation and Fee-for-Service (FFS) Reconciliation reports, monthly dashboards, provider productivity reports, and more. The Data Analyst will thoroughly analyze and clarify report requirements, make recommendations, and provide education when necessary to meet business needs. They will also be responsible for creating and maintaining internal controls and reference materials to promote data quality.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot data systems and databases, including identifying and correcting coding errors, data discrepancies, and other data-related issues to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Collect, analyze, report, and monitor encounter data and quality outcome measures from NextGen, i2i, health plan reporting systems, and other applicable data sources to support Health Hub Program requirements.
  • Extract, organize, clean, and transform data from primary and secondary sources into meaningful formats that support organizational decision-making, program evaluation, and reporting requirements for county contractors and other stakeholders.
  • Apply statistical methods and analytical tools to interpret datasets, identify trends and patterns, and support diagnostic, predictive, and performance improvement analyses.
  • Evaluate and interpret data within the context of local, national, and industry-wide trends to identify potential impacts, opportunities, and challenges affecting the organization and its programs.
  • Prepare reports for program directors and executive leadership that clearly communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data.
  • Collaborate with programmers, IT staff, and organizational leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend system modifications, and support the development of data governance policies.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external consultants within the data network to extract, evaluate, and deliver data requested by county representatives on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Develop and maintain clear documentation of data collection, extraction, validation, and analysis methodologies to support transparency, reproducibility, and verification of reported information.
  • Develop, update, and maintain data reference materials, including data dictionaries, codebooks, reporting specifications, and standardized documentation to promote consistency and accuracy across reporting processes.
  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain business intelligence dashboards and data visualizations using a user-centered design approach to ensure information is clear, accessible, accurate, and meaningful to the intended audience.
  • Coordinate the ordering, inventory tracking, monitoring, and replenishment of medical supplies and other program-related materials requested by Program Directors, ensuring requests are processed and fulfilled in accordance with established organizational procedures.
  • Adhere to all organizational safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors.
  • Participate in required safety and compliance training and apply learned practices in daily work activities.
  • Identify, report, and help mitigate unsafe conditions, incidents, or hazards in the workplace.
  • Use equipment, tools, and supplies safely and responsibly in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.
  • Maintain awareness of infection control, occupational health, and emergency preparedness procedures appropriate to the role.
  • Participate in JWCH’s customer service training called AIDET on an annual basis.
    • Demonstrate an understanding of AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, and Thank You) to apply in patient encounters or team discussions.
    • Utilize the AIDET communication framework to communicate with patients and team members in a manner that reduces patient anxiety, increases patient compliance, and improves clinical outcomes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of two years of demonstrated experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Specialist, or in a data management and reporting support role, preferably in a healthcare, behavioral health, or nonprofit setting.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications, with demonstrated experience using databases and analytical tools, including macros, Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), pivot tables, pivot charts, queries, and data filters.
  • Experience working with NextGen Electronic Health Records (EHR) or a comparable electronic medical records (EMR) system, including the ability to develop, execute, and maintain data queries and reports.
  • Experience using web-based data reporting portals, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP), and other platforms for data exchange, retrieval, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of healthcare data management, reporting requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local funding requirements related to healthcare services.

Knowledge, Skills And Ability

  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into meaningful insights.
  • Demonstrated ability to collect, organize, validate, analyze, and communicate large volumes of information with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, organizational leadership, external consultants, and community partners.
  • Experience working in a nonprofit, healthcare, or human services environment preferred.
  • All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Employee Benefits

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Monthly employer-sponsored allowance for assistance with health premiums.
  • Funded Health Savings Account (up to deductible) to assist with carrier-approved medical expenses.
  • Paid time off (vacation, sick leave) and 13 paid holidays.
  • 401(k) Safe Harbor Profit Sharing plan.
  • Mileage reimbursement.
  • Short- and long-term disability plans (LTD/STD).
  • Life insurance policy & AD&D, and more!

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient at a time.

JWCH Institute, Inc + Wesley Health Centers is an Equal Opportunity and Fair Chance Employer.

descriptionHtml:
Sullivan & Cromwell (“S&C”) is seeking an analyst who builds and improves the technology behind financial reporting. Within our legal professional services environment, you will write SQL queries, develop reports and analytical datasets, automate recurring processes, and troubleshoot data and reporting issues. Your work will help Finance deliver accurate, timely information for management decisions.

The role combines hands-on technical delivery with an understanding of financial data. You will translate reporting needs into working solutions, reconcile results to source systems and accounting controls, and document how those solutions operate.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of weekly, monthly, and ad hoc management reporting.
  • Write, maintain, and troubleshoot SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and validate data for recurring and ad hoc financial reporting.
  • Build and enhance reports, dashboards, and reusable datasets in business intelligence and financial reporting tools; maintain clear definitions for calculations and reporting measures.
  • Automate data preparation, reconciliation, and report production using Python, R, SQL, or other approved scripting and workflow tools.
  • Support data pipelines and scheduled reporting processes; investigate failed refreshes, missing records, duplicate data, and differences between source systems and reports.
  • Support and enhance financial systems and SaaS or cloud reporting applications, partnering with Finance, IT, and vendors on testing, troubleshooting, and controlled changes.
  • Translate stakeholder requests into data requirements, mappings, calculations, and acceptance criteria; test results before reports or changes are released.
  • Develop financial analyses and forecasting models for client and matter profitability, revenue, and compensation planning, using methods appropriate to the business question.
  • Document query logic, data sources, reconciliations, and operating procedures; explain findings and system issues clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.

In addition, responsibilities related to maintaining firm and client information are to be adhered to by all employees. This includes complying with the firm’s information security policies, protecting firm assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference, and reporting security events or potential events or other security risks to management.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, financial systems, data analytics, reporting development, or a closely related technical role.
  • Hands-on SQL proficiency, including joins, common table expressions, aggregate functions, and window functions; ability to explain query logic and diagnose incorrect results.
  • Experience developing and maintaining reports or dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Dodeca, or a comparable reporting platform, including the underlying data preparation and calculations.
  • Experience building or maintaining a repeatable automated data or reporting process using Python, R, SQL, or a comparable approved tool.
  • Understanding of relational data structures, data transformation, reconciliation, and validation controls; ability to trace a reported figure back to its source.
  • Strong Excel skills for modeling, analysis, and reconciliation, together with experience delivering solutions through databases, reporting platforms, or scripts.
  • Working knowledge of financial reporting concepts and ability to learn how revenue, expenses, profitability, and compensation are represented in business systems.
  • Ability to document technical work, gather business requirements, and communicate clearly with Finance and IT colleagues.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with law-firm or professional-services financial data, including client and matter profitability, billing, collections, or compensation analysis.
  • Experience supporting financial SaaS applications or cloud analytics environments, particularly Oracle; AWS or Azure experience is also relevant.
  • Experience applying forecasting or statistical methods to a defined financial business problem.
  • Relevant technical certifications or an advanced degree in information systems, analytics, data science, finance, or a related discipline.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

descriptionText:
Sullivan & Cromwell (“S&C”) is seeking an analyst who builds and improves the technology behind financial reporting. Within our legal professional services environment, you will write SQL queries, develop reports and analytical datasets, automate recurring processes, and troubleshoot data and reporting issues. Your work will help Finance deliver accurate, timely information for management decisions.

The role combines hands-on technical delivery with an understanding of financial data. You will translate reporting needs into working solutions, reconcile results to source systems and accounting controls, and document how those solutions operate.

Responsibilities



- Assist with the preparation and delivery of weekly, monthly, and ad hoc management reporting.
- Write, maintain, and troubleshoot SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and validate data for recurring and ad hoc financial reporting.
- Build and enhance reports, dashboards, and reusable datasets in business intelligence and financial reporting tools; maintain clear definitions for calculations and reporting measures.
- Automate data preparation, reconciliation, and report production using Python, R, SQL, or other approved scripting and workflow tools.
- Support data pipelines and scheduled reporting processes; investigate failed refreshes, missing records, duplicate data, and differences between source systems and reports.
- Support and enhance financial systems and SaaS or cloud reporting applications, partnering with Finance, IT, and vendors on testing, troubleshooting, and controlled changes.
- Translate stakeholder requests into data requirements, mappings, calculations, and acceptance criteria; test results before reports or changes are released.
- Develop financial analyses and forecasting models for client and matter profitability, revenue, and compensation planning, using methods appropriate to the business question.
- Document query logic, data sources, reconciliations, and operating procedures; explain findings and system issues clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.

 In addition, responsibilities related to maintaining firm and client information are to be adhered to by all employees. This includes complying with the firm’s information security policies, protecting firm assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference, and reporting security events or potential events or other security risks to management.

- Hands-on SQL proficiency, including joins, common table expressions, aggregate functions, and window functions; ability to explain query logic and diagnose incorrect results.
- Experience developing and maintaining reports or dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Dodeca, or a comparable reporting platform, including the underlying data preparation and calculations.
- Experience building or maintaining a repeatable automated data or reporting process using Python, R, SQL, or a comparable approved tool.
- Understanding of relational data structures, data transformation, reconciliation, and validation controls; ability to trace a reported figure back to its source.
- Strong Excel skills for modeling, analysis, and reconciliation, together with experience delivering solutions through databases, reporting platforms, or scripts.
- Working knowledge of financial reporting concepts and ability to learn how revenue, expenses, profitability, and compensation are represented in business systems.
- Ability to document technical work, gather business requirements, and communicate clearly with Finance and IT colleagues.
- Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience with law-firm or professional-services financial data, including client and matter profitability, billing, collections, or compensation analysis.
- Experience supporting financial SaaS applications or cloud analytics environments, particularly Oracle; AWS or Azure experience is also relevant.
- Experience applying forecasting or statistical methods to a defined financial business problem.
- Relevant technical certifications or an advanced degree in information systems, analytics, data science, finance, or a related discipline.

This role is on‑site and requires current residence in Cleveland, Ohio 
Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We do not provide employment sponsorship for this role. Summary: The BI Analyst will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help identify, plan, and implement strategic dashboards that drive business goals and results. Success will be measured by demonstrating the ability to make data understandable and will be accomplished by using available tools to access and analyze data sets and present analytical findings through reports, dashboards, graphs, charts, and maps that provide stakeholders with detailed intelligence about the state of the business. Essential Functions and Responsibilities:
  • Develops end-to-end reports and dashboards and modifies existing reports and dashboards, using Microsoft Reporting Services, Power BI, and other tools.
  • Identifies the most impactful layout and presentation of key metrics and translates that vision into easy-to-use self-service reports or dashboards.
  • Serves as subject matter expert for BI solutions and capabilities.
  • Provides analytics, business intelligence, and data visualization for data-driven decision-making.
  • Provides analytic and data consultation to other business areas, leadership, or external customers.
  • Investigates business issues and determines the best way to develop appropriate diagnostic and/or tracking data that will translate business requirements into usable decision-support tools.
  • Designs, constructs, and maintains data views and/or data models.
  • Supports BI solutions by monitoring and tuning queries and investigating data integrity.
  • Writes data requirements for data warehouse and ETL processes.
  • Establishes and continually expands/enhances knowledge of data warehouses, BI and enterprise applications, data, queries/programming, and organizational structure.
  • Produces standard reports according to calendar; ensures accuracy and timeliness of output and deliverables for assigned functional areas.
  • Ensures the integrity and security of enterprise data on host computers, databases, and data transfers by business needs and industry best practices regarding privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Conducts research on emerging products, services, and analytic tools in support of systems and development efforts.
  • Develops, documents, and maintains policies, procedures, and associated training plans for dashboard administration and appropriate use.
  • Provides guidance and serves as an escalation to the Help Desk.
  • Performs research and analysis in the development of program and/or project activities.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned. 
Minimum Skills and Qualifications: 
  • A high school diploma or equivalent is required; Bachelors’ degree in related field is preferred. 
  • Five or more years’ experience; or combination of education, experience, and equivalent background is required.
  • Hands-on experience developing/maintaining strategic reports and dashboards.
  • A highly qualified candidate would be familiar with using MS Analysis Services, Reporting Services, Excel (Pivot Tables), Power BI, and other related business intelligence software.
  • Ideal candidates combine business acumen with technical skills to produce data visualizations that facilitate business decisions.
  • Experience with relational databases and knowledge of query tools and statistical software is required.
  • Full project management and development life cycle experience.
  • Experience with data processing flowcharting techniques and the ability to manipulate large sets of data.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Preference will be given to candidates who provide sample data visualizations.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining configuration and process information with the ability to translate business goals into actionable BI use cases.
  • Knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and laws. 
  • Some after-hours and weekend on-call availability in support of BI systems.
  • Reliable transportation and freedom to travel overnight a few times per year for training and related meetings with stakeholders.
  • Must have excellent communication skills both verbal and written, and interpersonal, time management, multi-tasking, and attention to detail skills. 
Employee Benefits:
  • 401(k): Match and employer discretionary contribution. 
  • Health Insurance: Two options are available, including an HSA with a dollar-for-dollar match of up to $1,200 per year. 
  • Dental & Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage options. 
  • Financial Access: Credit Union membership is available. 
  • Insurance: Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability coverage. 
  • Educational Opportunities: Scholarships for employees’ spouses and children through the Ohio Machinery Education and Opportunity Foundation. 
  • Compensation: Base pay, annual bonus potential, and company success share bonuses. 
Physical Requirements:
  • Sitting for extended periods of time.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and to handle other computer components.
  • Lifting and transporting of moderately heavy objects, such as computers and peripherals.

Company

NICO National Indemnity Company

Want to work for a company with unparalleled financial strength and stability that offers “large company” benefits with an exciting, friendly, and “small company” atmosphere? Our companies, as members of the Berkshire Hathaway group of Insurance Companies, provides opportunities for professionals interested in just that.

The Insurance Finance Data Analyst, prepares, analyzes, and communicates financial working papers, statistical data, and management information related to insurance and reinsurance operations and contracted insurance programs in support of the Insurance Data Unit (IDU). This role supports financial, accounting, data management, and reporting activities to ensure accurate and timely insurance program analysis and compliance.

This position will be with National Indemnity Company in Omaha, NE and is eligible for Hybrid work after a period of in‑office training. This position is NOT eligible for employer visa sponsorship.

What Will You Do?

  • Analyze, reconcile, and interpret financial and insurance data from multiple sources
  • Prepare working papers, schedules, and financial or statutory reports for assigned programs
  • Process funding and loss payment requests and maintain cash controls, reconciliations, and intercompany settlements
  • Coordinate daily, monthly, and year‑end financial and program information between operating locations and the Omaha office
  • Support maintenance and accuracy of Financial Database systems in coordination with IT and Finance
  • Assist with calculating supplemental reserves and IBNR allocations according to guidelines
  • Develop and maintain spreadsheet and database tools to support reporting and processing needs
  • Compile data and prepare reports for management, regulators, auditors, and other internal partners
  • Stay current on insurance accounting and financial reporting practices
  • Respond to internal and external audit inquiries related to financial data and controls

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
  • One or more years of work experience
  • Knowledge of general accounting principles
  • Personal computer proficiency and experience with basic applications such as Excel and Word

Preferred Knowledge

  • Life or property casualty insurance accounting experience
  • Knowledge of financial reporting
  • Familiarity with company and department practices and procedures
  • Knowledge of statutory accounting principles
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Access

Who Would Excel in This Role?

  • Someone who communicates clearly and professionally and enjoys working with a variety of teams and stakeholders
  • A detail‑oriented individual who takes pride in producing accurate, high‑quality work
  • An organized self‑starter who can manage priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt as needs evolve
  • A collaborative teammate who is also comfortable working independently when needed
  • A curious, analytical thinker who enjoys solving problems and understanding the story behind the data
  • A dependable professional who is flexible during peak periods and supports team success
  • A trusted team member who handles sensitive information with care and discretion
  • A motivated analyst who enjoys compiling, reviewing, and interpreting financial information to support informed decision‑making

We want you to be involved! We offer Employee Resource Groups for volunteering, connecting with others, social gatherings, and professional development. We also regularly seek employees input through companywide surveys.

We care about your health and wellbeing! Our Wellness program is integrated into the Company culture with an online wellness portal that offers a year-round, one-stop-shop to manage and track all areas of health, our Omaha office boasts a complimentary state-of-the-art onsite fitness center, and a robust wellness program.

Benefits, Perks and more! We offer retirement and savings plan with immediate enrollment with 100% employer match up to 5%, Medical, Dental and Vision for regular, full-time employees and eligible dependents, a dedicated Learning & Development program for employees to grow personally and professionally, 100% upfront Educational Reimbursement program, subsidized downtown parking, competitive time off policies including parental leave, an Employee Assistance program and much more!

Under direct supervision of senior team members and Analytics leaders, Business Intelligence Analyst I delivers analytics solutions to end users that facilitate informed decision making. Enhances data literacy by educating customers to use data to improve MyMichigan Health processes, patient outcomes and patient & provider engagement and assists in developing training approaches. Competently uses tools to generate reports, dashboards & analytical solutions according to business needs or specifications. Manages time across multifaceted projects that range in size from small to medium. Is adaptable to changing priorities and assists in supporting analytics development alignment with strategic priorities. Demonstrates ability to work independently and/or in a team to train, guide, or assist others to utilize data to gain insights. Performs in-depth healthcare focused data analysis utilizing a variety of tools including Tableau, Excel, and Epic based analytics features. Has experience or expertise with at least one coding language such as SQL or Python. Has or is able to develop subject matter expertise for one or more application modules/data models within Epic or a specialized data analysis tool. Analyst is able to turn data into information or insights that assists in answering business questions, problems or clinical outcome understandings. Must complete Epic certification in 120 days of hiring.

Responsibilities

(40%) Collaborate and support MyMichigan analytics needs. Work with internal customers to identify analysis needs, gather and document requirements, build and test reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions. Designs simple to complex queries or analysis using structured query language and ensures analytic methodologies are followed and makes recommendations where necessary. Assist other technical team members with query and report design. Analysts work to integrate, analyze and interpret large data sets to create insights that drive the accomplishment of MyMichigan Strategic Priorities. Actively engages in required Epic reporting maintenance efforts and responsible for Epic Release and Implementation work required to support MyMichigan growth strategies.

(20%) Leads small support or project initiatives that align with the MyMichigan strategic priorities. Responsible for leading small initiatives including planning the work and managing the effort and tasks associated with the plan. Leverages support of others in completing the tasks on time and collaborates with Business and Clinical Leaders per project requirements. Coordinates work execution or workflow optimization with other Epic application teams as needed.

(15%) Collaborates with departmental teams to support data consolidation and warehousing needs by supporting or developing and maintaining ETL processes from source EMR systems into enterprise reporting environments (using Microsoft SQL Server and SSIS). Creates or partners to build user-friendly data visualizations in Tableau or Epic-based tools, maintaining and refining data sources that support dashboards, and indexing reporting content within Epic and other external platforms to ensure data quality, accessibility, and effective end-user consumption.

(15%) Provides support, troubleshooting, and problem resolution for reporting tools, dashboards, analytical solutions, and related processes by maintaining the existing report portfolio, addressing user-reported issues, tuning performance as needed, and resolving errors. Supports and troubleshoots ETL and content- migration workflows, and collaborates with senior team members, application analysts, and Database Administrators when complex technical solutions are required.

(10%) Participates in the implementation and validation of system configuration changes; supports testing activities for reports and data extracts related to system or business changes; and assists with product upgrades and new tool implementations (including Epic, Tableau, and other approved technologies), which may require occasional weekend or after-hours coverage.

Other Duties And Responsibilities

Provide excellent customer service to all customers while performing duties.

Lead meetings, prioritize, resolve conflicts, maintain issues lists, and manage a project plan.

Takes notes during meetings and can identify when issue escalation is required.

Demonstrate strong project management and organizational skills.

Communicate effectively with project leadership and subject matter experts.

Continue to learn the software and increase their knowledge over time.

Employees are required to take a Computer Skills Assessment via the learning management system upon hire. Based on the results of the assessment, an employee may be required to participate in further learning opportunities offered by MyMichigan Health.

Certifications and Licensures

N/A

Required Education

Bachelors degree is required

Bachelors Degree with 1-2 years computer related experience required. Degree in IT, business, or health care field preferred.

Other Information

Experience, Training And Skills

Preferrably one (1) or more years of experience or more years of experience developing applications/reports within Epic, a Business Intelligence tool such as Tableau or, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, DB2 or other RDBMS platform.

Preferably proficient in SQL or expertise in analytics tools such as Tableau.

Exposure to reporting tools such as Microsoft SQL Server Reporting (SSRS); Crystal Reports or Business Objects.

Proficiency in data manipulation and extraction techniques.

Exposure to Extract, Transform and Load (ETL) technology, Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) preferred.

Experience with integrating data from heterogeneous systems (flat files, Excel as well as relational database systems.)

Team Orientation, Problem Solving, And Communication Skills Required.

Proficient with Microsoft Excel.

Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with ability to collaborate at multiple organization levels across the health system as required, including both technical and non?technical staff.

Epic trained and / or certified preferred.

Working knowledge of data models from EMRs and/or healthcare.

Physical/Mental Requirements And Typical Working Conditions

Exposure to stressful situations, including those involving public contact, as well as, trauma, grief and death.

Able to wear personal protective equipment that includes latex materials or appropriate substitute if required for your position.

Is able to move freely about facility with or without an assisted device and must be able to perform the functions of the job as outlined in the job description.

Overall vision and hearing is necessary with or without assisted device(s).

Frequently required to sit/stand/walk for long periods of time. May require frequent postural changes such as stooping, kneeling or crouching.

Some exposure to blood borne pathogens and other potentially infectious material. Must follow MidMichigan Health bloodborne pathogen and TB testing as required.

Ability to handle multiple tasks, get along with others, work independently, regular and predictable attendance and ability to stay awake.

Overall dexterity is required including handling, reaching, grasping, fingering and feeling. May require repetition of these movements on a regular to frequent basis.

Physical Demand Level: Sedentary. Must be able to occasionally (0?33% of the workday) lift or carry 0?10 lbs.

Job Summary And Responsibilities

As our Data Analyst, you will transform complex data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, improving patient outcomes, and enhancing operational efficiency.

Every day you will collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets from patient care, operations, and finance. You'll create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to present findings, identify trends, and inform initiatives for quality, cost reduction, and evidence-based practices.

To be successful, you will demonstrate strong analytical skills, proficiency in data tools (SQL, Tableau, Excel), and an understanding of healthcare data. Excellent communication for technical insights and a commitment to data integrity are essential.

  • Furnishes routine and ad hoc data analysis and reporting.
  • Coordinates and analyzes data inputs and outputs for accuracy/ quality. Consults with other employees and vendors/payers as needed.
  • Makes recommendations to leadership on opportunities for improvement of data quality. Implement change efforts related to data quality as directed by leadership by interacting with subject matter experts supporting the various data sources (EMRs, payers and vendors).
  • Researches best practices for data structure, reporting and analytics involving health and social care integration.
  • Collaborates with clinical and IT staff to design workflows integrating technology and maximizing efficiency in population health interventions.
  • Consults with leadership regarding project priorities, timelines and assignments.
  • This is Not a Remote Role**

Required

Job Requirements

  • Bachelors in Computer Science, Information Systems and Management, Biomedical Science, Business or Healthcare Administration, or a related field and Two (2) years health care or data analytics experience
  • Other Formal education in programming languages (SQL, Python, etc.), upon hire
  • EPIC Certification, within 6 - months

Preferred

  • EPIC Clarity certification Strongly Preferred upon hire
  • Prior Clinical Research Experience
  • Masters in Computer Science, Information Systems and Management, Biomedical Science, Business or Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

Where You'll Work

CommonSpirit Health was formed by the alignment of Catholic Health Initiatives (CHI) and Dignity Health. With more than 700 care sites across the U.S., from clinics and hospitals to home-based care and virtual care services, CommonSpirit is accessible to nearly one out of every four U.S. residents. Our world needs compassion like never before. Our communities need caring and our families need protection. With our combined resources, CommonSpirit is committed to building healthy communities, advocating for those who are poor and vulnerable, and innovating how and where healing can happen, both inside our hospitals and out in the community.

Pay Range

$30.76 - $45.76 /hour

Description And Functions

General Description

Do you enjoy finding meaning in data and using it to improve people’s lives? Join the Wyoming Department of Health’s Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) Section, where your work helps Wyoming residents who are aging or have disabilities live independent, meaningful, and dignified lives in their own communities.

Wyoming’s Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS)Section provides community-based options to Wyoming citizens who are aging or have disabilities in order to live independent, meaningful, and dignified lives through access to person-centered, cost-effective services. These waivers serve approximately 5,000 individuals, with approximately 800 provider entities supporting these individuals across the state. Each of the three waivers, the Comprehensive, Supports, and Community Choices Waivers, is Medicaid-funded, jointly funded by the state and federal governments. The Home and Community Based Services Section within the Wyoming Division of Healthcare Finance, which is part of the Wyoming Department of Health, manages these waivers.

As the HCBS Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in keeping Wyoming’s Home and Community-Based Services programs running smoothly. You’ll use data and technology to help ensure people receive the care and services they need, when they need them. This position focuses on systems project management, data analysis, technical support, and training, all of which directly impact how effectively HCBS serves individuals across the state.

Working for the State of Wyoming offers more than a paycheck. Our total compensation package includes:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid vacation, sick leave, FMLA, and holidays
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility
  • Retirement - Pension and 457(b) plans that help you build a secure future
  • Flexible schedules and work-life balance options
  • Meaningful work that makes a difference for Wyoming communities

and MUCH MORE! Click here for detailed information, or you can watch this short video to learn about our benefits package!

Explore our Total Compensation Calculator: compensationcalculator.wyo.gov

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: The listed functions are illustrative only and are not intended to describe every function that may be performed at the job level.

  • Manage and improve data systems – Work within programs like IMPROV and EMWS to make sure information is accurate, reliable, and accessible. You’ll help identify problems, find solutions, and ensure the systems are working for the people who use them.
  • Analyze and interpret data – Use your analytical skills to find patterns, identify trends, and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery. You’ll turn complex information into clear reports and recommendations that leadership can act on.
  • Collaborate with others – Partner with internal teams, vendors, and outside stakeholders to enhance the tools and systems that keep HCBS operating efficiently. Your collaboration will help turn data into clear insights and guide system improvements.
  • Support decision-making and policy – The work you do will inform decisions about policy, planning, and program design, helping shape the future of HCBS in Wyoming.
  • Lead system updates and testing – Guide testing, development, and implementation of new system features. You’ll help ensure every change improves usability, accuracy, and efficiency for staff and providers.
  • Train and support staff – Provide guidance and training for HCBS staff on system use, data entry, and reporting tools so they can confidently navigate updates and changes.
  • Think critically and creatively – Use data insights to recommend new or improved ways to deliver services, streamline processes, and strengthen program integrity.

Qualifications

PREFERENCES:

Experience with Specific HCBS Systems: Direct experience or a deep understanding of the HCBS systems managed by the position (IMPROV, EMWS, HCBS Provider Submission Portal, EVV, WYSERVES).

  • Business Intelligence Tool Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in using the listed business intelligence tools (Cognos, Tableau, R, SQL, SSRS) to develop complex queries and reports.
  • Medicaid Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Medicaid law, regulatory structure, and policies, as well as the principles and practices of professional healthcare administration.
  • Scrum/Agile Experience: Active participation and leadership in developing test cases and engaging in Scrum meetings with vendor project teams.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge of State and federal government functions, procedures, and concepts, and an understanding of Medicaid law and regulatory structure.
  • Ability to comprehend, interpret, and integrate federal regulations, state statutes, program rules, and policy into legislation, statute, and policy.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues and resolve or recommend solutions; able to originate ideas and techniques for solving technical problems.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills to effectively interact with and present to a broad range of audiences (administrators, legislators, contractors, staff, etc.).
  • Ability to learn new and emerging technologies quickly.
  • Ability to gather functional and non-functional requirements expeditiously and effectively.
  • SQL writing, R, Python, etc.

Education

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's Degree (typically in Records or Data Management)

Experience

0-3 years of progressive work experience in (typically in Records and Data Management) with acquired knowledge at the level of a Records & Data Management Specialist II

OR

Education & Experience Substitution

4-6 years of progressive work experience in (typically in Records and Data Management) with acquired knowledge at the level of a Records & Data Management Specialist II

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

None

Physical Working Conditions

  • The employee may sit comfortably to perform the work; however, there may be some walking, standing, bending, carrying light items, driving an automobile, etc.

Notes

Working for the State of Wyoming means more than a job — it’s a stable, rewarding career that lets you make a difference while enjoying a great quality of life.

Employees Enjoy

  • Comprehensive health coverage – medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
  • Voluntary Benefits – including life insurance for you and family members, ambulance, pet insurance, short/long-term disability, flex spending and health savings accounts
  • Multiple retirement options – including the Wyoming Retirement System and a 457B account, helping you plan for long-term financial security
  • Generous paid leave and flexible schedules – vacation, sick leave, paid FMLA and 9 paid holidays each year
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness eligibility – for those with qualifying student loans
  • Training and professional development – to support your career growth and advancement

descriptionHtml:
The Business Data Analyst I role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to turn data into decisions that drive real impact in the supply chain world? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Business Data Analyst I who thrives on solving complex problems, creating powerful visualizations, and delivering actionable insights. This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. If you're passionate about analytics, innovation, and making a difference, this role is for you. If you're a curious, self-driven problem solver with a passion for analytics, innovation, and impact—this role is for you!

Job Description

As a Business Data Analyst I, you will play a key role in transforming operational data into strategic insights that identify opportunities, improve performance, and reduce costs. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build reports, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. This role is ideal for someone with foundational analytics experience who is ready to take ownership of projects and grow into a trusted resource for data solutions.


  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Collaborate with site and sector leadership to identify opportunities for efficiency and cost reduction
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through presentations and reports for internal and customer use
  • Ability to leverage data from various systems that support our operations (Warehouse Management System, Timekeeping systems, etc.)
  • Manage analytics projects independently, from concept to delivery
  • Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and support


Required Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 1+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Hands-on experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
  • Experience writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts and data modeling techniques, preferred
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, preferred
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines, required
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required


Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

Overview

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Data Analyst to support program management, data analytics, dashboard development and reporting activities at Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). This role will work with a team of both officers and contractors to interconnect reporting and analytics, tasking responses, and overall information to support the ICE mission. This role will directly support activities with the Miami Field Office on-site as they work to integrate processes to make law enforcement initiatives more efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analysis of ICE specific mission data, processes, field operations, strategic planning, or nuanced mission systems.
  • Develop data analytics dashboards, tools and templates to support the efficient collection and analysis of field metrics.
  • Utilize tools such as Power BI, tableau, Excel, and Access to provide visualizations to overall data sets.
  • Support collaboration with multiple stakeholders, such as business, scrum teams, other project managers, to collect and compile information to ensure timely responses to requests and ad hoc assignments.
  • Facilitate the needs, issues, and challenges faced by the clients; perform gap analysis and recommend solutions.
  • Use source data to assess the effectiveness of projects and business processes.
  • Develop, gather and disseminate information and documentation among both business and technical customers.
  • Work with all team members to analyze changes in requirements and recommend the most expedient solutions in a timely manner.
  • Leverage advanced writing skills to translate complicated issues from multiple information sources into a clear point of view to create a compelling, concise, and well-written narrative.
  • Leverage excellent presentation development skills to prepare meeting agendas and synthesize complex information into succinct visualizations using tools such as PowerPoint.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's with 3 + years (or commensurate experience) in dynamic customer delivery environments
  • Clearance Required: Ability to attain and maintain DHS clearance (US citizenship required)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Ability to translate ICE specific mission needs into tactical execution of reports, taskings and overall data analytics.
  • Excellent data analytic and oral communication skills.
  • Strong understanding in project management and data analysis.
  • Ability to lead data analytics development.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in an extremely fast-paced environment.
  • Be flexible to change direction on a moment’s notice while also tracking/executing tasks in progress.
  • Ability to think “outside of the box” while communicating or dealing with a variety of situations.
  • Possess clear understanding of the activities, roles, and responsibilities on large scale IT projects.

Posted Salary Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr.

Description

The Data Analyst, working as part of the Business Information Systems team, will support the data and analytics initiatives of Springfield Public Schools with a strategic focus on efficient and effective district operations, provisioning datasets for district leaders, and data governance through enterprise integration of district data assets. PLEASE NOTE: This is NOT a remote opportunity. Staff members are expected to work in the office.

Duties

  • Work with the Business Information Systems team to provide actionable data to stakeholders supporting and monitoring efficient and effective district operations.
  • Support state reporting by assuring data integrity
  • Convert existing Access databases and Power Queries to Power BI using Azure data platform.
  • Meet with stakeholders to understand data needs and define reporting requirements in alignment with district priorities. Develop reports and dashboards in Power BI to meet these needs
  • Support efforts to modernize and automate data processes.
  • Integrate data across district systems to promote data quality and governance.
  • Collaborate to define, develop, and deploy curated datasets.
  • In collaboration with stakeholders, test and validate data deliverables.
  • Develop and maintain documentation and code versioning.
  • Support a culture of data governance and data literacy.
  • Any other duties assigned by Business Information Systems Manager, CIO, or Superintendent of Schools.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, computer science, or related study.
  • Experience performing data analysis in a business/financial environment preferred.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Power Query or comparable data analytic software.
  • Experience using modern data and analytics platforms preferred (ex., Power BI or Tableau).
  • Experience with database management systems.
  • Proficiency with SQL is preferred.
  • Experience with one or more programming languages is preferred (Python, JavaScript, R).
  • An understanding of data integration patterns using API interfaces is preferred.
  • Experience developing data pipelines is preferred.
  • Experience with Power Automate or other low code technology is preferred.
  • Familiarity with both on-prem and cloud-native application architectures is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated success working independently and collaboratively.

PLEASE NOTE: This is NOT a remote opportunity. Staff members are expected to work in the office.

Duties



- Work with the Business Information Systems team to provide actionable data to stakeholders supporting and monitoring efficient and effective district operations.
- Support state reporting by assuring data integrity
- Convert existing Access databases and Power Queries to Power BI using Azure data platform.
- Meet with stakeholders to understand data needs and define reporting requirements in alignment with district priorities. Develop reports and dashboards in Power BI to meet these needs
- Support efforts to modernize and automate data processes.
- Integrate data across district systems to promote data quality and governance.
- Collaborate to define, develop, and deploy curated datasets.
- In collaboration with stakeholders, test and validate data deliverables.
- Develop and maintain documentation and code versioning.
- Support a culture of data governance and data literacy.
- Any other duties assigned by Business Information Systems Manager, CIO, or Superintendent of Schools.

Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, computer science, or related study.
- Experience performing data analysis in a business/financial environment preferred.
- Proficiency with Excel and Power Query or comparable data analytic software.
- Experience using modern data and analytics platforms preferred (ex., Power BI or Tableau).
- Experience with database management systems.
- Proficiency with SQL is preferred.
- Experience with one or more programming languages is preferred (Python, JavaScript, R).
- An understanding of data integration patterns using API interfaces is preferred.
- Experience developing data pipelines is preferred.
- Experience with Power Automate or other low code technology is preferred.
- Familiarity with both on-prem and cloud-native application architectures is preferred.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Demonstrated success working independently and collaboratively.
- Adept at effectively managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines in a high-demand environment.

"If you BELIEVE, we have a place for YOU on our team! Come work for us!"

About Our District

Springfield Public Schools is a cultural gem in Western Massachusetts that is committed to providing a learning environment that opens the doors of infinite possibilities to our amazing students and staff. We strive to equip each of our approximately 24,000 students with learning experiences that enhance their knowledge and critical thinking skills. We are the 3rd largest district in Massachusetts. Our district has over 44 languages spoken and over 60 countries represented by both students and staff. We foster a positive and professional environment in our schools and worksites where people feel valued, respected, supported, seen and heard. Our students and staff share their ideas and perspectives, learning from and appreciating each other. We are a district that is committed to equity and excellence.

Join a team that Empowers Educators

In addition to offering competitive salaries and benefits, we provide numerous cutting-edge professional development opportunities for all staff. We let our data shape the professional development of the district, therefore, it is relevant and actionable. We support our teaching staff with mentors such as instructional leadership specialists and effective educator coaches to work with them throughout the year in lesson planning, data analysis and management. Our district offers career advancement opportunities and is invested in “Grow our Own” and educational pipeline programs. These programs help our staff achieve a college degree or lead to certification pathways.
