MarshBerry, a subsidiary of Lincoln International, is growing! We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. We have a people-first, fast-paced, collaborative culture with plenty of opportunity for growth. MarshBerry has been successful in achieving growth objectives because of the trust our clients place in our talented team of professionals, and all MarshBerry colleagues play a critical role in directly or indirectly cultivating those trusted relationships. MarshBerry provides an environment where employees can learn, improve, and realize their career goals. We offer competitive benefits, hybrid work schedules, new challenges, and learning experiences.


Job Details

MarshBerry is currently seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst for our Beachwood, OH office. The Business Intelligence Analyst will translate complex information into clear, actionable insights for internal teams and external clients. This role combines hands-on data stewardship, detailed analysis, research and writing, and continuous improvement of the metrics, methodologies and tools that support MarshBerry’s Intellectual Capital products and services. The ideal candidate is proactive, self-motivated, curious and client-focused, with an interest in learning deal transaction terminology and processes and private markets.


This is a hybrid position. The identified candidate will work in the office Monday through Thursday with the option to work remotely on Friday's.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain, validate and enhance proprietary MarshBerry datasets, ensuring data quality, consistency, completeness and confidentiality.
  • Conduct fact finding, data gathering and detailed analysis; identify trends and synthesize findings into accurate, client-ready reports, presentations and written summaries.
  • Support internal and external client projects, benchmarking analyses, market research, surveys and special data requests from scoping through delivery.
  • Develop a strong understanding of MarshBerry’s data, methodologies, products and services.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing data, workflows, methodologies and reporting; proactively recommend new metrics, analyses and ways to make insights more useful.
  • Complete projects in desired timeframe utilizing prioritization skills to keep multiple projects progressing on target.
  • Perform special projects and other tasks as assigned.


Selection Criteria

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Statistics or Mathematics preferred; equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
  • 2-5 years of experience collecting, managing and analyzing data; prior experience in finance, investment banking or consulting is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with PowerBI is a plus.


Other:

  • Analytical and critical-thinking skills, with a proactive approach to identifying issues and improving processes.
  • Curiosity, initiative and self-motivation, with the ability to prioritize work and make sound decisions independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering accurate, client-ready work on schedule.
  • Client-focused mindset and strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize technical findings for different audiences.
  • Ability to handle confidential, sensitive, and proprietary information with sound judgment and discretion, ensuring client and company data is protected.


Working at MarshBerry


Who We Are:

MarshBerry is a global leader in investment banking and strategic consulting for the financial services industry. With over 40 years of experience, MarshBerry empowers firms in insurance brokerage & distribution, wealth advisory & retirement planning and accounting & tax practices to achieve long-term growth, maximize value, and navigate every stage of ownership. Core offerings include Investment Banking services such as Merger & Acquisition Advisory and Capital Raising, as well as Financial Consulting in Strategic Planning, Valuations, and Perpetuation Planning. MarshBerry also provides specialized support in Organic Growth Consulting, Executive Peer Exchange, Agency Network and Market Intelligence & Performance Benchmarking. For more information, visit www.MarshBerry.com.


What We Do:

MarshBerry provides consulting services in the financial services industry primarily to independent insurance agents, brokers and carriers, as well as wealth and retirement plan advisors. Our services include but are not limited to financial, operational, sales management, merger and acquisition advisory, an agency network, peer-to-peer exchange and information services. We are recognized in the financial services industry for providing innovative and customized solutions to our clients, with whom we build trusted advisor relationships. At MarshBerry, our mission is to help our clients learn, improve and realize their value. Our clients credit us for providing the vision, tools, and discipline to help them reach their strategic goals.


It’s one thing to be recognized as experts in our field, it is another to be noteworthy based on the sentiment and feedback of our team. MarshBerry has recently been awarded the following:


  • North Coast 99
  • Top Work Places – The Plain Dealer
  • Best Companies Group - Inclusive Workplace
  • Crain's Fast 50

To learn more about MarshBerry, visit www.marshberry.com.

About Us

At Selective, we don't just insure uniquely, we employ uniqueness.

Selective is a midsized U.S. domestic property and casualty insurance company with a history of strong, consistent financial performance for nearly 100 years. Selective's unique position as both a leading insurance group and an employer of choice is recognized in a wide variety of awards and honors, including listing in Forbes Best Midsize Employers in 2025 and certification as a Great Place to Work® in 2025 for the sixth consecutive year.

Employees are empowered and encouraged to Be Uniquely You by being their true, unique selves and contributing their diverse talents, experiences, and perspectives to our shared success. Together, we are a high-performing team working to serve our customers responsibly by helping to mitigate loss, keep them safe, and restore their lives and businesses after an insured loss occurs.

Overview

Partner closely with the Claims leadership team and other functions within Claims to develop reports, metrics, and dashboards that support Staff Counsel and potentially the larger claims organization initiatives. Build, update, and maintain a claims operations reporting suite and deliver on several high-impact and high-visibility analytical projects for both the Claims and the Executive Leadership Teams. All job duties and responsibilities must be carried out in compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain subject matter expertise for all claims reporting platforms and delivery methods, including but not limited to advanced functionality and content.
  • Establish and maintain a monthly claims legal, operational reporting package that includes a dashboard, scorecards, and reports utilizing Power BI, Cognos, Microsoft Excel, and legal platforms.
  • Support the claims team with ad-hoc analytical requests from management platforms such as Team Connect, Legal X, and claims financial/transactional platforms and databases.
  • Compile and analyze audit data relating to law firm performance and litigation support vendor performance. Provide creative alternatives and recommendations to reduce costs and improve financial performance, including opportunities for Staff Counsel efficiencies.
  • Perform descriptive analytics by producing and analyzing metrics and identifying data trends. Develop tables, charts, and graphs, including executive summaries for Executive Leadership.
  • Develop and document processes and techniques to extract, clean, and analyze data. Conduct training, including developing user procedures, guidelines, and documentation. Train the various Claims teams and new system users on new processes/functionality.
  • Educate end users on the various claims platforms. Seek out opportunities to scale Claims platforms and flag opportunities for efficiencies. Conduct impact analysis of technology changes on business processes and existing technology.
  • Leverage effective facilitation and collaboration skills to partner with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Attend team meetings, roundtables, depositions, trials, etc., as needed.

Qualifications

Knowledge and Requirements

  • Knowledge of claims financial/transactional platforms and databases
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships
  • Strong organizational, time management, and project prioritization skills
  • Excellent written communication skills; ability to clearly express thoughts and ideas through documentation
  • Expert proficiency in most standard business software applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint
  • Ability to generate reports and build dashboards utilizing Cognos analytics
  • Meticulous attention to detail
  • Property and Casualty industry knowledge

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred or 5+ years of experience developing analytics, reporting and providing actionable recommendations driven by data.
  • Experience working with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Cognos, or various claims management platforms.

Total Rewards

Selective Insurance offers a total rewards package that includes a competitive base salary, incentive plan eligibility at all levels, and a wide array of benefits designed to help you and your family stay healthy, achieve your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. These benefits include comprehensive health care plans, retirement savings plan with company match, discounted Employee Stock Purchase Program, tuition assistance and reimbursement programs, and 20 days of paid time off. Additional details about our total rewards package can be found by visiting our benefits page.

The actual base salary is based on geographic location, and the range is representative of salaries for this role throughout Selective's footprint. Additional considerations include relevant education, qualifications, experience, skills, performance, and business needs.

Pay Range

USD $83,000.00 - USD $108,000.00 /Yr.

Additional Information

Selective is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. That means we respect and value every individual’s unique opinions, beliefs, abilities, and perspectives. We are committed to promoting a welcoming culture that celebrates diverse talent, individual identity, different points of view and experiences – and empowers employees to contribute new ideas that support our continued and growing success. Building a highly engaged team is one of our core strategic imperatives, which we believe is enhanced by diversity, equity, and inclusion. We expect and encourage all employees and all of our business partners to embrace, practice, and monitor the attitudes, values, and goals of acceptance; address biases; and foster diversity of viewpoints and opinions.

For Massachusetts Applicants

Job Description

The Role

Be a part of the organization that helps service the Fidelity Stock Plan Services (SPS) Financial Reporting team! In this role you will be the first line of support to a defined client base in helping to provide a platform to acquire their financial reporting requirements related to equity compensation.

Serve as the client’s primary support for SPS’ financial reporting offering, with a client base typically 20 - 25 public companies spanning across all segments (Emerging, Mid, Large and Strategic). In this capacity, you are responsible for the processing and reporting of their client’s financial reporting data according to the client defined reporting schedule. You will work with their clients to establish, implement, execute, and supervise ad-hoc requests for support and analysis. The identification and development of process benchmarks and standard methodologies across the client base are important to client delivery. You will train client contacts to use Plan Sponsor Workstation (PSW) and its functionality such as SPS reporting, including customized reporting dashboards, as well as Team Workspace. The Financial Reporting Manager is highly engaged with client contacts and builds long term relationships to provide end to end service delivery.

  • As an important member of the Financial Reporting team, you will participate in all operational aspects of the reporting process; client developed scheduled reporting to ad-hoc report development (including fee for service projects).

descriptionHtml:
What To Expect
Tesla is committed to having industry-leading uptime and service for our deployed fleet of residential, commercial, and industrial utility scale solar, storage and charging systems. Commercial Service Operations Team is responsible for proactively monitoring the solar, storage and charging fleets for contractual compliance, operational challenges and ensure Service is delivered to our customers successfully.

As a Data Analyst on the Commercial Energy Service Operations team, you will have end-to-end ownership of data analytics projects related to (1) tracking successful delivery of our contractual obligations, (2) automating the required analysis to ensure compliance across the fleet and (3) improving the existing code base to ensure scalability and reliability of the data for decision making and process improvements. You will execute on all aspects of the project, i.e., those involving review of contracts and ticket system data, as well as those involving scripting and database management.

The ideal candidate would enjoy solving problems using data, have relentless curiosity, not be afraid to solve cross-functional problems and have a strong sense of ownership.

What You'll Do

  • Develop reports and visualizations to support business intelligence and reporting, data warehousing, and integration with enterprise applications
  • Develop models to track performance of Energy Products relative to their contractual obligations, project milestones and product lifecycles
  • Work closely with the subject matter experts to define and develop key performance indicators, measuring system performance and service outcomes
  • Develop and own user-centric data analytical dashboards displaying above metrics and seek continuous feedback from users to find areas of improvement
  • Conduct ad-hoc quantitative analyses to solve complex problems; formulate and refine hypotheses with stakeholders, collect and manipulate data, and draw compelling, actionable conclusions
  • Test and validate results to ensure accuracy and present results to the team and broader Energy Service organization


    • What You'll Bring

  • Evidence of exceptional ability, especially in navigating ambiguous environments
  • Proficient with SQL, Python, ticketing systems (Jira) and version control (Git)
  • 2-5 years of experience in data-intensive roles
  • Highly collaborative, team oriented, and comfortable driving tangible impact / influence on cross-functional projects, especially those consisting of both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to quickly grasp technical concepts at a detailed level and synthesize implications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when engaging with senior business leaders
  • A passion for sustainable energy


    • Benefits
    Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
  • Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
  • Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
  • Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
  • Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
  • Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
  • Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
  • Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
  • Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
  • Tesla Babies program
  • Commuter benefits
  • Employee discounts and perks program
  • Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)


    • Expected Compensation

    $69,600 - $168,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

    Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

Brief Job Description

Would you thrive in an environment where you learn and grow personally and professionally all while helping make a positive impact on people’s lives? Do you appreciate being around others like yourself who are dependable, trustworthy, hard workers who believe in the value of teamwork? HSCS is dedicated to building an atmosphere where employees feel valued and supported while providing specialized care for Texans in need. HSCS is comprised of ten psychiatric hospitals, two youth residential treatment facilities, and thirteen state supported living centers. Psychiatric hospitals are a hub of excellence for forensic mental health and complex psychiatric care, with all facilities accredited by The Joint Commission. They provide state-of-the-art treatment that is recovery-oriented and science-based. If providing hope and healing through compassionate, innovative, and individualized care interests you, we welcome your application for the position below.

The Data Analyst II performs routine (journey-level) data analysis work. Work involves creating and running queries to generate data sets, analyzing the data, and producing reports and graphics based on that data. Activities include a mix of running routine reports, responding to ad hoc report requests, and developing new reports to address identified needs. Responsibilities include ongoing development and technical support of local databases plus training and support of the individuals throughout the hospital using them. Works under moderate supervision, with limited latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Performs other duties as assigned. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Attends work on a regular basis and may be required to work a specific shift schedule or, at times, even a rotating schedule, extended shift and/or overtime in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.

Creates and supports databases and related data collection systems that are used by customers throughout the hospital. Assures that these systems function smoothly and return accurate and reliable results that can be used for data analysis. Monitors use of these data systems to promote accuracy of data input by various users. Creates or adjusts queries to meet ongoing changes in customers’ data needs. Provides relevant analysis of results as needed and discards unnecessary information.

Consults with internal and external customers to clarify their specific data needs and how those needs can best be met. Identifies existing reports that address ongoing data needs and ensures that customers can readily access those reports. Adjusts existing reports to better address existing needs. Creates new reports in response to newly identified needs.

Conducts ad hoc data analysis in response to specific requests from Hospital Management, State Hospitals Central Administration, and department heads throughout the hospital.

Runs production reports that involve some compilation of results on a daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis. Interprets the results to identify outliers in the data from ongoing measures and places results into optimal format for presentation.

Uses queries and reports to conduct audits or monitor for possible irregularities in how the electronic medical record and other databases are implemented. Assists in using the results of such analysis to provide training, modify procedures, or take other responsive action.

Performs other duties as assigned. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of common statistical measures and their relevance to data analysis.

Knowledge of the operation of electronic medical records and the specific types of information contained within them.

Skills in managing data in relational database management systems, including the creation of queries, linking of tables, extraction of relevant data, and assessment of the accuracy and validity of data within such systems.

Skills in the use of computers and common software programs used in data collection and analysis.

Ability to compile, review, and analyze data from existing data systems and to create reports and presentation graphics based on the results.

Ability to communicate with clinicians and department heads regarding their data needs.

Ability to maintain accuracy and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

None

Initial Screening Criteria

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field.

OR

Four (4) years’ equivalent experience in one or more of the above fields.

One year of experience in data analysis, research, and report design.

One year of experience with database software programs.

One year of experience creating queries and reports.

Experience can be overlapping.

Additional Information

Applicants must pass a fingerprint criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen, and registry checks including the Client Abuse/Neglect Reporting System (CANRS), Nurse Aid, Medication Aide and Employee Misconduct, List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Males between the ages of 18-25 must be registered with the Selective Service.

All applicants must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for employment at a state-operated facility. Waco and Terrell Center for Youth applicants must be 21 years of age.

Flexibility in work hours may be required for this position. The position may be required to work overtime and/or extended hours.

Compliance with HHSC immunization policy and state hospital operating procedures related to immunizations is required. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, healthcare workers are considered to be at significant risk for acquiring or transmitting hepatitis B, measles, mumps, rubella, varicella (chicken pox), tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis (whooping cough), and influenza. All these diseases are vaccine preventable. As a result, state hospital policy requires employees be vaccinated according to their level of contact with individuals. In the event you choose to not be immunized for the influenza virus, you may be required to wear a mask and take other protective measures.

Review our Tips for Success when applying for jobs at DFPS, DSHS and HHSC.

Active Duty, Military, Reservists, Guardsmen, And Veterans

Military occupation(s) that relate to the initial selection criteria and registration or licensure requirements for this position may include, but not limited to those listed in this posting. All active-duty military, reservists, guardsmen, and veterans are encouraged to apply if qualified to fill this position. For more information please see the Texas State Auditor’s Job Descriptions, Military Crosswalk and Military Crosswalk Guide at Texas State Auditor's Office - Job Descriptions.

ADA Accommodations

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), HHSC and DSHS agencies will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring and selection process for qualified individuals with a disability. If you need assistance completing the on-line application, contact the HHS Employee Service Center at 1-888-894-4747. If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodation to participate in the interview process, please notify the person scheduling the interview.

Pre-Employment Checks And Work Eligibility

Depending on the program area and position requirements, applicants selected for hire may be required to pass background and other due diligence checks.

HHSC uses E-Verify. You must bring your I-9 documentation with you on your first day of work. Download the I-9 Form

This position may be eligible for telework. Please note, all HHS positions are subject to state and agency telework policies in addition to the discretion of the direct supervisor and business needs.

Skills in managing data in relational database management systems, including the creation of queries, linking of tables, extraction of relevant data, and assessment of the accuracy and validity of data within such systems.

Skills in the use of computers and common software programs used in data collection and analysis.

Ability to compile, review, and analyze data from existing data systems and to create reports and presentation graphics based on the results.

Ability to communicate with clinicians and department heads regarding their data needs.

Ability to maintain accuracy and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

None

Initial Screening Criteria

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field.

OR

Four (4) years’ equivalent experience in one or more of the above fields.

One year of experience in data analysis, research, and report design.

One year of experience with database software programs.

One year of experience creating queries and reports.

Experience can be overlapping.

In the event you choose to not be immunized for the influenza virus, you may be required to wear a mask and take other protective measures.

job purpose:

descriptionHtml:
About the Company


The future of energy is digitized, decarbonized and localized. At SmartestEnergy, we need revolutionary thinkers to help our customers make the most of this new landscape, thinking differently to find smart solutions to complex problems.Formed in 2001, we’re an agile business driven by entrepreneurial thinking. As a subsidiary of the Marubeni Corporation, we also have strong investment and infrastructure behind us. As well as our three offices in the US, we have three offices in the UK and another in Australia. Further expansion is planned for 2027 and beyond which means global career opportunities for you, with plenty of potential to explore new markets.When you join our Team, you will have the opportunity to contribute and make an impact every single day.


About the Role


The Reporting Specialist is responsible for producing complete, accurate, and timely financial and executive reporting that supports business decision-making, financial performance monitoring, and operational effectiveness. The role delivers meaningful performance insights while enhancing reporting solutions, data quality, and processes.The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Commercial, Risk, and other business teams to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and aligned with organizational objectives.


This position is eligible for a hybrid working arrangement, requiring a minimum of 2-3 days per week worked in-office.


The anticipated salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000 annually. This position is eligible to participate in our company bonus.


Responsibilities


In this role, you will be involved with the following:


Reporting & Data Analysis


  • Produce monthly and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders.
  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and performance drivers.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Ensure data integrity through validation, reconciliation, and quality control processes.
  • Present findings and recommendations in a clear and concise manner.


Business Performance Reporting


  • Assist in the preparation of monthly reporting packages and supporting analysis.
  • Analyze actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Provide commentary and insights on significant variances and business drivers.
  • Assist in the preparation of executive and board-level reporting materials.


Data Management & Systems


  • Extract, transform, and analyze data from various systems and databases.
  • Maintain reporting models and automate recurring reporting processes where possible.
  • Partner with IT and business teams to improve reporting tools, processes, and data availability.
  • Document reporting methodologies, assumptions, and data sources.


Process Improvement


  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, accuracy, and automation.
  • Support implementation of new reporting tools and business intelligence solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across reporting and analytics functions.


Governance & Controls


  • Ensure reporting complies with internal controls, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain traceable support and audit trails for key reports.
  • Support audit requests and provide reporting-related information as required.


Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you are likely to have the following skills/experience:


Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.


Required Skills


  • 3-5 years of experience in reporting, financial analysis, business intelligence, or data analytics.
  • Experience preparing management or board packs with written commentary.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and complex formulas.
  • Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.


Preferred Skills


  • Preferred Qualifications: Experience within the energy, utilities, or commodities sectors.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Workday, QuickBooks or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of financial reporting and budgeting processes.
  • Key Competencies: Analytical thinking Attention to detail Data interpretation Problem-solving Communication and presentation skills Stakeholder management Time management and prioritization Continuous improvement mindset


Equal Opportunity Statement


Celebrating our inclusive and diverse culture is core to what we do. We value everybody irrespective of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability and genetic information (including family medical history). EOE.We know that for our business to thrive we need diverse talent with a range of backgrounds, skills and capabilities in each of the countries in which we operate. We view diversity as one of the key enablers that helps our business to grow.We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As such, if a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please reach out to the HR & People Team via email us-hrssc@smartestenergy.com so we can discuss with you further.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Data Analyst to support program management, data analytics, dashboard development and reporting activities at Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). This role will work with a team of both officers and contractors to interconnect reporting and analytics, tasking responses, and overall information to support the ICE mission. This role will directly support activities with the San Antonio Field Office on-site as they work to integrate processes to make law enforcement initiatives more efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analysis of ICE specific mission data, processes, field operations, strategic planning, or nuanced mission systems.
  • Develop data analytics dashboards, tools and templates to support the efficient collection and analysis of field metrics.
  • Utilize tools such as Power BI, tableau, Excel, and Access to provide visualizations to overall data sets.
  • Support collaboration with multiple stakeholders, such as business, scrum teams, other project managers, to collect and compile information to ensure timely responses to requests and ad hoc assignments.
  • Facilitate the needs, issues, and challenges faced by the clients; perform gap analysis and recommend solutions.
  • Use source data to assess the effectiveness of projects and business processes.
  • Develop, gather and disseminate information and documentation among both business and technical customers.
  • Work with all team members to analyze changes in requirements and recommend the most expedient solutions in a timely manner.
  • Leverage advanced writing skills to translate complicated issues from multiple information sources into a clear point of view to create a compelling, concise, and well-written narrative.
  • Leverage excellent presentation development skills to prepare meeting agendas and synthesize complex information into succinct visualizations using tools such as PowerPoint.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's with 3 + years (or commensurate experience) in dynamic customer delivery environments

Clearance Required: Ability to attain and maintain DHS clearance (US citizenship required)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Ability to translate ICE specific mission needs into tactical execution of reports, taskings and overall data analytics.
  • Excellent data analytic and oral communication skills.
  • Strong understanding in project management and data analysis.
  • Ability to lead data analytics development.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in an extremely fast-paced environment.
  • Be flexible to change direction on a moment’s notice while also tracking/executing tasks in progress.
  • Ability to think “outside of the box” while communicating or dealing with a variety of situations.
  • Possess clear understanding of the activities, roles, and responsibilities on large scale IT projects.

Posted Salary Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr.

*Job Summary and Responsibilities*

As our Data Analyst, you will transform complex data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, improving patient outcomes, and enhancing operational efficiency.

Every day you will collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets from patient care, operations, and finance. You'll create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to present findings, identify trends, and inform initiatives for quality, cost reduction, and evidence-based practices.

To be successful, you will demonstrate strong analytical skills, proficiency in data tools (SQL, Tableau, Excel), and an understanding of healthcare data. Excellent communication for technical insights and a commitment to data integrity are essential.

  • Furnishes routine and ad hoc data analysis and reporting.
  • Coordinates and analyzes data inputs and outputs for accuracy/ quality. Consults with other employees and vendors/payers as needed.
  • Makes recommendations to leadership on opportunities for improvement of data quality. Implement change efforts related to data quality as directed by leadership by interacting with subject matter experts supporting the various data sources (EMRs, payers and vendors).
  • Researches best practices for data structure, reporting and analytics involving health and social care integration.
  • Collaborates with clinical and IT staff to design workflows integrating technology and maximizing efficiency in population health interventions.
  • Consults with leadership regarding project priorities, timelines and assignments.

***This is Not a Remote Role***

*Job Requirements**Required*

  • Bachelors in Computer Science, Information Systems and Management, Biomedical Science, Business or Healthcare Administration, or a related field and Two (2) years health care or data analytics experience
  • Other Formal education in programming languages (SQL, Python, etc.), upon hire
  • EPIC Certification, within 6 - months

*Preferred*

  • EPIC Clarity certification Strongly Preferred upon hire
  • Prior Clinical Research Experience
  • Masters in Computer Science, Information Systems and Management, Biomedical Science, Business or Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

Where You'll Work

CommonSpirit Health was formed by the alignment of Catholic Health Initiatives (CHI) and Dignity Health. With more than 700 care sites across the U.S., from clinics and hospitals to home-based care and virtual care services, CommonSpirit is accessible to nearly one out of every four U.S. residents. Our world needs compassion like never before. Our communities need caring and our families need protection. With our combined resources, CommonSpirit is committed to building healthy communities, advocating for those who are poor and vulnerable, and innovating how and where healing can happen, both inside our hospitals and out in the community.

*Pay Range*

$30.76 - $45.76 /hour

descriptionHtml:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We collaborate with education organizations to develop strategies and implement solutions that enable the transformative change our clients need to own their future. Together, we empower clients to drive innovation, create sustainable funding streams and deliver better student outcomes.

Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on the essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change.

You’ll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

The Platform Analyst is a technically capable and client-aware contributor responsible for maintaining and enhancing the reporting tools, data visualizations and client-facing deliverables that define the quality of our Managed Services output.

This role owns the day-to-day health of our Power BI environment and client reporting infrastructure, while also playing a meaningful role in building technical capability across the broader team through our Tech Committee.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates clearly with both internal stakeholders and clients and is motivated by turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the maintenance, version control, and continuous improvement of internal Power BI reports and dashboards used to monitor performance across client portfolios.
  • Develop, maintain, and iterate on client-facing reporting functionality, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely, visually clear, and aligned to client reporting requirements.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for routine reporting questions from internal team members and clients, triaging issues and coordinating fixes with the DevOps Platform Engineer as needed.
  • Support the Tech Committee by developing and delivering technical skill-building content, facilitating learning sessions, and helping committee members grow competency in relevant tools and platforms (Power BI, ADO, AI tools, etc.).
  • Document reporting logic, data definitions, and dashboard standards to ensure consistency and enable

knowledge transfer across the team.

  • Assist the DevOps Platform Engineer with testing and QA on platform changes that affect reporting data flows or client-facing outputs.
  • Identify opportunities to automate or streamline manual reporting processes and bring recommendations to the team with supporting analysis.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in a business analyst, data analyst, or platform/reporting role within a technology forward organization.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including report and dashboard development, DAX fundamentals, data model management, and workspace administration.
  • Experience developing and maintaining client-facing reports or deliverables, with a strong sense of data accuracy and presentation quality.
  • Experience working with structured data from multiple sources (Excel, SharePoint, SQL, APIs) and understanding of basic ETL concepts.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical outputs clearly to non-technical audiences, both in writing and in conversation.
  • Experience collaborating in a cross-functional team environment, including working with senior engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a Managed Services, consulting, or multi-client delivery environment.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps for task and project tracking.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Dataflows Gen2, or Power Query for data transformation.
  • Prior experience facilitating training sessions, lunch-and-learns, or technical enablement activities.
  • Familiarity with AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) as productivity aids within a professional workflow.
  • Microsoft Power BI certification (PL-300) or equivalent. Success Indicators — First 90 Days
  • Full inventory of existing Power BI reports is documented, with known issues triaged and a remediation backlog established.
  • Client-facing reporting outputs are reviewed for accuracy and a quality checklist or release process is proposed.
  • First Tech Committee learning session is planned and delivered, with attendee feedback collected.
  • At least one reporting process is identified for automation or simplification, with a proposal presented to the team.

Huron is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Position Level

Analyst

Country

United States of America

At OSUP, we foster a culture grounded in the values of inclusion, empathy, sincerity, and determination. We meet our teams where they are, coming together to serve each other and our community.

Purpose: Under the direction of management, and in collaboration with The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center (OSUWMC), creates and generates custom/standard reports for organizational initiatives and business operations including analytic development from Epic applications and databases to address operational measurement and decision making requirements. Responsibilities include querying Epic/OSUWMC databases, data analysis, data discovery modeling, creating/updating SQL queries, integration of various external data sources, and generation of presentation materials and/or data visualization tools.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develops clear and well-structured analytical plans and utilizes data sets to analyze operational data sets, patient populations, business outcomes, and business operations of a significant and sensitive nature. Partners with business leaders to understand analyses and the impact of cause-and-effect relationships.

  • Develops written procedures and user documentation for data analysis and reporting
  • Produces information for administrative, billing and clinical presentations and decision support.

  • Participates in conference calls and conferences to maintain knowledge and understanding of quality initiatives inrelation to data requirements.

  • Epic certification (either at date of hire, or within 6 months of date of hire).
  • Proficiency in SQL.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret data specifications to create/generate the files and reports necessary to meet program/contract requirements and create actionable recommendations based off that data.

Preferences

  • Existing Epic certification in Resolute PB, Cadence, EpicCare Ambulatory, Healthy Planet and/or Clarity, or a related module.
  • Experience in computer applications including proficiency in querying relational databases (including SQL), data transformation (e.g. Alteryx) and data visualization (e.g. Qlik, PowerBI, Tableau).

Pay Range

USD $81,423.73 - USD $122,135.60 /Yr.

descriptionHtml:
The Data Analyst within the Office of Institutional Analytics uses statistical methods, existing reports, and ad hoc reporting developed using university report writing assets to call up, refine, and report data to inform institutional analytics processes and solve business problems. The Data Analyst also consults on data collection / processes and engages in projects of institutional analytics need, particularly those focused on enrollment, retention, productivity, efficiency and contact center routing strategies.

Work Location: Virginia Beach, VA (Qualified candidates may be considered for remote work depending on location.)

Salary: $45,000-$50,000 annually

Essential Duties

  • Determine data needs from various constituencies and lead or contribute to the design, testing, validation, and delivery of reports which provide the desired data outputs.
  • Collect, maintain, and expand upon the regularly requested reports in support of the various needs of the institution, including weekly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reporting needs for the university.
  • Maintain applicable websites and/or project inventories.
  • Master in-house and popular reporting/analysis tools (Pyramid, Discoverer, Microsoft BI, Tableau) and provide expert training to other data constituents.
  • Develop data documentation manuals or other learning materials, as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to the work described above (e.g.: math or computer science); Master’s degree preferred, though significant experience related to the job requirements can substitute for a relevant master’s degree
  • Prior experience with analytical software is a must

Candidates Must Have

  • Must be comfortable with the detailed work of data validation and preparation
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate the ability to translate data into presentable formats, via PowerBI or other visualization tools for organizational executives; careful attention to detail and professional business acumen are a foremost consideration
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both oral and written, which demonstrate the ability to convey complex and technical data and concepts in ways suited to the recipient’s needs
  • Excellent customer service and project management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptionHtml:
About us


Network Rail Consulting (NRC) is the international consultancy arm of Network Rail – the owner and operator of Britain’s mainline rail system. We have been active in the North American, Australian and the Middle East markets since 2013 and have successfully delivered more than 150 consultancy contracts for government, public and privately owned organizations.


Through our consulting services in the United States (US), we are assisting both public agencies and private clients in the transportation sector to accelerate transformation efforts, make step-changes in major program delivery, and achieve leaps forward in areas such as asset management & maintenance, major projects, railway operations, strategic planning and advisory.


Our work is driven forward by our values: agile, always safe, care about people, collaborative, impartial and passionate.


About the Role


NRC supports multiple US clients from our strategic locations in Washington DC, New York City, and Boston, as well as West Coast clients from our offices in California and Seattle.

We are seeking a Data Analyst for our Seattle location.


You will provide support to our internal project teams and our clients to extract, compile, analyze and visualize data to help us make informed decisions that drive improvement in the way that transit assets are managed. Creating impactful PowerPoint presentations is a significant part of the role.


The initial client work will be with Sound Transit and King County Metro staff, focusing on data related to work orders, inventory, training data, and project dashboards.


What will you be doing?


  • Compile data from client systems including Trapeze EAM, Maximo EAM, and various LMS / EAM / ERP systems for training and inventory data.
  • Perform data mapping to support data migration and data conformance evaluation.
  • Develop data definition/dictionaries with SMEs.
  • Evaluate data quality against agency data quality metrics.
  • Develop data standards through partnering with data governance program.
  • Communicate to business on the remediation plan needed and develop plans to support next steps work on data remediation.
  • Develop reference data and taxonomies.
  • Provide feedback on data remediation recommendations.
  • Extract and organize data for analysis and trending and compares ERP/EAM Program needs and requirements.
  • Ensure data quality and compliance with applicable state and federal laws and regulations.
  • Design and build dashboards in Excel and Power BI for internal and external use.
  • Prepare PowerPoint presentations for internal and external use.
  • Assist the Client, Project Manager or project team as required.


About You


Applicants should be a recent graduate or have a bachelor’s or master’s Degree or equivalent in a relevant field.


You are passionate about data and ways that data can tell a story. You have strong analytical and critical thinking skills; strong formal report, presentation and note writing skills, proficiency in spreadsheet manipulation; great attention to detail and communication skills.

  • Highly skilled in Power BI, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Excellent communicator and writer
  • Experience in MS Co-Pilot
  • A highly capable visual storyteller that can make data easy to understand
  • An excellent listener that can work independently with clients
  • Experience with EAM / CMMS applications is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience with ERP / LMS / GIS applications is desirable but not essential.


For the right person, this role presents a fantastic opportunity to develop their career, joining an established and passionate team, with ambitious plans to grow.


We offer benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Healthcare insurance premiums (100% paid for by us)
  • Generous vacation leave entitlement
  • 401K with employer matching contributions
  • Access to Employee Discount Program via LifeMart


NRC supports flexible working practices, and we understand that life balance is an important part of our employees' lives. We offer a wide range of flexible work/life balance options such as hybrid (home/office) working, flexible working hours where appropriate.


Candidate must be eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future


Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role


Apply


Network Rail Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, or veteran status.


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

descriptionHtml:
The Business Intelligence Analyst supports the analysis of operational workflows and lifetime profitability to measure operational and marketing channel effectiveness, and ensure adequate profitability for the business being written by the Direct Group. The person is responsible for assisting in the creation and maintenance of various databases, performance metrics and analytics required to achieve these goals.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Works closely with others to gain strong understanding of insurance concepts such as financial P&Ls, expense ratios, rate level indications, loss ratio trends, and marketing funnel metrics and to get familiar with internal workflows (i.e. underwriting, sales and claims handling).
  • Identify creative reporting solutions, including ad-hoc analysis that facilitates effective measurement of operational effectiveness. Upgrade existing reports to increase efficiency of distribution, reduce redundancy across reports and to improve ease of presentation.
  • Collaborate with other analytical teams throughout the enterprise to review insights from recent analytical exercises.
  • Effectively uses available front end reporting tools, data systems and information gathered from different areas throughout the company to analyze business issues. Communicate results to management.
  • Work with large databases from Production Data warehouse. Collaborate with data teams to leverage tools and techniques developed for effective data extraction, transformation and loading (ETL).
  • Build automated reporting and analytical tools, which includes a) queries that extract and summarize data from our data warehouse and b) procedures that integrate this data into dynamic workbooks allowing for multiple levels of analysis.
  • Acts as a liaison between the Business Intelligence team and other departments within the Direct Group.


Qualifications and Education

  • Demonstrated problem solving experience gained through related coursework and work experience. BA/BS degree in quantitative field of study.
  • Property and Casualty Insurance experience preferred.
  • Analytical problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and attention to detail. Prior Product or Actuarial experience desired.
  • Strong programming/query experience in SQL Server and Tableau report building.
  • Proficient with all Microsoft Office products.
  • Three or more years of experience with relational database tools and concepts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Collaborative nature but also has the ability to work independently and efficiently on a high volume of tasks.


Salary Range

The pay range for this position is $71,000 to $94,000 annually. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including employee knowledge and experience, role scope, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.


Perks & Benefits


  • 4 weeks accrued paid time off, 8 paid national holidays per year, and 2 floating holidays
  • Low cost and excellent coverage health insurance options that start on Day 1 (medical, dental, vision)
  • Annual 401(k) Employer Contribution
  • Free onsite gym at our Woodbridge Location
  • Resources to promote Professional Development (LinkedIn Learning and licensure assistance)
  • Robust health and wellness program and fitness reimbursements
  • Various Paid Family leave options including Paid Parental Leave
  • Tuition Reimbursement


About the Company

The Plymouth Rock Company and its affiliated group of companies write and manage over $2 billion in personal and commercial auto and homeowner’s insurance throughout the Northeast and mid-Atlantic, where we have built an unparalleled reputation for service. We continuously invest in technology, our employees thrive in our empowering environment, and our customers are among the most loyal in the industry. The Plymouth Rock group of companies employs more than 1,900 people and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Plymouth Rock Assurance Corporation holds an A.M. Best rating of “A-/Excellent”.

Job Summary

Jabil, Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented Finance Data Analyst to support financial planning, analysis, and reporting through robust data management and insightful analysis. This role is crucial for transforming raw financial data into actionable intelligence, contributing to strategic decision-making and operational efficiency.

Location

This role will be based on-site at our Salt Lake City, UT/Grantsville facility.

What Will You Do?

  • Collect, clean, and validate large datasets from various financial systems and sources (e.g., SAP, ERP systems, data warehouses).
  • Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms.
  • Perform in-depth financial analysis, including variance analysis, trend analysis, forecasting, and budgeting support.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within financial data collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with finance, accounting, and other cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver relevant insights.
  • Support the preparation of presentations and reports for senior management, highlighting key financial performance indicators and strategic recommendations.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all financial reporting and analytical activities.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of new financial systems and tools as required.

How Will You Get Here?

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 2+ years of experience in a financial analyst, data analyst, or similar role, preferably within a large manufacturing or technology company.
  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and data warehousing concepts.
  • Or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and/or training.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables, VBA preferred).
  • Strong experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense).
  • Solid understanding of financial principles, accounting concepts, and financial reporting.
  • Ability to work with large datasets and perform complex data manipulation and analysis.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex data clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
  • SQL proficiency is a plus.

Overview

Job Description Summary

Supports the development of reporting and analytics solutions that drive operational, clinical, and financial decision-making across the healthcare enterprise. Learns healthcare data systems, assists with report development, and ensures data accuracy, working closely with more experienced analysts and stakeholders.

Job Description

Essential Functions:

  • Assists in the creation and maintenance of standard and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and visualizations.
  • Modifies existing reports under guidance and develops basic reporting solutions from defined requirements. Helps document report specifications, definitions, and data sources.
  • Supports users in retrieving data and understanding basic report content. Provides training and support to others to ensure effective use of business intelligence reports, tools, and solutions.
  • Translates business requirements into technical specifications and data models.
  • Performs basic data validation and quality checks to ensure report accuracy.
  • Collaborates with senior BI analysts, clinical informatics teams, and business users to understand reporting needs.
  • Identifies and recommends process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness of data collection and analysis.

Education Requirement

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field, required.

Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, follow instructions, and contribute in a team setting.
  • Foundational knowledge of SQL and proficiency in writing basic queries.
  • Familiarity with at least one BI tool such as Qlik, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or Crystal Reports.
  • Understanding of relational databases and data structures.

Experience

  • Experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare analytics, preferred.
  • Experience in a healthcare environment or with healthcare data, preferred

Physical Requirements

OCCASIONALLY: Bend/twist, Climb stairs/ladder, Flexing/extending of neck, Hand use: grasping, gripping, turning, Lifting / Carrying: 0-10 lbs, Pushing / Pulling: 0-25 lbs, Reaching above shoulder, Repetitive hand/arm use, Squat/kneel, Standing, Walking

FREQUENTLY: Audible speech, Color vision, Depth perception, Hearing acuity, Peripheral vision, Seeing – Far/near

CONTINUOUSLY: Computer skills, Decision Making, Interpreting Data, Problem solving, Sitting

descriptionHtml:
The ESG Data Analyst collects, manages, audits and works to improve the precision and quality of environmental, social, and governance (ESG)related data; ensures data accuracy; analyzes findings; and calculates and tracks ESG data. The Analyst will work with a cross-functional team to develop, implement, and track the effectiveness of sustainability and greenhouse gas emissions reduction measures and their financial returns. This team member also assists in preparing the Company’s internal and external ESG reporting and disclosures.

Essential Job Functions

Work cross-functionally to collect, organize, and analyze all data necessary for the Company’s internal and external ESG reporting and disclosures. Establish and implement a process to ensure timely and accurate collection of ESG data for reporting purposes. Update and maintain ESG data repositories.

Audit ESG data for precision, quality, completeness, and audit readiness through quality assurance process, including working with third-party data assurance providers, as necessary.

Identify and recommend best practices to continuously improve quality, precision, accuracy, and granularity of data, collaborating with consultants and third-party suppliers as necessary.

Calculate and track scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in accordance with GHG protocol standards.

Work with ESG Director, and ESG Reporting Manager, to track progress towards GHG reduction targets for scopes 1, 2, and 3.

Participate in the Energy Management Committee working groups to identify, implement, track and measure energy reduction initiatives, including modeling energy savings and financial impact of such initiatives in order to determine impact on meeting GHG reduction targets.

Partner with ESG Reporting Manager, ESG Reporting Committee, and other relevant stakeholders to draft and submit internal and external ESG reporting and disclosures, including the annual Impact report and the Company’s CDP response.

Provide project and initiative support to the ESG team, to develop meaningful insights and make informed recommendations that will influence decisions. This includes benchmark analysis, market research, and other projects as requested.

Provide insight and guidance regarding ESG data reporting methodology, frameworks, and disclosure systems such as GHG Protocol, CDP, TCFD, ISSB and SBTi, as well as regulatory reporting requirements. Stay up to date on evolving guidance and reporting requirements.

Create, maintain, and enhance data visualizations, models and dashboards to communicate sustainability performance and insights and meet business needs.

All other duties as assigned.

Skills/Education/Experience

REQUIRED

Bachelor’s degree or certificate in a relevant field, such as Data/Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Statistics, etc.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to retrieve and manipulate data using Microsoft query, formulas, pivot tables and macros

Data management, analysis, and visualization experience

Scripting using tools such as SQL, Python, R (preferred)

Experience with at least one (e.g., R or Python) object oriented statistical language and working with structured and unstructured databases. Analytical skills with experience in data manipulation and statistical analysis.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)

Ability to effectively communicate with various levels of the organization

Excellent time management skills supporting multiple projects with different objectives, milestones and deliverables

DESIRED

2-3 years of relevant professional experience

Knowledge of GHG Protocol Corporate Standard

Familiarity with ESG reporting frameworks such as CDP, TCFD, and SBTi

Experience in carbon accounting, including GHG inventory development

Experience translating GHG emissions findings into actionable recommendations for target setting and decarbonization

O’Reilly Auto Parts has a proven track record of growth and stability. O’Reilly is full of successful career stories and believes in a strong promote-from-within philosophy, encouraging you to grow your career along with the organization.

  • Stock Purchase Plan & 401k with Employer Contributions Starting Day One

  • Experience using data and analytical methods to evaluate policy or program outcomes and inform policy development and program evaluation.

No C2C or 3rd Party Vendors at this time.

Position Overview

A growing organization is seeking a Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across multiple business units. This individual will work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, analyze operational and financial data, identify trends, develop dashboards, and provide actionable insights that improve business performance. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, experience working with large datasets, and the ability to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business, operational, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
  • Gather reporting requirements from stakeholders and translate business needs into meaningful analytics solutions.
  • Perform data validation, cleansing, and quality assurance activities to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Create recurring and ad hoc reports for various business departments.
  • Support KPI development, performance tracking, and executive reporting initiatives.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and provide recommendations to improve business processes.
  • Collaborate with IT, business teams, and leadership to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities.
  • Document reporting processes, business rules, calculations, and data definitions.
  • Assist with data warehouse, ERP, CRM, and business application reporting initiatives.

Project & Data Environment

  • Enterprise business systems including ERP, CRM, HRIS, and operational applications.
  • Reporting and analytics environment supporting multiple business units and executive leadership.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Finance, Operations, Sales, Human Resources, and Information Technology teams.
  • Focus on reporting automation, dashboard development, data governance, and business intelligence.

Required Qualifications & Competencies

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Data Analytics Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics roles.
  • Experience working with large datasets and transforming raw data into actionable insights.

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query).
  • SQL querying and data analysis.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
  • Experience building dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

Analytical Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis abilities.
  • Experience identifying trends, anomalies, and process improvement opportunities.

Communication Skills:

  • Ability to clearly present findings and recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Strong documentation, organizational, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or NetSuite.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Experience with Python, R, or advanced analytics tools.
  • Exposure to financial, operational, or supply chain analytics.
  • Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, energy, construction, or industrial environments.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, or military or veteran status. Job Description

Are you ready to make an impact in the world of financial and regulatory reporting? We are looking for a detail-oriented and driven professional to join our team, where you will play a key role in the production, review, and filing of critical reports for regulatory agencies.

As an Analyst in the Financial Reporting team, you will handle the oversight of financial statements and management reporting, ensuring a sound control environment. You will apply your accounting knowledge to ensure compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements, coordinate the preparation of regulatory requirements, and validate balance sheet items. This role provides an opportunity to consolidate, review, and analyze financial data, communicate financial information to various business lines, and participate in the production and filing of reports for regulatory agencies.

Job Responsibilities

  • Apply up-to-date product,industry,market knowledge in specialty areas of financial reporting
  • Contribute to the preparation, review, and submission of monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual reports for alternative investment fund clients and their auditors, supporting regulatory efforts to compile key statistics on domestic and international portfolio positions and trends
  • Prepare, review, and analyze quarterly, semi-annual, and annual financial statements for alternative investment funds in accordance with US GAAP, IFRS, Lux GAAP, and other applicable standards, ensuring accuracy and completeness by performing quarter-over-quarter variance analytics
  • Coordinate data collection and quarterly business results with various lines of business, Regulatory Controllers and reporting teams
  • Assist in the thorough assessment of the issues and outcomes
  • Adhere to proof & control procedures to ensure accurate reconciliation between regulatory filings,
  • Adhere to various control procedures and edit checks to ensure the integrity of reported financial results
  • Ensure accurate and complete data submission to the Regulators
  • Interpret and define regulatory requirements and coordinate internal and external policies
  • Establish and manage relationships with the line of business as well as with external regulatory agency constituents through ongoing partnership and dialogue
  • Participate in continuous improvement effort around data quality review and external reporting improvement projects

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • 2+ years in a Finance organization with exposure to accounting, financial statements, and/or regulatory reporting
  • Bachelor degree required, degree preference is Accounting, Finance or Economics
  • Professional and proactive approach to work, problem solver
  • The ability to manage change and deliver results
  • Strong communication skills - both verbal and written
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and as a key member of a group

ABOUT US

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Job Description

Ready to join a team that is the driving force behind regulatory capital excellence at JPMorganChase? The Basel Measurement and Analytics (BM&A) Team within Treasury functions as trusted partners to key areas such as Capital Management, Capital & Liquidity Policy (C&LP), Credit Risk Reporting, Firmwide Regulatory Reporting & Analysis (FRRA), and the Lines of Business (LOBs). We champion best practices and accountability in the Regulatory Capital and Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) production process. Our team delivers Firmwide Capital and RWA results every month, while leading the implementation, design, and reporting infrastructure for Basel Rules and other capital requirements including Supplementary Leverage Ratio (SLR) and the Capital Numerator. Additionally, our team manages Quantitative Impact Studies (QIS) for regulators and provides expert responses to stakeholder inquiries on capital-related matters and estimates.

As an Analyst in the Basel Measurement and Analytics (BM&A) team, you will work with line of business Controllers to support the calculation and analysis of RWA results. You will be responsible for producing RWA under Basel rules, analyzing quarter-over-quarter RWA variances, and interfacing with LOB controllers to determine variance drivers such as portfolio changes, policy updates, and capital treatment. You will be involved in the end-to-end production process and be part of issue identification, tracking, and resolution. Additionally, you will be instrumental in supporting and leading projects to advance the current Capital Infrastructure.

  • Support the collection and aggregation of monthly RWA datasets
  • Perform routine data validation controls for reporting accuracy

  • Support project work and test cases
  • Collaborate with business partners and handle day-to-day inquiries
