descriptionHtml:
Your Job

INVISTA is seeking an experienced Accounting Analyst to join our CFO organization in Wichita, KS. In this role you will partner with other teams across the globe to create and execute data strategies to deliver value to Koch and to the INVISTA businesses. A successful candidate is highly motivated, self-driven, and has a passion for driving continuous improvement and transformation. They should have a solid understanding of accounting concepts, good critical and economic thinking, and strong communication skills. INVISTA transforms daily life through innovations that create long-term value for our customers and society. You can be a part of the difference by joining the INVISTA team!

Our Team

Join Koch in Wichita and enjoy a vibrant work environment! Our office is located in northeast Wichita, a lively city with great restaurants, shopping, museums, and parks. Easy access to highways means a flexible commute from anywhere in the area. Our campus offers walking trails, coffee shops, and convenient on-site amenities like a post office and dry cleaning. At Koch, you’ll thrive in a supportive community focused on your personal and professional growth. Come see why Koch/INVISTA is a great place to build your career!

What You Will Do

  • Data Analysis, Reporting, and Forecasting: Own analyzing, reporting, and forecasting our Corporate business, providing clear, actional insights to business leaders and other stakeholders to support decision-making.
  • Financial Analysis & Storytelling: Understand the data and use tools such as Excel and Power BI to identify trends and provide insights to support decision-making. Tell the story by adapting the presentation based on the audience.
  • Own and Transform: Own accounting activities by ensuring excellent stewardship of the balance sheet through analytics and quality close. Identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and implement waste elimination and transformation initiatives across processes to provide value for the organization.
  • Business Team Partnership: Seek and share knowledge, build partnerships across the global finance organization, IT, and other capabilities. Develop and foster partnerships with other finance functions, leveraged capabilities and business units to prioritize and support profitable decision making and value creation, with a focus on integrity and long-term stability.
  • Lifelong Learner: Create a knowledge network by seeking and sharing knowledge, building partnerships across the organization. Learn and quickly adapt to change including new systems and processes.


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Solid understanding of General Ledger, Balance Sheet, and Income Statement from education or professional experience
  • Experience in Excel (spreadsheet creation/editing, pivot tables, graphs, data manipulation/analysis and formula creation)
  • Ability to present and tailor messages to a variety of audiences, including leadership
  • This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship


What Will Put You Ahead

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field
  • SAP or OneStream experience
  • Experience with data visualization tools (PowerBI or Tableau)


At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, INVISTA has a long history of working to make the world around you a better place. From parts for the automotive industry to medical equipment, air bags, food packaging and clothing, our ingredients in the nylon 6,6 and polypropylene value chains help bring many of life’s essential products to market.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. Job Details:
Our company, a technology-driven storage and logistics business, is seeking a sharp, self-directed Data Analyst to join our team in Denver. This is an analyst-first role. We need someone who lives in SQL, writes complex queries quickly, and can learn an unfamiliar database’s tables and relationships with minimal guidance. Experience with Power Automate, Power BI/Fabric refresh pipelines, or ETL/ELT processes is a big bonus, as is using AI tools to speed up your query writing. Above all, you take assigned work and run with it, teach yourself new skills, and have the confidence to own your results. A backlog of reports is waiting for someone who can understand the business through its data and start delivering right away. This is a full-time, hybrid role with at least two days per week in our Denver office, and it has a defined path to Senior Data Analyst.

Responsibilities:

Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, views, and stored procedures that support reporting, analytics, and daily operations.
Quickly learn our data environment, mapping tables, relationships, and business logic across SQL Server and Dataverse as we consolidate onto SQL.
Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, starting with an existing backlog of priority reports for Operations, Finance, and leadership.
Translate business questions into data, and data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Own data quality across key areas such as facilities, rent, and invoices by spotting discrepancies, tracing root causes, and fixing them.
Support invoice validation, reconciliation, and exception reporting in partnership with Finance and Operations.
Automate manual work using Power Automate, Power BI/Fabric refresh pipelines, and ETL/ELT processes.
Provide basic database support (roughly 10–20% of the role) alongside our DevOps team: troubleshoot slow queries and indexes, monitor scheduled jobs, and make controlled production data corrections.
Document data models, report logic, and database dependencies so knowledge is shared and repeatable.

Contribute to scalable solutions for major brands looking to modernize their supply chains.
Gain exposure to a wide range of industries, from retail to healthcare, through dynamic fulfillment projects.
Join a company that prioritizes customer success, operational efficiency, and employee development.


Job Details

Job Details:
Our company, a technology-driven storage and logistics business, is seeking a sharp, self-directed Data Analyst to join our team in Denver. This is an analyst-first role. We need someone who lives in SQL, writes complex queries quickly, and can learn an unfamiliar database’s tables and relationships with minimal guidance. Experience with Power Automate, Power BI/Fabric refresh pipelines, or ETL/ELT processes is a big bonus, as is using AI tools to speed up your query writing. Above all, you take assigned work and run with it, teach yourself new skills, and have the confidence to own your results. A backlog of reports is waiting for someone who can understand the business through its data and start delivering right away. This is a full-time, hybrid role with at least two days per week in our Denver office, and it has a defined path to Senior Data Analyst.

Responsibilities:

Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, views, and stored procedures that support reporting, analytics, and daily operations.
Quickly learn our data environment, mapping tables, relationships, and business logic across SQL Server and Dataverse as we consolidate onto SQL.
Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, starting with an existing backlog of priority reports for Operations, Finance, and leadership.
Translate business questions into data, and data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Own data quality across key areas such as facilities, rent, and invoices by spotting discrepancies, tracing root causes, and fixing them.
Support invoice validation, reconciliation, and exception reporting in partnership with Finance and Operations.
Automate manual work using Power Automate, Power BI/Fabric refresh pipelines, and ETL/ELT processes.
Provide basic database support (roughly 10–20% of the role) alongside our DevOps team: troubleshoot slow queries and indexes, monitor scheduled jobs, and make controlled production data corrections.
Document data models, report logic, and database dependencies so knowledge is shared and repeatable.
Deliver ad hoc analysis for the Executive Leadership Team and proactively raise risks, trends, and opportunities.

Ready to elevate your career? GFL Environmental is expanding! We are officially hunting for our next National Accounts Data and Reporting Analyst in Raleigh, North Carolina—someone ready to bring fresh ideas and grow alongside a dynamic team.

About Us

Our employees, collectively known as 'Team Green,' enjoy numerous benefits: career advancement opportunities, competitive benefits, job stability within an essential services company, and the chance to make a positive impact every day for our customers and communities, Green for Life!

The Role

We are looking for a talented National Accounts Data and Reporting Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for National Accounts’ business and customer reporting, including designing new report requests, collaborating with IT as needed to gain access to necessary data, and providing critical reporting to US National Accounts leadership. You will work closely with Implementation, Data Validation, and Corporate IT teams to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partners with users in US National Accounts to understand business processes and critical data and systems.
  • Understands data field definitions as determined by Corporate IT and addresses any discrepancies in how these are used by the US National Accounts team.
  • Coordinates with Implementation and Data Validation teams to ensure mutual understanding of the use of systems and specific data fields, including potential impact to customers, employees, suppliers, processes, systems, and data from any changes made by Corporate IT.
  • Works with National Accounts stakeholders to identify, define, and monitor key performance measures critical for National Accounts’ success.
  • Designs and deploys reports through data collection, transformation, modelling, presentation, and other strategies that demonstrate business insight.
  • Ensures that for each field used in KPI and other reporting, appropriate preventative and detective controls are in place to identify and remediate data that does not conform to expected practices.
  • Balances day-to-day support of US National Account operations with longer term projects.
  • Coordinates with GFL Corporate IT to obtain necessary access to datasets, tools, and company-wide reporting mechanisms for self and applicable team members as appropriate.
  • Accurately documents all aspects of daily work: catalogues, cases, diagrams, matrices, process flows and specifications.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Prior experience (2-4 years) in a Data Engineering/BI Analyst role. Demonstrated familiarity with query languages and reporting packages.
  • Education: Minimum high school diploma or GED.
  • Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Plans, schedules, and monitors own work competently within limited deadlines.
  • Soft Skills: Demonstrated curiosity in how data can be leveraged to help users make decisions. Demonstrates an analytical and systematic approach to problem solving. Understands the wider field of information, and how own role relates to other roles and to other departments/functions.
  • Bonus Points: Associate or Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field. Knowledge of Tower and TRUX systems. Experience using Cognos, Power BI, and/or other reporting tools.

What We Offer

Why join us? We believe in taking care of our team. Here is a snapshot of our total rewards you can expect:

  • Health: 4 medical plan options including a HSA with employer contribution & match program, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Wellness: Employee Assistance Program with free counseling services, Paid time off.
  • Financial: 401(k) with an employer match and competitive wages.
  • Culture: Growth opportunities and continuous learning opportunities.

GFL Environmental is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It will make reasonable accommodations to enable employees to perform their jobs.

Join us and become part of "Team Green" at GFL Environmental, where your skills and dedication will be valued and rewarded. Apply now for this exciting opportunity! #GFLTalent

GFL is committed to equal opportunity for all, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. descriptionHtml:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.
  • Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Analyst to help us turn data into useful insights and make better business decisions while contributing to the continued development of our data infrastructure. In this role, you’ll independently partner with stakeholders across the organization to explore data, improve reporting, answer business questions, define meaningful metrics, and develop practical, reusable solutions. You’ll also help test, validate, and execute new data models, processes, and tools as we build a more scalable data foundation. This is an opportunity for someone who brings strong analytical fundamentals, sound judgment, and a practical approach to solving complex problems while helping establish sustainable analytics practices across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Independently partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into reliable analyses, reports, dashboards, metrics, and data solutions.
  • Explore, clean, reconcile, and validate data from operational systems and emerging data infrastructure to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities.
  • Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reports, SQL queries, analytical datasets, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making.
  • Test and execute new data models, reporting processes, and analytical workflows; identify issues, document findings, and provide feedback to improve scalability and usability.
  • Help establish consistent metrics, data definitions, documentation, quality checks, and reporting practices as our data capabilities scale.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operations analysis, finance, product analytics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own analytical projects from requirements gathering through analysis, validation, communication, and delivery.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and the ability to investigate and validate query results.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, datasets, or analytical tools used by business stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment when working with complex or imperfect data.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Experience with a BI or visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or a similar platform.
  • Experience validating data models, reporting pipelines, data transformations, or analytical workflows across multiple systems.
  • Familiarity with data modeling concepts such as tables, dimensions, measures, data grain, reusable reporting datasets, and metric definitions.
  • Exposure to Python, R, APIs, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, dbt, lakehouse concepts, Git, or other data development practices.
  • Experience improving data quality, automating manual reporting, documenting data processes, or helping establish analytics standards.

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $80,000 - $150,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

Additional Requirements

  • Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach, CA. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

- Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity. 
- What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results. 
- It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

- Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
- Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Analyst to help us turn data into useful insights and make better business decisions while contributing to the continued development of our data infrastructure. In this role, you’ll independently partner with stakeholders across the organization to explore data, improve reporting, answer business questions, define meaningful metrics, and develop practical, reusable solutions. You’ll also help test, validate, and execute new data models, processes, and tools as we build a more scalable data foundation. Responsibilities



- Independently partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into reliable analyses, reports, dashboards, metrics, and data solutions. 
- Explore, clean, reconcile, and validate data from operational systems and emerging data infrastructure to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities. 
- Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reports, SQL queries, analytical datasets, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making. 
- Test and execute new data models, reporting processes, and analytical workflows; identify issues, document findings, and provide feedback to improve scalability and usability. 
- Help establish consistent metrics, data definitions, documentation, quality checks, and reporting practices as our data capabilities scale. 

Qualifications



- 4+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operations analysis, finance, product analytics, or a related field. 
- Demonstrated ability to independently own analytical projects from requirements gathering through analysis, validation, communication, and delivery. 
- Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and the ability to investigate and validate query results. 
- Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, datasets, or analytical tools used by business stakeholders.

- Experience with a BI or visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or a similar platform.

This position will be posted for a minimum of five calendar days internally. All internal applicants are required to inform your current supervisor/manager prior to applying. Internal applicants are required to be in "good standing" in your current role, which is defined as a performance rating of “met all objectives” or higher. You cannot be on a current performance improvement plan or written warning for any reason and must have been in your current role for a minimum of 6 months, unless otherwise approved for an early transfer by your current leader and the People Department.

Your opportunity

This role is responsible for producing, reviewing, and enhancing reporting materials used by Fund Boards, committees, senior management, and other key stakeholders.

  • Lead the preparation and delivery of reporting materials for Fund Boards, committees, senior management, and other key stakeholders.
  • Serve as a primary reviewer of reports and supporting data to ensure accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with established procedures and controls.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex reporting, data, and process issues and drive continuous improvement.
  • Lead and support internal committee meetings, including agenda development, materials preparation, and follow-up activities.
  • Analyze reporting requirements and stakeholder feedback to recommend and implement report enhancements.
  • Maintain, update, and improve reporting templates, processes, and documentation.
  • Develop and maintain policies and procedures related to reporting activities.
  • Identify and support automation and process improvement opportunities to increase efficiency, strengthen controls, and improve report quality.
  • Conduct ad hoc reporting, research, and analysis to support business initiatives and stakeholder requests.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned

What to expect when you join our firm

  • Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations
  • Generous Holiday policies
  • Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to Wellhub
  • Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community
  • Support to grow through professional development courses, tuition/qualification reimbursement and more
  • Maternal/paternal leave benefits and family services
  • Unique employee events and programs including a 14er challenge
  • Complimentary beverages, snacks and all employee Happy Hours

About this role:

As a BI Analyst within Gartner's Operations & Strategy team, you'll work closely with business partners to answer questions, solve problems, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions. You'll help transform complex data into clear insights that support operational and strategic decision-making across the organization.

Who You Are:

You thrive in ambiguity: asking clarifying questions, structuring unclear problems, and adapting as business needs evolve. You’re comfortable when definitions shift and requirements are incomplete, and you can translate the gray into actionable insights.

What You'll Do:

  • Frame ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions. Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify objectives, define success measures, identify decision points, and translate evolving requests into practical requirements.
  • Develop and refine KPIs that reflect business process reality. Partner with business teams and SMEs to define metric logic, document assumptions, reconcile competing definitions, and ensure reporting outputs support meaningful operational decisions.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify patterns, root causes, risks, and opportunities. Use structured analysis to improve processes, uncover inefficiencies, and support recommendations that address business challenges.
  • Build decision-ready reporting and analytical outputs. Develop reports, dashboards, datasets, and supporting analyses using tools such as Power BI, Salesforce Native reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics, Databricks, Excel, Tableau, or comparable platforms.
  • Validate data before insights are shared. Review source data, transformation logic, joins, calculations, business rules, and edge cases to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and trusted.
  • Translate data findings into practical business recommendations. Communicate insights clearly, including what the data shows, what remains uncertain, what tradeoffs exist, and what actions should be considered.
  • Clarify stakeholder needs and align expectations. Use thoughtful questioning, active listening, and clear communication to confirm requirements, surface assumptions, explain analytical choices, and keep stakeholders aligned as priorities evolve.
  • Manage competing priorities across cross-functional projects. Balance urgent requests with longer-term improvements, clarify tradeoffs, communicate progress, and keep work aligned to business impact.
  • Improve analytical processes and reporting scalability. Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, simplify, or redesign recurring analysis, data preparation, validation, and reporting workflows.
  • Use emerging tools responsibly to improve productivity and quality. Apply automation, AI-assisted analytics, and modern data tools where appropriate, maintaining strong validation practices and human review of outputs.

What You’ll Need:

Experience

  • 1–3 years of business, analytics, operations, finance, or related analysis experience (internships and academic projects considered).
  • Experience working with stakeholders to clarify requirements, define metrics, analyze data, and communicate findings.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities or projects where requirements, timelines, data availability, or stakeholder needs may shift.

Technical Skills

Required:

  • Hands-on experience in Power BI: building/maintaining reports, dashboards, datasets, or analytical views.
  • Proficiency with modern analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Salesforce Native reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics, Databricks, Tableau, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Strong Excel skills: Power Query, pivot tables, formulas, data preparation, and quality checks.
  • Ability to work across CRM, data platform, and BI/reporting environments, understanding how source systems, business processes, data definitions, and transformation logic affect analytical outputs.
  • SQL experience for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, validation, and repeatable analysis.

Preferred:

  • Python for data preparation, automation, exploratory analysis, or scalable analytical workflows.
  • Exposure to automation and low-code tools (e.g., Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio).
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools, with an emphasis on responsible use, output review, data validation, and business context.
  • Experience with OPI/GSP applications.
  • Ability to create executive-ready outputs, including PowerPoint presentations, data visualizations, and concise written summaries.

Analytical & Operational Skills

  • Comfort working in ambiguity, including situations where data is incomplete, requirements are evolving, definitions are unsettled, or the business question changes as analysis progresses.
  • Strong analytical rigor and attention to detail, especially when validating data, reconciling inconsistencies, and explaining assumptions.
  • Critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions, structure unclear problems, and identify the real business question behind an initial request.
  • Ability to distinguish between symptoms and root causes when analyzing business process issues.
  • Strong business process understanding and ability to connect data findings to operational decisions.
  • Ability to determine when analysis is directionally useful versus when additional validation is required before decisions are made.

Stakeholder & Communication Skills

  • Strong initiative and ownership, with the ability to move work forward proactively while seeking input at the right moments.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, limitations, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Effective listening and questioning skills to uncover the actual business need behind a request.
  • Ability to build trust with stakeholders through reliable analysis, clear assumptions, practical recommendations, and consistent follow-through.
  • Strong organization and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize work based on business impact, urgency, feasibility, and data readiness.
  • Openness to feedback, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across functions while maintaining accountability for analytical quality, validation, and delivery.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 64,000 USD - 87,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling Human Resources at +1 (203) 964-0096 or by sending an email to ApplicantAccommodations@gartner.com.

Job Requisition ID:112102

By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you have read and agree to the country or regional recruitment notice linked below applicable to your place of residence.

Brief Job Description

The Data Analyst V reports to the Manager of the Medicaid CHIP Reporting unit in the Data Dissemination and Reporting section of the Office of Data, Analytics and Performance (DAP). The DA V performs highly complex (senior level) data analysis to inform policy and program decisions related to Medicaid acute care. The DA V consults with internal and external customers to identify and support Medicaid data reporting needs. Using standard statistical tools, methods and techniques, the DA V compiles and queries service utilization, provider and other Medicaid acute care data sets; creates original programming logic and evaluates and/or modifies existing programs to take into account changes in requirements; and reviews work products developed by other analysts. Interacts with agency Program staff, division managers, and/or other analysts to ensure requirements are met and that all work products are appropriately reviewed and validated. Identifies data gaps, errors, anomalies, inconsistencies, and redundancies by analyzing the content, structure, and relationships within data. Provides data validation and integrity checks for program data. The DA V prepares concise, comprehensive technical reports to present and interpret the data for program staff, leadership, advisory committees and other stakeholders. Reviews project deliverables to ensure compliance with customer needs and agency/department policies. The DA V serves as a resource for colleagues and is a key contributor in a complex and crucial data analytic environment. The DA V works under limited supervision with considerable latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

EJF 1 Data Quality/Integrity: Provides suggestions regarding systematic changes that will improve the efficiency and quality of data analysis processes. Assesses data quality by identifying any missing, erroneous, incongruent, or duplicate data in data sets used by the unit. Coordinates with other internal groups within DAP or other areas to improve data quality. Consults and provides requirements for the improvement of data collection systems and the methods used to perform data analytics. 25%

EJF 2 Data Analysis: Determines the most effective method to address a given data request, construct a performance measure, or monitor various service trends. Compiles and manipulates data points using SQL, SAS, or other languages from a variety of source formats, to support complex analyses related to monitoring Medicaid programs. Cleans and prepares data to produce datasets required for data analysis. 20%

EJF 3 Reporting: Oversees the interpretation of analysis results to inform the team’s presentations and reports of the results. Prepares comprehensive standard and ad-hoc reports, in written, graphical and oral format, for internal and external audiences. Ensures accuracy of data included in reports. 20%

EJF 4 Customer Focus and Communication: The Analyst engages with a variety of people across the agency to build strong relationships and to find creative solutions to analytic projects. Utilizes communication skills to gather the information necessary from customers to assess and address their needs. Explains analysis results in clear and non-scientific language as necessary to ensure that customers can leverage the information in decision-making. Coordinates with program subject matter experts and leadership to both ensure accuracy in approach for the analysis and to inform staff of findings in a timely manner. 20%

EJF 5 Special projects and assignments as assigned/required: Serves on agency committees and workgroups as an SME consultant for Medicaid data. Prepares and updates standard operating procedures and processes for reporting. 15%

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of reporting and analytic tools such as Business Objects, SAS, SPSS, Snowflake, and SQL.

Knowledge of HHSC program data and reporting.

Knowledge of data quality and integrity processes.

Skill in communicating with individuals at all levels on technical issues.

Ability to work and communicate effectively with others.

Ability to gather, assemble, correlate, and analyze facts; to devise solutions to problems; to prepare concise reports; develop and evaluate policies and procedures.

Ability to perform detailed work accurately and in accordance with standards.

Ability to meet deadlines and work on projects with changing priorities.

Ability to read and understand requirements/design specifications and propose logical solutions to meet requirements/specifications.

Ability to operate effectively as a member of a team managing multiple projects.

Ability to read, interpret, and analyze existing documentation and reports.

Ability to create/maintain technical documentation of work/project assignments.

Ability to interpret and report on data analytic findings.

Ability to exercise independent judgment and show initiative.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

None.

Initial Screening Criteria

Graduation from an accredited 4-year college or university with major coursework in a social science, business, statistical or related field. Three or more years of experience with acquisition, collection, management, analyses and dissemination of health and human services-related data and/or other large datasets preferred. Education and experience may be substituted for each other, up to four years.

  • Build analytics skills across the function’s core areas each quarter.
  • Take on first owned analyses under the guidance of Managers.

The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775) 784-1495 or jobs@unr.edu. For UNR Med professional job postings, please contact the Office of Professional Recruitment at (775) 784-6778.

Job Description

The University of Nevada, School of Medicine is recruiting for a Patient Safety Data Analyst. This position is is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data collection, reporting, analytics, and visualization solutions for the Rural Patient Safety Organization. The position works with PSO leadership, participating healthcare organizations, data stewards, and technology partners to convert patient safety data into accurate, understandable, and actionable information. The Analyst supports secure patient safety reporting, data quality, data modeling, metric development, dashboard creation, regulatory submissions, and documentation of data processes. The position develops analytical products that support organizational learning, patient safety improvement, rural healthcare benchmarking, and strategic decision-making.

The Analyst also supports the evaluation, configuration, testing, and ongoing operation of the PSO’s reporting and analytics environment. The position exercises independent judgment while handling confidential and

sensitive healthcare information and must consistently follow applicable data-governance, security, and Patient Safety Work Product requirements.

descriptionHtml:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Brown Brothers Harriman is currently recruiting an Addepar Analyst, Family Office Client Services & Reporting to join our Capital Partners team. In this role, you will be responsible for providing consolidated reporting to high-net-worth clients and family offices. You will be responsible for providing consolidated and custom reports in a timely and accurate manner. You will work directly with Relationship Managers and 3rd party advisors. You will handle all client inquiries and resolve issues related to reporting. To be successful, you will need expertise using Addepar, strong technical and interpersonal skills, and communication skills. Our ideal candidate is determined to tackle problems, can skillfully coordinate internal teams, and loves working directly with relationship teams.

Some Of Your Key Responsibilities Include

  • Working directly with the front office on client reporting.
  • Become a subject matter expert on Addepar to serve as the primary point of contact for escalation of all issues
  • Understanding client relationships and ownership structures which contribute to the accuracy of consolidated reporting.
  • Working closely with Front Office, end users (clients) to configure Addepar reporting and resolve issues.
  • Running monthly and quarterly reporting for high-net-worth clients, Family offices and Endowments and Foundations
  • Updating asset classification and security pricing in Addepar
  • Working with an internal performance team to reconcile accounts in Addepar
  • Report on internal and external private investments
  • Working with internal groups to integrate systems and workflows
  • Identifying trends and recommending process improvements to increase efficiency
  • Collaborate with various parts of the organization to resolve client issues
  • Work in complex data sets to identify and resolve data and calculation discrepancies.

Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree with 3+ years of relevant work experience; Addepar experience is required
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, i.e. customizing charts and graphs, conducting multi-sheet analysis, linking data across workbooks, and using advanced formulas
  • Strong knowledge of performance and financial reporting
  • Strong knowledge of private investments (private equity, venture capital, private real estate) and being able to track and report on them
  • Ability to analyze monthly performance returns and market value changes to ensure accuracy.
  • Ability to identify, escalate, and resolve problems/issues.
  • Avid learner willing to develop subject matter expertise on new software.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to meet tight deadlines and work under pressure.
  • Proactive self-starter who is goal oriented
  • Working knowledge of performance analysis concepts
  • Experience with First Rate and Sungard AddVantage a plus
  • Strong work ethic and self-starter, able to effectively prioritize and adapt within a fast-paced business environment.

This role can be based in either our New York, Boston, or Philadelphia locations and is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three (3) days in office.

Salary Range

NYC/Boston: $65k-$90k base salary + annual bonus target

Philadelphia: $75k-$85k base salary + annual bonus target

BBH and its affiliates' compensation program includes base salary, discretionary bonuses, and profit-sharing. The anticipated base salary range(s) shown above are only for the indicated location(s) and may differ in other locations due to cost of living and labor considerations. Base salaries may vary based on factors such as skill, experience and qualification for the role. BBH's total rewards package recognizes your contributions with more than just a paycheck—providing you with benefits that enhance your experience at BBH from long-term savings, healthcare, and income protection to professional development opportunities and time off, our programs support your overall well-being.

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, genetic information, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state or local law.

Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in advancing the organization's regulatory reporting, data quality, and analytical capabilities. This position owns the end-to-end transformation of complex policy, claims, underwriting, and financial data into accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory submissions while driving improvements in data processes, governance, and reporting standards.

As a senior analytical professional, this role combines advanced data analysis, data engineering, insurance domain expertise, and business insight to solve complex data challenges, influence decision-making, and identify opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance. The Senior Data Analyst serves as a trusted partner to business and technical stakeholders and provides mentorship and guidance to analysts across the organization.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design and execute advanced analyses to support regulatory reporting, compliance initiatives, and strategic business decisions.
  • Transform complex business requirements into scalable data solutions, analytical frameworks, and actionable insights.
  • Analyze policy, claims, underwriting, financial, and operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, reconciliations, and datasets to improve performance, scalability, and reusability.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Application teams to design and implement data enrichment, transformation, and integration solutions.
  • Support and enhance data platforms, reporting processes, and analytical assets using modern data technologies and best practices.
  • Own data preparation, validation, and reconciliation activities supporting statutory reporting, regulatory filings, annual statement reporting, premium tax reporting, market conduct examinations, audits, and ad hoc regulatory requests.
  • Develop deep expertise in Property & Casualty insurance operations, regulatory reporting requirements, and statutory accounting principles.
  • Ensure analytical outputs align with regulatory expectations and support sound business decision-making.
  • Translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable data processes and controls.
  • Independently diagnose data quality, integration, and reporting issues across multiple systems and business functions.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective actions that improve data integrity and reporting accuracy.
  • Design analytical approaches for complex or ambiguous business problems where requirements may be incomplete or evolving.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve efficiency, and enhance data accessibility for business stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships with Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, MGA Operations, Applications, and Data Engineering teams.
  • Effectively communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop clear narratives that connect data insights to regulatory, operational, and business outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions, provide data-driven recommendations, and influence prioritization of data and reporting initiatives.
  • Champion data governance practices and contribute to the development of data standards, controls, documentation, and definitions.
  • Establish and enhance data quality monitoring processes within assigned domains.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for analytical methodologies, reporting practices, and regulatory data requirements.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to analysts by reviewing analytical approaches, sharing best practices, and supporting professional development.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and analytical excellence.

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, business analytics, computer science, actuarial science, finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, or related functions within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory reporting, statutory reporting, compliance initiatives, or financial reporting processes.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance operations and data structures across policy, claims, underwriting, accounting, finance, or actuarial functions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale relational databases, data warehouses, and data transformation methodologies.
  • Experience performing complex data analysis, reconciliation, root-cause investigation, and data quality assessments.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and data storytelling skills.

Preferred Qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Compensation: $80,000/year - $90,000/year

Position Summary

At Children’s Aid, we believe that all kids have limitless potential. Our dedicated staff provides comprehensive support for nearly 50,000 children and families in targeted, under-resourced New York City neighborhoods. We know what it takes to ensure children grow up strong, healthy, and ready to thrive in school and life: excellent education and health care, social-emotional support, and strong, stable families.

The mission of the Office of Performance Management is to create sustainable data-driven operations in programmatic and central divisions to increase effectiveness and achieve mission-driven outcomes for children. The Data Analyst contributes to this mission through database creation, management, analysis, reporting, and collaboration with a diverse array of programs and central departments. The Data Analyst possesses superior data management and analytic skills, as well as a proven ability to communicate in writing and verbally with a wide range of stakeholders to foster accountability and learning, including effectively translating technical issues and concepts into accessible insights for non-technical audiences.

Essential Duties

  • Create and/or strengthen systems for data collection, management, reporting, and analysis including documenting all procedures.
  • Create databases to aggregate data from multiple sources to track process and outcome measures.
  • Create and produce recurring and ad hoc reports of operational and performance indicators for all levels of staff, Board, and external audiences.
  • Analyze actual performance against projected performance as well as trends within and across programs on a regular basis.
  • Collaborate with Performance Management staff in working directly with programs and departments to implement all components of a comprehensive performance management system.
  • Assist staff with accessing and analyzing data to inform them of strategic and programmatic decisions.
  • Manage the exchange of data pursuant to data-sharing agreements, observing all confidentiality and use requirements.
  • Train staff on data collection, entry, management, and analysis.
  • Participate in Children’s Aid’s Data Governance Council.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting tools that help program teams and leadership monitor key performance indicators and operational metrics.
  • Support the creation of agency-wide performance dashboard by helping to standardize data definitions, reporting logic, and KPI structures across multiple divisions.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and IT teams to connect and organize data from multiple program systems into centralized reporting structures.
  • Assist with documenting data flows, data definitions, and reporting processes as part of broader organizational data governance and data strategy initiatives.
  • Contribute to efforts to inventory and map organizational data systems to better understand how data is collected, stored, and used across the agency.
  • Support the development of scalable data pipelines and reporting processes that allow data from multiple sources to be integrated into centralized analytics.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • A Bachelor of Arts or Sciences with an emphasis on database design, development, and data management for the social or health sciences; a Master’s preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of demonstrated, high level of expertise with Excel, SQL scripting, and relational databases.
  • 2+ years of experience building or supporting dashboards using Power BI
  • 1+ years of experience working with multiple data systems and integrating data for reporting or analytics purposes.
  • Experience documenting data processes, definitions, or reporting methodologies.

Key Competencies

  • Experience using various third-party business intelligence or report writing tools (e.g., SAP Business Objects, SAP Crystal Reports, IBM COGNOS, etc.)
  • Knowledge of statistics and statistical software (e.g., SPSS, SAS).
  • Experience with programming languages used for data analysis and automation (e.g., R, Python) preferred.
  • Experience conducting outcomes reporting in a non-profit, education setting, or healthcare setting.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 applications, including Copilot.
  • Customer service orientation; ability to work collaboratively; ability to understand data needs from the perspectives of various audiences.
  • Ability to create and maintain strong interdepartmental relationships to advance the mission of the organization and ensure positive outcomes.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize, meet deadlines, and problem-solve.
  • Comfort performing hands-on work as well as assisting in strategic projects.
  • Results-oriented perspective and commitment to operational excellence.

It is the policy of Children's Aid to provide equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment and is dedicated to maintaining a work environment that is free from harassment and discrimination. Children's Aid will not tolerate discrimination, harassment, or retaliation on any basis, including race, creed, color, national origin, ethnicity, alienage or citizenship status, gender/sex (including pregnancy), disability, religion, source of income, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, familial status, caregiver status, military status, marital or partnership status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking, predisposing genetic characteristics, arrest or conviction record, credit history, unemployment status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Children’s Aid is committed to complying with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Children’s Aid will conduct a prompt and thorough investigation of all allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation, or any violation of the Equal Employment Opportunity Policy in a confidential manner and will take appropriate corrective action, if and where warranted. Children’s Aid prohibits retaliation against employees who provide information about, complain about, or assist in the investigation of any complaint of discrimination or violation of the Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

The incumbent is expected to work a schedule, whether in-person or hybrid, as determined by the department's needs to facilitate effective collaboration with the team. This flexibility is essential for maintaining seamless communication, fostering teamwork, and ensuring the smooth operation of the department's processes. The position's requirements are subject to periodic review and adjustment based on organizational needs and changes in work dynamics.

We offer a competitive salary for this role, with an expected range of $65,900 to $83,500. The final offer will depend on your experience, skills, and overall qualifications. General Dynamics - Bath Iron Works also provides a variety of benefits including medical & dental insurance coverage, 401(k) retirement savings plan, flexible spending accounts/HSAs, life and disability insurance, company paid holidays, paid time off (PTO), health coaching, athletic trainers, employee assistance programs and onsite health services.

The Program Metrics & Reporting Analyst provides integrated program performance reporting, data analytics, and decision support to the DDG 51 Planning Yard Program Office. This position is responsible for developing, maintaining, analyzing, and communicating program-level metrics that provide leadership with clear visibility into program execution, performance against established objectives, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.

Working collaboratively with Engineering, Design, Materials, Manufacturing, Team Leaders, various Project Managers and SOSB, the analyst consolidates project-level information into an integrated view of program performance across schedule, cost, funding, technical performance, quality, risk, and other key operational areas. The analyst validates data, identifies trends and performance gaps, develops dashboards and executive briefings, and provides meaningful analysis to support informed decision-making.

The successful candidate will independently manage recurring reporting requirements, develop and maintain reporting tools using Microsoft Excel and Power BI, and identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data integrity, and standardize reporting practices across the program office.

This role requires a combination of analytical capability, technical proficiency, and attention to detail. The ideal candidate will go beyond reporting what happened to help leadership understand why performance is changing, where attention is needed, and what actions may be warranted.

Key Responsibilities

Safety Leadership

  • Demonstrate a commitment to a safe working environment by complying with applicable safety policies, procedures, and training requirements.
  • Support a culture of accountability by following established procedures and reinforcing the importance of safety in program execution.


Program Performance Metrics and Analysis

  • Develop, maintain, and monitor program-level key performance indicators (KPIs), metrics, and performance measures.
  • Consolidate project-level data into an integrated assessment of overall program health and execution.
  • Analyze performance trends, variances, exceptions, and changes against established targets, plans, milestones, and objectives.
  • Support reporting and analysis across schedule performance, cost, funding, technical deliverables, quality, risks, issues, and other program priorities.
  • Identify emerging performance concerns, data anomalies, unfavorable trends, and potential impacts to program objectives.
  • Develop historical trend analyses and comparisons to support forecasting, performance assessments, and continuous improvement.
  • Recommend improvements to existing metrics and reporting methods to increase their relevance, accuracy, and usefulness to leadership.


Reporting and Executive Communications

  • Independently manage recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc program reporting requirements.
  • Develop and maintain standardized reporting products, dashboards, and charts.
  • Translate complex program data into clear, concise, and actionable information appropriate for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
  • Coordinate with project managers and functional stakeholders to ensure required inputs are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
  • Ensure consistency of metric definitions, calculations, reporting periods, and presentation standards across reporting products.


Dashboard Development and Reporting Automation

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and analytical reports using Microsoft Power BI.
  • Use advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities to consolidate, analyze, reconcile, and present data from multiple sources.
  • Leverage Power Query, Power Automate, and other approved tools to streamline data preparation and automate recurring reporting activities.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate redundant manual work, reduce reporting cycle time, and improve the repeatability of reporting processes.
  • Establish and maintain standardized templates, and reporting procedures.
  • Implement appropriate data validation and quality checks to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and calculation errors.
  • Coordinate with appropriate information technology, data owners, and functional teams to address data accessibility and reporting limitations.


Program Controls and Cross-Functional Reporting Support

  • Support the consolidation and presentation of cost, schedule, funding, technical performance, quality, and risk information.
  • Assist with the preparation of variance summaries, performance comparisons, milestone tracking, funding status reports, and management review materials.
  • Identify relationships between performance indicators and communicate potential downstream impacts to program execution.
  • Support project managers in interpreting performance data and ensuring consistency between project-level and program-level reporting.
  • Assist with monitoring performance against approved plans, established targets, contractual requirements, and internal commitments.
  • Maintain appropriate coordination with stakeholders to resolve reporting discrepancies and improve the reliability of program information.


Process Improvement and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Evaluate existing reporting processes and recommend improvements to efficiency, consistency, accuracy, and usability.
  • Establish and maintain standardized reporting practices and metric governance across the program office.
  • Proactively follow up on missing, inconsistent, or outdated data and work with responsible stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Support special projects, performance improvement initiatives, and ad hoc analyses at the direction of PMO leadership.
  • Handle program information in accordance with applicable security, confidentiality, and data-handling requirements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, data analytics, finance, engineering, information systems, project management, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.


Required/Preferred Experience

3-5 years of relevant experience in data analytics, program reporting, business intelligence, project controls, operations analysis, or a related field is required.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented analyst who combines strong technical skills with an understanding of how complex programs operate. This individual is comfortable working independently, coordinating across multiple teams, and managing recurring deliverables in a deadline-driven environment.

The candidate will demonstrate the ability to move beyond compiling data and producing presentations to identify trends, investigating performance gaps, improving reporting methods, and providing useful insights to leadership.

Success in this position requires someone who can establish credibility with project managers and functional stakeholders, maintain high standards for data quality, and continuously improve the program office’s ability to measure and communicate performance.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage recurring reporting deliverables and analytical assignments with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookup functions, complex formulas, data manipulation, reconciliation, and analytical reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, including the development of clear, professional presentations for management and executive audiences.
  • Working proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, including dashboard development, data visualization, and the ability to transform data into useful performance insights.
  • Experience developing or maintaining performance metrics, KPIs, dashboards, or management reporting products.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends and variances, investigate discrepancies, and communicate findings in a concise and understandable manner.
  • Experience consolidating information from multiple sources and validating data for accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with project managers, functional stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, recurring deadlines, and competing reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Experience Supporting DDG-51 Post Delivery, defense, aerospace, shipbuilding, engineering, manufacturing, or other complex government programs.
  • Experience working within a Program Management Office (PMO), program controls organization, or project management environment.
  • Familiarity with U.S. Navy or Department of Defense program execution, government customer reporting, and defense acquisition environments.
  • Experience supporting program-level performance reviews, executive briefings, and integrated program status reporting.
  • Proficiency in Power Query and experience automating reporting processes using Power Automate or comparable tools.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple sources into standardized dashboards, and reports.
  • Familiarity with program cost, schedule, funding, technical performance, quality, risk, and issue management.
  • Experience with SharePoint, or other approved collaboration and data-management platforms.
  • Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies and process standardization.


Ability to obtain a Security Clearance

  • This position requires you to be able to obtain a government security clearance. You must be a US Citizen for consideration, and you must be able to obtain an interim security clearance within the first 45 days of hire. For more information regarding the security clearance process, please visit Investigations & Clearance Process.

Investor & Management Reporting Analyst

Unlock your potential! Join our team as an Investor & Management Reporting Analyst! Heartland Dental is actively looking to bolster our dynamic Investor & Management Reporting Team. In this pivotal role, the analyst will play a central part in crafting comprehensive internal reporting materials.

To give you an idea of the team structure, you will work on a highly visible team who regularly interact with all areas of Accounting & Finance, reporting to the Manager of Investor & Management Reporting.

Heartland Dental is the largest dental support organization (DSO) in the United States, supporting approximately 1,700 dental offices across 38 states domestically. Our company is experiencing rapid growth, and we are looking for a dedicated and proven individual to join our Heartland Dental family.

This position is remote but will require regular travel to Indianapolis so we are focusing our search on candidates local to the Indy market.

Below is an overview of the duties and responsibilities you would take on in this role:

  • Manage and contribute to the preparation of monthly internal financial results, including comprehensive financial reporting packages for presentation to Senior Leadership and our Board of Directors. This includes a specific focus on enhancing analytical review processes, scalability and automation.
  • Conduct in-depth analytical reviews of balance sheets and income statements for our consolidated financial statements to ensure accuracy and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Drive continuous improvement by refining and strengthening existing processes and controls within the Financial Reporting function to further improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and clarity. Design and implement advanced data analysis techniques to provide valuable support for financial results.
  • Identify, document, and implement process improvements in financial reporting to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.
  • Conduct benchmarking analyses against peers and other comparable companies to gain valuable insights and inform strategic decision-making.
  • Provide valuable support to the external financial reporting function as needed, ensuring seamless coordination between internal and external efforts.
  • Be flexible and ready to assist with ad-hoc or miscellaneous reporting projects, contributing to the overall success of the Financial Reporting Team.

Minimum Requirements:

  • This position offers a hybrid work arrangement, with a base in our Indianapolis Support Office.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
  • Superior analytical and problem-solving skills with emphasis on process improvements.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft suite of products.
  • Ability to work independently and possess proven project management skills.
  • Proven ability to work effectively under pressure & meet deadlines.
  • Live near Indianapolis, IN for in office meetings

Desired:

  • 2+ years public accounting experience (Big 4 or serving public companies) or 2+ years financial reporting experience preferred.
  • Experience in other financial/business intelligence tools, including SAP Analytics, is preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to perform essential duties satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties of the position
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

We put our people first at Heartland Dental, and that shows in our generous benefits package.

Company retains the sole discretion to change the duties of the position at any time.

We provide all employees and applicants for employment the protections of federal, state, and local laws affording equal opportunity in employment.
