Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in advancing the organization's regulatory reporting, data quality, and analytical capabilities. This position owns the end-to-end transformation of complex policy, claims, underwriting, and financial data into accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory submissions while driving improvements in data processes, governance, and reporting standards.

As a senior analytical professional, this role combines advanced data analysis, data engineering, insurance domain expertise, and business insight to solve complex data challenges, influence decision-making, and identify opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance. The Senior Data Analyst serves as a trusted partner to business and technical stakeholders and provides mentorship and guidance to analysts across the organization.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design and execute advanced analyses to support regulatory reporting, compliance initiatives, and strategic business decisions.
  • Transform complex business requirements into scalable data solutions, analytical frameworks, and actionable insights.
  • Analyze policy, claims, underwriting, financial, and operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, reconciliations, and datasets to improve performance, scalability, and reusability.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Application teams to design and implement data enrichment, transformation, and integration solutions.
  • Support and enhance data platforms, reporting processes, and analytical assets using modern data technologies and best practices.
  • Own data preparation, validation, and reconciliation activities supporting statutory reporting, regulatory filings, annual statement reporting, premium tax reporting, market conduct examinations, audits, and ad hoc regulatory requests.
  • Develop deep expertise in Property & Casualty insurance operations, regulatory reporting requirements, and statutory accounting principles.
  • Ensure analytical outputs align with regulatory expectations and support sound business decision-making.
  • Translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable data processes and controls.
  • Independently diagnose data quality, integration, and reporting issues across multiple systems and business functions.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective actions that improve data integrity and reporting accuracy.
  • Design analytical approaches for complex or ambiguous business problems where requirements may be incomplete or evolving.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve efficiency, and enhance data accessibility for business stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships with Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, MGA Operations, Applications, and Data Engineering teams.
  • Effectively communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop clear narratives that connect data insights to regulatory, operational, and business outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions, provide data-driven recommendations, and influence prioritization of data and reporting initiatives.
  • Champion data governance practices and contribute to the development of data standards, controls, documentation, and definitions.
  • Establish and enhance data quality monitoring processes within assigned domains.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for analytical methodologies, reporting practices, and regulatory data requirements.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to analysts by reviewing analytical approaches, sharing best practices, and supporting professional development.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and analytical excellence.

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, business analytics, computer science, actuarial science, finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, or related functions within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory reporting, statutory reporting, compliance initiatives, or financial reporting processes.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance operations and data structures across policy, claims, underwriting, accounting, finance, or actuarial functions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale relational databases, data warehouses, and data transformation methodologies.
  • Experience performing complex data analysis, reconciliation, root-cause investigation, and data quality assessments.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and data storytelling skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in quantitative, analytical, or business-related discipline.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and visualization platforms.
  • Experience with data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality programs.
  • Intermediate or advanced Property & Casualty insurance designations (CPCU, AINS, AU, API, or equivalent).
  • Experience partnering with Actuarial teams and supporting actuarial, financial, or regulatory reporting processes.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering concepts.

Key Competencies

  • Technical & Analytical Skills - Designs advanced analyses, metrics, and scalable data solutions while improving performance, quality, and reusability of datasets and reporting assets.
  • Business Acumen & Domain Knowledge - Applies deep Property & Casualty insurance and regulatory expertise to connect analytical work with broader business objectives and outcomes.
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - Independently solves complex, ambiguous problems and develops analytical approaches from the ground up.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling - Translates complex data into clear, compelling narratives that influence business decisions and drive action.
  • Stakeholder Management & Influence - Builds trusted partnerships across functions, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps guide analytical priorities.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - Provides informal leadership through mentoring, knowledge sharing, review of analytical work, and coaching of other analysts.
  • Data Quality & Governance - Improves data quality standards, governance practices, and reporting controls within the domain.
  • Strategic Thinking & Innovation - Connects analytics to broader organizational goals and identifies high-impact opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational effectiveness.

The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.

  • Chicago Pay Range: $128010.00 - $152,184.00
  • Omaha and Richmond Pay Range: $116,382.00 - $138,414.00
  • Los Angeles and New York City Pay Range: $139,638.00 - $166,260.00

Please Note

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

Who’s driving the success of one of the fastest-growing retailers in the nation?

ALDI National Real Estate! Our Real Estate Analytics team uses data, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics to help shape the future of our store network. We are

looking for someone who is passionate about numbers and problem solving, using data to understand the past and help predict the future.

As a Data Analytics Associate II, you will develop analyses, build and improve data workflows, and create reporting and visualizations that support strategic real estate

decisions across the country. You will also support non-technical users of a technical system by answering questions and helping them understand analytical outputs and

insights. The ideal candidate has a strong analytical background, solid math and statistics skills, and at least one year of relevant experience. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with Tableau, Power BI, and other workflow and visualization tools are strong pluses

Position Type: Full-Time

Starting Wage: $31.75 per hour

Wage Increases: Year 2 - $32.75 | Year 3 - $34.50 | Year 4 - $36.00

Work Location: Dublin, OH

This role is eligible to participate in ALDI’s Hybrid Work Program, which allows remote work up to 3 days per week (i.e., work remotely up to 3 days per week; work in-office at least 2 days per week)

Duties And Responsibilities

Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Aggregates data from various sources to construct streamlined data pipelines and integrate data from multiple databases for centralized analysis.
  • Develops and executes statistical models to support various internal client goals and derive statistically significant insights.
  • Develops and implements databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other tools that optimize statistical quality and efficiency. }
  • Maintains and validates data regularly to enhance the quality of the analysis and resultant output.
  • Seeks out process, data sourcing improvements and programs scheduled refreshes continually.
  • Maintains various computer applications, databases, and report generation and tracking spreadsheets.
  • Makes data visually appealing and simple to both navigate and comprehend for end-users.
  • Collaborates with team members and communicates relevant information to direct leader.
  • Complies with ALDI privacy and security requirements and policies if job responsibilities include possible access to confidential and/or sensitive information.

  • Ability to stay organized and multi-task efficiently.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
  • Establishes goals and works toward achievement.
  • Effective time management; maximizes productivity.
  • Excellent understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.

  • Problem-solving skills.

Company: Heartland Consulting

Location: Arlington, VA

Employment Type: Full-Time

Clearance Required: Secret Clearance

About The Role

Heartland Consulting is seeking a highly organized and analytical Readiness and Reporting Analyst to support the National Guard Bureau - Joint Surgeon General (JSG).

The selected candidate will develop comprehensive readiness and budget reports, maintain communication records, analyze operational performance, and recommend process improvements supporting 27 Combat Readiness Evaluation (CRE) Medical Elements (MEDELs). This position plays a critical role in strengthening reporting accuracy, readiness visibility, and operational efficiency.

What You Will Do

  • Prepare and submit monthly summary reports detailing contractor activities, accomplishments, and functions performed.
  • Develop monthly readiness status reports using the previous month's data to evaluate historical trends, current readiness, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day forecasts.
  • Create component-specific charts and visualizations for Training, Manning, and Equipment readiness.
  • Produce color-coded readiness charts using green, yellow, and red indicators in accordance with CNGBI 3510.01, CNGBM 3510.01, and ITRM standards.
  • Collaborate with government personnel to establish and finalize readiness reporting formats within 45 days of contract award.
  • Develop monthly CRE MEDEL budget reports in coordination with the JSG Resource Manager.
  • Prepare up to 12 ad hoc reports per month in response to government requirements.
  • Maintain accurate correspondence logs documenting communications with MEDEL units, including dates, times, and summaries.
  • Submit quarterly recommendations for improvements to reporting processes, data collection methods, database structures, and performance measures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting timelines, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain and update existing Power BI and Power Apps solutions supporting readiness reporting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong analytical, data interpretation, and reporting capabilities with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience developing reports and maintaining structured datasets.
  • Familiarity with government readiness reporting processes and data standards.
  • Experience maintaining and updating solutions developed using Microsoft Power BI and Power Apps.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple reporting requirements and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with National Guard operations, military readiness programs, or CRE MEDEL requirements.
  • Experience applying CNGBI/CNGBM readiness standards and ITRM reporting requirements.
  • Previous experience supporting federal government or military contracts.
  • Experience supporting multiple concurrent reporting streams and time-sensitive deliverables.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their resume for consideration. For additional information, please contact HR@HeartlandConsulting.com .

Equal Employment Opportunity

Heartland Consulting is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and veterans. We are proud to state that we do not discriminate in employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or disability status.

Heartland Consulting participates in E-Verify for all employees.

Salary: $80000 - $90000 per year

descriptionHtml:
Position Purpose

The Data Analyst will be part of the OWI Analytics team, partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate business questions into structured analyses that drive decision-making. This role goes beyond report production — it requires understanding the "why" behind a request, identifying the right data and methodology, and delivering insights that business partners can act on.

Duties, Tasks, And Responsibilities

  • Learn and map business processes end-to-end with stakeholders to identify the KPIs that genuinely measure performance for that process, then determine what data is required to analyze both the KPI itself and the underlying factors driving its performance
  • Partner with the Data Engineering and Data Science teams to translate those KPI and data requirements into validated data models — confirming the models actually deliver on the business objective identified in the step above, not just that they're technically complete
  • Partner with business stakeholders to scope analytical requests, clarify objectives, and identify the right metrics and data sources before analysis begins
  • Create visualizations that provide business insights for our global customers — dashboards, cash-flow projections, histograms, projective analysis, financial analysis, KPIs, and SLA reporting
  • Use SQL to independently mine data and translate business needs into clear, creative visualizations
  • Validate data and reporting outputs against SAP as the source-of-truth ERP, identifying and resolving discrepancies before they reach stakeholders
  • Assess data quality and flag data quality issues to the Data Warehouse team; support data governance practices
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot in Power BI, generative AI for data exploration and narrative summaries) to accelerate insight generation and surface patterns in large datasets
  • Demonstrate critical thinking and sound judgment to offer thoughtful, concise input toward problem resolution
  • Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, functional teams, and other data analysts to develop insight-driven visualizations
  • Support requirements gathering, design, deployment, and change management for reporting projects (entry-level project management)
  • Build and demo prototypes to stakeholders — peer groups, business partners, and senior leaders
  • Support and train peers/SMEs on report usage, troubleshooting, and results analysis
  • Develop leadership skills to promote ideas, coordinate work, and plan deliverables within a project team

Education, Skills And Abilities

  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI (required); DEX (Deployment Pipelines/Dataflows Experience) knowledge strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of SAP as an ERP/data validation source
  • Entry-level SQL proficiency for data querying and mining
  • Exposure to AI-assisted analytics tools (Copilot, generative AI for BI) a plus
  • Entry-level experience with data analytics concepts — data dictionaries, data mapping, normalization concepts
  • Basic project management and business process modeling
  • Minimum Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, Computer Science, or closely related field
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical issues to both technical and business audiences
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve problems effectively and in a timely manner

This Opportunity Offers a Competitive Benefits Package Including

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with wellness benefits
  • Company-matching 401(k) plan
  • Company-paid life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment benefits
  • Company-paid long-term care coverage
  • Company-paid disability
  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts
  • Company-paid employee assistance program
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Additional benefits included: voluntary life insurance, legal benefits, critical illness, accident insurance, and pet insurance

Old World Industries is among the largest privately held companies competing in the automotive aftermarket today. Built upon a 50-year history of ingenuity, the Northbrook, Illinois-based company is transforming the automotive, commercial and chemical industries that keep the world moving forward. Old World’s brands include a full line of PEAK® Performance Automotive Aftermarket Products including Antifreeze/Coolant, Washer Fluid, Lighting and Wiper Blades; BlueDEF® Diesel Exhaust Fluid and Equipment; FINAL CHARGE® PRO-SERIES Heavy Duty Extended Life Coolant, Fleet Charge® SCA Precharged Heavy Duty Coolant and Thermal Charge® Heat Transfer Fluid.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

Who Are We?    

The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens, to venues such as St Andrews Links and Target Field, we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100 years of operation under our belt and a healthy tenure, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place in the Twin Cities to build a career.

Job Purpose

As a Data Analyst III, you will design and deliver analytics solutions that support the Commercial Sales, Marketing, and Distributor Development teams. Working independently and collaboratively, you will develop reports and dashboards, optimize data models and their performance. You will translate business needs into reliable insights, promote self-service analytics, and support effective decision-making across the division.

Through accurate data stewardship, responsive analysis, and continuous process improvement, you will help the division achieve its sales objectives.

What Will You Do? 

  • Develop, manage, and distribute interactive dashboards and reports, including advanced calculations and measures.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Distributor Development and stakeholders to define reporting needs and document requirements.
  • Design and optimize data models, calculated fields, semantic layers, and report performance.
  • Create and maintain standardized report templates and themes.
  • Ensure the accuracy and reliability of data, reports, and dashboards by troubleshooting data-quality, integration, and visualization issues.
  • Analyze business performance and provide actionable recommendations that support divisional objectives.
  • Own the customer-classification process to enable retail-sales analysis by market segment.
  • Support ad hoc analysis and reporting from Commercial Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Finance, Product Forecasting and Distributor Development.
  • Serve as a data steward by cleansing, maintaining, and compiling data as needed.
  • Support user adoption by maintaining system and process documentation, delivering demonstrations and training, and providing first-level support to internal and external users.
  • Plan and complete special projects that support Commercial Division strategies
  • Represent the division on enterprise-wide Business Intelligence initiatives.
  • Continuously improve Sales and Marketing information processes.
  • Other duties as requested or assigned by supervisor.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS) or a related field
  • Three to five years of experience in analytics or reporting development
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models that support decision-making and enable self-service analytics
  • Advanced experience with at least one business intelligence platform; Power BI with DAX experience preferred
  • Intermediate SQL and data-modeling skills
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms; Snowflake experience preferred
  • Experience developing semantic layers
  • Strong understanding of data visualization concepts
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated proficiency with other Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex data and insights clearly to stakeholders and executive leadership
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects

Other Job-Related Components

  • Occasional travel of less than 10% may be required
  • Hybrid work environment: 3 days in office required

What Can We Give You?    

At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical/dental/vision plan, 401k, and many other great benefits - The Toro company offers employees at our Bloomington, MN HQ location a variety of perks, including: 

  • Dress for your day - We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. 
  • Location – Conveniently located near both St. Paul and Minneapolis, we are centrally located for most commuters! 
  • Food - Take advantage of our onsite café, which serves both breakfast and lunch. With a Caribou Coffee attached, you can grab a snack and a coffee at any time during your day. 
  • Wellness - The Toro Company’s HQ offers complimentary use of our onsite fitness facility to employees. In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health and financial health resources to all employees.
  • Volunteerism - The Toro Company is proud to provide employees 20 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. 
  • Summer Hours – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at our Bloomington HQ are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. 
  • Competitive Salary – The pay range takes into account skills, experience, education, and location. It is not common to be hired at or near the top of the range; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is between $96,900 - $121,100. Cash compensation is one piece of our competitive total rewards package. You may be eligible to participate in an incentive program, which rewards employees based on individual and organizational performance. Eligibility and award amounts are determined by company policy and performance metrics. If you need to, you can access your pay early with the dailypay app.

At The Toro Company, we are committed to fostering a secure and trustworthy recruitment experience for our applicants. Recruitment fraud is a growing concern for job seekers, so please be aware that throughout our recruitment process, you’ll never be required to pay any fees or disclose personal financial details when applying to TTC opportunities. All legitimate job opportunities must be applied for directly through our official careers page at jobs.thetorocompany.com or via Workday, our applicant tracking system.

The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

descriptionHtml:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Brown Brothers Harriman is currently recruiting an Addepar Analyst, Family Office Client Services & Reporting to join our Capital Partners team. In this role, you will be responsible for providing consolidated reporting to high-net-worth clients and family offices. You will be responsible for providing consolidated and custom reports in a timely and accurate manner. You will work directly with Relationship Managers and 3rd party advisors. You will handle all client inquiries and resolve issues related to reporting. To be successful, you will need expertise using Addepar, strong technical and interpersonal skills, and communication skills. Our ideal candidate is determined to tackle problems, can skillfully coordinate internal teams, and loves working directly with relationship teams.

Some Of Your Key Responsibilities Include

  • Working directly with the front office on client reporting.
  • Become a subject matter expert on Addepar to serve as the primary point of contact for escalation of all issues
  • Understanding client relationships and ownership structures which contribute to the accuracy of consolidated reporting.
  • Working closely with Front Office, end users (clients) to configure Addepar reporting and resolve issues.
  • Running monthly and quarterly reporting for high-net-worth clients, Family offices and Endowments and Foundations
  • Updating asset classification and security pricing in Addepar
  • Working with an internal performance team to reconcile accounts in Addepar
  • Report on internal and external private investments
  • Working with internal groups to integrate systems and workflows
  • Identifying trends and recommending process improvements to increase efficiency
  • Collaborate with various parts of the organization to resolve client issues
  • Work in complex data sets to identify and resolve data and calculation discrepancies.

Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree with 3+ years of relevant work experience; Addepar experience is required
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, i.e. customizing charts and graphs, conducting multi-sheet analysis, linking data across workbooks, and using advanced formulas
  • Strong knowledge of performance and financial reporting
  • Strong knowledge of private investments (private equity, venture capital, private real estate) and being able to track and report on them
  • Ability to analyze monthly performance returns and market value changes to ensure accuracy.
  • Ability to identify, escalate, and resolve problems/issues.
  • Avid learner willing to develop subject matter expertise on new software.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to meet tight deadlines and work under pressure.
  • Proactive self-starter who is goal oriented
  • Working knowledge of performance analysis concepts
  • Experience with First Rate and Sungard AddVantage a plus
  • Strong work ethic and self-starter, able to effectively prioritize and adapt within a fast-paced business environment.

This role can be based in either our New York, Boston, or Philadelphia locations and is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three (3) days in office.

Salary Range

NYC/Boston: $65k-$90k base salary + annual bonus target

Philadelphia: $75k-$85k base salary + annual bonus target

BBH and its affiliates' compensation program includes base salary, discretionary bonuses, and profit-sharing. The anticipated base salary range(s) shown above are only for the indicated location(s) and may differ in other locations due to cost of living and labor considerations. Base salaries may vary based on factors such as skill, experience and qualification for the role. BBH's total rewards package recognizes your contributions with more than just a paycheck—providing you with benefits that enhance your experience at BBH from long-term savings, healthcare, and income protection to professional development opportunities and time off, our programs support your overall well-being.

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

Description

The Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst will play a key role in transforming raw data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the organization. This role is ideal for early-career professionals (0–4 years) who possess strong analytical skills, curiosity, and a desire to solve problems using data. The BI Analyst collaborates across departments, develops reports and dashboards, and ensures data accuracy while supporting strategic and operational initiatives. This is a new role created as a result of growth in SuperHero’s data and analytics infrastructure. This role will report to SuperHero’s Senior Director of FP&A with high visibility to SuperHero’s executive leadership.

About SuperHero

SuperHero Fire Protection is a leading fire protection company with 18 locations and over 900 employees across the Southeastern United States. SuperHero offers the full suite of fire protection services including servicing of sprinklers, fire alarms, and suppression systems, as well as system installation in new and existing buildings. Through our partnership with Hidden Harbor Capital Partners, SuperHero has grown from its founding in Georgia in 2012 to serve customers across 14 states.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, manage, and maintain BI solutions such as dashboards, reports, and data models
  • Gather business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into analytical or reporting needs
  • Maintain and refine source data pulls from data lake to Power BI
  • Perform ad hoc analyses to support business questions, identify trends, and provide insights
  • Monitor performance of BI systems and troubleshoot issues as needed
  • Support data governance by documenting processes, reporting logic, and data definitions

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field
  • 0–4 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or related fields.
  • Experience with BI tools, Power BI preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets
  • Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts.
  • Exposure to financial, operational, or KPI driven reporting environments.

Join our team and Build a Career Around Work That Matters! We offer a collaborative work culture, opportunities for professional growth, and comprehensive benefits to support your career development.

Fusion Technology is a performance-driven HUBZone Small Business concern residing in the heart of the beautiful mountainsides of West Virginia, steps away from the Federal Bureau of Investigation's Criminal Justice Information Services Division's Headquarters. Founded in 2007 by an Engineer-by-trade, Fusion Technology dedicates our valuable resources to providing comprehensive IT services and solutions to mission-critical US Government programs and the Intel Community.

Position Location: Washington, DC

Who are you?

Security-cleared Professional: An active TS Clearance is required to be considered for this position.

Education and Experience: You have a Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis experience, with some user design experience is required.

Preferred Certifications: CompTIA Data+, CompTIA DataSys+, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, Microsoft SQL, Microsoft PowerBI, Microsoft PowerPoint.

What You'll Do

The Data Analyst helps with the interpretation, implementation, analysis and visualization of large amounts of data within OCIO into more readable formats for personnel and our partners within the organization cybersecurity environment. The data analyst utilizes various programs and methods to manipulate data to display it in a more readable and concise manner that is desired or required by the Agency and its stakeholders. Such methods could include through Microsoft Excel spreadsheets, charts, Microsoft PowerBI dashboards, and other analytical methods.

  • Performs analysis on a variety of data relevant for documents, reports, and summaries to prepare for additional reports or requirements.
  • Manages the compilation, cataloging, caching, distribution, retrieval, and archiving of data.
  • Participates in ad-hoc data analysis projects and produces actionable requests, proposals, or events for both internal and external stakeholders for the Agency.
  • Collects data from various sources and produces basic to advanced reports and charts based on client inquiries and requirements.
  • Accurately enters required data into one or multiple databases, documents, and spreadsheets for the client for analysis and retention.

What Matters To You Matters To Us.

Fusion Technology values its employees and works hard to ensure proper care for them and their families. We desire to compensate employees in a competitive, motivational, fair, and equitable way with other employers in the marketplace. Salary is only one component of employee compensation but an integral part of recruiting and retaining qualified employees. However, at Fusion Technology, we take a comprehensive approach and consider each employee's needs to tailor a compensation plan that provides financial security and peace of mind. Our competitive package includes a best-in-class matching 401K program, a comprehensive healthcare plan through Cigna, a competitive employer contribution to a health savings account, vision and dental plans, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, and personal leave, in addition to paid certifications and training.

Fusion Technology LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills, and experiences within our workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Salary: $85000 - $90000 per year

Job Title: Data Analyst

Location: Texas, USA

Experience: 2–4 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst with 2–4 years of experience in collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data to support business decisions. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL and Excel skills, experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI or Tableau.
  • Analyze business trends, patterns, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders and management.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to identify discrepancies.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and track business performance against established targets.
  • Document data processes, reporting procedures, and analytical findings.
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and data manipulation.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and advanced formulas.
  • Experience with at least one data visualization tool: Power BI or Tableau.
  • Good understanding of data cleaning, data validation, data transformation, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of statistical concepts and analytical techniques.
  • Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate actionable insights.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently as well as collaboratively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis and automation.
  • Exposure to databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes and data warehousing concepts.
  • Knowledge of cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience working in Agile or cross-functional business environments.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Master's degree or relevant certifications in Data Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or SQL are a plus.

What We're Looking For

  • A data-driven professional with strong attention to detail.
  • Someone who can turn raw data into meaningful business insights.
  • A proactive problem-solver who can work with stakeholders and deliver accurate reports on time.
  • A clear communicator who can explain analytical findings and recommendations effectively.

Who’s driving the success of one of the fastest-growing retailers in the nation? ALDI National Real Estate! Our Real Estate Analytics team uses data, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics to help shape the future of our store network. We are looking for someone who is passionate about numbers and problem solving, using data to understand the past and help predict the future.

Who’s driving the success of one of the fastest-growing retailers in the nation?

ALDI National Real Estate! Our Real Estate Analytics team uses data, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics to help shape the future of our store network. We are

looking for someone who is passionate about numbers and problem solving, using data to understand the past and help predict the future.

As a Data Analytics Associate II, you will develop analyses, build and improve data workflows, and create reporting and visualizations that support strategic real estate

decisions across the country. You will also support non-technical users of a technical system by answering questions and helping them understand analytical outputs and

insights. The ideal candidate has a strong analytical background, solid math and statistics skills, and at least one year of relevant experience. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with Tableau, Power BI, and other workflow and visualization tools are strong pluses

Position Type: Full-Time

Starting Wage: $31.75 per hour

Wage Increases: Year 2 - $32.75 | Year 3 - $34.50 | Year 4 - $36.00

Work Location: Dublin, OH

This role is eligible to participate in ALDI’s Hybrid Work Program, which allows remote work up to 3 days per week (i.e., work remotely up to 3 days per week; work in-office at least 2 days per week)

Duties And Responsibilities

Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Designs, manages, and delivers analyses for all real estate-related departments via workflows and statistical modeling.
  • Aggregates data from various sources to construct streamlined data pipelines and integrate data from multiple databases for centralized analysis.
  • Develops and executes statistical models to support various internal client goals and derive statistically significant insights.
  • Develops and implements databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other tools that optimize statistical quality and efficiency. }
  • Maintains and validates data regularly to enhance the quality of the analysis and resultant output.
  • Seeks out process, data sourcing improvements and programs scheduled refreshes continually.
  • Maintains various computer applications, databases, and report generation and tracking spreadsheets.
  • Makes data visually appealing and simple to both navigate and comprehend for end-users.
  • Collaborates with team members and communicates relevant information to direct leader.
  • Complies with ALDI privacy and security requirements and policies if job responsibilities include possible access to confidential and/or sensitive information.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Job-specific Competencies:

  • Consistently demonstrates the Mindsets, ALDI Acts Competencies and Professional Skills (M.A.P.) as outlined for the role.
  • Gives attention to detail and follows instruction.
  • Ability to stay organized and multi-task efficiently.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
  • Establishes goals and works toward achievement.
  • Effective time management; maximizes productivity.
  • Excellent understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large data sets and crunch numbers.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, Math, Statistics or a related field required.
  • A minimum of 1 year of relevant experience required.
  • Or, a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge.
  • Experience with Power BI preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Work may be performed in an office, remote office or a combination of both where a computer and office equipment may be used as needed to perform duties.
  • Regularly required to sit, reach, grasp, stand and move from one area to another.
  • Constantly and repeatedly use keyboard/mouse.
  • Occasionally required to push, pull, bend, lift and move up to 25 lbs.

Travel

  • Minimal travel required as needed for job related duties such as training, project work and administrative tasks.

ALDI offers competitive wages and benefits, to all employees including:

  • 401(k) Plan
  • Company 401(k) Matching Contributions
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • PerkSpot National Discount Program

In Addition, Full-time Employees Are Offered

  • Medical, Prescription, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Generous Vacation Time & 7 Paid Holidays
  • Up to 6 Weeks Paid Parental Leave at 100% of pay
  • Up to 2 Weeks Paid Caregiver Leave at 100% of pay
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Life, Dependent Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Term Life Insurance
  • Full-time employees average 30 or more hours per week within an annual lookback period
  • Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by state Click here to learn more about the benefits ALDI has to offer

As a proud Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE), we do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, religion, sex, sexual stereotyping, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), or any other protected characteristic. Our expertise includes:

•	Program & project management
•	Project controls & performance management
•	Operations & delivery readiness

Logic is relied upon where complexity is high and outcomes matter, bringing experienced people, disciplined delivery leadership, and execution focus that stays with programs over time.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT LOGIC

Logic is a practitioner-led program management firm that helps utilities, public agencies, and infrastructure owners deliver complex capital programs. Our teams provide program and project controls, PMO and governance, and organizational change and business transformation, working inside our clients’ programs as part of their teams, not advising from the sidelines. We hire experienced people, give them real ownership of their work, and build an inclusive environment where they want to stay. Join us to do work that keeps critical infrastructure moving.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

Logic is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst II to support a utility wildfire program for a major utility client in the San Diego area. This role supports reporting and analytics work for wildfire mitigation programs and regulatory deliverables. That work includes gathering, transforming, validating, reconciling, analyzing, and visualizing data, and turning technical findings into clear, defensible information. It’s a strong fit for a data professional with 2–5 years of experience who enjoys owning analytics work from start to finish and wants work with real-world public safety impact. You’ll work closely with project managers, subject matter experts, data owners, and regulatory stakeholders.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting & Analytics

  • Execute processes to assess client datasets and prepare reliable, traceable data for analysis, reporting, and visualization.
  • Lead assigned reporting and analytics projects independently, including planning, stakeholder coordination, testing, documentation, and delivery.
  • Build and maintain interactive Power BI or Tableau dashboards that communicate key performance indicators and wildfire mitigation performance in an actionable format.
  • Apply statistical methods and diagnostic or predictive modeling, as appropriate, to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and anomalies.
  • Develop thorough test plans and perform QA/QC to confirm the proper functioning of reports, calculations, dashboards, and data automation tools.

Wildfire Mitigation Regulatory Support

  • Support quarterly data and spatial reporting, annual information reports, Wildfire Mitigation Plan (WMP) filings and tables, and regulatory data requests.
  • Gather, analyze, validate, and reconcile data that supports quarterly data reports, WMP tables, effectiveness studies, narratives, and regulatory responses.
  • Investigate reporting changes, anomalies, conflicting values, missing information, and source-system discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with data owners and program SMEs.
  • Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and alignment across regulatory deliverables.

Documentation, Communication & Continuous Improvement

  • Document data sources, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, assumptions, business rules, validation procedures, and data lineage.
  • Translate technical analyses into plain-language findings and recommendations for project managers, executives, business leaders, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, standardize methodologies, automate recurring processes, and reduce manual effort.
  • Perform all work in accordance with client procedures, security and confidentiality requirements, and established data governance practices.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or a related field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Power BI and advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including reconciliation, data shaping, and quality review.
  • 2–5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, data management, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading reporting or analytics assignments.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for database querying and analysis.
  • Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, automation, or modeling.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams).
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to explain technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to attend in-person meetings in the San Diego area as needed.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in utility, wildfire mitigation, regulatory reporting, compliance, risk, asset management, or infrastructure programs preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data tools, including Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift, preferred.
  • Experience with Tableau or other visualization platforms a plus.
  • Working knowledge of statistics, hypothesis testing, and data modeling preferred.
  • Power BI Data Analyst certification or a comparable analytics certification preferred.


PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Hybrid — Enhanced work-life balance with our hybrid model combining both remote and in-office work.
  • Climbing PTO — Enjoy freedom and flexibility with our annual increasing paid time off.
  • Paid Holidays — We observe 9 federal holidays.
  • Health & Wellness — We prioritize your physical and mental well-being with health and wellness initiatives and programs.
  • Medical & Retirement Benefits — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and retirement with company match ensures you and your family’s health and future are well-protected.
  • Career Growth — Track your career with our robust learning and development opportunities.
  • Culture Focused — Thrive in our inclusive, vibrant culture that values diversity, teamwork, and mutual respect.

- Execute processes to assess client datasets and prepare reliable, traceable data for analysis, reporting, and visualization.
- Lead assigned reporting and analytics projects independently, including planning, stakeholder coordination, testing, documentation, and delivery.
- Build and maintain interactive Power BI or Tableau dashboards that communicate key performance indicators and wildfire mitigation performance in an actionable format.
- Apply statistical methods and diagnostic or predictive modeling, as appropriate, to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and anomalies.
- Develop thorough test plans and perform QA/QC to confirm the proper functioning of reports, calculations, dashboards, and data automation tools.
Wildfire Mitigation Regulatory Support

- Support quarterly data and spatial reporting, annual information reports, Wildfire Mitigation Plan (WMP) filings and tables, and regulatory data requests.
- Gather, analyze, validate, and reconcile data that supports quarterly data reports, WMP tables, effectiveness studies, narratives, and regulatory responses.
- Investigate reporting changes, anomalies, conflicting values, missing information, and source-system discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with data owners and program SMEs.
- Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and alignment across regulatory deliverables.

- Document data sources, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, assumptions, business rules, validation procedures, and data lineage.
- Translate technical analyses into plain-language findings and recommendations for project managers, executives, business leaders, and regulatory stakeholders.
- Identify opportunities to improve data quality, standardize methodologies, automate recurring processes, and reduce manual effort.
- Perform all work in accordance with client procedures, security and confidentiality requirements, and established data governance practices.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or a related field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Strong proficiency with Power BI and advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including reconciliation, data shaping, and quality review.
- 2–5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, data management, business intelligence, or a related field.
- Demonstrated experience independently leading reporting or analytics assignments.
- Strong proficiency in SQL for database querying and analysis.
- Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, automation, or modeling.
- Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams).
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to explain technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to attend in-person meetings in the San Diego area as needed.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in utility, wildfire mitigation, regulatory reporting, compliance, risk, asset management, or infrastructure programs preferred.
- Hands-on experience with AWS data tools, including Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift, preferred.
- Experience with Tableau or other visualization platforms a plus.
- Working knowledge of statistics, hypothesis testing, and data modeling preferred.
- Power BI Data Analyst certification or a comparable analytics certification preferred.


PERKS & BENEFITS

- Hybrid — Enhanced work-life balance with our hybrid model combining both remote and in-office work.
- Climbing PTO — Enjoy freedom and flexibility with our annual increasing paid time off.
- Paid Holidays — We observe 9 federal holidays.
- Health & Wellness — We prioritize your physical and mental well-being with health and wellness initiatives and programs.
- Medical & Retirement Benefits — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and retirement with company match ensures you and your family’s health and future are well-protected.
- Career Growth — Track your career with our robust learning and development opportunities.
- Culture Focused — Thrive in our inclusive, vibrant culture that values diversity, teamwork, and mutual respect.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Habitat for Humanity of Oregon is growing! The Data Analyst supports Habitat Oregon’s multi-county housing and home repair programs by managing program data, ensuring data quality, producing and analyzing reports, strengthening compliance and monitoring program performance for private, state and federal grants.

Responsibilities

  • Manage Habitat Oregon’s internal program database and maintain accurate project files.
  • Generate reports and performance metrics for leadership and funders.
  • Develop and administer surveys using SurveyMonkey or other survey tools, and analyze results to support grant reporting and program evaluation.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, project timelines, and expenditures.
  • Support federal and state grant reporting requirements, including preparation of financial draw request forms.
  • Provide technical assistance to Habitat affiliate staff on data collection and reporting.
  • Analyze trends and recommend process improvements, as needed.
  • Support evaluation, forecasting, and evidence-based decision making.
  • Coordinate with the Staff Accountant to reconcile program financials, resolve discrepancies, and ensure accurate financial reporting and compliance with grant requirements.
  • Collaborate with program and financial staff on reimbursement activities, with a primary focus on the state and federally-funded Healthy Homes repair programs.
  • Conduct document review to support the Individual Development Account (IDA) program managed by Habitat Oregon as a fiduciary organization.
  • Provide technical assistance to affiliates to complete reimbursement for pass-through funding programs in compliance with state and federal requirements.
  • Support Staff Accountant to disperse reimbursements on time and within budget.
  • Actively participate in shared Habitat Oregon endeavors, including in-person training events, webinars for the network, advocacy initiatives, strategic planning retreats, weekly staff meetings, and quarterly Board meetings. Other duties and responsibilities may be defined at a later time.

Qualifications

  • Commitment to expanding economic opportunities among underserved communities in Oregon.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in data analytics, statistics or related field.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, complex formulas, and financial reporting.
  • Experience with Salesforce and/or other data collection and tracking platforms, including relevant computer skills and software.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills.
  • Experience supporting government or nonprofit grants (preferred).
  • Valid driver’s license, access to a vehicle, and auto insurance.
  • Ability to pass a background check.

Compensation

Salary is from $50,000 - $56,000, depending on experience for this full-time, exempt position.

How to Apply

Send your cover letter, resume, and pronouns to [email protected].

The subject line of your email should read: Data Analyst from [Your Name].

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman is seeking a Data Insight Analyst to join the Warner Robins Data Analytics team within the Engineering organization. This role reports to the Manager, Computer Systems Analysis and is an on-site position in Warner Robins, Georgia.

The selected candidate will support the day‑to‑day operation, maintenance, and user enablement of our business intelligence and data preparation platforms. You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, database administrators, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure our data tools are reliable, secure, and performant.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Extract, transform, and validate large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., SQL databases, Excel) to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and Power BI to support operational decision‑making.
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear data models, KPIs, and visual storytelling solutions.
  • Perform advanced data analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights that drive strategic initiatives.
  • Bridge operational technology (OT) with IT systems to enable high‑performance data visualization and logging.
  • Optimize report and dashboard performance, manage data refresh schedules, and implement governance standards for dashboard consistency and usability.

**This position may be filled at either Data Insight Analyst or Principal Data Insight Analyst role.**

Basic Qualifications

  • For a Level 2: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field and 3+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or business intelligence roles.
  • For a Level 3: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field and 5+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or business intelligence roles.
  • **Will consider 4 additional years of related experience in lieu of Bachelor's Degree.
  • Minimum 2+ years of hands‑on experience developing interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Power BI in a professional environment.
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data extraction and transformation, including joins, subqueries, CTEs, and performance tuning.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing data models, including relationships, calculated fields, DAX measures, and data validation processes.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into KPIs, metrics, and visually compelling dashboards for operational and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with the ability to clearly present insights to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Must currently hold or be able to obtain and maintain a U.S Government Secret level security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related discipline, with 3+ years of experience in enterprise‑level business intelligence environments.
  • Advanced expertise in Tableau (including Tableau Prep and advanced calculations) and/or Power BI (including complex DAX development and performance optimization) or
  • Experience implementing data governance standards, BI best practices, and scalable reporting frameworks across departments.
  • Holds a current U.S Government Secret level security clearance.

NGSkills

Primary Level Salary Range: $72,100.00 - $108,100.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $89,400.00 - $134,200.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

descriptionHtml:
Our Story

Founded in 2008, Hightower is a wealth management firm that provides investment, financial and retirement planning services to individuals, foundations and family offices, as well as 401(k) consulting and cash management services to corporations. Hightower's capital solutions, operational support services, size and scale empower its vibrant community of independent-minded wealth advisors to grow their businesses and help their clients achieve their financial vision. Based in Chicago with advisors across the U.S., we operate as a registered investment advisor (RIA).

Your Future Team

Hightower's Compliance Department strives to provide support to our advisor teams. We are passionate about serving as collaborators within all facets of the organization. We focus on developing strategies that are for advisors, their clients, and other mid and back-office departments. We do this while observing the spirit of the regulation.

We are seeking a Compliance Officer, Compliance Data and Reporting to support Hightower's branch examination program and broader compliance testing efforts. This junior-level role will work with experienced compliance professionals to develop useful reporting, review data for potential issues, and communicate findings. The analyst will help turn examination and compliance needs into reliable, repeatable analysis for an SEC-registered investment adviser and FINRA-regulated broker-dealer.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytical tools that support branch examination planning, data review, and risk identification.
  • Gather, reconcile, and validate information from compliance, branch, examination, and other business systems.
  • Analyze reporting results to identify unusual activity, recurring issues, trends, and potential compliance risks.
  • Explain analytical results and their limitations, document potential findings, and present clear summaries to compliance leaders and examination partners.
  • Support the branch examination lifecycle, including risk assessment, examination preparation, findings review, and remediation tracking.
  • Build and perform repeatable data-based tests for branch examinations and related compliance reviews.
  • Contribute to the development of testing and reporting for other Compliance Department priorities as capacity allows.
  • Use SQL and data preparation or reporting tools such as Alteryx to analyze information, and help automate recurring work with Microsoft Power Automate and Power Apps.
  • Work with compliance, examination, business, and technology partners to clarify needs, deliver practical reporting solutions, and document data sources, definitions, report logic, and quality checks.


What You'll Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, compliance testing, audit, or a related role; experience in financial services is preferred.
  • Experience analyzing structured data and developing reports or other repeatable analytical outputs for business or compliance users.
  • Working proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with a reporting or data preparation tool such as Alteryx, Power BI, or a comparable platform.
  • Foundational knowledge of investment adviser or broker-dealer compliance, supervision, audit, or examination practices, with the ability to learn applicable SEC, FINRA, and firm requirements.
  • Ability to assess data for accuracy, investigate exceptions, identify meaningful patterns, and communicate results clearly to nontechnical audiences.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Power Automate and Power Apps and approved AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot, or the ability to learn them quickly and use them responsibly.


What We Offer

  • Coverage on the first day of employment for medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid parental leave (16 weeks for primary caregiver and 8 weeks for secondary caregiver)
  • Mother's lounge onsite
  • Flexible PTO plan
  • In-office Monday through Thursday and work from home on Fridays
  • Free brand-new gym in the Chicago office
  • 401k matching plan
  • HSA employer contributions
  • Student loan assistance
  • Pet insurance
  • Base salary of up to $110,000 plus discretionary bonus (exact base salary amount will be dependent on experience)


AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: Hightower is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, national origin, citizenship, veteran status, ancestry, age (over 40), physical or mental disability, medical condition (cancer-related), gender identity or expression, genetic information including sickle cell or hemoglobin C trait, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local law.

You are a U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident or possess other unrestricted U.S. work authorization and will not require sponsorship for U.S. work authorization now or anytime in the future.

descriptionHtml:
LyondellBasell is a leader in the global chemical industry creating solutions for everyday sustainable living. With a nearly 70-year legacy that includes a Nobel Prize in Chemistry and our proprietary MoReTec recycling technology, LYB is enabling a more sustainable future for generations to come. LYB develops high-quality and innovative products for applications ranging from sustainable transportation and food safety to clean water and quality healthcare. LYB places high priority on diversity, equity and inclusion and is Advancing Good with an emphasis on our planet, the communities where we operate and our future workforce. We're addressing the global challenges of ending plastic waste, taking climate action, and supporting a thriving society, while generating value for our customers, investors, and society.

Come Join an Inclusive Team

The HR Reporting Analyst creates and executes routine and adhoc HR data reporting, ensuring extracts, dashboards, and workforce metrics are accurate, complete, and delivered on time. The role supports recurring hire-to-retire (H2R) reporting cycles, maintains reporting documentation and schedules, and helps uphold consistent data quality across HR systems and reporting sources. This role also supports stakeholder requests for standard data extracts and reporting insights.

A Day in the Life

General

  • Create, run and distribute scheduled HR reports according to defined timelines.
  • Generate metrics for headcount, workforce movement, and demographic reporting needs.
