descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Business Analyst

We, at Leggett & Platt Inc., are searching for a Business Analyst within our Home Furniture Sales and Field Support team to help support our Home Furniture business. Our Home Furniture business brings an intense focus on the customer, innovation, world-class manufacturing capabilities, and a global footprint together to create full package solutions for the industry. We do not make furniture. We make furniture more comfortable. We need the best people on our team to support our strategy, and your work will ensure people around the world have a little more comfort in their lives.

As a Business Analyst, you will have the opportunity to influence strategic business decisions, support innovation, and contribute to revenue and margin growth across a global organization. You'll work alongside talented professionals across multiple functions while gaining broad exposure to product development, commercial strategy, and financial planning.

So, what will you be doing as a Business Analyst?

  • Create, maintain, and improve business reporting, KPI dashboards, and recurring management reports using Excel, Power BI, and Zoho Analytics
  • Analyze sales, operational, inventory, and financial data to support business decisions and identify trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Reconcile data from multiple systems and sources, identify discrepancies, and establish trusted reporting metrics
  • Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting for leadership teams
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Sales teams to understand business performance and reporting needs
  • Investigate variances, data anomalies, and unexpected business results to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning activities through data analysis and reporting
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of meaningful KPIs that support operational and financial performance
  • Work with manufacturing and operational data to improve reporting accuracy, consistency, and visibility across the organization
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process inefficiencies and opportunities for automation where practical
 
To Be Successful in This Role, You'll Need
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business, Analytics, Economics or a related field preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through incomplete, inconsistent, or conflicting data
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, lookups, formulas, and data analysis
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and KPIs that support business decision-making
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail
  • Strong business curiosity and desire to understand how operational activities affect financial results
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a manufacturing
  • Experience with Power BI, Zoho Analytics, Zoho Projects, or similar reporting platforms
  • Experience reconciling and validating data from multiple systems
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and operational reporting processes
  • Exposure to inventory reporting, product costing, procurement, forecasting, or budgeting
  • Experience identifying root causes of business performance issues and providing actionable recommendations
  • Familiarity with Bills of Material (BOMs), inventory transactions, product costing, or manufacturing processes is a plus
 

What Will Make Someone Successful in This Role?

The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems, digging into data, identifying inconsistencies, and translating information into meaningful business insights. Success in this role comes from being able to find the truth in imperfect operational and financial data, build trusted reporting, and help leaders make informed decisions.

What to Do Next

Now that you've had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available.

Our Values

Our values speak to our shared beliefs and describe how we approach working together.

  • Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an inclusive environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging
  • Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth, good or bad
  • Do Great Work...Together occurs when we engage without hierarchy, collaborate as a team, embrace challenges, and work for the good of all of us
  • Take Ownership and Raise the Bar demonstrates our responsibility to add value and make a difference, challenge the status quo and biases to make things better, foster innovative and creative solutions to drive impact, and explore new perspectives and embrace change

Our Commitment to You

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all. Leggett & Platt is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veteran status, and more. Join us!

We welcome and encourage applications if you meet the minimum qualifications. Even if you do not meet the preferred qualifications, we'd love the opportunity to consider you.

Equal Employment Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer

For more information about how we handle your personal data in connection with our recruiting processes, please refer to the Recruiting Privacy Notice on the "Privacy Notice" tab located at http://privacy.leggett.com.

The RoleCCC's Financial Intelligence team is hiring an Analyst. This team builds the reporting, data, and systems layer that Finance and executive leadership run on including dashboards, Board & IR materials, and finance process automation.

This is a role for someone analytical and driven who wants to understand how a large SaaS business works. You will see revenue, expense, headcount, and operations across every segment of the company. You will work with Finance, Accounting, and Operations leadership regularly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop working fluency in our finance and data stack: Workday, Adaptive Planning, Essbase, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric
  • Maintain and improve the reports and dashboards used by Finance, executive leadership, including data quality and dimension governance across our financial systems
  • Perform ad-hoc corporate analysis for senior leadership; investigate the question behind the question, get to an answer, and explain it clearly
  • Support the preparation of Monthly Operating Review, Board reporting, and investor relations materials through data analysis and visualization
  • Identify and reconcile inconsistencies across source systems and recommend structural fixes rather than one-time patches
  • Partner with FP&A, Accounting, and Operations to find manual processes and automate them, reducing cycle time and error rates
  • Build reusable tools, queries, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline. We do not require a specific major. Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, and Business Analytics are all common backgrounds here
  • 0–3 years of experience in an analytical role. Strong candidates come from finance, consulting, operations, data analytics, or business intelligence
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets
  • Ability to read a P&L and reason about what drives the numbers. Deep accounting knowledge is not required
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain an analysis to someone who did not do it
  • SQL, Python, Power BI, or Tableau exposure is a plus, not a requirement
  • Experience with Workday, Adaptive Planning, Essbase, or similar enterprise finance systems is a plus, not a requirement

What We're Looking For

  • Logical and structured thinking with comfortability in ambiguous questions and asks.
  • A critical thinker who questions all outputs and how a number came to be.
  • A strong drive and individual ownership
  • Interest in how a business operates end to end

Why This Role

Most entry-level finance roles give you one slice of the company. This one gives you the whole picture - every segment, every cost center, the revenue model, and the systems underneath all of it. You will have team members mentor you directly on the day-to-day, on a team with direct visibility to the CFO. The people who do this well develop a rare combination: they understand the business and they can build the tools that run it.

Interview Policy & Privacy Notice

A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE.

Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion & Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most.

At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Reporting Analyst will be a proactive partner to the Finance and Accounting team and other internal customers to understand business challenges and reporting needs. You will identify datasets and accurately analyze and validate data quality for reporting needs and collaborate with business developers to model out that data to provide the best reporting solution for internal customers.

Be part of a dynamic collaborative environment and join the team at our stunning campus in Redlands, CA, where your analytical skills will help drive strategic business decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and departments to propose, design, and guide the implementation of new reporting solutions and in some cases, support the implementation of changes in business processes
  • Develop wireframes and document the proper workflow process to support the design and development of Reporting Solutions for our customers
  • Research new datasets and combine information from multiple sources, conduct data gap analysis, perform DAX queries and functions, data modelling and basic M (Power Query Editor) capabilities, and basic SQL querying to visualize tables and data structures for best results
  • Partner with Finance and Accounting to understand the business process requirements to design, develop, test, and implement automated dashboards and reports to provide meaningful insights that drive action or help in decision making to support the department and various divisions across Esri
  • Collaborate and partner with Finance and Accounting teams for continuous process improvement in Reporting initiatives and other operational initiatives that best supports decision making by leadership
  • Support various accounting and reporting analyses and technical accounting research when needed

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar Analyst position
  • Excellent written and communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication style based on audience
  • Ability to communicate with the business and translate those requirements in a technical format to the Data Developers
  • Strong critical thinking skills to help solve business problems and make decisions
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including diplomacy, negotiating, reasoning, and problem solving
  • Ability to develop strong analytical skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret business needs
  • Detail oriented to ensure data accuracy
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools
  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience working with reporting and analytical tools such as Microsoft Access, Microsoft Power BI, Visio, and Lucid Charts
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational database management systems
  • Experience with SAP or similar ERP Systems

Total RewardsEsri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. descriptionHtml:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will turn a federal program's operational data into figures its people can rely on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you building the reporting a federal program runs on. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Work with the people who own each process to define its measures, and document the business rules behind every figure
  • Write the Structured Query Language (SQL) that turns platform data on Amazon Aurora and related Amazon Web Services (AWS) data stores into clean, reconciled analytical datasets
  • Build the recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations the program actually uses, with documented measures, refresh schedules, and access controls, designed to answer the question, load fast, and never mislead with a scale or a label
  • Trace each discrepancy to its source, whether a definition, timing, a filter, or a source system, until the figure is explained
  • Produce the quality evidence behind the reporting: validation checks, reconciliation reports, and issue logs that hold up in an audit
  • Replace manual reporting with repeatable, tested workflows
  • Make AI-assisted analysis standard practice, using coding assistants and language models across the work with your own judgment on top

You help deliver figures a federal program can run on, each with the provenance to show where it came from, and clean datasets that give every later analysis solid ground.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data analysis experience using SQL
  • Bachelor's degree
  • A strong working command of SQL
  • Experience building reports and dashboards in a business intelligence tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool
  • Familiarity with Python or R for analysis scripting
  • The ability to own an analysis from the first question to a delivered, documented answer
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Experience with cloud data platforms on AWS
  • Experience with federal program, financial, or performance data
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and analysis tools

Who You Are

You are exact with numbers and wary of any you cannot explain: an anomaly is something to run down, not a footnote. You move easily between a stakeholder's question and the data that answers it, and you would rather hand a program one figure it can trust than ten it cannot. You adapt, and you pick up new concepts, systems, and tools fast enough to stay ahead of what the program needs as projects finish and priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • A practical command of SQL and spreadsheets, with Python or R scripting where it makes the work faster or safer
  • The discipline of defined measures: rules written down, sources reconciled, and reports that refresh without surprises
  • The judgment to pick the chart that serves the reader, and the restraint to leave out the one that does not
  • The care to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $67,000 to $123,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

Job Title: Senior Associate, Business Intelligence Analyst

Job Code: 45322

Job Location: Malabar, FL

Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week

Job Description:

The Business analyst provides business analytics and reporting to manufacturing operations on production programs. Identifies and develops metrics by working with users and stakeholders to understand data visualization and reporting requirements. Translates business results into meaningful metrics and recommendations aimed at improving performance. Responsible for performing financial and business performance analysis. Defines configuration specifications and business analysis requirements. May partner with leaders to assess needs and define requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop and maintain monthly performance reporting by evaluating historical data trends and forecasting future performance metrics to support data-driven decision making.
  • Conduct detailed cost analysis across program financials, identifying key focus areas and delivering actionable recommendations to leadership to drive continuous improvement.
  • Perform Basis of Estimate (BOE) development and learning curve analysis by researching comparable programs and applying analytical methodologies to support accurate cost estimating.
  • Leverage business intelligence and enterprise tools such as Power BI, MS Office, and ERP systems (e.g., PeopleSoft, COBRA, EMPOWER) to input, manage, and transform data into meaningful reports and dashboards.
  • Design and develop advanced data analysis solutions, including automated reporting tools, Excel macros, and VBA-based applications to streamline analysis of program financials.
  • Establish and maintain baseline cost planning inputs by gathering manufacturing execution plan data to develop and monitor monthly cost and schedule performance indices.
  • Facilitate action plan closure meetings, ensuring accountability, timely follow-up, and resolution of open action items across stakeholder groups.
  • Prepare and deliver high-quality reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and executive-level documents that clearly communicate complex data findings to diverse audiences.
  • Coordinate and support cross-functional meetings and events, managing logistics and ensuring effective communication across teams.
  • Collaborate closely with Operations Managers, Manufacturing and Quality Engineering teams, and Program Management Leadership to align financial analysis with operational goals and program objectives.
  • Ability to obtain Secret Security Clearance.


Qualifications:

  • Requires practical knowledge of job area. Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.


Preferred Additional Skills:

  • Experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) and applying EVM principles to track project cost, schedule, and performance metrics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data modeling, with demonstrated ability to design clear and compelling tables, graphs, and charts for business reporting.
  • Proficient in Power BI, including building and maintaining interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations; experience connecting and transforming data sources, using DAX formulas, and delivering actionable insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proficient in relational database tools such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft SQL Server, with experience writing complex queries, manipulating large datasets, and optimizing data pipelines for reporting and analysis.
  • Experience developing Excel Macros and VBA automation to streamline repetitive processes and improve reporting efficiency.
  • Experience writing technical proposals and Basis of Estimates (BOEs), including cost narratives and supporting data analysis.
  • Strong ability to manage and prioritize multiple assignments simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • High attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.

descriptionHtml:
Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? Well, we pump peanut butter into your jar, and the oil in your car. We glue the soles of your shoes, the glass in your windows and the screen on your phone. We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life.

The Business Intelligence Analyst plays a key role in supporting data-driven strategies, operational efficiency, and data visualization at Graco. With a foundational understanding of analytics and business intelligence, this role works works across Operations & Supply Chain and other departments to assist in the development and execution of a Business Intelligence (BI) roadmap. The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in data analytics and a desire to grow their skills in providing insights that support strategic and operational decisions.

What You Will Do At Graco

Data Analysis, Reporting, and Strategy Support

  • Work with operations & supply chain , finance, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to create and standardize financial and operational reports, ensuring they align with key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Assist in building and maintaining dashboards that offer insights into financial and operational performance, trends, and forecasts.
  • Perform data analysis to transform datasets into useful information that supports decision-making.
  • Provide data summaries and reports to support finance and leadership teams in making informed decisions.
  • Use business intelligence tools (such as Power BI and SQL) to organize, analyze, and visualize data, promoting data-driven decision-making.
  • Help in the development of solutions to improve forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis processes.
  • Support the integration of data from financial systems like Oracle ERP, OneStream, and other data sources.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects that involve data analysis, reporting, and data visualization.
  • Contribute to the creation of clear process documentation to improve the efficiency and usability of reporting tools.

Process Improvement and Automation Assistance

  • Identify opportunities for improving data reporting processes and support the implementation of solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Learn and adopt new data technologies and tools to help leverage data more effectively for decision-making.
  • Assist in managing ad hoc projects and initiatives that aim to improve reporting and analytics capabilities.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Work closely with operations & supply chain , finance teams, IT, and other departments to help integrate financial data systems smoothly.
  • Present data insights and findings to team members in a clear and concise manner, using data visualization techniques.
  • Serve as a link between supply chain and technology teams, ensuring data solutions support business goals.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy and support project execution.

What You Bring To Graco

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, data science, business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or financial analysis.
  • Ability to interpret data and identify trends to support business decisions.
  • Strong focus on accuracy and the ability to manage multiple data sources.
  • Basic knowledge of financial and business operations with a desire to learn more.
  • Ability to work effectively across different departments.
  • Willingness to learn and apply problem-solving techniques to improve data processes.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI and SQL, with a willingness to learn more advanced tools.
  • Ability to present data insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Basic proficiency in Power BI, SQL, Excel, or similar tools.
  • Understanding of data visualization techniques and financial reporting basics.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with a desire to learn and grow in the field of data analytics.

Accelerators

  • Global industrial manufacturing experience and knowledge.
  • MBA or Master’s degree preferred

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., H-1B, TN, F-1 OPT).

At Graco, you truly make a difference. Your unique talents contribute to our organizational growth and future. Not only do you make a difference, but Graco’s culture empowers employees to create their own career path. Whether you choose to advance within your current department or explore new opportunities in different divisions, you have the ability to build your future. Our managers are here to provide support and guidance as you continue to grow within your career.

Graco has excellent opportunities available to individuals who want to be part of a fast-moving, growing company that is committed to quality, innovation and solving fluid handling problems for our customers. Graco is proud to be named a Best Place to Work by Fortune Magazine in 2016, 2018, 2019, 2021 & 2022. Graco offers attractive compensation, benefits and career development opportunities. descriptionHtml:
Job Description

The Data Analyst will work with financial and operational datasets to assess performance, monitor cost drivers and provide analysis that supports planning and resource allocation. The position combines quantitative analysis, reporting and collaboration with business teams to explain variances, evaluate trends and identify opportunities for improvement.

A key part of the role will involve comparing actual results with budgets, forecasts and operational targets. The analyst will investigate unexpected movements, improve the consistency of management reporting and translate analytical findings into practical insights for stakeholders responsible for financial planning and day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse operational expenditure, resource utilisation and productivity metrics to identify significant changes in performance.
  • Compare actual business results against budgets, forecasts and agreed performance targets.
  • Investigate cost variances and identify the operational factors that may explain them.
  • Develop recurring reports to monitor expenditure, efficiency and resource allocation.
  • Build dashboards that provide stakeholders with clear visibility of financial and operational indicators.
  • Use SQL to extract, combine and analyse data from relevant business systems.
  • Apply Excel-based modelling and analytical techniques to support planning and performance reviews.
  • Work with finance and operations teams to validate figures and clarify differences between reporting sources.
  • Identify recurring inefficiencies, unusual cost patterns and opportunities for further investigation.
  • Prepare concise analytical summaries and recommendations for business managers.
  • Improve reporting processes by standardising calculations, documentation and performance definitions.
  • Support forecasting and scenario analysis by preparing datasets and evaluating historical trends.

Requirements

  • A degree in Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, Statistics or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
  • Previous experience in data analysis, financial analysis, management reporting, operations analytics or a similar role.
  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, data validation and analytical modelling.
  • Practical SQL skills for extracting and analysing structured business data.
  • Experience with a business intelligence platform such as Power BI, Tableau or a comparable reporting tool.
  • Understanding of budgets, forecasts, cost variances and key performance indicators.
  • Ability to work with large datasets, identify inconsistencies and validate analytical outputs.
  • Strong numerical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to present findings clearly and explain analytical conclusions to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Good organisational skills and attention to detail when preparing reports and supporting business reviews.
  • Familiarity with financial planning systems, ERP platforms or management accounting processes is an advantage.
  • Experience with Python, R or other analytical tools is an advantage.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

descriptionHtml:
The Business Data Analyst I role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. The position also requires 10-15% local travel to other sites.

The Business Data Analyst I role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to turn data into decisions that drive real impact in the supply chain world? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Business Data Analyst I who thrives on solving complex problems, creating powerful visualizations, and delivering actionable insights. This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. If you're passionate about analytics, innovation, and making a difference, this role is for you. If you're a curious, self-driven problem solver with a passion for analytics, innovation, and impact—this role is for you!

Job Description

As a Business Data Analyst I, you will play a key role in transforming operational data into strategic insights that identify opportunities, improve performance, and reduce costs. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build reports, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. This role is ideal for someone with foundational analytics experience who is ready to take ownership of projects and grow into a trusted resource for data solutions.


  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Collaborate with site and sector leadership to identify opportunities for efficiency and cost reduction
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through presentations and reports for internal and customer use
  • Ability to leverage data from various systems that support our operations (Warehouse Management System, Timekeeping systems, etc.)
  • Manage analytics projects independently, from concept to delivery
  • Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and support


Required Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 1+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Hands-on experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
  • Experience writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts and data modeling techniques, preferred
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, preferred
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines, required
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required


Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

Established in 1998 at Indiana University (IU), GlobalNOC's mission is to advance the future of research, education, and the public interest through the support and evolution of networks. With more than 120 staff members, GlobalNOC provides comprehensive contracted network management services to over 20 large-scale networks. As part of Indiana University, GlobalNOC operates as a non-profit and focuses on developing great technical staff and providing excellent service to our clients.

The GlobalNOC Business Operations team has an exciting role providing support for GlobalNOC services deployed for client organizations across the nation and their connections around the globe. GlobalNOC Specializes in 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year management of complex higher education and government research networks, using some of the most advanced networking technology available, you will have room to grow in your career as a network professional at GlobalNOC.

Department-Specific Responsibilities

  • Maintains and expands the process of constructing and updating Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for GlobalNOC's client networks, including, maintenance and development of relevant metrics and visualizations, coordination with customer relationship managers (CRMs) and other internal staff to verify data accuracy/integrity and identify key data insights, and construction of finalized slide decks to be shared with client network stakeholders.
  • Consistently communicates with managers and stakeholders to understand the business needs of GlobalNOC and its clients.
  • Maintains the existing and develops new Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and other metrics that adapt to the evolving needs of GlobalNOC and its clients.
  • Fulfills ad-hoc performance metric reporting requests from internal staff and external clients. Intakes requests, develops action items, and submits reports through the request cycle.
  • Documents and maintains the metrics and reporting processes and procedures to ensure continuity of support.

General Responsibilities

  • Provides analysis of existing data and data structures and satisfies ad-hoc reporting/analysis requests.
  • Creates reporting specifications for new reports/dashboards/analytical tools and assists in testing/validation; ensures integrity, accessibility, and accuracy of reports/dashboards and data structures; reviews and approves user requests for access to reporting data and tools.
  • Consults with faculty and/or staff to identify new business reporting needs and provides guidance and interpretation of complex environments and data.
  • Documents data analysis efforts (data sources, reporting specifications, tools, issue/problem resolutions).
  • Researches and stays up to date on emerging technologies and data analysis tools.

Combinations of related education and experience may be considered. Education beyond the minimum required may be substituted for work experience. Work experience beyond the minimum required may be substituted for education.

Preferred

  • Some experience in data analysis/reporting or a related field.

Skills

  • Maintains a high degree of professionalism.
  • Demonstrates time management and priority setting skills.
  • Demonstrates a high commitment to quality.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
  • Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty.

  • Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools, especially Tableau and R.
  • Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions, such as ServiceNow.
  • Experience with SmartSheets.
  • Experience with data collection and translation, such as Structured Query Language (SQL).

This role requires the ability to effectively communicate and to operate a computer and other standard office productivity equipment. The position involves sedentary work as well as periods of time moving around an office environment and the campus. The person in this role must be able to perform the essential functions with or without an accommodation.

Federal background checks and/or nondisclosure agreements on behalf of the GlobalNOC's customer base may be required to fulfill employment requirements.

With the more than 20 networks we operate and manage, and the size and variance of our client networks, the person in this position won't be pigeon-holed doing just 1 thing. Department: MED-Pulmonary

Salary/Grade: EXS/8

Job Summary

Provides expertise in data management, quality assurance, analysis and reporting. Establishes data accuracy and validity derived from a variety of systems. Performs data analysis using statistical techniques. Researches and analyzes information using multiple databases and creates reports of data and results. Assists in the preparation and delivery of decision support reports to both internal and external customers.

Specific Responsibilities

Strategic Planning

  • Partners with clients to define requirements based on business objectives.

Administration

  • Develop standardized templates, policies, and procedures for internal and external reporting.
  • Designs and prepares documentation for qualitative and quantitative data analysis.
  • Discuss findings with senior management

Development

  • Develop queries and quality metrics.
  • Interprets results using a variety of techniques, ranging from simple data aggregation to more complex statistical analysis.
  • Manages complex databases.

Performance

  • Completes data cleaning and organizes data files for analysis.
  • Reviews data and identifies quality issues.
  • Presents findings in an appropriate manner.

Supervises

  • Provides work direction and/or supervises staff such as team members, subordinates, contractors, vendors, students, etc.

Miscellaneous

Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree; OR appropriate combination of education and experience.
  • 2 years data analysis/report writing or similar experience required.

Infrastructure

  • Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • High Performance Computing (HPC)
  • Linux Operating System
  • Mac OS X Operating System
  • Microsoft Exchange
  • Microsoft Lync
  • Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Access, Outlook)
  • Microsoft SharePoint
  • SQL/MySQL/Postgres
  • Other: Microsoft Azure; OpenAI Codex

Programming Languages and Frameworks

  • JavaScript
  • Python
  • Shell Scripting

Analytical

  • critical thinking
  • data mining
  • data modeling
  • database design/ data structure
  • Debugging
  • decision making
  • judgment
  • metadata creation and management
  • problem solving

Project

  • agile environment
  • Code documentation
  • collaboration and teamwork
  • facilitate collaboration
  • functional documentation
  • iterative & incremental development
  • organizational skills
  • planning
  • Scrum project framework
  • workflow development & documentation
  • write proposals and project charters

Preferred Competencies: (Skills, knowledge, and abilities)

  • Action oriented - Willing or likely to take practical action to deal with a problem or situation.
  • Coachability - Receptive to feedback, willing to learn, embracing continuous improvement.
  • Collaboration - Facilitates open and effective communication, cooperation and teamwork within and outside of one's own team.
  • Collegiality - Helpful, respectful, approachable; builds strong working relationships and a positive work environment.
  • Initiative - Exhibits energy and desire to achieve; sets ambitious goals and acts decisively; takes action that no one has requested to improve or enhance job results and avoid problems.
  • Meets deadlines - Displays consistency and success in adhering to deadlines.
  • Multi-tasking - Demonstrates ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Organization - Plans, organizes and schedules in an efficient, productive manner; anticipates contingencies and pays attention to detail.

Target hiring range for this position will be between $70,020 - $90,260 per year. Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

companyDescription:
Our story began on December 27, 1972, when our Founder and Chairman, Nathan S. Collier, purchased a modest single duplex in Gainesville, Florida. He then continued to steadily expand his real estate portfolio, acquiring three or four properties each year, championing the entrepreneurial energy that is integral to our company’s success.

By January of 1980, Collier had earned a strong reputation along with the trust of local investors and lenders. His portfolio grew to 25 homes in College Park, a neighborhood just north of The University of Florida.

Since our humble beginnings, our company’s intuition and ambition have allowed us to reach many more landmark achievements. Now known as The Collier Companies, our organization adopted the principles of The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People as the cornerstone of our company’s culture. These tenets became deeply woven into our corporate culture, inspiring us to rebrand our properties in College Park with the name ‘Paradigm Properties’. This would serve us as a poignant, lasting reminder to view the world with a strong sense of awareness and insight.

Today, The Collier Companies stands as the largest provider of student housing owned by a private individual in the nation.  Our portfolio comprises over 12,000 apartment homes in the Southeast region of the United States, continuing to grow and expand. We’ve set our sights on success with an aggressive initiative to double our number of apartment homes over the next decade. We credit our legacy to our deep-rooted company culture and a dedicated team of people who are unified by their entrepreneurial spirit and love of learning.

descriptionHtml:
The Collier Companies is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team!

This is an on-site role, reporting from one of The Collier Companies’ Home Office in Gainesville, which offers beautiful natural areas, a temperate climate, and tremendous educational, cultural, and commercial opportunities. Gainesville was recently ranked as one of the top 10 places to live in the United States.

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst with expertise in Power BI to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights, creating interactive dashboards, and supporting strategic decision-making processes. This role requires a blend of technical proficiency, analytical skills, and business acumen. The successful candidate will work closely with executive-level team members, providing them with critical data insights to drive high-level business strategies.

Perks – The Good Stuff

  • The Collier Companies 401k match is 100% of your contribution up to 10% of your gross income.
  • Up to 24 days off during your first year with an annual increase!
  • Stylish TCC logo attire provided.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental & vision insurance.
  • Group & supplemental life insurance policy options.
  • Healthcare reimbursement account & legal services insurance.
  • Career growth opportunities.
  • Industry education opportunities.

Qualifications

Your Skills – Show Us What You Got:

  • Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI or related data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau or similar).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with database management.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong experience with DAX, Power Query M, and SQL.
  • Strong experience creating dashboards and reports with Power BI and Power BI Paginated Reports.
  • Strong experience with SQL Server Management Studio.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Knowledge with SSIS/SSRS packages, Data Factory and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with API development and management.
  • Working knowledge of git and GitHub in a team setting.
  • Experience with programming languages such as Python or C.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and data modeling techniques.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Data Collection and Analysis: Gather, clean, and analyze data from various sources to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
  • Dashboard Development: Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports to visualize key metrics and business performance.
  • Data Modeling: Create and manage data models using Power BI, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and provide analytical support.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Validate data quality, identify inconsistencies, and implement data cleansing processes.
  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members on the effective use of Power BI tools and techniques.
  • Documentation: Document data analysis processes, methodologies, and findings for future reference.

Our Culture – How We’re Different

The Collier Companies is a fast-growing company that fosters a professional attitude and a strong team spirit. We are committed to training our teams well, honoring their achievements, and promoting from within. Our team is highly focused on both personal and professional growth, building a strong relationship with our residents, and creating an environment that each of our residents can call home.

  • At The Collier Companies, we recognize TEAM MEMBERS for being the foundation of our success which aligns with our internal mission statement PROUDLY SUPPORTING OUR TEAM MEMBERS IN BECOMING THEIR BEST SELVES.
  • Our external mission is PROUDLY MAKING YOUR HOME THE HEART OF OUR BUSINESS.
  • We are good STEWARDS to each other, believe in collaboration and support one another to achieve our missions.
  • We PRIDE ourselves on working and growing with the principles taught in “The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People”, written by Stephen Covey.
  • The Collier Companies Team Members are committed to CANI (Constant & Never-Ending Improvement) & to utilizing our I&R (Initiative & Resourcefulness) to find solutions that are BOTH E&E (Efficient & Effective) that we implement via IIT (I Intend To ____)
  • We are committed to ONGOING LEARNING – At The Collier Companies & sponsor book clubs, training, and mentorship to support the professional and personal growth of our team.
  • We also have our internal learning program called Collier College that is based on the structure and teachings from the Nathan Collier Master of Science in Real Estate program at the University of Florida.
  • GROWTH – We have a goal to double in size within the coming decade! Our team members have a FIRE IN THE BELLY and hold the torch with a BURNING SENSE OF URGENCY!
  • We bring STABILITY into the marketplace and to our residents with a LONG-TERM HOLD strategy. This benefits our human capital, finances, and customer experience.
  • ROOTED – We are privately owned and have been in business since the 1970’s. We currently own and manage over 12,000 apartment homes and we’re pacing over 1,000 new apartment home construction starts each year.

At The Collier Companies, it is all about people. Our Residents depend on us to be observant, interested in their lives, and quick to respond to their needs. We enjoy working with them and with each other. Every day is different: rewarding, challenging, and fun. When someone lives in one of our communities, they are entrusting us with providing their Home, something fundamental to their emotional, spiritual, and physical well-being and we consider that both a wonderful Honor and a significant Duty that we are passionate about. We ask all that join us to commit to doing likewise.

PROUDLY MAKING YOUR HOME THE HEART OF OUR BUSINESS WHILE SUPPORTING TEAM MEMBERS TO BECOME THEIR BEST SELVES

Background checks are an employment requirement. Upon submission of your application, you will be invited to complete our candidate assessment.

These Are Required Steps In The Hiring Process.

The Collier Companies is an Equal Opportunity Employer

What You Will Do

The Data Analyst will:

  • Collect, organize, and analyze data from multiple operational and business systems.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, charts, and visualizations to support decision-making.
  • Perform routine data validation, quality checks, and data preparation activities.
  • Support performance measurement and readiness reporting activities.
  • Assist senior analysts and project leads in executing analytical tasks.
  • Develop presentations and analytical products for stakeholders.
  • Document findings, methodologies, and recommendations.

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform applications.

Welcome to Waverly Advisors, LLC—simplifying the complexities of wealth management and financial planning since 1999. Our passion drives us, integrity guides us, and earning your trust is central to our mission.

For more than two decades, we’ve helped clients navigate the sophisticated needs that come with wealth. With 290+ team members in offices across the U.S., we provide comprehensive services rooted in strong personal relationships, disciplined strategies, and independent advice.

As a fee-only, federally registered investment advisory firm, we serve high-net-worth individuals and families, corporate retirement plans, trusts, endowments, and institutions—managing over $17.3 billion in assets. Our retirement plan services include plan design, consulting, and investment oversight, operating as an ERISA 3(38) fiduciary.

At Waverly, we listen. We take time to understand your goals, then build tailored strategies designed to support your life, family, and future. You don’t work with just one advisor—you gain a full team of specialists with deep technical knowledge and a shared commitment to your best interest.

Our fiduciary standard means we are bound by the duties of care and loyalty—always putting your needs first. We recognize that every wealth journey is different, and our advice evolves with yours.

While expertise is essential, what sets us apart is empathy. Our team brings curiosity, care, and long-term perspective to every relationship—helping you move forward with clarity and confidence.

Investment advisory services are offered by Waverly Advisors, LLC, ("Waverly"), an investment adviser registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

descriptionHtml:
Waverly Advisors’ primary goal is to serve our clients, one another, and our communities. We aren’t your typical wealth management firm. Our intense client focus is at the center of everything we do. We go far beyond just managing our clients’ investments, offering truly in-depth financial planning. We set ourselves apart by actually living and acting on our guiding principle, ‘Serve.’ It is the reason we go to work every day.  

In this role, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds our guiding principle and drives Waverly Advisors forward. We hope you’ll grow as a person and leader in your field and transform those around you as well.   

We are looking to add a Reporting Analyst to our team in our Seattle office. As a Reporting Analyst, your key focus is on preparing accurate and timely reports for institutional clients by compiling disparate data sources into a cohesive structure. This role requires a high level of precision and thoroughness. Successful candidates will exhibit a willingness to learn new skills and collaborate with team members to achieve client service standards.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the quarterly reporting cycle, including collecting, requesting, and tracking data from vendor partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare book-wide investment performance calculations and ensure data is accurate, complete, and reconciled.
  • Develop and distribute quarterly participant education materials and other client-facing reporting.
  • Prepare, finalize, and distribute quarterly client reviews, ensuring materials are accurate and delivered on schedule.
  • Gather updated performance and balance information and prepare ad-hoc analyses to support client meetings, including fee reviews, plan design analyses, and participant reviews.
  • Document client meeting notes, action items, and deliverables and coordinate follow-throughs to ensure timely completion.
  • Complete post-meeting client deliverables and ongoing reporting needs while maintaining accurate and organized records.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and automate recurring reporting processes and reconcile records as needed.
  • Support long-term, non-cyclical projects and initiatives that improve reporting, client service, and operational efficiency.
  • Research relevant industry trends, regulatory and legislative developments, and other applicable topics to inform client service and prepare for upcoming quarterly reporting cycles.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, required.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in an analytical capacity. Experience in an RIA/Broker Dealer is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Excel, Morningstar Direct, Adobe Acrobat, PowerApps & Dataverse, preferred.
  • Experience with a portfolio management system. Tamarac or Orion is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent written and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong mathematical/quantitative skills.
  • A high level of personal initiative and willingness to assist other team members.

Travel: 

  • Minimal travel is required. 

Physical Requirements: 

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times. 
  • Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities. 

Benefits:  

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage to support your overall well‑being. 
  • 401(k) retirement plan with match and profit sharing to help you invest in your future. 
  • Twelve paid holidays each year. 
  • An extra vacation day during your birthday week—so you can celebrate you! 
  • Responsible Time Off Policy giving flexibility without annual PTO limits, while balancing team responsibilities and business needs.   
  • Paid sabbatical program: Enjoy four consecutive weeks of paid time off after seven years of service.  
  • Compensation commensurate with experience. 

Salary: $65,000-$80,000

Legal:  

Waverly Advisors, LLC. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender, genetic information, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Koch Ag & Energy Solutions (KAES) is a global leader in delivering innovative solutions for the agriculture, energy and chemical industries. Through our diverse portfolio, we empower farmers, fuel industries and provide critical resources for manufacturing products used in daily life.

Koch Agronomic Services provides crop performance technologies for farmers worldwide. It is committed to stewardship, improving yields and meeting growing agricultural demands. 

Koch Fertilizer produces, markets and distributes more than 12 million tons of fertilizer products annually, meeting worldwide demands through a network of state-of-the-art global facilities. 

Koch Methanol produces and supplies methanol, a key component in fuels, industrial materials and other essential products used globally, to support industries around the world.

Koch Energy Services delivers reliable natural gas to meet the growing energy needs of industries worldwide.

At KAES, we are committed to growth, innovation and operational excellence. Our mission is to enhance agricultural productivity, deliver essential energy solutions and develop value-added products that support our communities and a growing global population.

Join us at KAES and be part of a company that makes a real impact. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more about how we empower people and industries to thrive at https://kochagenergy.com.
descriptionHtml:
Your Job

Koch Ag & Energy Solutions (KAES) is seeking a Project Analyst to partner with Turnaround and Project teams across the KAES fleet to help teams use data and analytics to make better, faster decisions.

This role will work closely with internal customers to understand business needs, identify opportunities to improve how information is used, and translate complex project and turnaround data into clear, actionable insights. The successful candidate will build trusted relationships across the organization, collaborate with a variety of stakeholders, and influence the adoption of consistent data and analytics practices.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who is curious, comfortable working through ambiguity, and motivated by solving business problems through data, relationships, and continuous improvement.

This role will be located at our main campus in Wichita, Kansas.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with Project, Turnaround, and other business teams to understand their needs, challenges, and decision-making processes
  • Translate business questions and complex data into meaningful insights, reports, and analytics that support decision-making
  • Build strong relationships with internal customers and become a trusted partner in identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Collaborate across teams to develop consistent metrics, reporting practices, and definitions for project and turnaround data
  • Develop and improve dashboards and reporting solutions that make information easier to understand and act upon
  • Influence stakeholders to adopt common data practices, reporting approaches, and analytical solutions
  • Facilitate conversations across teams to create alignment when priorities, processes, or data needs differ
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve reporting, and increase the value teams receive from their data
  • Partner with IT and data teams when technical support or scalable solutions are needed
  • Experiment with new analytical approaches and tools that can improve how teams work and make decisions


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Degree in a Business, Analytics, Engineering, Technical, or related field, or relevant professional experience in lieu of a degree
  • Experience using data, reporting, or analytics to help solve business problems or support decision-making
  • Experience collaborating with customers or cross-functional stakeholders to understand needs and develop solutions
  • Experience communicating information, recommendations, or insights to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge
  • Experience building relationships and influencing change or adoption without relying on direct authority
  • Experience managing multiple priorities and determining where your work can create the most value


What Will Put You Ahead

  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, visualizations, or other analytical tools used to support business decisions
  • Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Alteryx, or similar platforms
  • Experience working with project, turnaround, maintenance, operations, industrial, or construction teams
  • Experience facilitating conversations with customers to define problems, identify opportunities, and translate needs into analytical solutions
  • Experience improving or standardizing business processes, metrics, or reporting
  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, data modeling, or similar analytical techniques


This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch Company, Koch Ag & Energy Solutions (KAES) is a global provider of value-added solutions for the agriculture, turf and ornamental, energy and chemical markets. From agriculture to energy, KAES makes things grow better with plant nutrient and biological technologies. Our team of innovators unleash their potential while developing the technologies that feed and power the world.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. descriptionHtml:
We value: Safety,Integrity,Ownership,Collaboration,Service,Sustainability

Moses Lake Industries, Inc. (MLI) is a rapidly growing producer of ultra-pure chemical products, serving the semiconductor and flat-panel screen industries worldwide. We deliver world class products to the leaders of the industries we serve.

You will be working for a midsized company with great people and a history of steady growth and profitability. Sound like a match? If you are prepared to work in an exciting and rewarding environment, we look forward to considering your experience and qualifications.

Shift/Hours/Location: M-F, 8am-5pm, Hybrid/Onsite, Moses Lake

What You Will Be Working On

  • Assists in the generation and maintenance of statistical data for internal and external customers.
  • Prepares statistical reports, dashboards, and trend charts for internal/external customers.
  • Provide explanations, interpretations, and recommendations based on data analysis.
  • Communicates as directed with internal/external customers on reports, issues, and requests.
  • Gather data from internal/external suppliers/customers for various internal/external reports.
  • Generate and distribute routine and ad hoc internal and external reports as directed.
  • Analyze data and trends to identify key insights and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support decision making through accurate and timely reporting of metrics.
  • Maintain quality records and ensure documentation is accurate, complete, and up to date.
  • Support compliance with record retention and quality management requirements.
  • Uphold all MLI policies and "MLI Code of Conduct".
  • Strict compliance with Environmental and Safety regulations.
  • Compliance and individual accountability with the Quality System and ISO Registration is required.
  • Performs other related duties as directed as this list is not all inclusive.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Mathematics or related field. Or a minimum of 3 years of equivalent experience.
  • Working knowledge of computers and MS Office software.
  • Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Working knowledge of arithmetic and grammar.
  • Demonstrated ability to:
  • Follow written and verbal instructions in English.
  • Manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously in order to meet established deadlines.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
  • Work as a team and/or independently.
  • Perform tasks with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of NWA and JMP statistical analysis software.

Salary & Benefits

Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary pay range: $28.32 to $36.06 /hour.

Located in central Washington, an outdoor recreational oasis, we offer the following benefits: compensation, medical, vision, and dental insurance benefits.

  • You can work in an environment where teamwork is encouraged and where you have the opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Generous PTO: Your time off is important
  • Medical/Dental/Vision: Majority of premiums paid by MLI. Includes virtual medical and mental health options.
  • Additional Health Coverage: FSA and HSA available. Voluntary insurance options include life and AD&D, accident, hospitalization, and critical illness.
  • Earn More: We offer a generous discretionary bonus program in addition to salary/wage.
  • 401 (K) Savings Plan: Jump start your retirement with MLI’s employer matching contributions.
  • Company – Paid Benefits: Long-Term Disability Insurance, EAP, Fitness Club Membership Program, & Education Assistance Program.
  • Additional Benefits: We provide position-based clothing, travel expenses, training and relocation assistance available.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The Production Analyst III is responsible for independently analyzing, validating, and maintaining daily and monthly production reports. This role may require filing monthly regulatory forms for oil, gas, and fresh /saltwater systems and serving as a primary point of contact with third-party representatives to resolve issues and ensure the accuracy of volumetric data. In addition, the Production Analyst III is expected to proactively identify, and recommend process improvements, lead approved improvements and uphold process governance, controls, and documentation standards for the team.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced technical support to managers and engineers in all stages of development, analysis and presentation of data using advanced knowledge of spreadsheets, databases, and other software.
  • Independently develop and deliver high-quality reports and presentations for departmental and management use.
  • Perform and interpret trend analysis; proactively investigate variances and anomalies and communicate root causes and recommended actions.
  • Design, build, and maintain queries in various software and generate reports as needed; serve as a resource to other analysts on query and reporting tools.
  • Import/maintain production data (oil/gas/water), independently completing daily and monthly tasks with validations and following up on outstanding items through resolution.
  • Provide production data and reports in conjunction with company policies and procedures; ensure adherence to process controls and keep job-function documentation and procedures current with the latest knowledge.
  • Verify, manipulate, analyze, and report data across various databases and software applications, and independently make supported corrections with established controls.
  • Prepare, analyze, and validate monthly gas and oil data from reporting services to provide accurate data to other Business Units and regulatory agencies, resolving discrepancies prior to submission.
  • Lead the review of daily new wells data and production and partner with field offices to ensure the accuracy of delivery systems and allocation.
  • Generate reports and provide information to internal clients and regulatory agencies as needed, serving as a point of contact for complex or escalated requests.
  • Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements and automation opportunities; evaluate impacts to controls and documentation before changes are adopted.
  • Train, mentor, and serve as a resource for team members as assigned.
  • Support internal control and audit requests by ensuring work is documented, reviewed, and reproducible.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantitative subjects such as Mathematics, Computer Science, Accounting or Finance.
  • Six (6+) years of industry experience in production reporting, production accounting, data analysis, or a related oil and gas function.
  • Six (6+) years of advanced Excel experience, creating and configuring complex lookups (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH), Pivot Tables, formulas and charts.
  • Advanced ability to perform data mining and reconcile data across multiple platforms.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues to internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum Three (3+) years of experience using ProCount, Carte, eVIn, Spotfire, and SAP.
  • Experience within the oil and gas industry.
  • Thorough knowledge of production accounting, allocation, and state regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Advanced knowledge of field flows, measurement, and allocation methodologies.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or other query/automation tools.
  • Experience developing process documentation, controls, or workflow improvements.

Relocation:

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Work Authorization

Diamondback Energy is not currently sponsoring employment visas for this position.

Diamondback is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Diamondback provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, veteran or disability status, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other status protected by law. Diamondback participates in E-Verify. Learn more about E-Verify.

Overview:

The Business Analyst Payer Escalations is responsible for designing, producing, and analyzing data-driven reports to support business operations and special projects. This role involves utilizing various databases, information systems, and analytical tools to monitor, evaluate, and enhance business performance. The Business Analyst also assists in the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of information systems, ensuring data accuracy, accessibility, and usability for decision-making. This role is ideal for an analytically minded professional who enjoys working with data, optimizing reporting systems, and supporting business decision-making through actionable insights.

The Business Analyst is responsible for designing and generating reports, dashboards, and visualizations for business operations. Analyzing trends, patterns, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide actionable insights and maintaining data integrity, accuracy, and consistency in reporting.

The incumbent must be able to utilize SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics tools to extract and manipulate data; conduct statistical analysis to support data-driven decision-making and translate complex data into concise, easy-to-understand reports for stakeholders.

The Business Analyst must be able to assist in the development, implementation, and optimization of business information systems; maintain data structures, queries, and reporting tools to support business needs; and work closely with IT teams to ensure data availability and system functionality. In addition, the incumbent will be responsible for: documenting business processes, data sources, and reporting methodologies, identifying inefficiencies and opportunities for process improvement, providing recommendations for enhancing data collection, storage, and analysis methods while working closely with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and IT to understand reporting needs.

Experience working with large datasets and multiple databases.

Knowledge of business intelligence (BI) tools, SQL querying, and reporting software.

3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, data reporting, or analytics.

Education

  • Bachelor's level degree (Required)


Certification/Licensure

  • No specific certification or licensure requirements


Experience

  • Experience working with Large Datasets and Multiple Databases
  • Knowledge of BI Tools, SQL, querying and reporting software
  • 3 + years relevant experience in business analysis, data reporting or analytics


We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, and benefits. The base pay range for full-time employment is $76,086.40 - $115,585.60 annually. Additional compensation may be available for this role, such as shift differentials, on-call pay, shift premiums, extra-shift incentives, or bonus opportunities. Compensation within the range may vary based on qualifications, experience, location, market conditions, and business needs.   • Paid Time Off and Sick Leave

  • Tuition Assistance – $5,250/year and discounted educational opportunities through Guild Education
  • Student Debt Pay Down – $10,000
