Stord is the physical intelligence layer for independent commerce, giving brands the fulfillment network, software, AI, and robotics they need to own the entire relationship with their customer, from checkout to delivery to returns.

Prime reset what consumers expect from delivery, and every brand competing against it pays with margin, data, and the relationship with their own customer. Stord Labs, our physical intelligence lab in Atlanta, builds and tests AI and robotics on live orders before rolling proven systems out across the full network. The result is intelligence that compounds with every order that runs through it.

The physical intelligence layer for independent commerce is here.

This is a place for people who want to work at the edge of commerce and applied AI on real, physical problems, not simulations. About Stord

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

We are looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Strategy team and partner closely with senior leadership. This person will own the reporting, dashboards, and analysis that help our executive team make better decisions and communicate the performance of the business to our Board of Directors, investors, and internal leadership.

This is not a traditional reporting role. You will be responsible for taking complex business questions, finding the right data, turning it into clear insights, and building scalable reporting that can be used repeatedly across the organization.

You will work closely with Strategy, Finance, and senior leadership, with significant exposure to the executive team.

BI Analyst, Office of the President

About The Role

We are looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Strategy team and partner closely with senior leadership. This person will own the reporting, dashboards, and analysis that help our executive team make better decisions and communicate the performance of the business to our Board of Directors, investors, and internal leadership.

This is not a traditional reporting role. You will be responsible for taking complex business questions, finding the right data, turning it into clear insights, and building scalable reporting that can be used repeatedly across the organization.

You will work closely with Strategy, Finance, and senior leadership, with significant exposure to the executive team.

What You'll Do

Executive, Board & Investor Reporting

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting used for Board of Directors meetings, investor materials, executive reviews, and leadership meetings
  • Own the underlying data and analysis behind key company metrics
  • Partner with Strategy and Finance to prepare recurring reporting and investor materials
  • Translate complex business performance into clear, executive-ready insights and visualizations
  • Quickly investigate changes in performance and identify the key drivers behind the numbers

Business & Financial Reporting

  • Build recurring reporting around revenue, margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, headcount, sales, customer performance, and other key business metrics
  • Support actuals vs. budget vs. forecast reporting
  • Partner with Finance to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and aligned with financial statements and company planning
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and reduce reliance on spreadsheets and one-off analyses

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Build and own executive dashboards that provide a clear view of company performance
  • Develop dashboards and reporting for internal leadership meetings across areas such as Sales, Operations, CX, Finance, and People
  • Establish consistent KPI definitions and create a single source of truth for critical business metrics
  • Improve the way leaders access and consume data across the organization

Data & Analytics

  • Pull, analyze, and reconcile data across multiple systems and data sources
  • Strong SQL proficiency and Semantic data layer experience
  • Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to resolve them
  • Turn ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
  • Build repeatable processes and automated reporting wherever possible

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, strategic finance, FP&A, or a similar analytical role
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large or complex datasets
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a similar BI platform
  • Strong understanding of financial and operational metrics
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and take an ambiguous question from idea → analysis → executive-ready output
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex data clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

You'd Be Especially Strong If You Have

  • Experience supporting a CEO, CFO, Strategy team, or executive leadership team
  • Experience with Board or investor reporting
  • Experience in FP&A or financial reporting
  • Experience in a high-growth technology, logistics, e-commerce, or SaaS company
  • Experience working with data warehouses and modern data stacks
  • Experience automating recurring reporting
  • Python or other analytical programming experience
  • A strong understanding of how financial, operational, and commercial metrics connect

What Success Looks Like

You will become the person the Strategy and executive teams rely on to answer questions like:

  • How is the business performing?
  • What changed?
  • Why did it change?
  • What are the key drivers?
  • Are we on track against our plan?
  • What should leadership be paying attention to?

You'll build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make those answers accessible, accurate, and repeatable.

Most importantly, you'll help turn data into a competitive advantage for how we run the business.

About Houston Public Works (hpw)

Houston Public Works (HPW) plays a vital role in building, maintaining, and enhancing the infrastructure that keeps Houston moving and supports the quality of life of its residents, businesses, and communities. As one of the City of Houston’s largest departments, HPW is responsible for the planning, operation, maintenance, construction management, and technical engineering of the city’s essential public infrastructure.

With a workforce of approximately 4,900 employees, HPW oversees a broad and complex portfolio of critical services and assets, including water and wastewater systems, roadways, bridges, traffic and mobility systems, stormwater drainage, permitting, solid waste, and other infrastructure and public services. HPW is at the forefront of Houston’s continued growth and its efforts to build a more resilient, sustainable, and connected city. Through long-term planning, strategic investment, innovation, and responsible stewardship of public resources, the department works to ensure that Houston’s infrastructure can meet the needs of a growing and dynamic community.

With a commitment to excellence, accountability, and service, Houston Public Works helps lay the foundation for Houston’s future—delivering the infrastructure and essential services that enable the city to thrive today and for generations to come.

Description Of Duties/Essential Functions

Provides professional analytical, administrative, and management systems support to the Houston Public Works (HPW) Chief of Staff Office and senior leadership in monitoring organizational priorities. The position supports a range of high-priority initiatives and operational projects across the Director and Chief of Staff’s office. This includes analysis of operational data and decision-support reporting through the development and maintenance of datasets, contribution to Power BI dashboards, and preparation of reports to identify trends, track progress, and inform leadership decisions.

Responsibilities include coordinating with Houston Public Works divisions to collect and validate information, maintaining structured tracking of priority processes and initiatives, developing and maintaining datasets, dashboards, and reports to support leadership visibility and decision-making.

The role emphasizes translating data into actionable insights, tracking progress against key priorities, and identifying risks and opportunities for improvement.

The Staff Analyst also supports cross-functional projects, event coordination, and external partnership activities, contributes to process improvements and reporting standardization, and enhances workflow efficiency. This position works collaboratively with city departments to support aligned initiatives while maintaining a primary focus on operational tracking, reporting, and project execution for the Chief of Staff and Director’s offices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operational tracking and coordination: Maintains structured tracking of active initiatives and priority processes, including status, key milestones, and required actions; monitors timelines and follows up with divisions and stakeholders to ensure timely progress; provides regular status updates to the Director’s Office.
  • Data collection and analysis: Coordinates with divisions to gather, validate, and analyze operational data; identifies trends, risks, and performance gaps; prepares clear, actionable reports to support leadership decision-making and track progress against priorities.
  • Data QA/QC and dataset management: Performs quality assurance on datasets, including reconciliation of source data, validation of metric definitions, and documentation of assumptions and business rules to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Dashboard development and reporting: Develops, updates, and maintains dashboards and standardized reports that provide visibility into key initiatives, operational metrics, and performance trends; uses reporting tools to highlight bottlenecks and support executive-level decision-making.
  • Process documentation and improvement: Develops and maintains process documentation, trackers, templates, and reporting tools; identifies opportunities to improve data collection, reporting workflows, and coordination across teams.
  • Project and initiative support: Supports and may independently execute high-priority projects, including research, benchmarking, analysis, reporting, and coordination across divisions; contributes to workflow improvements and implementation of strategic initiatives.
  • Stakeholder and event coordination: Coordinates with internal divisions and external partners to support meetings, events, and collaborative initiatives; assists with logistics, tracking deliverables, and follow-up activities.
  • Confidential information: Handles sensitive and confidential information related to organizational priorities with discretion and appropriate controls.
  • Cross-departmental collaboration: Works with other city departments to support aligned initiatives, data coordination, and reporting needs.
  • Analytical and project support: Prepares summaries, briefings, and status reports for leadership; maintains organized documentation for projects and initiatives.
  • Analysis and recommendations: Investigates operational issues, evaluates current processes, and develops recommendations to improve performance, efficiency, and coordination.
  • Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Work is substantially complex and varied and requires interpretation of technical and detailed guidelines, policies, and procedures. Strong analytic ability is needed to gather, interpret and develop recommendations based on analysis of multiple factors. Some assignments may be non-routine and require the exercise of independent judgment under general guidance.

Essentially normal office environment; physically comfortable work with discretion about walking/standing; ability to make simple gross motor responses within large tolerances.

This is a Department of Houston Public Works position at the Tier III Level.

Minimum Requirements

EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS

Requires a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration or a field directly related to the type of work being performed.

Substitution: Graduate degrees related to the type of work to be performed may substitute for the experience requirement on a year-for-year basis.

Experience Requirements

Three (3) years of professional administrative, financial or analytical experience related to the type of work being performed are required.

Substitution: Professional experience related to the type of work to be performed may substitute for the education requirement on a year-for-year basis.

License Requirements

None

PREFERENCES

  • Demonstrated experience developing, report publishing, and maintaining Power BI dashboards.
  • Experience performing QA/QC on datasets, including reconciliation, anomaly detection and validation checks.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, Power Pivot, Power Query, formulas, data validation).
  • Experience contributing to KPI definitions, data dictionaries, standardized templates, and/or process documentation to support consistent reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Experience coordinating projects across multiple stakeholders and supporting external partnerships (universities, community colleges, trade schools, workforce organizations).
  • Demonstrated initiative and proactive problem-solving skills, including the ability to independently identify emerging issues, conduct research and analysis, anticipate operational needs, and recommend solutions or process improvements with minimal direction.
  • Preference shall be given to eligible veteran applicants provided such persons possess the qualifications necessary for competent discharge of the duties involved in the position applied for, such persons are among the most qualified candidates for the position, and all other factors in accordance with Executive Order 1-6.** GENERAL INFORMATION

SELECTION/SKILLS TESTS REQUIRED None

However, the department may administer a skill assessment evaluation.

SAFETY IMPACT POSITION Yes

If yes, this position is subject to random drug testing and if a promotional position, candidate must pass an assignment drug test.

SALARY INFORMATION

Factors used in determining the salary offered include the candidate's qualifications as well as the pay rates of other employees in this classification.

Pay Grade 26

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

Only online applications will be accepted for this City of Houston job and must be received by the Human Resources Department during active posting period. Applications must be submitted online at: www.houstontx.gov.

To view your detailed application status, please log-in to your online profile by visiting: http://agency.governmentjobs.com/houston/default.cfm or call 832-393-6737.

If you need special services or accommodations, call 832.393-6737. (TTY 7-1-1)

If you need login assistance or technical support call 855-524-5627.

Due to the high volume of applications received, the Hiring Department will contact you directly, should you be selected to advance in our recruitment process.

All new and rehires must pass a pre-employment drug test and are subject to a physical examination and verification of information provided.

Working closely with business partners and technology teams to transform data into clear, trustworthy information and actionable insight, the BI Analyst will help define business questions, priorities, and key performance indicators; investigate the source, definition, and context behind the data; and ensure that analysis is accurate, relevant, and easy to use.

Who We Are

We’re an $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform.

At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians, and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally.

Responsibilities

  • Business Partnership & Critical Thinking: Partner with business leaders to clarify the decisions behind analytical requests, challenge assumptions constructively, and recommend alternative measures or approaches when the requested analysis may not answer the underlying business question.
  • Problem Framing: Lead analytical discovery with stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into measurable questions, hypotheses, KPIs, and analytical approaches.
  • KPI Stewardship: Define, evaluate, and refine key performance indicators to ensure they are actionable, aligned to business objectives, consistently understood, and resistant to misinterpretation.
  • Insight & Recommendation: Explore data to identify meaningful patterns, relationships, anomalies, and trends; translate those findings into clear business implications, recommendations, and questions for leadership.
  • BI Solution Development: Develop reports, visualizations, dashboards, and custom extracts using business intelligence and data visualization tools.
  • Data Quality & Integrity: Analyze and validate data from multiple sources, understand database relationships and interconnections, and collaborate with BI and technology partners to resolve data integrity issues.
  • Solution Delivery: Participate in planning, technical design, development, testing, and delivery of BI solutions; create work plans and manage timelines and workflows to meet commitments.
  • Continuous Improvement: Review existing reports and analytical products for accuracy, consistency, usability, and continued business value; recommend when metrics, reports, or processes should be changed or retired.
  • Standards & Enablement: Research best practices, stay informed on BI tools and business direction, recommend standards and procedures, and design end-user training and supporting materials.
  • Team contribution: Provide guidance, training, and problem-solving assistance to other team members and contribute to a culture of analytical rigor and curiosity.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to turn complex or ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop a clear point of view based on data.
  • Ability to respectfully challenge assumptions and influence stakeholders using evidence and sound business judgment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts, analytical findings, and the business value of recommendations in a clear and understandable way.
  • Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools; Sigma experience preferred.
  • Experience working with relational databases and understanding data relationships across multiple systems.
  • Ability to translate analytical findings into meaningful business recommendations and actionable next steps.
  • Experience leveraging AI and emerging analytical tools to solve business problems, accelerate analysis, or develop custom solutions.
  • Experience managing complex projects and balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience; Master’s degree preferred.

What We Offer

  • Free premium medical, dental, life and vision insurance
  • Generous 401(k) match
  • Aya also offers other benefits to those that are eligible and where required by applicable law, including reimbursements and discretionary bonuses
  • Aya provides paid sick leave in accordance with all applicable state, federal, and local laws. Aya’s general sick leave policy is that employees accrue one hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked. However, to the extent any provisions of the statement above conflict with any applicable paid sick leave laws, the applicable paid sick leave laws are controlling
  • Celebrations! We hit our goals and reward ourselves.
  • Company-sponsored virtual events, happy hours and team-building activities are always on the horizon — plus, you get a special treat on your birthday!
  • Unlimited DTO — we believe in time off!
  • Virtual yoga, meditation or boot camp classes offered daily

Compensation: Aya reasonably anticipates the pay scale for this position to be an annual salary of $75,000 to $95,000.

The pay scale for this position may vary if applicant possesses experience outside of what Aya reasonably anticipates for this position. Bonuses are subject to the role and your manager’s discretion.

Aya is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including Disability / Vets, and welcomes all to apply. Please click here for our EEO policy.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.

Goldbelt Apex, a part of the Healthcare Technology Transformation Group, is a data-focused company dedicated to process and quality in every aspect. As experts in healthcare IT experts, Apex is committed to building systems for healthcare organizations to seamlessly communicate and exchange data across different systems and devices.

Summary:

The Mid-level Data Analyst will support survey and program data analysis, recurring/ad hoc reporting, data quality, system data support, charts/graphs/tables, and analysis of DES and SCAADL program performance.

Personnel are assigned in support of DHHQ in Falls Church, VA, but may work from the contractor facility or remotely when authorized.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Develop, refine, and generate recurring and ad hoc reports using approved data analysis and reporting software to analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
  • Analyze DES and SCAADL program data to identify performance trends, population changes, timeliness, process outcomes, quality measures, and other program metrics.
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reports in accordance with established program requirements and deadlines.
  • Develop clear and accurate charts, graphs, tables, and statistical visualizations appropriate to the type and complexity of the data, including scatter plots and other advanced visualizations when appropriate.
  • Prepare draft DES performance reports addressing population changes, phase and stage timeliness, process outcomes, special interest metrics, and other required measures.
  • Prepare draft SCAADL performance reports and analyze historical enrollment and participation data to identify trends and support program reporting.
  • Maintain and update the SCAADL Microsoft Access database and compile data received from Military Departments for analysis and reporting.
  • Analyze program data and reporting results and provide recommendations for process improvements based on identified trends and findings.
  • Support IDES satisfaction survey activities by gathering survey outcomes, analyzing results, and preparing reports, graphs, and recommendations for corrective actions.
  • Assist with the development and modification of MEB, PEB, and Personnel survey instruments and related survey documentation.
  • Pull MEB and PEB cohorts from the Veteran’s Tracking Application (VTA) and review data for accuracy, completeness, and survey eligibility.
  • Monitor data quality in program-related systems, identify data errors, and assist with tracking and resolving data quality issues.
  • Assist with system data support activities, including drafting system change requests, supporting user acceptance testing, and identifying opportunities to improve system capabilities and performance.
  • Assist with developing and maintaining business process documentation, reporting procedures, and user guidance for program-related systems and processes.
  • Coordinate with Government personnel and other stakeholders to obtain, validate, and clarify data and reporting requirements.
  • Provide other support as needed.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and one or more analytical/reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Access, R, Python, or similar
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and written communication skills

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, information systems, business analytics, computer science, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, statistical analysis, or reporting
  • Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
  • Experience developing reports, charts, graphs, tables, and data visualizations
  • Experience performing data validation and identifying data-quality issues
  • Tier 1/non-sensitive, with the applicable DHA background investigation and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Skills):

  • Federal, DoD, DHA, healthcare, or military personnel data experience preferred

Pay And Benefits

The salary range for this position is $75,000.00 to $100,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Position Details

Position Information

Banner Position Number R10938 Position Title Data Analyst (2 positions available) Classification Title MURC-Misc Other Technicians Department SOM - VP Health Science/Dean - RC5000 Job Description

Position Overview

The Data Analyst support clinical and research programs addressing chronic diseases including obesity and diabetes. The analyst manages program data, develops performance dashboards, and leads the preparation and coordination of required data reporting to support health interventions and continuous improvement.

Working with program leaders, clinical teams, and external partners, the analyst turns complex healthcare and program data into clear, actionable findings across initiatives such as telehealth and value-based care. The role requires strong analytical skills, and extensive familiarity with healthcare systems.

Core Responsibilities

Data Management and Quality

  • Manage and maintain data across several initiatives, integrating approved sources such as program records, electronic health records, claims, enrollment files, and partner submissions as available.
  • Develop repeatable processes to extract, clean, transform, link, and validate data. Investigate missing values, duplicates, inconsistencies, and reconciliation issues with data owners and program partners.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, measure specifications, source documentation, and version-controlled analytical code to support consistent definitions, reproducible results, and reliable reporting.

Dashboards and Performance Measurement

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards using tools such as Power BI or Tableau to monitor key performance indicators, service utilization, access, quality, and program outcomes.
  • Collaborate with the intervention team to define measures, baselines, targets, denominators, and reporting periods. Establish dashboard refresh schedules appropriate to source availability and clearly display data currency and limitations.
  • Analyze trends and variation across initiatives, populations, providers, and geographic areas. Assess rural access barriers and disparities while applying appropriate safeguards for small populations.

Federal and State Reporting

  • Lead data collection, validation, analysis, and preparation of required federal and state reports. Coordinate internal review, approval, and timely submission according to terms, reporting specifications, and program deadlines.
  • Maintain reporting calendars, submission instructions, validation checks, and supporting documentation. Reconcile reported results to source data and retain an auditable record of submissions, revisions, and approvals.
  • Monitor changes to reporting requirements with program and compliance staff, translate them into data specifications, and help resolve reporting discrepancies and follow-up requests

Data Governance and Partner Collaboration

  • Support data-sharing agreements and exchange protocols in collaboration with legal, privacy, security, and information technology teams.
  • Follow approved data-use restrictions, access controls, secure transfer procedures, retention requirements, and applicable privacy policies. Escalate data access, quality, or security concerns through established channels.
  • Provide technical assistance and training on data submission specifications, dashboard use, measure interpretation, and basic data literacy. Work with partners to improve completeness and consistency of submissions.

Analysis and Program Improvement

  • Use appropriate statistical and analytical methods to identify trends, service gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Distinguish descriptive findings from causal conclusions and communicate limitations, including data lags and incomplete coverage.
  • Translate findings into concise reports, presentations, and recommendations tailored to clinical, operational, and executive audiences. Partner with program teams to evaluate changes and monitor progress toward established goals.

Location MURC - Marshall University Research Corporation Salary Range Salary is commensurate with education, experience, and internal equity

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, public health, economics, information systems, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

  • At least one year’s of professional experience in data analysis or business intelligence.
  • Understanding of rural healthcare delivery and the access barriers, provider capacity constraints, and community factors relevant to West Virginia.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Excel; demonstrated experience developing dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable visualization platform, and using R, Python, SAS, or a comparable tool for analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to validate complex datasets, document analytical methods, interpret statistical results, and manage multiple reporting deadlines with close attention to accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings to nontechnical audiences and collaborate with clinical, program, technical, and external partner teams.
  • Knowledge of healthcare data privacy, confidentiality, secure data handling, and data governance practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Education

  • Master’s degree in a relevant quantitative, public health, or health informatics field.

Experience

  • Experience in a U.S. healthcare organization and grant-funded programs.
  • Experience with West Virginia healthcare data or partners; telehealth, transportation, or value-based care evaluation; geographic analysis; or automated reporting and data integration.

Assists in the preparation of the financial information by creating reports/analysis to support a department/business unit and/or an accounting /finance function. descriptionHtml:

Our purpose is to transform the future of food; this guides our vision of being the global leader in food and beverage technology, by harnessing the full power of JBT Marel to partner with our customers and pioneer sustainable innovation.

Our values show who we are at our best. As we Create with Collaboration, Serve with Integrity, Grow with Excellence, and Advance with Innovation.

You will report to Vice President, HR Operations.

Opportunity

JBT Marel is looking for a report Analyst. You will designs, builds, and maintains reporting and analytics solutions that provides JBT Marel organization insights on all HR related data and supports decision making across the company. This role owns Workday reporting as its primary focus including custom reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and Workday Prism/Discovery Boards while also contributing to broader analytics initiatives using Power BI, and AI-assisted tools such as Copilot and Data Bricks. The ideal candidate translates business questions from stakeholders into accurate, scalable, and well-governed reporting solutions, and helps the team modernize how HR data is accessed and consumed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain Workday custom reports (advanced, matrix, composite) using calculated fields, business objects, and report groups.
  • Develop and maintain Workday dashboards and Discovery Boards for HR leadership, HRBPs, and operational teams.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Workday BIRT reports to support HR, payroll, and workforce analytics needs, ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of actionable insights to business stakeholders.
  • Partner with Workday HCM governance, business, and functional teams (Recruiting, Time, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation) to ensure reporting aligns with data and change control standards.
  • Build and support reporting/data pipelines in Power BI, connecting to Workday and other HR data sources for cross-functional dashboards.
  • Leverage other sources for data preparation, transformation, and larger-scale or cross-system reporting needs beyond native Workday capabilities.
  • Use Copilot and other AI-assisted tools to accelerate report development, documentation, and data quality checks, in line with data governance and security requirements.
  • Translate ambiguous business requests into clear reporting requirements, mock-ups, and delivery timelines.
  • Perform data validation, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis when reports or dashboards produce unexpected results.
  • Maintain documentation for report logic, data lineage, and refresh schedules to support audit and SOX compliance needs.
  • Support ad hoc and recurring reporting requests tied to headcount, turnover, compensation, and other core HR metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate, standardize, automate, or retire redundant reports across tools.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building reports in Workday (custom reports, calculated fields, dashboards); Workday Report Writer certification preferred.
  • Working proficiency in Power BI, including data modeling and dashboard design.
  • Exposure to Databricks or similar cloud data platforms (SQL, notebooks, or pipeline concepts).
  • Comfort using AI-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot) for report development and documentation.
  • Strong SQL skills and general data literacy across relational data structures.
  • Experience working with HR or people data and an understanding of common HR metrics.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly around data accuracy, security, and compliance (SOX or similar controls experience a plus).
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical HR stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Workday Prism Analytics.
  • Familiarity with HR shared services / Global People Services operating models.
  • Experience supporting multi-region or global HR reporting requirements.
  • Background in change control or data governance frameworks.

What Success Looks Like

In the first six months, the Report Analyst becomes a trusted owner of core Workday reporting, reduces turnaround time on standard requests, and begins extending select dashboards into Power BI or Databricks where it adds value — all while maintaining the documentation and governance standards required for a SOX-compliant environment.

Travel & Location

  • This position is fully remote, and we ask that you travel approximately 25% of the time.

Why JBT Marel

  • We are committed to our employees and will provide you with development and opportunities to allow you to be the best version of yourself at work, at home, and in your community.
  • We foster a genuine inclusive team culture enjoying collaborative working across our global teams to deliver world-class projects.
  • We encourage development - ensuring new experiences and challenges at JBT Marel to feed your growth!
  • Benefits: JBT Marel offers benefits on day 1 of your employment. Including: Medical, Dental, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, family leave, vision coverage, and a matched 401(k) plan.

Commitment to Diversity: Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging is a fundamental value to JBT Marel and critical to our future success. A thoughtful, focused, and sustained effort to work towards our DEIB goals is not just a principled choice, but also a business imperative.

Use of Technology in Our Hiring Process

JBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.

These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.

All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

Equal Opportunity Employment

JBT Marel provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and qualified applicants for employment. We will not tolerate any form of discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. At JBT Marel, we apply this policy to all our employment practices, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, benefits, and training. We make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit and business needs at the time. JBT Marel will reasonably accommodate applicants who need adjustments to participate in the application or interview process. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application process, please contact JBT Marel at 844-286-4524.

This is a Hybrid position.

The New York City Department of Correction (DOC) is an integral part of the City’s evolving criminal justice system, participating in reform initiatives and strategies aimed to move the City towards a smaller jail system without compromising public safety. The DOC is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our employees, visitors, volunteers, and people in our custody. Importantly, safe jails enable DOC to provide people in custody with the tools and opportunities they need to successfully re-enter their communities. The DOC operates facilities and court commands across the five boroughs with more than 7,500 diverse professionals and knowledgeable experts.

The Office of Management, Analysis, and Planning (OMAP) is seeking a skilled and proactive Business Intelligence Analyst to transform complex operational data into actionable dashboards, automated reporting pipelines, and strategic insights. Working at the intersection of data engineering and visual analytics, this role supports executive leadership and operational divisions by ensuring high-integrity, real-time visibility into agency performance, compliance metrics, and strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Automated Reporting:

  • Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries across relational databases and centralized data

warehouses to extract, transform, and validate operational records.

  • Design, build, and maintain automated scheduled data pipelines and executive dashboards using tools

like Tableau, Python (Dash), or Power BI.

  • Establish and monitor automated data validation scripts to proactively identify system entry gaps, data

discrepancies, or pipeline failures.

Performance Metrics & Analytics

  • Collaborate with operational stakeholders to translate operational workflows and policy mandates into

structured KPIs and performance scorecards.

  • Conduct exploratory and descriptive data analysis to detect trends, system utilization gaps, and

longitudinal performance shifts.

  • Prepare recurring executive briefings, compliance summaries, and ad-hoc data extracts for leadership,

legal, or oversight reviews.

Data Governance & System Integration

  • Partner with enterprise IT to reconcile discrepancies between front-end data entry applications, legacy

administrative systems, and centralized data warehouses.

  • Contribute to standardizing data dictionaries, field mappings, and master data management practices

across diverse operational units.

  • Document data extraction methodologies, reporting logic, and pipeline workflows to ensure institutional

continuity.

CITY RESEARCH SCIENTIST - 21744

Minimum Qualifications

  • For Assignment Level I (only physical, biological and environmental sciences and public health) A master's degree from an accredited college or university with a specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological or environmental science or in public health.

To be appointed to Assignment Level II and above, candidates must have:

  • A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or
  • A master's degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and three years of responsible full-time research experience in the appropriate field of specialization; or
  • Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least a master's degree in an appropriate field of specialization and at least two years of experience described in "2" above. Two years as a City Research Scientist Level I can be substituted for the experience required in "1" and "2" above.

Note

Probationary Period

Appointments to this position are subject to a minimum probationary period of one year.

Preferred Skills

  • Programming & Data Manipulation: Advanced proficiency in Python for robust data manipulation, exploratory analysis, and visualization. - Database & SQL Expertise: Deep expertise in SQL, with a strong ability to write optimized queries, navigate complex relational databases, and extract data from enterprise data warehouses. - Data Visualization & BI: Extensive experience designing, building, and maintaining interactive, executive-ready dashboards using tools like Tableau, Dash, or Power BI. - Automation & Deployment: Demonstrated experience developing, deploying, and automating server- based analytical resources, including scheduling recurring reports and maintaining automated data pipelines. - Applied Analytical Skills: Solid foundation in applied statistical modeling, performance tracking, and identifying actionable trends within large, complex datasets. - Domain Experience: Prior experience working with public sector, criminal justice, operational, or highly regulated administrative data is desirable. - Project Management & Communication: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to manage multiple deliverables, track cross-functional dependencies, and clearly communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders and agency leadership.

Public Service Loan Forgiveness

As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.

Residency Requirement

New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.

Additional Information

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

Position Summary

  • Collaborates with internal departments and vendor partners to identify and understand data and information needs.
  • Establishes processes and infrastructure to capture and house data from relevant sources.
  • Ensures data consistency across vendors and programs.
  • Makes extensive use of tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI and SQL requiring advanced skills.

Tandem Diabetes Care, a global insulin delivery and diabetes technology company, manufactures and sells advanced automated insulin delivery systems that reduce the burden of diabetes management, while creating new possibilities for patients, their loved ones, and healthcare providers. The Company’s pump portfolio features the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump, both of which feature Control-IQ advanced hybrid closed-loop technology. 
Tandem is the #1 recommended insulin pump brand by people living with diabetes, four years and counting. (dQ&A US Diabetes Connections Patient Panel Report; Net Promoter Score; Q1 2019-Q3 2023: P.49, Q3 2023 (Jan. 2019-Sept. 2023). Tandem Diabetes Care is based in San Diego, California. For more information, visit tandemdiabetes.com.
SAFETY INFORMATION Please note that this account is not intended to be used for product support or medical advice. If you are having a medical emergency, please dial 911. If you are having an issue with one of our products and need immediate assistance, please call our 24-hour customer support team at 877-801-6901 and press 1 twice. 
RX ONLY. Indicated for patients with type 1 diabetes, 6 years and older. WARNING: Control-IQ technology should not be used by people under age 6, or who use less than 10 units of insulin/day, or who weigh less than 55 lbs. Safety info: tandemdiabetes.com/safetyinfo.

descriptionHtml:
Grow With Us

Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

Stay Awesome

Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A Day In The Life

The Data Analyst II supports data-driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights, reports, and analytical solutions. This role partners with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, integrate and prepare data from multiple sources, and deliver analyses that improve operational effectiveness and business outcomes. This position combines business analytics, data wrangling, and technical development skills using SQL, Python, and modern analytics platforms.

Data Analyst II's Are Also Responsible For

  • Uses SQL, Python, and analytics platforms to prepare, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Ensures data quality through validation, investigation, and documentation of data sources and methodologies.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders across Tandem’s business units to define user needs and develop proof-of-concept analyses, datasets, and visualizations that inform solution design.
  • Analyzes data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
  • Develops reports, dashboards, visualizations, and analytical datasets that support business decision-making.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate and improve reporting and analytical processes.
  • Ensures compliance with company policies, including Privacy/HIPAA, and other legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

When & Where You’ll Work

Remote: This position is fully remote and is open to candidates throughout the United States, with a preference for those located in San Diego, California. Equipment for the role will be provided, and training will be conducted remotely.

Schedule: This position will work Monday - Friday from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST.

What You'lld Need

  • Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience using Python for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
  • Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Strong data wrangling and data modeling skills.
  • Ability to work with large, complex datasets.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Certifications/Educational Level

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field
  • Master's degree in a related field may substitute for the required experience.

Minimum Experience

  • Two (2) years of related experience in Data Analytics.
  • Preferred experience in any of the following areas:
    • Experience translating business questions and stakeholder needs into analytical requirements, metrics, and reporting solutions.
    • Experience working in a regulated industry, such as medical device, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare.
    • Experience with Databricks or other cloud-based analytics platforms.
    • Experience integrating data from multiple business systems
    • Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives.
    • Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and supporting team backlog management using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
    • Knowledge of statistical analysis and modeling techniques preferred.
Compensation & Benefits

The base pay for this position is $82,000 - $100,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes incentive compensation, equity, and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

You Should Know

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.

SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers.

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

Referrals

We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

Application Deadline

The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

Schedule: This position will work Monday - Friday from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST.

What You'lld Need



-  Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
- Experience with SQL and relational databases.
- Experience using Python for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
- Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Strong data wrangling and data modeling skills.
- Ability to work with large, complex datasets.
- Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
- Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Certifications/Educational Level



- Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field
- Master's degree in a related field may substitute for the required experience.

Minimum Experience



- Two (2) years of related experience in Data Analytics. 
- Preferred experience in any of the following areas:

- Experience translating business questions and stakeholder needs into analytical requirements, metrics, and reporting solutions.
- Experience working in a regulated industry, such as medical device, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare.
- Experience with Databricks or other cloud-based analytics platforms.
- Experience integrating data from multiple business systems
- Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives.
- Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and supporting team backlog management using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
- Knowledge of statistical analysis and modeling techniques preferred.
Compensation & Benefits

The base pay for this position is $82,000 - $100,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes incentive compensation, equity, and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.

At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. The City of Atlanta remains a transportation hub, not just for the country but also for the world: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is one of the nations busiest in daily passenger flights.  Direct flights to Europe, South America, and Asia have made metro Atlanta easily accessible to the more than 1,000 international businesses that operate here and the more than 50 countries that have representation in the city through consulates, trade offices, and chambers of commerce.  The city has emerged as a banking center and is the world headquarters for 13 Fortune 500 companies.

Atlanta is the Capital city of the southeast, a city of the future with strong ties to its past.  The old in new Atlanta is the soul of the city, the heritage that enhances the quality of life in a contemporary city.  In the turbulent 60's, Atlanta was "the city too busy to hate."​  And today, in the 21st Century, Atlanta is the "city not too busy to care"​.

For more than four decades Atlanta has been linked to the civil rights movement.  Civil Rights leaders moved forward, they were the visionaries who saw a new south, a new Atlanta.  They believed in peace. They made monumental sacrifices for that peace.  And because of them Atlanta became a fast-pace modern city which opened its doors to the 1996 Olympics.

Die-hard Southerners view Atlanta as the heart of the Old Confederacy; Atlanta has become the best example of the New South, a fast-paced modern city proud of its heritage.

In the past two decades Atlanta has experienced unprecedented growth -- the official city population remains steady, at about 420,000, but the metro population has grown in the past decade by nearly 40%, from 2.9 million to 4.1 million people.  A good measure of this growth is the ever-changing downtown skyline, along with skyscrapers constructed in the Midtown, Buckhead, and outer perimeter (fringing I-285) business districts.

Job Description

Position open until 11/19/2026

Salary: 47,474.94annually

General Description And Classification Standards

This position reports to the Atlanta Police Department Chief Administrative Office (CAO). Performs seasoned-level reporting and analysis work in support of departmental research, performance reporting, operations management, and departmental operations. Plans and executes projects to study operations effectiveness or trends. Designs and prepares reports by accessing databases or by consolidating data from multiple sources. Lays out report formats and produces reports. Summarizes data and provides commentary or observations based on analysis. Position does not perform data entry. Sources of data may be enterprise systems, complex spreadsheets, databases, etc., requiring specialized expertise or training.

Note: positions in this class may also lead other related administrative or operations processes within the organization provided they have a similar level of professional challenge.

Supervision Received

Direction received is very general and focuses on end results and is typically collaborative in nature. Position plans own work and project schedules and sequences.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities These are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.

  • Receives assignments and plans for data collection and analysis for assigned departmental functions or activities.
  • Designs custom reports and data displays for projects and standard report formats for ongoing functions based on organizational needs for information.
  • Reviews assigned operating records and/or databases for quality. Identifies processes or reporting functions that do not provide the necessary level of completeness, detail or accuracy.
  • Designs standard report formats based on organizational needs for information.
  • Retrieves and summarizes data from various information systems for inclusion into research or operating reports.
  • Writes queries in the appropriate reporting language.
  • Reviews monthly operating statistics and operating data and prepares operating reports.
  • Leads or participates in internal and external research projects by collecting, reviewing, and summarizing results.
  • Generates reports, presentations, graphics, forms and other documents to demonstrate information flow and project results.
  • Presents periodic reports or special projects to organizational management.
  • Interacts with line staff, managers and supervisors when conducting studies, surveys, or audits.
  • Performs other duties related to the maintenance and operation of administrative and information systems related to the area of assignment.
  • May interpret organizational policies and recommend exceptions; establishes work methods, timetables, performance standards, etc.
  • May provide leadership to lower level, interns, temporary employees, etc.
  • Serves as a technical resource or mentor to other employees.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. COA may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Qualifications

Knowledge Skills and Abilities This is a partial listing of necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job successfully, it is not an exhaustive list.

  • Thorough knowledge of databases, reporting methods and formats, and appropriate reporting languages.
  • Skill in operation of computers to retrieve data and prepare reports and presentations; in writing narrative reports; in communicating.
  • Skill in leading groups and in speaking to groups.
  • Ability to organize and present data in presentations and narrative reports.
  • Ability to review data and identify data trends and/or inconsistencies.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business/public administration, accounting, finance, information technology, statistics, human resources, or a related field (Additional years of experience may be considered as a substitute for the required degree on an exceptional basis, with a minimum of eight (8) years of professional related experience in creation, reporting, and/or management of data),
  • Minimum of four (4) years of professional related experience in creation, reporting, and/or management of data or closely related tasks (not including data entry).
  • Required Skills: SQL, Microsoft Access, Microsoft Excel.

Licensures and Certifications

No specific certifications or licensures required. Individual positions may require completion of training in specific reporting languages or software.

Preferred Requirements

Bachelor’s degree as described above, plus 5 years data analysis experience. Experience with R, Python, Visual Basic is preferred.

Work Environment

Required physical, lifting, and sensory capabilities are requirements to perform the job successfully. Typical environmental conditions associated with the job.

Lifting Requirements: Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.

Work Schedule: This position follows the City’s hybrid work schedule policy as assigned by the Department of Human Resources Commissioner and requires in-person work at City worksites/facilities at least four (4) days per week, with the option to work remotely one (1) day per week, based on eligibility, departmental needs, and supervisor approval. The hybrid work schedule is subject to change at any time to five (5) days in-person work.

General Summary

This is the third level of a four level job family. A prerequisite to this level is experience as Metrics and Reporting Analyst II or equivalent related experience.

Incumbent partners with business managers to drive the development and implementation of management information reporting.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develop operational/performance metrics appropriate to the various business functions. Performance metrics include:
    • Expense variance analysis and expense forecasting
    • Operating efficiency and effectiveness metrics
    • Key volume metrics
    • Headcount and staffing analysis
    • Capacity planning and modeling
  • Build and/or implement tools and develop techniques (technical solutions) for measuring and reporting performance metrics for assigned areas.
  • Develop new metrics to measure performance against assumptions of business plans
  • Assist business areas in linking operating budget to business plan and adjusts expense estimates/forecasts in support of changes in the plan
  • Partners with business manager to translate senior management directives into action steps for front line management teams
  • Develop business trend analysis, monitor key operating metrics and communicate those results to management
  • Mentors/trains junior analysts
  • Translate needs of customers into reporting solutions, with minimal guidance from manager
  • Provides operational and ad hoc information as well as customized reports for specific audiences.
  • Assist in or Drive the development of an annual operating budget, quarterly forecasts and ongoing expense management for assigned business areas
  • Develop and deliver detailed budget expense and headcount analysis and reporting for assigned business areas
  • Communicate/educate managers on corporate budgeting/expense methodology
  • Train managers to use budget system and provide ongoing user support
  • Provide monthly expense variance analysis and revise/adjust expense forecasts
  • Proactive identification of potential expense initiatives – work with management team to develop an action plan
  • Accountable for performing in-depth analysis of complex operating or expense information
  • Manages or participates departmental projects
  • Work closely with management to identify, prioritize and execute plans to improve the efficiency of metrics and reporting.
  • Active participation in business management meetings and independent interaction with senior management of assigned area
  • Responsible for developing and running weekly, monthly and annual reports
  • Maintain performance metrics for assigned area
  • Performs feasibility analysis and participates in development of new policies, procedures and improved processes
  • Identifies, understands and applies accounting principles and practices
  • May perform other duties as assigned
Job Specifications

  • Bachelor degree or equivalent related work experience required
  • 4 - 6 years experience with budgeting, financial analysis and performance measurement reporting required and/or advanced degree (MBA)
  • Ability to work with management teams to translate high-level business plans into action steps and reporting solutions
  • Ability to work in a rapidly changing environment
  • Ability to prioritize work under the pressure of deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to work/communicate with all levels of management
  • Proficient in Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word
  • Ability to utilitze data-mining/query tools and techniques
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Demonstrate solid leadership skills in building enterprise value as an indispensable business partner
  • Demonstrates solid working knowledge of financial accounting rules and concepts
  • Strong communication skills – verbal and written
  • Demonstrates exceptional customer service skills
  • Demonstrates solid working knowledge of external industry and financial trends

We work from strategy through implementation. Our teams help leaders shape AI and data strategies, strengthen governance, modernize data architecture, enable advanced analytics, and make information easier to discover and use. We also support cloud modernization, data migration, and workforce learning. Our clients include the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We begin with the people and the problem. Strategists, data scientists, architects, engineers, and other specialists work with clients to understand needs, test ideas, and build solutions that fit the mission. Our motto is “Experiment. Fail. Learn. Repeat.” We test ideas and learn from the results.

Peregrine brings together people who are curious, collaborative, and committed to making a difference. We learn through the work and from one another, building technical expertise, problem-solving skills, judgment, and leadership. Alongside client work, we contribute ideas, develop tools and methods, and help build the firm.

Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.
