descriptionHtml:
PSEG is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.


Job Summary

This position will enhance existing or create new databases to perform calculations, organize and save data and create reports for various Revenue Operations groups. This position will also be responsible for helping an organization make sound operational decisions by analyzing budgets, business processes and performance data. Some job duties are but not limited to managing the Electric Energy Service Companies (ESCO) portfolio, and rate verifications. Ensure policies, process improvements and strategies are compliant with the tariff, with New York's Home Energy Fair Practices Act, and Uniformed Business Practices in the LIPA service territory. Monitor and disseminate any regulatory changes as implemented by LIPA, NY State or Federal Regulatory bodies. Accountable for analyzing data, developing reports as requested by management as related to the department’s achievement of various OSA metrics, or to meet various regulatory requirements. Devise strategies for business optimization, spearhead the development of processes, identify strengths and weaknesses, and offer recommendations on areas in need of improvement. Work as the go between with management and the IT department to communicate complex technical issues for innovative solutions; the creation of daily, weekly, monthly reports for Back Office Billing department. Conduct comprehensive data analysis using Microsoft Access and other analytical tools to identify trends, patterns, insights and develop reports as requested by management.


Job Responsibilities

Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, including variance analysis, forecasting, and financial reporting

Create, maintain, and enhance databases, spreadsheets, reports, and data reconciliation processes to ensure data accuracy and integrity

Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including journal entries, analysis, and reporting

Analyze business and financial performance, identify trends, risks, cost-saving opportunities, and recommend corrective actions

Lead problem-solving and process improvement initiatives through root cause analysis, gap assessment, and solution implementation

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver actionable insights

Manage competing priorities and stakeholder requests while ensuring timely, accurate deliverables

Track vendor contracts, invoices, and project expenditures

Support special projects and other business initiatives as needed


Job Specific Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree in Accounting, Business, Data Analytics, Social Science, or a related discipline, and 2 years of experience performing analysis (e.g., data analysis, financial analysis, business analysis, or other relevant analytical work); in lieu of a degree, a minimum of 6 years of experience performing analysis may be considered
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Access, Excel, Power Point, Word, Tableau and SAP
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Must have excellent verbal, quantitative and written communication skills
  • Must possess and maintain a valid U.S. driver's license and a safe and satisfactory driving history
  • Must demonstrate a sense of teamwork and initiative
  • Compliance with the Department of Energy's regulation 10 CFR 810 is required


Some positions at PSEG require access to information covered by the Department of Energy’s regulation 10 CFR 810 (Part 810). If applicable, the successful applicant must prove they are: (1) a citizen or national of the USA; OR (2) a lawful permanent resident of the United States (Non-Conditional Permanent I-551 / Green Card / Permanent Resident Card holder); OR (3) a citizen, national, or permanent resident of a “Generally Authorized” destination on the attached list and not also a citizen, national, permanent resident of any country not listed; OR (4) a “Protected Individual” under the Immigration and Naturalization Act (8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3)).


As an employee of PSEG Long Island, you should be aware that during storm/outage restoration efforts, you may be required to perform functions different from normal operations and work extended hours beyond your regular work schedule. You may also be required to work on premise or in an alternate location as directed by the company.


For all roles, PSEGLI’s drug and alcohol testing program includes pre-employment testing, testing for cause, and post-incident/accident testing.

Employees who are hired or transfer into a federally regulated role (including positions covered by USDOT, PHMSA, or NRC regulations) are subject to random drug and alcohol testing, inclusive of marijuana. Although numerous states throughout the country have legalized marijuana/cannabis products recreationally and medically, the use of these products are prohibited for employees in federally regulated roles. Please note that the use of CBD products may result in a positive drug test for THC/Marijuana and such use is not a legitimate medical explanation for a positive result.


If you are a current PSEG employee and offered an opportunity with PSEG Long Island, you will be treated as a new hire. Please note that as a new hire to the Long Island subsidiary, your benefits will change and generally will be consistent with other similarly situated PSEG Long Island new hires. Similarly, for PSEG Long Island employees who accept job opportunities with PSEG or any of its subsidiaries (other than PSEG Long Island), their benefits will change and generally be consistent with other similarly situated new hires of that company.


PSEGLI is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment, including the hiring process, based on any legally protected characteristic. Legally protected characteristics include race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, disability or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in locations where PSEG employs individuals.

PSEGLI is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance applying for a position, please call 973-430-3845 or email accommodations@pseg.com.

If you need to request a reasonable accommodation to perform the essential functions of the job, email accommodations@pseg.com. Any information provided regarding a disability will be kept strictly confidential and will not be shared with anyone involved in making a hiring decision.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

We’re Dealer Tire, a family-owned, international distributor of tires and parts established in 1918 in Cleveland, OH. We’re laser focused on helping the world’s largest and most trusted auto manufacturers grow their tire business—in fact, we’ve sold more than 60 million tires to date. We’re a thriving company, and we’re looking for driven individuals to join our team. That’s where you come in!

Base Pay Range

$80,000 - $90,000

As a Program Management Analyst, your essential job functions will include the following:

Reporting and Analysis

  • Serve as a primary analytical resource for Program Management data and information requests, independently managing priorities and recommendations.
  • Develop, compile and analyze operational and financial data to identify trends, performance drivers and actionable insights.
  • Serve as an analytical resource to the Program Management team by investigating data questions, identifying root causes and recommending appropriate solutions.
  • Partner with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to interpret findings, identify successful behaviors and uncover opportunities to improve program performance.
  • Define the goals of analysis activities and perform needs assessments for reporting requests. Ask questions to understand the underlying business need and desired outcome, and recommend additional areas of analysis when appropriate.
  • Use analytical tools to monitor OEM program elements, communicate performance trends, and document relationships among data, processes, and business events.
  • Transform and analyze large, complex datasets to produce reliable, reproducible results and usable information for business stakeholders.
  • Prepare clear and concise presentations to communicate findings and recommendations effectively.
  • Partner with Program Operations leadership and other key stakeholders to ensure reporting and analysis align with business priorities and organizational goals.

Reporting Automation & Data Visualization

  • Build, maintain and enhance Program Management dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and other analytical tools.
  • Transform complex data into clear and intuitive visualizations that enable stakeholders to quickly understand program performance.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and reduce manual reporting processes.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and develop scalable solutions that support ongoing business decisions.
  • Monitor and continuously improve reporting solutions as program and stakeholder needs evolve.

Program & Project Support

  • Lead analytical support for new program launches, program changes and other Program Management initiatives.
  • Evaluate the operational and financial implications of proposed program changes and identify potential impacts or risks.
  • Measure the effectiveness of implemented changes and provide analysis to determine whether intended business outcomes are being achieved.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects requiring Program Operations data, analysis or reporting expertise.
  • Manage assigned analytical and process-improvement projects from definition through completion.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Validate, reconcile and improve the quality of data used in Program Management reporting by identifying recurring issues and recommending process improvements.
  • Investigate data discrepancies and partner with appropriate business and technical resources to identify root causes and resolve issues.
  • Document data sources, business definitions, reporting logic and key processes to improve consistency and continuity across Program Management.
  • Develop an understanding of how data flows across systems and how upstream changes may impact downstream reporting.

Job Requirements

Other Duties as Assigned

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Analytics or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in business analysis, financial analysis, data analytics, reporting, or a related area.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, investigate root causes and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.
  • Experience with Sigma or similar analytics platforms preferred.
  • Experience with SQL or other data-querying tools preferred.
  • Ability to analyze and reconcile information from multiple data sources with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables in a rapidly changing business environment.
  • Self-starter who can work both independently and collaboratively.

Physical Job Requirements

  • Continuous viewing from and inputting data to a computer screen
  • Sitting for long periods of time

Position Summary

The Analyst, Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Operations & Analytics supports the End User Support & Productivity (EUSP) organization by leveraging data, analytics, reporting, and Digital Employee Experience technologies to improve employee experience, support effectiveness, and operational decision-making.

This role is ideal for a highly analytical, self-motivated individual who enjoys identifying trends, solving problems through data, and contributing to the evolution of modern support organizations. The Analyst will work closely with EUSP leadership, Technical Field Engineers (TFEs), Global Service Desk, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to transform operational and employee experience data into actionable insights that drive continuous improvement.

The role serves as a key contributor to EUSP's transition toward a more proactive, data-driven, and AI-enabled support model by identifying trends, measuring outcomes, supporting DEX platform initiatives, and helping prioritize opportunities that improve both employee experience and support efficiency.

This position will be on a Hybrid schedule with 3 days per week in the San Diego, CA or New York, NY office.

Job Responsibilities

DEX Platform Operations & Enablement

  • Support the ongoing development and maturity of the DEX platform by helping manage enhancement requests, reporting needs, and use-case opportunities.
  • Support the intake, documentation, prioritization, and tracking of DEX-related requests, including dashboards, investigations, alerts, campaigns, remote actions, workflows, and analytics requirements.
  • Evaluate new DEX features, releases, library content, and capabilities to identify opportunities that support employee experience and operational improvements.
  • Maintain inventories of DEX dashboards, investigations, automations, workflows, use cases, and related documentation.
  • Support the champions in the adoption and best practice implementation of the DEX platform across the organization through the documentation of SOPs, knowledge transferring and training.
  • Monitor platform utilization, adoption, data quality, coverage, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Partner with technology teams, support organizations, and vendors to maximize the value of DEX capabilities across EUSP and other infrastructure departments in the organization.


DEX Analytics & Employee Experience Reporting

  • Analyze endpoint, application, collaboration, device, and employee sentiment data to identify trends impacting employee productivity and technology experience.
  • Develop and maintain DEX dashboards, investigations, NQL queries, DEX score reporting, and operational analytics.
  • Establish experience baselines and monitor trends related to:
  • Device health and reliability
  • Startup and login performance
  • Application performance and stability
  • Microsoft 365 experience
  • Microsoft Teams performance
  • Connectivity and network experience
  • Endpoint compliance
  • Software adoption
  • Employee sentiment and experience indicators
  • Correlate DEX data with ticketing, support, device, geography, and business-unit information to identify recurring experience patterns and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify operational insights and potential proactive support opportunities before employees submit support tickets.
  • Conduct before-and-after analyses of technology changes, deployments, automations, and support initiatives to measure impact and effectiveness.


Ticket Auditing & Support Analytics

  • Perform recurring reviews and audits of support tickets across EUSP support organizations.
  • Analyze incidents, service requests, escalations, support trends, and recurring issues to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Identify recurring support patterns, process inefficiencies, knowledge gaps, and opportunities for proactive remediation.
  • Cross-reference ticket data against DEX insights to determine whether earlier detection, automation, self-service, or proactive communications could have reduced support effort.
  • Produce recurring reports and recommendations focused on improving operational efficiency, user experience, and support effectiveness.
  • Support Problem Management and Continuous Improvement efforts through data-driven analysis and reporting.


Dashboards, Reporting & Data Analysis

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve operational, executive, and DEX-focused dashboards.
  • Leverage SQL and reporting tools to analyze large datasets and transform findings into actionable insights.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of:
  • Executive scorecards
  • Operational KPI dashboards
  • DEX performance reporting
  • Service health reporting
  • Adoption scorecards
  • Trend and root-cause analyses
  • Develop recurring reports highlighting service performance, employee experience, device health, support trends, and operational outcomes.
  • Support reporting automation efforts that improve reporting accuracy, consistency, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective data visualizations and reporting solutions.


DEX Platform Adoption & Utilization Reporting

  • Track and report on DEX platform adoption, utilization, and feature engagement.
  • Develop reporting that measures platform usage, dashboard utilization, investigation activity, campaign participation, and overall DEX program maturity.
  • Analyze adoption trends and identify opportunities to improve engagement and platform value.
  • Support measurement of business outcomes generated through DEX initiatives and platform investments.
  • Produce recurring adoption scorecards for operational leaders and stakeholders.


Data Quality & Process Improvement

  • Act as a steward for support reporting data quality by identifying opportunities to improve ticket categorization, data consistency, and reporting reliability.
  • Identify gaps in data collection, operational processes, and reporting methodologies that limit effective analysis and decision-making.
  • Support documentation of KPI definitions, data sources, reporting methodologies, and dashboard requirements.
  • Analyze employee feedback, sentiment data, survey results, and support metrics to identify service improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute recommendations that strengthen reporting capabilities, proactive support initiatives, and DEX program maturity.
  • Maintain operational documentation, procedures, and reporting standards.


Executive Reporting & Operational Insights

  • Support the creation of executive-level scorecards, presentations, and reporting packages.
  • Translate technical and operational data into clear, leadership-ready insights and recommendations.
  • Assist with operational reviews, business updates, quarterly reviews, and strategic reporting initiatives.
  • Develop recurring reporting packages that highlight:
  • Trends
  • Risks
  • Opportunities
  • Adoption metrics
  • Service outcomes
  • Employee experience indicators
  • Business value realization
  • Present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Automation Opportunity Identification

  • Analyze support data and DEX insights to identify opportunities for automation, self-service, and proactive support.
  • Assist in documenting requirements and business cases for new automation and DEX initiatives.
  • Support measurement of the effectiveness and business impact of implemented automation solutions.
  • Track metrics such as ticket reduction, recurring issue elimination, proactive resolution opportunities, and support effort reduction.
  • Collaborate with support and engineering teams to prioritize opportunities based on business impact, user experience improvements, and operational value.
  • Other Duties as assigned
  • Honesty, trustworthiness and ethical conduct are material requirements for the responsibilities outlined above


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or currently completing a degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities within large datasets.
  • Experience with SQL querying and data analysis.
  • Experience creating dashboards, reports, or data visualizations.
  • Strong Microsoft 365 skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and desire to drive measurable business value through data.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) concepts or platforms such as DEX.
  • Familiarity with IT Service Management (ITSM) concepts, ticketing systems, and support operations.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting platforms.
  • Exposure to service desks, endpoint management, workplace technology, or enterprise IT environments.
  • Understanding of Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, Teams, and Windows.
  • Interest in AI, automation, proactive support models, and employee experience improvement.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

The Senior Financial Reporting Analyst is responsible for owning key reporting and compliance deliverables end to end, ensuring financial reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, and delivered on established timelines. This role leads preparation of complex schedules (including covenant reporting packages and board/owner reporting), performs analytical reviews and data validation, and drives standardization and continuous improvement in partnership with BI and upstream data owners.

This role performs work under minimal supervision and handles complex issues and problems, referring only the most complex issues to higher-level staff.

Job Overview

Under general supervision of the Institutional Research & Reporting Lead and reporting to the Senior Director, the Institutional Research Analyst will collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data to support student success and institutional decision-making, planning, and reporting. The incumbent’s primary responsibility will be to support timely submission of required reports to the CSU Chancellor’s Office (CO), state and federal governments, accrediting and regulatory agencies, college ranking sites, and other internal and external entities. Other responsibilities include querying large-scale institutional databases; performing research and statistical analysis; developing and maintaining data dashboards; creating tabular, graphical, and narrative reports; providing administrative and technical support for select departmental projects; and effectively collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders in carrying out these responsibilities. The Institutional Research Analyst is expected to develop and maintain broad knowledge of institutional data, university policy, and operations to contribute to a wide variety of cyclical and ad hoc institutional research activities.

Position Summary

Institutional Research Analyst (Institutional Research Analyst II)

This is a full-time, exempt position, which will lead toward permanent status following the successful completion of a probationary period.

For a complete list of responsibilities and required qualifications, please review the position description linked at the top of the page.

Pay, Benefits, And Work Schedule

Anticipated Hiring Salary Range: $5,274 - $6,180 per month (steps 1-9)

CSU Classification Salary Range: $5,274 - $7,684 per month

Salary is commensurate with the background and experience of the individual selected.

This position is eligible for a broad range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances, retirement (CalPERS), tuition waiver, vacation and sick leave. In addition, 15 paid holidays are offered each year; 14 scheduled on specific days and a Personal Holiday that may be taken any time during the year.

A comprehensive benefits summary for this position is available online by visiting our Benefits Portal . The CSU Total Compensation Calculator demonstrates the significance of the benefits package.

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule.

California State University San Marcos

A mid-size university located in San Diego's vibrant North County, we are dedicated to service, innovation, leadership and student success. We have an attentive faculty and state-of-the-art facilities which offer our students hundreds of opportunities to learn, lead, play and serve.

California State University San Marcos is a new kind of university, pushing the boundaries of innovation to prepare tomorrow's leaders, build stronger communities and solve pressing issues.

Cutting-edge research meets hands-on application at our campus and in the real world.

This position is open until filled. For assurance of full consideration, please submit application, cover letter and resume by 11:59pm on November 17, 2026.

Department

Division of Enrollment Management | Technology Operations Unit

Responsibilities

The Division of Enrollment Management is comprised of four distinct units: Office of Admissions, Office of the University Registrar, Office of Financial Aid, and Technology Operations. Enrollment Management’s integrated services provide distinctive support throughout the students’ development and progression in their academic experience – from recruitment through commencement. Through collaboration, communication, and commitment, all units within Enrollment Management achieve the highest level of student-centered service to current and prospective students and families as well as to campus partners across the University. The Technology Operations Unit within Enrollment Management provides technology support, technology-based solutions, systems configuration, identity and data management, and analysis across the division. The unit works closely with subject matter experts in Admissions, Registrar, and Financial Aid to meet the operational and reporting needs of various stockholders across campus.

Responsible for creating, designing, and maintaining financial aid reporting and analysis. Serves as data management analyst and leverages financial aid data with other key institutional data.

Designs, develops, and maintains financial aid databases and reports for state, federal, and institutional reports such as Board of Governors, IPEDS, Common Data Set (CDS) as well as other reports that aid in the leveraging of financial aid. Optimizes the use of PS query and interactive visualization software to develop departmental dashboards for a variety of reporting needs that include financial aid data as well as data from other campus departments. Responsible for accessing university data stores and creating ad hoc reporting datasets to complete institutional reports for administration.

Develops and maintains Snowflake reports for use by functional end users across campus. Utilizes the current Snowflake software to assess and analyze information to respond to official requests for Financial Aid data. Meets with clients to determine data needs to create informational databases. Analyzes data for accuracy and presented in a logical, consistent manner for timely dissemination. Makes recommendations to senior leadership for the enhancement or creation of Snowflake queries and PS queries.

Collects and analyzes financial aid data to respond to surveys that profile FSU for publications and University reporting. Maintains historical documentation relating to various surveys. Assists with the gathering and evaluation of financial aid data for Board of Governor (BOG) reporting. Identifies efficiencies, participates in testing, advises of regulatory changes, and ensure compliance with quality assurance. Assist with admissions and enrolled student reporting.

Provides support to departmental and administrative clients in the use of PS Query and current Snowflake software as well as their best practices. Maintains documentation for training purposes on these products.

Assists in developing strategies to aid in streamlined data management. Researches problems within sections programs and presenting findings to ensure compliance with state, federal, and institutional regulations. Makes recommendations to senior leadership for the enhancement of overall processes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and two years of experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and six years of relevant experience. (Note: a combination of post high school education and experience equal to six years.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and two years of experience in enrollment services.
  • Ability to multi-task within a fast-paced work environment.
  • Experience implementing and/or supporting new initiatives (policy, technology, procedure, etc.).
  • Preferred candidates will have experience with interactive visualization software.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills desired.
  • Previous experience and comfort working with a variety of computer software applications, databases, and student information systems (PeopleSoft).
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and responsibilities at the same time.
  • Prior experience analyzing data to create reports, to identify trends and to make decisions.

University Information

One of the nation's elite research universities, Florida State University preserves, expands, and disseminates knowledge in the sciences, technology, arts, humanities, and professions, while embracing a philosophy of learning strongly rooted in the traditions of the liberal arts and critical thinking. Founded in 1851, Florida State University is the oldest continuous site of higher education in Florida. FSU is a community steeped in tradition that fosters research and encourages creativity. At FSU, there’s the excitement of being part of a vibrant academic and professional community, surrounded by people whose ideas are shaping tomorrow’s news!

Learn more about Florida State University and our campuses.

Anticipated Salary Range

The anticipated salary range for this position is around $50,000 annually, commensurate with education and experience.

FSU Total Rewards

FSU offers a robust Total Rewards package. Visit our FSU Total Rewards website to learn more about our Compensation, Benefits, Wellness, Recognition, and Employee Development programs.

Use our FSU Total Compensation Calculator to calculate Total Compensation options based on potential salary, benefits and retirement contributions, earned leave, and other employment-related perks.

How To Apply

If qualified and interested in a specific job opening as advertised, apply through the FSU Careers site (jobs.fsu.edu). If you are a current FSU employee, apply through myFSU Self Service.

Applicants are required to complete the online application with all applicable information. Applications must include all work history up to ten years, and education details even if attaching a resume.

Considerations

This is an A&P position.

This position requires successful completion of a criminal history background check.

This position is being re-advertised. Previous applicants need not reapply.

Equal Employment Opportunity

FSU is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most. We pioneered the way consumers shopped for term life insurance, and now, we also help people find home insurance, auto insurance, senior health insurance and more. Our quick and easy process saves consumers both time and money, and today, more than 2 million families trust us to help them with their insurance needs.

But what truly sets us apart is our people, and the opportunities to grow your career with SelectQuote are unmatched.

About The Role

The Operations Analyst II is responsible for developing and delivering analytical findings creating and maintaining multiple reports and working with a variety of stakeholders to identify areas of advancement on topics ranging from data infrastructure to business strategy decisions.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain performance metrics reporting for the sales and customer service support teams
  • Prepare quantitative analysis using Microsoft Excel, SQL and other analytic & visualization tools to develop meaningful insights of various program performance
  • Provide forward-looking and historical analysis for strategic initiatives through modeling and sensitivity tool usage
  • Produce clear and concise presentations regarding projects and other assigned tasks
  • Provide ad hoc analytical support to various teams throughout the business
  • Create reporting for key performance indicators, monitor results and provide analysis of results to company stakeholders
  • Define benchmarks for success within the division using historical analysis
  • Collaborate with department leaders to build, analyze, and defend strategy and business cases for new initiatives, workflow enhancements, technological enhancements, etc.
  • Translate high level business problems into meaningful analysis and provide recommendations to stakeholders
  • Complete assigned tasks quickly and with a sense of urgency
  • Develop expert knowledge of business processes, data generated within each process, and flow of data within the database

Skills/Abilities

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills especially relating to presentation development
  • High level of self-motivation; ability to accomplish goals independently
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset; a high degree of accuracy is required in all functions
  • Ability to explain complex concepts and data to key stakeholders to assist in decision making
  • High level of curiosity and problem-solving aptitude
  • Resourcefulness and ability to push through ambiguity and find answers independently
  • Vocal and Consistent contributor of ideas to help solve problems and generate solutions
  • Team player; must be able to contribute to the team and rely on others to achieve objectives

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required preferably in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or related field (or related YOE)
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in analyst role (finance, operations, business, or equivalent) required
  • Experience working with technical applications and programming languages like PowerBI, Tableau, Python R, etc. highly preferred

Physical Requirements

Work is performed indoors with potential for exposure to safety and health hazards related to office work. Could periodically travel to other office and operational sites. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:

The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. At Wilson Elser, we are redefining what it means to work at a national law firm. With more than 1,400 attorneys across 46 offices nationwide, we are recognized among the top 100 law firms by The American Lawyer and ranked #30 in the National Law Journal’s survey of the nation’s largest law firms.

Our continued success is built on a culture of collaboration, innovation, client service, and mutual respect. We are committed to fostering an environment where employees are empowered to grow their careers, contribute meaningfully, and thrive professionally.

 

Summary

Data Analyst opportunity focused on turning raw data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will collect, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, uncover trends and patterns and present your findings in ways that help leadership make informed business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with proficiency in data visualization tools and excellent communication skills – able to make complex data clear and actionable in support of the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI,
    Tableau, or Excel.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and provide
    actionable insights.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements to data collection and management
    processes.
  • Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning through data analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics or related field.
  • 1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing databases.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence tools.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for developing reports to support management decision making. Key responsibilities include performing all phases of the report development process including participating in client meetings to understand needs and develop requirements, performing data research and data discovery, data sourcing including data automation, creating report visualizations, and managing report deployment including user on-boarding. Job expectations include developing, maintaining, or enhancing components of large reporting platforms to deliver comprehensive end-to-end reporting solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Designs, develops, and maintains innovative automated reports, dashboards, and scorecards using Business Intelligence tools including MicroStrategy and Tableau
  • Designs, develops, and maintains automated data Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes from various database platforms, storing data in ‘Fit for Use’ relational tables
  • Analyzes disparate database sources including relational structures, dimensional data models, and cubes
  • Designs and builds relational data models to support the development of actionable reports, dashboards, and scorecards
  • Partners with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Creates and maintains required standard documentation including metadata, detailed workflows documenting program, and desktop procedures
  • Works collaboratively in a cross-functional team, learns from colleagues, and provides routine updates on calls related to projects

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 year direct experience with such applications as Alteryx, Tableau, SQL & SAS
  • Minimum of 3 years of data reporting experience

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with LoanIQ, Data and Database

Skills:

  • Automation
  • Data Mining
  • Data Quality Management
  • Data Visualization
  • Reporting
  • Agile Practices
  • Attention to Detail
  • DevOps Practices
  • Production Support
  • Technical Documentation
  • Business Acumen
  • Business Process Analysis
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Innovative Thinking
  • Quality Assurance

Minimum Education Requirement:

  • High School Diploma / GED / Secondary School or equivalent

Shift:

1st shift (United States of America)

Hours Per Week:

40

descriptionHtml:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:

  • State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
  • State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
  • State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
  • State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
  • State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
  • State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
  • State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
  • State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
  • Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
  • State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
  • State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
  • State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
  • State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
  • Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000

The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.

EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Vet. Principal Applicants Only.

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications. The Analyst will work with several databases to pull and integrate data, statistical analysis and data modeling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.
  • Determine, write and present report results with key findings and trends to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Complete multiple concurrent ad-hoc analyses, provide corresponding reports based on customer specifications, determine and communicate analytical conclusions and recommendations.
  • Develop beginner to intermediate level reports and ad-hoc analysis based on specifications outlined by department management. Automate such reports and ensure that they are performed and delivered on schedule.
  • Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
  • Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to converse and write fluently in English.
  • Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree Required. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred.
  • Demonstrated use of analytical software. SAS or SQL preferred.
  • Experience in Power BI, Tableau or similar software preferred.1-2 years of related experience preferred.

CommunityCare is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin

descriptionHtml:
Michael Best is seeking a Financial Data Analyst to work in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee or Waukesha offices! The Financial Data Analyst supports the Firm’s financial reporting, budgeting, and analytical functions while helping develop and maintain the technical reporting solutions used by Finance & Accounting. Reporting to the Financial Reporting & Analysis Supervisor, this role prepares recurring and ad hoc financial reports, assists with the annual budget, analyzes financial and operational data, writes SQL queries, supports Power BI and other reporting tools, validates data, and helps improve reporting processes. The position combines foundational accounting and financial analysis with hands-on data and reporting work and is suited for an early-career professional with practical experience who wants to grow both financial and technical expertise.


Core responsibilities:

  • Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages used to evaluate Firm, practice group, client, department, and individual performance.
  • Produce recurring and customized financial and operational reports for internal stakeholders and external requests.
  • Support development of the annual budget by gathering assumptions, building and maintaining budget schedules and models, consolidating submissions, and analyzing proposed results.
  • Assist with forecasts, budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, and follow-up with budget owners.
  • Analyze general ledger, revenue, expense, productivity, and other financial data; investigate variances and reconcile reporting results to source systems.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to extract, combine, validate, troubleshoot, and analyze financial data. SQL knowledge is required for this role.
  • Gather and summarize information for surveys, RFP responses, client reporting requests, peer benchmarking, and ad hoc business questions.


Stakeholder partnership:

  • Collaborate with Accounting, Billing, Financial Applications, Legal Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver accurate reporting solutions.
  • Work with department leaders and budget owners to collect budget information, explain report results, and resolve data or reporting questions.
  • Maintain a responsive, service-oriented approach and communicate financial and technical information clearly to non-technical users.


Programs/initiatives:

  • Participate in testing, data validation, documentation, and implementation of reporting enhancements, system changes, and integrations.


Process, tools, and reporting:

  • Use SQL, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and financial systems to develop, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, budget models, and analytical tools.
  • Create and maintain SQL queries, data extracts, reporting datasets, and recurring processes with appropriate validation and documentation.
  • Support data imports, exports, interfaces, reconciliations, reporting structures, account and expense coding, and other data-quality processes.
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues, identify root causes, test corrections, and help users understand results.


Continuous improvement / strategy:

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, budgeting, reconciliation, and data-preparation activities.
  • Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, financial models, and reporting processes that increase accuracy, efficiency, and usability.
  • Build knowledge of the Firm’s financial systems, data structures, accounting processes, and business intelligence tools.


Job Requirements:


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a comparable business or applied sciences discipline required.


Experience:

  • One to three years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, reporting, data analysis, or financial systems work preferred. Relevant internships combined with post-graduate professional experience may be considered.
  • Working knowledge of accounting concepts, financial statements, general ledger data, reconciliations, and budget development.
  • Required experience writing and executing SQL queries against relational databases. Candidates must be able to use SQL to retrieve, join, filter, validate, and analyze data.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, charts, and analysis of large data sets.
  • Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or a similar reporting or business intelligence platform preferred.
  • Experience with Aderant Expert or another financial, accounting, billing, or ERP system preferred.
  • Law firm or professional services experience preferred but not required.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect financial results to underlying data.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accurate, well-documented work.
  • Ability to manage recurring deadlines while responding to ad hoc requests and changing priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data and financial information to varied audiences.
  • Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in accounting, budgeting, SQL, reporting tools, and financial systems.
  • Collaborative, service-oriented approach and sound judgment about when to resolve an issue independently or escalate it.
  • Required: Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively to improve quality, efficiency, and decision-making, consistent with organizational policies, confidentiality, and applicable laws.


The Company

This is an opportunity to work with the Best. We are Michael Best & Friedrich, LLP. We are a full-service law firm with more than 350 lawyers and technical professionals who work in collaborative, interdisciplinary practices to serve clients around the world.


We work with companies in all kinds of industries, as well as trade associations, nonprofits, educational institutions, governments, family trusts, and high-net-worth individuals. Since our firm’s founding in 1848, we’ve continuously evolved to meet our clients’ changing needs and expectations. One thing remains the same: For generations, clients have relied on Michael Best for exceptional legal service and business acumen.


The Location

We have offices in Wisconsin (Green Bay, Madison, Milwaukee, Waukesha); Illinois (Chicago); Utah (Salt Lake City); Colorado (Denver, Broomfield); Texas (Austin); North Carolina (Charlotte, Durham, Raleigh, Wilmington); California (Los Angeles); Nebraska (Lincoln); New York (New York City); and Washington DC. Our contemporary office spaces are ideal for concentration and collaboration; supporting our culture of working together to make great things happen for our Clients. This position can be based in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee, or Waukesha offices.


Why You Should Apply

At Michael Best, we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards package that provides a variety of resources designed to enhance its employees’ overall well-being, both at work and at home. Competitive base pay, outstanding benefits, opportunities for learning and growth, programs designed to help you plan for the future, and perks that inspire your downtime are all part of our total compensation package.


Learning and Growth

  • Challenging and Dynamic Role
  • Career Development Planning
  • Professional Growth Opportunities
  • Performance Management and Coaching
  • Specialized Training Programs

Health & Wellness

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision Care
  • Health Savings Accounts
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Wellness Program
  • Employee and Family Assistance Program

Total Compensation

  • Competitive Base Pay
  • Annual Merit Review/Incentive Pay
  • Outstanding Benefits
  • Generous PTO Plus 10 Paid Holidays

Planning for the Future

  • 401(k) with Company Contribution
  • Short Term Disability Plan
  • Long Term Disability Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Parental/Family Leave

Culture and Workplace

  • Respected organization with Collaborative Culture
  • Growing Firm with an Exciting Future
  • Contemporary Work Environment
  • Positive and Respectful Work Climate
  • Performance Recognition


For California, Colorado, District of Columbia, and Illinois applicants only: The annual compensation range for a Policy Advisor in our California, Colorado, District of Columbia, and Illinois offices is between $60,000 and $85,000. The salary range reflects our good-faith expectation for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation will depend on experience, skills, and internal equity. Policy Advisors are eligible to participate in Michael Best’s bonus program, subject to the program’s conditions and restrictions. This position is considered full-time and is therefore eligible to participate in employer-sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, vision, as well as elective/voluntary life, disability, accident coverage, paid holidays, paid time off, and eligible reimbursements. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in the firm's 401k plan. Application review will begin on 10/7/2026 and will continue until the position is filled. To be considered for this position, please submit an application via our online portal.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:

  • State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
  • State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
  • State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
  • State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000

  • State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
  • State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
  • State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
  • Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
  • State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
  • State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
  • State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
  • State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
  • Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000

The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for developing reports to support management decision making. Key responsibilities include performing all phases of the report development process including participating in client meetings to understand needs and develop requirements, performing data research and data discovery, data sourcing including data automation, creating report visualizations, and managing report deployment including user on-boarding. Job expectations include developing, maintaining, or enhancing components of large reporting platforms to deliver comprehensive end-to-end reporting solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Designs, develops, and maintains innovative automated reports, dashboards, and scorecards using Business Intelligence tools including MicroStrategy and Tableau
  • Designs, develops, and maintains automated data Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes from various database platforms, storing data in ‘Fit for Use’ relational tables
  • Analyzes disparate database sources including relational structures, dimensional data models, and cubes
  • Designs and builds relational data models to support the development of actionable reports, dashboards, and scorecards
  • Partners with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Creates and maintains required standard documentation including metadata, detailed workflows documenting program, and desktop procedures
  • Works collaboratively in a cross-functional team, learns from colleagues, and provides routine updates on calls related to projects

  • Minimum 3 year direct experience with such applications as Alteryx, Tableau, SQL & SAS
