Michael Best is seeking a Financial Data Analyst to work in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee or Waukesha offices! The Financial Data Analyst supports the Firm’s financial reporting, budgeting, and analytical functions while helping develop and maintain the technical reporting solutions used by Finance & Accounting. Reporting to the Financial Reporting & Analysis Supervisor, this role prepares recurring and ad hoc financial reports, assists with the annual budget, analyzes financial and operational data, writes SQL queries, supports Power BI and other reporting tools, validates data, and helps improve reporting processes. The position combines foundational accounting and financial analysis with hands-on data and reporting work and is suited for an early-career professional with practical experience who wants to grow both financial and technical expertise.


Core responsibilities:

  • Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages used to evaluate Firm, practice group, client, department, and individual performance.
  • Produce recurring and customized financial and operational reports for internal stakeholders and external requests.
  • Support development of the annual budget by gathering assumptions, building and maintaining budget schedules and models, consolidating submissions, and analyzing proposed results.
  • Assist with forecasts, budget-to-actual reporting, variance analysis, and follow-up with budget owners.
  • Analyze general ledger, revenue, expense, productivity, and other financial data; investigate variances and reconcile reporting results to source systems.
  • Write and execute SQL queries to extract, combine, validate, troubleshoot, and analyze financial data. SQL knowledge is required for this role.
  • Gather and summarize information for surveys, RFP responses, client reporting requests, peer benchmarking, and ad hoc business questions.


Stakeholder partnership:

  • Collaborate with Accounting, Billing, Financial Applications, Legal Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver accurate reporting solutions.
  • Work with department leaders and budget owners to collect budget information, explain report results, and resolve data or reporting questions.
  • Maintain a responsive, service-oriented approach and communicate financial and technical information clearly to non-technical users.


Programs/initiatives:

  • Participate in testing, data validation, documentation, and implementation of reporting enhancements, system changes, and integrations.


Process, tools, and reporting:

  • Use SQL, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and financial systems to develop, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, budget models, and analytical tools.
  • Create and maintain SQL queries, data extracts, reporting datasets, and recurring processes with appropriate validation and documentation.
  • Support data imports, exports, interfaces, reconciliations, reporting structures, account and expense coding, and other data-quality processes.
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues, identify root causes, test corrections, and help users understand results.


Continuous improvement / strategy:

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, budgeting, reconciliation, and data-preparation activities.
  • Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, financial models, and reporting processes that increase accuracy, efficiency, and usability.
  • Build knowledge of the Firm’s financial systems, data structures, accounting processes, and business intelligence tools.


Job Requirements:


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a comparable business or applied sciences discipline required.


Experience:

  • One to three years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, reporting, data analysis, or financial systems work preferred. Relevant internships combined with post-graduate professional experience may be considered.
  • Working knowledge of accounting concepts, financial statements, general ledger data, reconciliations, and budget development.
  • Required experience writing and executing SQL queries against relational databases. Candidates must be able to use SQL to retrieve, join, filter, validate, and analyze data.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, charts, and analysis of large data sets.
  • Experience with Power BI, SSRS, or a similar reporting or business intelligence platform preferred.
  • Experience with Aderant Expert or another financial, accounting, billing, or ERP system preferred.
  • Law firm or professional services experience preferred but not required.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect financial results to underlying data.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accurate, well-documented work.
  • Ability to manage recurring deadlines while responding to ad hoc requests and changing priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data and financial information to varied audiences.
  • Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in accounting, budgeting, SQL, reporting tools, and financial systems.
  • Collaborative, service-oriented approach and sound judgment about when to resolve an issue independently or escalate it.
  • Required: Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively to improve quality, efficiency, and decision-making, consistent with organizational policies, confidentiality, and applicable laws.


The Company

This is an opportunity to work with the Best. We are Michael Best & Friedrich, LLP. We are a full-service law firm with more than 350 lawyers and technical professionals who work in collaborative, interdisciplinary practices to serve clients around the world.


We work with companies in all kinds of industries, as well as trade associations, nonprofits, educational institutions, governments, family trusts, and high-net-worth individuals. Since our firm’s founding in 1848, we’ve continuously evolved to meet our clients’ changing needs and expectations. One thing remains the same: For generations, clients have relied on Michael Best for exceptional legal service and business acumen.


The Location

We have offices in Wisconsin (Green Bay, Madison, Milwaukee, Waukesha); Illinois (Chicago); Utah (Salt Lake City); Colorado (Denver, Broomfield); Texas (Austin); North Carolina (Charlotte, Durham, Raleigh, Wilmington); California (Los Angeles); Nebraska (Lincoln); New York (New York City); and Washington DC. Our contemporary office spaces are ideal for concentration and collaboration; supporting our culture of working together to make great things happen for our Clients. This position can be based in any of our Chicago, Madison, Milwaukee, or Waukesha offices.


Why You Should Apply

At Michael Best, we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards package that provides a variety of resources designed to enhance its employees’ overall well-being, both at work and at home. Competitive base pay, outstanding benefits, opportunities for learning and growth, programs designed to help you plan for the future, and perks that inspire your downtime are all part of our total compensation package.


Learning and Growth

  • Challenging and Dynamic Role
  • Career Development Planning
  • Professional Growth Opportunities
  • Performance Management and Coaching
  • Specialized Training Programs

Health & Wellness

  • Medical

  • Vision Care
  • Health Savings Accounts
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Wellness Program
  • Employee and Family Assistance Program

Total Compensation

  • Competitive Base Pay
  • Annual Merit Review/Incentive Pay
  • Outstanding Benefits
  • Generous PTO Plus 10 Paid Holidays

Planning for the Future

  • 401(k) with Company Contribution
  • Short Term Disability Plan
  • Long Term Disability Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Parental/Family Leave

Culture and Workplace

  • Respected organization with Collaborative Culture
  • Growing Firm with an Exciting Future
  • Contemporary Work Environment
  • Positive and Respectful Work Climate
  • Performance Recognition

  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Help teams make high-stakes migration decisions with clear, reliable analytics. In this role, you will turn complex portfolio and project data into insights that improve planning, execution, and risk visibility. You will partner with cross-functional teams to build practical reporting and dashboard solutions that support specialists and leaders. If you enjoy disciplined data handling and thoughtful storytelling, you'll have opportunities to make a measurable impact.

As a Migration Data Analytics Associate in the Client Migration Data & Analytics team, you translate business questions into clear analysis, reporting, and decision-ready materials that support client migration execution. You help identify trends, exceptions, risks, and data quality concerns, and you deliver recurring and ad hoc insights used by migration teams and leaders. You contribute to scalable analytics solutions while maintaining strong controls, documentation, and responsible use of approved tools.

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze portfolio, project, client, and migration data to identify trends, gaps, exceptions, dependencies, and emerging risks requiring review or escalation
  • Review migration populations and readiness indicators to highlight concerns, support planning, and inform follow-up actions
  • Design, test, document, and enhance analytics solutions such as SharePoint Online lists/sites, dashboards, and recurring reporting views
  • Translate stakeholder requests into defined data needs, analysis approaches, visualizations, extracts, and leadership-ready materials
  • Prepare presentations, briefing materials, written narratives, and visual summaries that explain findings, implications, and decision points
  • Use approved AI-enabled tools to support analysis and narrative development, while validating outputs and following data protection requirements
  • Collect, organize, reconcile, and validate inputs from product, operations, technology, and project teams before using them in analytics or reporting
  • Perform data quality checks, document assumptions and limitations, investigate anomalies, and escalate material issues to the appropriate owner
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc data extracts with clear definitions, filters, source references, version control, and delivery notes
  • Maintain controlled analytics artifacts, including repositories, data dictionaries, requirements, run instructions, change logs, and evidence of approvals where required
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve repeatability through improved data structures, workflow automation, templates, and other approved tools

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

Job Description

The Senior Financial Reporting Analyst is responsible for owning key reporting and compliance deliverables end to end, ensuring financial reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, and delivered on established timelines. This role leads preparation of complex schedules (including covenant reporting packages and board/owner reporting), performs analytical reviews and data validation, and drives standardization and continuous improvement in partnership with BI and upstream data owners.

This role performs work under minimal supervision and handles complex issues and problems, referring only the most complex issues to higher-level staff.

Experience Is Everything.

At LCS, experience is everything. We provide you the opportunity to use your talents in a progressive, growing organization that makes a positive difference in the lives of the seniors we serve. If you are seeking an organization that gives back, you’ll love working here. Our principles and hospitality promises define our company culture. LCS employees can be found participating in volunteer activities, getting involved in our committees or collaborating with team members in our innovative workspace. You’ll find several opportunities to grow as a professional, serve the community, and enhance the lives of seniors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own assigned monthly CAM reporting deliverables, including data validation, variance investigation, and stakeholder follow ups
  • Prepare board/owner packet schedules and respond to non standard board/owner reporting requirements with strong documentation and controls
  • Prepare and submit assigned regulatory and industry reports, ensuring compliance with defined formats, deadlines, and supporting documentation
  • Prepare medical expense deduction datasets and insurance claim reporting packages; ensure completeness, consistency, and traceability to source systems
  • Prepare debt covenant calculations and lender/holder reporting packages, maintaining an audit trail of inputs, definitions, and adjustments
  • Perform exception reporting and data governance checks between systems; coordinate resolution of data issues with BI, IT, and source process owners
  • Maintain and continuously improve reporting calendars, trackers, templates, and standard work instructions
  • Support third party compliance activities (sales & use tax, personal property tax, unclaimed property, renewals/appeals) by providing accurate schedules, reconciling support, and coordinating information requests
  • Support due diligence financial requests by preparing
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent years of experience
  • 4-6 of progressive accounting, reporting, audit, or finance experience
  • Strong working knowledge of GAAP and financial statement mechanics
  • Demonstrated experience independently owning
  • Complex journal entries, reconciliations, or reporting deliverables
  • Regulatory, audit, or compliance driven documentation or
  • Transaction, contract, or transition related accounting activities (by COE)
  • Demonstrated ability to independently apply professional judgment within owned reporting and compliance deliverables and resolve complex issues with minimal supervision
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy with ability to interpret financial results to identify, explain and resolve accounting issues
  • High documentation quality and audit readiness discipline
  • Ability to independently analyze discrepancies and resolve reconciling items
  • Effective time management and ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision, especially during close cycles
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team and respond to requests from leadership
  • Professional judgment, discretion, and willingness to learn
  • Possesses comprehensive knowledge of subject matter.
  • Preferred qualifications
  • Experience with reporting/BI tools and ERP systems

Why Join Us?

  • Industry Leader.
  • Inclusive & collaborative culture.
  • Top Workplace USA.
  • Top Workplace Iowa.
  • Charity and community involvement.
  • Outstanding advancement opportunities.
  • Ongoing career development.

Benefits

Competitive pay, great benefits and vacation time. We are an equal opportunity employer with benefits including medical, dental, life insurance, disability, 401(K) with company match and paid parental leave.

Our Commitment

LCS creates living experiences that enhance the lives of seniors. You’ll see this commitment in our people. They’re talented, dedicated professionals who truly care about residents, with each conducting his or her work with integrity, honesty and transparency according to the principles of LCS. We strive to help every community succeed—strengthening available resources, establishing proven practices that lead to long-term growth and value for those living in, working for and affiliated with the community. Check us out on our website: https://www.lcsliving.com

Additional Information

Travel frequency: 0-10%

Estimated Salary: $74,000 - $93,000

The actual title & salary will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors.

Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:

  • State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
  • State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
  • State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
  • State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
  • State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000
  • State of Maryland: $113,000 - $171,000
  • State of Massachusetts: $116,000 - $222,000
  • State of Minnesota: $116,000 - $192,000
  • Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000
  • State of New York: $108,000 - $234,000
  • State of Vermont: $115,000 - $220,000
  • State of Virginia: $76,000 - $220,000
  • State of Washington: $113,000 - $214,000
  • Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000

The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Please include a cover letter and resume when applying.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for providing reporting support including leading the development work for automated reporting solutions serving one or more lines of business or business disciplines. Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining systems of knowledge delivered via easy to navigate automated self-serve business intelligence solutions. Job expectations include working with business partners to understand client needs, creating solutions to meet those needs and leading aspects of the end to end development and deployment of the required reporting and analytical solutions.

LOB Description: GCO (Global Credit Operations):Responsible for the fulfillment, servicing and protection of credit offerings for business banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), commercial and corporate clients as well as leasing and trade products.

Responsibilities:

  • Leads critical aspects in the development and maintenance of innovative automated business intelligence solutions, supporting data-driven business decisions
  • Designs, develops, and maintains automated data Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes from various database platforms, storing data in ‘Fit for Use’ relational tables
  • Leads analysis of disparate database sources including relational structures, dimensional data models, and cubes
  • Ensures on-time delivery of work while following established procedures and quality guidelines

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

WHAT WE’RE DOING

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we're on a mission to drive innovation and uphold the highest standards of business ethics. We believe that by pushing the boundaries of visionary thinking, we can achieve exceptional results. As a Lockheed Martin employee, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working in an environment that values integrity and excellence.

THE WORK

  • We are seeking a highly skilled data analyst with strong expertise in VBA, Python, SQL, Power Query (M Code), and PowerApps/PowerFX, and SAP HANA.
  • This role serves as a data liaison across cross‑functional groups, employing scripting, coding, and AI‑enabled inspection tools to automate data extraction, trend analysis, and reporting, thereby reducing manual effort and accelerating decision‑making.
  • The candiate with be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive solutions that answer manufacturing related questions/needs.
  • One major responsibility will be to keep existing production and quality reports up‑to‑date in Power BI, Excel, PowerApps, etc.
  • Candidate will perform data validation, reconcile source systems, and ensure data integrity.
  • As manufacturing needs change, this individual will write VBA macros, Python scripts, Power Query (M Code) to pull data from SAP HANA, MES, and legacy databases.

Who We Are

We are a world class manufacturing center. Our customers are world-wide and so is our reputation for creating innovative solutions with the latest technologies. Our products keep our customers safe and bring them home to their families at night. We provide the resources, inspiration, and focus - if you have the resourcefulness and perseverance to work hard, then we want to create a better tomorrow with you.

Who You Are

You possess manufacturing knowledge, critical thinking skills, and demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement.

WHY JOIN US

In addition to the responsibilities highlighted above we offer extensive benefits that include competitive 401k, health and dental insurance and 4/10 work schedule.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 4 years of hands‑on experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Proficient with VBA, Python, SQL, and Power Query (M Code)
  • Proven adapability - Comfortable working in ambiguous “gray‑area” situations and bridging functional gaps.
  • No formal degree required; equivalent experience and demonstrable expertise will be considered.

Desired Skills

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt trained/certified
  • Ability to leverage LM approved AI tools to enhance code and create quick turn-around on manufacturing requests (Cognition Devin, LM Navigator, AI Assist, etc.)
  • Experience with SAP BusinessObjects
  • InfoPath / PowerApp experience

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $70500.00 - $130900.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

descriptionHtml:
Find YOUR fit at Ohio Machinery Co.!  Join a winning culture that strives to be the top-performing, dynamic industry leader and partner of choice for the products and solutions that help our customers build, improve, feed, power, and protect our world.  Come grow your career - See what opportunities await today! 

This role is on‑site and requires current residence in Cleveland, Ohio 
Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We do not provide employment sponsorship for this role. Summary: The BI Analyst will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help identify, plan, and implement strategic dashboards that drive business goals and results. Success will be measured through demonstrating talent at making data understandable and will be accomplished by utilizing available tools to access and analyze data sets that present analytical findings through reports, dashboards, graphs, charts, and maps that provide stakeholders with detailed intelligence about the state of the business. Essential Functions and Responsibilities:
  • Develops end-to-end new reports and dashboards and modifies existing reports and dashboards, utilizing Microsoft Reporting Services, Power BI, and others.
  • Identifies the most impactful layout and presentation of key metrics and translates that vision into easy-to-use self-service reports or dashboards.
  • Serves as subject matter expert for BI solutions and capabilities.
  • Provides analytics, business intelligence, and data visualization for data-driven decision-making.
  • Provides analytic and data consultation to other business areas, leadership, or external customers.
  • Investigates business issues and determine the best way to develop appropriate diagnostic and/or tracking data that will translate business requirements into usable decision-support tools.
  • Designs, constructs, and maintains data views and/or data models.
  • Supports BI solutions by monitoring and tuning queries and investigating data integrity.
  • Writes data requirements for data warehouse and ETL processes.
  • Establishes and continually expands/enhances knowledge of data warehouses, BI and enterprise applications, data, queries/programming, and organizational structure.
  • Produces standard reports according to calendar; ensures accuracy and timeliness of output and deliverables for assigned functional areas.
  • Ensures the integrity and security of enterprise data on host computers, databases, and data transfers by business needs and industry best practices regarding privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Conducts research on emerging products, services, and analytic tools in support of systems and development efforts.
  • Develops, documents, and maintains policies, procedures, and associated training plans for dashboard administration and appropriate use.
  • Provides guidance and serves as an escalation to the Help Desk.
  • Performs research and analysis in the development of program and/or project activities.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned. 
Minimum Skills and Qualifications: 
  • A high school diploma or equivalent is required; Bachelors’ degree in related field is preferred. 
  • Five or more years’ experience; or combination of education, experience, and equivalent background is required.
  • Hands-on experience developing/maintaining strategic reports and dashboards.
  • A highly qualified candidate would be familiar with using MS Analysis Services, Reporting Services, Excel (Pivot Tables), Power BI, and other related business intelligence software.
  • Ideal candidates combine business acumen with technical skills to produce data visualizations that facilitate business decisions.
  • Experience with relational databases and knowledge of query tools and statistical software is required.
  • Full project management and development life cycle experience.
  • Experience with data processing flowcharting techniques and the ability to manipulate large sets of data.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Preference will be given to candidates who provide sample data visualizations.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining configuration and process information with the ability to translate business goals into actionable BI use cases.
  • Knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and laws. 
  • Some after-hours and weekend on-call availability in support of BI systems.
  • Reliable transportation and freedom to travel overnight a few times per year for training and related meetings with stakeholders.
  • Must have excellent communication skills both verbal and written, and interpersonal, time management, multi-tasking, and attention to detail skills. 
Employee Benefits:
  • 401(k): Match and employer discretionary contribution. 
  • Health Insurance: Two options are available, including an HSA with a dollar-for-dollar match of up to $1,200 per year. 
  • Dental & Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage options. 
  • Financial Access: Credit Union membership is available. 
  • Insurance: Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability coverage. 
  • Educational Opportunities: Scholarships for employees’ spouses and children through the Ohio Machinery Education and Opportunity Foundation. 
  • Compensation: Base pay, annual bonus potential, and company success share bonuses. 
Physical Requirements:
  • Sitting for extended periods of time.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and to handle other computer components.
  • Lifting and transporting of moderately heavy objects, such as computers and peripherals.

  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Help deliver transparent, accurate financial and regulatory reports that stakeholders rely on. You'll partner across teams to uphold a strong control environment and drive improvements in data quality and reporting processes.

As an External Reporting Controller, you'll consolidate and analyze quarterly financial results and coordinate inputs across partners to support timely, high-quality external submissions. You'll apply current product, industry, and market knowledge in specialty reporting areas and use clear, inclusive communication to surface issues early. You'll also reinforce proof and control procedures and support process improvements that strengthen reporting integrity and efficiency.

Job Responsibilities

  • Consolidate, review, and analyze quarterly financial data, including quarter-over-quarter variance analysis
  • Coordinate data collection and quarterly business results with lines of business and external/regulatory reporting partners
  • Apply current product, industry, and market knowledge to specialty external reporting topics
  • Support preparation, review, and submission of monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual regulatory reports (e.g., Call Report, FR Y 9C, Pillar 3)
  • Execute proof and control procedures to reconcile regulatory filings to other published financial reports (e.g., Forms 10 Q and 10 K)
  • Interpret regulatory and U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) requirements and help coordinate supporting internal policies and documentation
  • Build strong relationships with business partners and regulatory stakeholders; communicate financial information clearly and flag issues proactively

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Finance, including exposure to accounting, financial statements, and/or regulatory reporting
  • Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including presenting financial information and surfacing risks/issues
  • Strong time management and organization skills, with the ability to deliver under deadlines in a control-focused environment

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Experience supporting external, SEC, and/or bank regulatory reporting deliverables
  • Familiarity with governance, controls, and reconciliation practices in financial reporting
  • Experience partnering across multiple stakeholders to coordinate inputs and resolve issues

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Standard Job Description

The Infrastructure Technology Experience and Enablement (ITxN) team is hiring an experienced Data Analyst Sr. This role is part of a small, motivated team of architects, engineers, and developers who are focused on the design, development, and deployment of infrastructure and supporting automation capabilities across both the Enterprise and Business Area ecosystems.

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will working with the automations and network operations team and supporting various important databases. Your responsibilities will include (but not be limited to) the following:

  • Working with all business areas to clean and represent appropriate data
  • Timely updating critical information
  • Working with change management teams across the enterprise to properly document and update site and device specific data

This role will require close attention to detail, collaboration with leadership, and experience manipulating Service Central forms and applications.

Further Information About This Opportunity

This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to system access.

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems.Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule

Basic Qualifications

  • Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (or ServiceCentral) – daily usage and administration.
  • Documented experience in ServiceNow, integrating with JavaScript and databases.
  • Strong understanding of configuration management databases (CMDB’s) and IT Service Management (ITSM) databases.
  • Proven ability to build and script catalog items (UI policies, client scripts, flow, etc.)
  • Testing experience and intake requirements.
  • Continuous process improvement amongst the various BA’s using the approved services.
  • Data analysis- identifying, parsing, understanding, and documenting data important to both ServiceNow and the associated application.
  • Communicating with wide audiences on a regular basis about CMDB and data governance.

Desired Skills

  • Ability to receive requirements for, design, deploy and maintain new applications using Python and GIT as a repository.
  • Experience with governance review panels
  • Excellent written and verbal abilities for interfacing with network and systems engineers, cyber security, senior leadership, and program leadership across all Business Areas.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification.
  • Experience integrating ServiceNow with external systems (APIs, middleware, etc.).
  • Dashboard and report creation and maintenance through ServiceNow and other applications.
  • Cisco Networking Experience (Foundational)
  • Strong sense of self-management while being able to support the team and autonomously support multiple projects.

Pay Information

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $76700.00 - $142500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Ocala, FL; Lufkin, TX; etc.

descriptionHtml:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in advancing the organization's regulatory reporting, data quality, and analytical capabilities. This position owns the end-to-end transformation of complex policy, claims, underwriting, and financial data into accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory submissions while driving improvements in data processes, governance, and reporting standards.

As a senior analytical professional, this role combines advanced data analysis, data engineering, insurance domain expertise, and business insight to solve complex data challenges, influence decision-making, and identify opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance. The Senior Data Analyst serves as a trusted partner to business and technical stakeholders and provides mentorship and guidance to analysts across the organization.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design and execute advanced analyses to support regulatory reporting, compliance initiatives, and strategic business decisions.
  • Transform complex business requirements into scalable data solutions, analytical frameworks, and actionable insights.
  • Analyze policy, claims, underwriting, financial, and operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, reconciliations, and datasets to improve performance, scalability, and reusability.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Application teams to design and implement data enrichment, transformation, and integration solutions.
  • Support and enhance data platforms, reporting processes, and analytical assets using modern data technologies and best practices.
  • Own data preparation, validation, and reconciliation activities supporting statutory reporting, regulatory filings, annual statement reporting, premium tax reporting, market conduct examinations, audits, and ad hoc regulatory requests.
  • Develop deep expertise in Property & Casualty insurance operations, regulatory reporting requirements, and statutory accounting principles.
  • Ensure analytical outputs align with regulatory expectations and support sound business decision-making.
  • Translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable data processes and controls.
  • Independently diagnose data quality, integration, and reporting issues across multiple systems and business functions.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective actions that improve data integrity and reporting accuracy.
  • Design analytical approaches for complex or ambiguous business problems where requirements may be incomplete or evolving.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve efficiency, and enhance data accessibility for business stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships with Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, MGA Operations, Applications, and Data Engineering teams.
  • Effectively communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop clear narratives that connect data insights to regulatory, operational, and business outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions, provide data-driven recommendations, and influence prioritization of data and reporting initiatives.
  • Champion data governance practices and contribute to the development of data standards, controls, documentation, and definitions.
  • Establish and enhance data quality monitoring processes within assigned domains.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for analytical methodologies, reporting practices, and regulatory data requirements.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to analysts by reviewing analytical approaches, sharing best practices, and supporting professional development.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and analytical excellence.

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, business analytics, computer science, actuarial science, finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, or related functions within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory reporting, statutory reporting, compliance initiatives, or financial reporting processes.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance operations and data structures across policy, claims, underwriting, accounting, finance, or actuarial functions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale relational databases, data warehouses, and data transformation methodologies.
  • Experience performing complex data analysis, reconciliation, root-cause investigation, and data quality assessments.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and data storytelling skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in quantitative, analytical, or business-related discipline.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and visualization platforms.
  • Experience with data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality programs.
  • Intermediate or advanced Property & Casualty insurance designations (CPCU, AINS, AU, API, or equivalent).
  • Experience partnering with Actuarial teams and supporting actuarial, financial, or regulatory reporting processes.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering concepts.

Key Competencies

  • Technical & Analytical Skills - Designs advanced analyses, metrics, and scalable data solutions while improving performance, quality, and reusability of datasets and reporting assets.
  • Business Acumen & Domain Knowledge - Applies deep Property & Casualty insurance and regulatory expertise to connect analytical work with broader business objectives and outcomes.
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - Independently solves complex, ambiguous problems and develops analytical approaches from the ground up.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling - Translates complex data into clear, compelling narratives that influence business decisions and drive action.
  • Stakeholder Management & Influence - Builds trusted partnerships across functions, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps guide analytical priorities.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - Provides informal leadership through mentoring, knowledge sharing, review of analytical work, and coaching of other analysts.
  • Data Quality & Governance - Improves data quality standards, governance practices, and reporting controls within the domain.
  • Strategic Thinking & Innovation - Connects analytics to broader organizational goals and identifies high-impact opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational effectiveness.

The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.

  • Chicago Pay Range: $128010.00 - $152,184.00
  • Omaha and Richmond Pay Range: $116,382.00 - $138,414.00
  • Los Angeles and New York City Pay Range: $139,638.00 - $166,260.00

Please Note

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

As a senior analytical professional, this role combines advanced data analysis, data engineering, insurance domain expertise, and business insight to solve complex data challenges, influence decision-making, and identify opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance. The Senior Data Analyst serves as a trusted partner to business and technical stakeholders and provides mentorship and guidance to analysts across the organization.

Essential Responsibilities



- Design and execute advanced analyses to support regulatory reporting, compliance initiatives, and strategic business decisions.
- Transform complex business requirements into scalable data solutions, analytical frameworks, and actionable insights.
- Analyze policy, claims, underwriting, financial, and operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
- Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, reconciliations, and datasets to improve performance, scalability, and reusability.
- Partner with Data Engineering and Application teams to design and implement data enrichment, transformation, and integration solutions.
- Support and enhance data platforms, reporting processes, and analytical assets using modern data technologies and best practices.
- Own data preparation, validation, and reconciliation activities supporting statutory reporting, regulatory filings, annual statement reporting, premium tax reporting, market conduct examinations, audits, and ad hoc regulatory requests.
- Develop deep expertise in Property & Casualty insurance operations, regulatory reporting requirements, and statutory accounting principles.
- Ensure analytical outputs align with regulatory expectations and support sound business decision-making.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable data processes and controls.
- Independently diagnose data quality, integration, and reporting issues across multiple systems and business functions.
- Perform root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective actions that improve data integrity and reporting accuracy.
- Design analytical approaches for complex or ambiguous business problems where requirements may be incomplete or evolving.
- Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve efficiency, and enhance data accessibility for business stakeholders.
- Build strong partnerships with Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, MGA Operations, Applications, and Data Engineering teams.
- Effectively communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Develop clear narratives that connect data insights to regulatory, operational, and business outcomes.
- Challenge assumptions, provide data-driven recommendations, and influence prioritization of data and reporting initiatives.
- Champion data governance practices and contribute to the development of data standards, controls, documentation, and definitions.
- Establish and enhance data quality monitoring processes within assigned domains.
- Serve as a subject matter resource for analytical methodologies, reporting practices, and regulatory data requirements.
- Mentor and provide guidance to analysts by reviewing analytical approaches, sharing best practices, and supporting professional development.
- Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and analytical excellence.

Qualifications & Experience Required



- Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, business analytics, computer science, actuarial science, finance, or a related quantitative field.
- 5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, or related functions within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
- Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory reporting, statutory reporting, compliance initiatives, or financial reporting processes.
- Strong knowledge of insurance operations and data structures across policy, claims, underwriting, accounting, finance, or actuarial functions.
- Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale relational databases, data warehouses, and data transformation methodologies.
- Experience performing complex data analysis, reconciliation, root-cause investigation, and data quality assessments.
- Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
- Strong verbal, written, presentation, and data storytelling skills.

Preferred Qualifications



- Master's degree in quantitative, analytical, or business-related discipline.
- Experience with Snowflake, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and visualization platforms.
- Experience with data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality programs.
- Intermediate or advanced Property & Casualty insurance designations (CPCU, AINS, AU, API, or equivalent).
- Experience partnering with Actuarial teams and supporting actuarial, financial, or regulatory reporting processes.
- Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering concepts.

Key Competencies



- Technical & Analytical Skills - Designs advanced analyses, metrics, and scalable data solutions while improving performance, quality, and reusability of datasets and reporting assets.
- Business Acumen & Domain Knowledge - Applies deep Property & Casualty insurance and regulatory expertise to connect analytical work with broader business objectives and outcomes.
- Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - Independently solves complex, ambiguous problems and develops analytical approaches from the ground up.
- Communication & Data Storytelling - Translates complex data into clear, compelling narratives that influence business decisions and drive action.
- Stakeholder Management & Influence - Builds trusted partnerships across functions, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps guide analytical priorities.
- Leadership & Mentorship - Provides informal leadership through mentoring, knowledge sharing, review of analytical work, and coaching of other analysts.
- Data Quality & Governance - Improves data quality standards, governance practices, and reporting controls within the domain.
- Strategic Thinking & Innovation - Connects analytics to broader organizational goals and identifies high-impact opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational effectiveness.

Description

The Analyst provides entry-level analytical, data management, and operational support to the organization. This role assists with collecting, organizing, and analyzing data; preparing reports; supporting program operations; and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of information used to support mission objectives. The Analyst I works under general supervision and follows established procedures, guidelines, and organizational policies.

  • Collect, review, and validate data from multiple systems and sources.
  • Assist in preparing routine and ad-hoc reports, dashboards, and data summaries.
  • Conduct basic trend analysis, data comparisons, and correlation reviews.
  • Support the development and maintenance of reporting tools and templates.
  • Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with government standards.
  • Maintain and update databases, spreadsheets, and tracking systems.
  • Support data entry, data cleanup, and data normalization efforts.
  • Assist with managing user roles, permissions, and access controls as directed.
  • Document processes, workflows, and data procedures for internal use.
  • Assist staff with research, information gathering, and administrative analysis.
  • Support program evaluations, performance tracking, and operational reviews.
  • Help identify inconsistencies or issues in data and escalate findings appropriately.
  • Participate in meetings, briefings, and working groups as required.
  • Troubleshoot basic reporting or data issues and coordinate with senior analysts for resolution.
  • Assist in evaluating system updates or changes that may impact reporting or data integrity.
  • Provide end-user support for reports, dashboards, and data tools.

The salary for this position is between $60,000 - $65,000 a year.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 1–2 years of relevant analytical experience
  • Ability to successfully complete corporate background investigation to include credit and criminal check
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Government suitability determination/clearance

Additional Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams) and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ability to learn and effectively use government systems, databases, and digital record platforms.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to read, write, understand, in English.
  • Ability to follow detailed written and oral instructions and complete tasks to standard.
  • Capable of performing repetitive tasks independently while maintaining consistency and quality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and collaborate well with others.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Skilled in organizing work, establishing priorities, and maintaining accuracy under strict timelines.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, you may occasionally be required to stand; walk; sit; lift up to 20 lbs.; bend; reach; carry; stoop; kneel; use hands and fingers to handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; use fingers and hands to type or write; speak; or hear. Specific vision abilities may be required to perform this job, which may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, or the ability to adjust focus.

Work Location: In person (onsite)

descriptionHtml:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Senior Analyst, Business Intelligence & Analytics, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, in the Data Analytics group, is responsible for data analytics and data products that support data-informed strategic decision-making across the firm with focused analysis on client profitability, segmentation, market-informed growth analytics, and scalable business intelligence solutions that support the entire firm.

This role supports the firm's analytics and reporting capabilities through the development and enhancement of dashboards, executive scorecards, data models, KPI frameworks, and automated reporting solutions that combine internal financial data with market research, benchmarking, and business development insights.

Working with Revenue, Strategic Finance, Business Development, Pricing, Technology, Finance, and business stakeholders, this position translates client, competitor, and financial analysis into meaningful insights that support data-informed decision-making and consistent self-service reporting.

Location

This position can sit in our New York, Short Hills, or Chicago office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analytical support and reporting for strategic planning initiatives for Vertical leads, the Global Finance Committee Head, Practice Group leadership, and Business Development leadership.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to align analytics products with business priorities.
  • Collaborate with the Manager, Strategic Finance & Market Analytics to align recommendations with business priorities.
  • Conduct profitability analysis across clients, sectors, segmentation, matters, and practices.
  • Analyze and highlight growth opportunities and margin risks using financial, market, and benchmarking data.
  • Translate analytical requirements and outputs for strategic business questions.
  • Develop reusable data models that connect financial, operational, revenue, pricing, and market sources.
  • Support the development of KPI definitions, calculation logic, ownership, and governance standards.

descriptionHtml:
About Partner Forces

Partner Forces is a management consulting firm helping homeland security organizations solve some of their most pressing and complex challenges. We partner with government agencies and industry to strengthen national security and critical infrastructure through expertise in strategy, program management, stakeholder engagement, technology implementation, preparedness, and business transformation.

At Partner Forces, we're more than consultants—we're trusted advisors. We work alongside our clients to solve meaningful problems, deliver actionable solutions, and make a lasting impact. As a growing firm, every employee has the opportunity to contribute not only to our clients' success, but also to the future of Partner Forces. We believe great consultants are developed through collaboration, mentorship, continuous learning, and meaningful opportunities to lead.

Our culture is grounded in six core values: Integrity, Excellence, Positivity, Candor, Determination, and Teamwork. These values shape how we work with our clients, support one another, and grow together. We believe that when our people thrive, our clients do too, which is why we invest in our employees' well-being, professional development, and long-term success.

What We Are Looking For

Partner Forces is seeking a Cleared Data Analytics & Visualization Analyst to support a Department of Homeland Security cybersecurity program. We’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with the communication and consulting skills needed to work directly with customers, understand their needs, and turn data into meaningful insights. This role will initially focus on data analysis, reporting, visualization, and development of analytic products, with the opportunity to evolve into broader technical program and PMO support. The right person does not need to be a software developer, but should be technically curious, comfortable working alongside technical teams, and able to understand and translate conversations about data, systems, and technology.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze program and operational data to identify trends, insights, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, visualizations, and other analytic products that make complex information easier to understand and act on.
  • Engage directly with customers and stakeholders to gather requirements, understand business needs, and translate those needs into useful data and technology solutions.
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Support recurring and ad hoc reporting and help improve or automate existing reporting processes.
  • Work alongside technical teams to understand requirements, dependencies, risks, and priorities across data and software initiatives.
  • Support technical program management activities, including tracking requirements, decisions, deliverables, action items, and project progress.
  • Participate in technical discussions involving databases, data schemas, software systems, integrations, and related technologies.
  • Support data governance, documentation, process development, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Adapt to evolving program needs and take on new responsibilities as the program and technical environment mature.

Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal client suitability/security requirements. Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain DHS suitability. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.
  • Bachelors degree required.
  • Secret clearance required.
  • Experience in data analysis, business analytics, program analysis, or a related field.
  • Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience developing reports, dashboards, or other analytic products.
  • Experience working directly with customers or stakeholders to gather, clarify, and translate requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience with or exposure to Python or R; advanced programming expertise is not required.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability and interest in learning new systems, technologies, and technical concepts.
  • Experience with Power BI, Databricks, ServiceNow, Power Automate, or similar tools preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with database concepts, data schemas, data governance, or software development environments preferred.
  • ServiceNow administration or development experience is a plus.
  • Previous experience supporting federal government clients or exposure to cybersecurity programs is a plus.

Next Steps

If your application looks like a match, someone from our People Operations team will reach out to schedule a phone screening. During this conversation, we will determine if the current or future position aligns with your experience and skills. If things go well, from there you'll meet with members from the project team, including the hiring manager and teammates, and possibly be asked to submit a writing assessment to showcase your practical knowledge. If we find you are a match, you’ll get a call offering you the role. While we wish we could hire every great candidate who comes our way, the reality is that we can't. If you are not selected, we will be sure to connect with you and let you know so you can move on with your search. We will also keep your resume for future needs.

Salary Range & Compensation Philosophy

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000 - 135,000. At Partner Forces, we recognize that every candidate brings a unique combination of skills, experiences, and qualifications. Compensation decisions consider several factors, including years of relevant experience, specialized expertise, clearance level, and the requirements of the role.

We also believe compensation is a starting point, not a finish line. We're committed to recognizing contributions, rewarding strong performance, and creating opportunities for continued growth as our employees develop their skills and careers at Partner Forces.

Partner Forces is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at recruiting@partnerforces.com.

Reporting & Data Analyst – AI & Dashboards

Company: Paul Logistics

Location: Tulsa, OK (On-site)

Job Type: Full-Time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Reports To: Chief Financial Officer

Experience: 1–3 years in SQL, database, BI, or data reporting roles

Salary: $55,000–$65,000

About The Role

Paul Logistics, a growing asset-based carrier and brokerage in Tulsa, is looking for a technical, AI-first Reporting & Data Analyst to build our reporting from the ground up. We need someone who can pull our data together, give it structure, and turn it into dashboards and reports that leadership uses every day.

You'll use Claude as your primary tool to pull, clean, analyze, and present data and to automate recurring reports, owning each request from the first question to the finished dashboard.

This is a technical role first: strong SQL and data skills are a must. An FP&A or accounting background is a plus but not required.

Key Responsibilities

Build the reporting foundation

  • Design and build reporting from scratch: decide what to measure, where the data comes from, and how it should be structured
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to pull data from our many systems, primarily McLeod, plus APIs, flat files, and spreadsheets, into clean, consistent, reusable datasets

Dashboards and reporting

  • Build and maintain KPI dashboards and scorecards for leadership, pricing, operations, and finance (interactive dashboards, Power BI, Excel workbooks, and presentation-ready summaries)
  • Track freight KPIs such as revenue and cost per mile, margin, utilization, and deadhead by customer, lane, truck, and business unit

AI and automation

  • Use Claude every day to analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and verify every output against the general ledger and source data
  • Build reusable Claude workflows and automate recurring reports with scheduled tasks and connected apps (Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Excel)

Financial reporting support

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, cash flow projections, and ad hoc analysis for decisions such as equipment purchases, pricing, new locations, and acquisitions

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • Strong SQL experience (joins, query optimization, data modeling). This is an IT-first role
  • Track record of building reports and dashboards from the ground up
  • Expert-level, daily use of Claude or similar AI tools, with strong prompting skills. A portfolio of 2–3 reports, dashboards, or automated workflows you built is required
  • Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data modeling)
  • Extremely detail-oriented, with the habit of checking work against the source

Preferred

  • FP&A or accounting background, with a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Experience in logistics or transportation, and familiarity with McLeod
  • Power BI experience (data modeling, DAX)
  • Experience with Claude Code, Claude skills, or connecting AI to business tools

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; paid time off and paid holidays; and career growth opportunities.
