Job Summary

The Business Data Analyst supports decision-making across North End Teleservices by investigating and managing business processes and changes in business performance and recommending actions backed by data. Reporting to the Senior Director of Project and Contract Management, this role partners with leaders across departments to determine what changed, assess the factors driving the change that may include improvements or decline in performance, and articulate where actions could have the greatest impact.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Analysis and Investigation

  • Translate business questions into analysis plans. Identify and combine approved data from Operations, Workforce Management, Finance, Human Resources, Quality, Training, and other functions.
  • Strong relationships across disciplines and all levels of leadership.
  • Able to work with a project management discipline utilizing PM best practice tools.
  • Investigate unexpected results and recurring issues by comparing performance across programs, teams, cohorts, and time periods. Test plausible explanations with data and validate findings with process owners.
  • Build functional department and operational knowledge necessary to do the work.
  • Assess trends, risks, and opportunities tied to company priorities, including revenue, profitability, retention, engagement, and client satisfaction.

Recommendations and Follow Through

  • Present findings in plain language. Recommend practical actions, explain tradeoffs and expected impact where measurable, and communicate assumptions and limitations.
  • Partner with business owners to define success measures, track results after changes are implemented, and recommend adjustments based on the outcome.

Reporting and Data Quality

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports that help leaders monitor performance and spot changes that warrant investigation.
  • Reconcile source data, investigate discrepancies, and document metric definitions and calculation logic so teams can interpret results consistently.
  • Handle employee, client, and financial data in accordance with company confidentiality, security, and access requirements.
  • Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in contact center operations, workforce analytics, financial performance analysis, or client reporting.
  • Experience with Power BI data modeling, Power Query, DAX, or scenario analysis.

Key Qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in business data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate a business problem, test possible causes, and translate findings into an actionable recommendation.
  • Proficiency in Excel and SQL for preparing, combining, and validating data. Experience building dashboards in Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.
  • Ability to present findings to technical and nontechnical audiences and manage competing requests across departments.

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security, and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire, and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you! The Senior Metric & Data Analyst will support the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) Program within the Strategic Reentry Programs (SRP) Organization under the Navy Reentry Directorate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Framework Ownership & Optimization – Lead data and metrics development utilizing Tableau, Alteryx, Vemo, etc.; proactively identify gaps and drive iterative improvements.
  • Automation & Self-Service Delivery – Design and implement self-service automations, tools, and data workflows that accelerate metric delivery, reduce manual effort, and support portfolio integration needs.
  • Leadership Staffing Rhythm & Decision Support – Own the regular metrics cadence and executive briefing cycle for Strategic Reentry Programs (SRP) and Fleet Ballistic Missiles (FBM) leadership
  • Seating Strategy & Cross‑Org Communication – Utilize staffing data and cost model projections to develop seating strategies and plans
  • Data Translation & Storytelling – Convert complex data into concise visualizations and narratives; investigate over/underruns and create a Root Cause corrective action (RCCA)

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, data analytics, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Analytical skills with the ability to interpret and work with complex data.
  • Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools for creating dashboards and workbooks.
  • Understanding of data preparation and automation concepts to support metric tracking.
  • Communication skills for conveying data insights to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional settings within a dynamic, priority-driven environment

Desired Skills

  • Greenbelt or Blackbelt certified
  • Active Top Secret/ Secret clearance
  • Experience owning and scaling reporting frameworks (Tableau, Alteryx, Vemo, etc.)
  • Proven design of self-service automations, data pipelines, and tools that accelerate metric delivery and reduce manual effort.
  • Experience supporting senior leadership with regular metrics cadences, executive briefings, and data-driven decision support.
  • Familiarity with earned value management (EVM) techniques and integration with staffing metrics.
  • Experience with SAP data.
  • Proficiency with AWS for data storage, processing, and hosting automated workflows.
  • Understanding of SQL for querying, extracting, and manipulating large datasets

Location: Hybrid NYC

About the Role:

We are seeking a high-caliber Senior Analyst, Finance & Reporting to support a broad range of accounting, financial reporting, and data-driven workstreams. Reporting alongside senior financial leadership-including the SEC Reporting Manager, Controllers, and CFO-this role bridges traditional accounting and modern financial analytics.

The ideal candidate combines a solid foundation in public company financial reporting with strong technical data analytics skills (SQL, Tableau, BI tools) to improve reporting quality, automate workflows, and deliver actionable insights to executive stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Dual Reporting Focus: Support both external SEC/regulatory filings and internal management reporting workstreams across the corporate finance organization.
  • Reporting Packages: Prepare, maintain, and enhance recurring management reporting packages, executive dashboards, and ad hoc variance analyses.
  • Period-End Support: Assist with quarter-end and year-end close and reporting cycles, including audit workpapers, tie-outs, and documentation requests.

Data Analytics, Systems & Process Improvement

  • Complex Data Reconciliation: Leverage SQL, Tableau, and advanced BI tools to analyze large datasets, investigate variances, reconcile multi-source data, and explain underlying business drivers.
  • Dashboard Design: Help design, build, and maintain interactive reporting tools, data outputs, and automated visual dashboards.
  • Automation & Governance: Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, enhance data controls, improve reporting accuracy, and support cross-functional systems/data governance projects.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of progressive experience in public accounting audit, financial reporting, or a hybrid accounting/analytics role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting and data visualization tools.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, financial statements, and corporate reporting processes; experience supporting public company SEC/regulatory reporting or enterprise management reporting is strongly preferred.
  • High attention to detail, strong reconciliation discipline, and the ability to communicate effectively across accounting, audit, and technology teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active CPA license or active progress toward CPA certification.
  • Experience querying, modeling, or bridging data from modern ERPs and enterprise data warehouses.

Job Description

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We’re actively seeking a talented Sr. Financial Reporting Analyst to join our Investment Accounting and Reporting team in Charlotte, NC

As a Senior Financial Reporting Analyst, you will play a key role in Pacific Life’s growth and long-term success by providing timely and accurate investment reporting on quarterly and annual basis, as well as ad-hoc reporting to Investment Management’s main constituents. You will fill an existing role that sits on a team of six people in the corporate division.

This role is on-site 4 days a week. You'll work at our Charlotte, NC office.

How You’ll Help Move Us Forward

  • Coordinate and/or prepare various reports, schedules, presentations, dashboards and ad hoc deliverables across a board base of assets including fixed income, mortgage loans, derivatives and equity investments
  • Prepare various investment reporting, including divisional due diligence reports, bank presentations, rating agency surveys, and industry related surveys
  • Actively participate in technology and other projects that impact the reporting for commercial and residential mortgage loans
  • Be innovative in leading improvements to reporting processes
  • Prepare ad-hoc financial analysis and management reports as requested, requiring a thorough understanding of the data
  • Maintain proper controls over reporting and understanding the right level of control consciousness; assist with special projects as needed

The Experience You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of relevant finance/accounting experience
  • CPA preferred
  • Proven organizational skills with the ability to work under tight deadlines
  • Ability to work independently on assignment of various levels of complexity with minimal direction
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills and communication (written and verbal) skills and the ability to collaborate with others to effectively problem solve
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience is preferred

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience with investment accounting tools like ePAM, Clearwater Analytics or Enterprise
  • Experience in the life insurance industry and/or financial services preferred
  • Experience with investment accounting tools for Mortgage Loans such as Enterprise
  • Familiarity or working knowledge of a broad spectrum of investment types including fixed income, mortgage loans and derivatives
  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in financial systems and tools, including Power BI, Business Objects and Workiva (WDesk)

We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife

The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

$93,690.00 - $114,510.00

Your Benefits Start Day 1

Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life, and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

  • Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents
  • Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

First American Title Insurance Company, one of the nation's largest title insurers, provides comprehensive title insurance coverage and professional services for residential, commercial, and new construction purchases, along with refinances and equity loans. Join the global title operations team that supports title and escrow operations across the company, helping create a smoother path through each transaction for the customers, partners, and communities we serve. You’ll work alongside talented operations professionals and business partners to support title and escrow teams, improve the customer experience, help solve complex challenges, and move the industry forward. Along the way, you’ll be part of a supportive, relationship-driven culture where people are invested in your growth and success.

What We Do

Job Description

The Role

Be a part of the organization that helps service the Fidelity Stock Plan Services (SPS) Financial Reporting team! In this role you will be the first line of support to a defined client base in helping to provide a platform to acquire their financial reporting requirements related to equity compensation.

Serve as the client’s primary support for SPS’ financial reporting offering, with a client base typically 20 - 25 public companies spanning across all segments (Emerging, Mid, Large and Strategic). In this capacity, you are responsible for the processing and reporting of their client’s financial reporting data according to the client defined reporting schedule. You will work with their clients to establish, implement, execute, and supervise ad-hoc requests for support and analysis. The identification and development of process benchmarks and standard methodologies across the client base are important to client delivery. You will train client contacts to use Plan Sponsor Workstation (PSW) and its functionality such as SPS reporting, including customized reporting dashboards, as well as Team Workspace. The Financial Reporting Manager is highly engaged with client contacts and builds long term relationships to provide end to end service delivery.

  • As an important member of the Financial Reporting team, you will participate in all operational aspects of the reporting process; client developed scheduled reporting to ad-hoc report development (including fee for service projects).
  • You will be a key member, along with SPS Implementation and Account Management, to implement a client’s reporting information from a legacy provider to the Fidelity Stock Plan Administration system. You provide assistance with the overall testing effort for the SPS financial team as coordinated by the SPS Product Development team.
  • Providing complete and accurate reporting delivery during peak volumes of the monthly/quarterly reporting cycle
  • Partnering with SPS Operations and SPS Client Service Managers to deliver exception full-service stock plan administration.
  • Assisting with SPS Product and SPS Technology partners on major product improvements to ensure business is adequately prepared to support new features and functionalities
  • Client advisor regarding solution-based financial report modifications within the financial section of the Plan Sponsor Workstation platform.
  • Crafting and maintaining required data for process measures and reporting.

The Expertise And Skills You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
  • 3-5 years of Accounting/Finance, Financial Services and/or Stock Plan Administration experience
  • Excel and Access skills
  • Certified Equity Professional (CEP) level 1 encouraged
  • Your strong ability to multi-task, react and think quickly
  • You bring a Positive can-do demeanor and a willingness to work across groups to get the job done
  • You are a team player who will consistently provide a very high level of support to the group
  • Your Proficiency in Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • Strong operational and project management skills.
  • Proven success in developing presentations and reporting.
  • Very strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • You are passionate about the details and possess strong communication and organizational skills.
  • You're a Self-starter with strong sense of ownership and involvement is essential. Must be very proactive in approach.
  • You are flexible enough to work overtime if needed

The Team

Fidelity’s SPS provides companies with outstanding administration for their equity compensation programs, including stock option, restricted stock, employee stock purchase, stock appreciation rights and performance plans.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

Certifications

Category:

Operations

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

descriptionHtml:
We, at Leggett & Platt Inc., are searching for a Business Analyst within our Home Furniture Sales and Field Support team to help support our Home Furniture business. Our Home Furniture business brings an intense focus on the customer, innovation, world-class manufacturing capabilities, and a global footprint together to create full package solutions for the industry. We do not make furniture. We make furniture more comfortable. We need the best people on our team to support our strategy, and your work will ensure people around the world have a little more comfort in their lives.

As a Business Analyst, you will have the opportunity to influence strategic business decisions, support innovation, and contribute to revenue and margin growth across a global organization. You'll work alongside talented professionals across multiple functions while gaining broad exposure to product development, commercial strategy, and financial planning.

So, what will you be doing as a Business Analyst?

  • Create, maintain, and improve business reporting, KPI dashboards, and recurring management reports using Excel, Power BI, and Zoho Analytics.
  • Analyze sales, operational, inventory, and financial data to support business decisions and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Reconcile data from multiple systems and sources, identify discrepancies, and establish trusted reporting metrics.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting for leadership teams.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Sales teams to understand business performance and reporting needs.
  • Investigate variances, data anomalies, and unexpected business results to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning activities through data analysis and reporting.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of meaningful KPIs that support operational and financial performance.
  • Work with manufacturing and operational data to improve reporting accuracy, consistency, and visibility across the organization.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process inefficiencies and opportunities for automation where practical.

To Be Successful in This Role, You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business, Analytics, Economics or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through incomplete, inconsistent, or conflicting data.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, lookups, formulas, and data analysis.
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and KPIs that support business decision-making.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Strong business curiosity and desire to understand how operational activities affect financial results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a manufacturing
  • Experience with Power BI, Zoho Analytics, Zoho Projects, or similar reporting platforms.
  • Experience reconciling and validating data from multiple systems.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and operational reporting processes.
  • Exposure to inventory reporting, product costing, procurement, forecasting, or budgeting.
  • Experience identifying root causes of business performance issues and providing actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Bills of Material (BOMs), inventory transactions, product costing, or manufacturing processes is a plus.

What Will Make Someone Successful in This Role?

The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems, digging into data, identifying inconsistencies, and translating information into meaningful business insights. Success in this role comes from being able to find the truth in imperfect operational and financial data, build trusted reporting, and help leaders make informed decisions.

What To Do Next

Now that you've had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available.

Our Values

Our values speak to our shared beliefs and describe how we approach working together.

  • Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an inclusive environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging.
  • Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth, good or bad.
  • Do Great Work...Together occurs when we engage without hierarchy, collaborate as a team, embrace challenges, and work for the good of all of us.
  • Take Ownership and Raise the Bar demonstrates our responsibility to add value and make a difference, challenge the status quo and biases to make things better, foster innovative and creative solutions to drive impact, and explore new perspectives and embrace change.

Our Commitment to You

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all. Leggett & Platt is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veteran status, and more. Join us!

We welcome and encourage applications if you meet the minimum qualifications. Even if you do not meet the preferred qualifications, we'd love the opportunity to consider you.

Equal Employment Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Orrick currently has an excellent opportunity for a Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics in our San Francisco or Los Angeles Office.

The role: The Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics provides reporting, data management, visualization, and analytical support across the Firm’s HR programs and technology environment. The role is responsible for accurate and timely workforce reporting, including business-critical and regulatory requirements, while helping develop a more consistent and effective approach to people analytics.

The Senior Analyst works with HR leaders, Firm leadership, attorneys, professional staff, and business stakeholders to analyze workforce information, identify trends and risks, and provide clear information to support decision-making. The role requires the ability to go beyond pulling and presenting data - to interpret what the data is showing, identify the story behind the numbers, and communicate clear, meaningful insights to the appropriate audience.

Success in the role will mean maintaining a reliable and well-controlled workforce reporting function while helping the Firm improve how workforce information is analyzed, reported, and used. The Senior Analyst will combine strong technical skills with sound judgment, practical problem-solving, and the ability to turn complex workforce data into a clear and compelling story.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the Firm’s recurring and ad hoc workforce reporting, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, confidentiality, and appropriate delivery.
  • Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot reports, data extracts, and dashboards using PeopleSoft HCM, UKG, SQL, Excel, Power BI, and other relevant systems.
  • Integrate and reconcile workforce information from multiple HR systems and investigate data discrepancies or reporting issues.
  • Lead or support professional liability insurance, state bar, regulatory, audit, client, and other Firm reporting and filing requirements, working with Risk Management and other stakeholders as appropriate.
  • Maintain documentation of report logic, data sources, definitions, processes, controls, and filing requirements to support continuity and auditability.
  • Analyze workforce data across areas such as headcount, recruiting, turnover, mobility, leave, workforce composition, learning, performance, employee relations, immigration, compensation, and inclusion.

DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Senior Analyst, Business Intelligence & Analytics, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, in the Data Analytics group, is responsible for data analytics and data products that support data-informed strategic decision-making across the firm with focused analysis on client profitability, segmentation, market-informed growth analytics, and scalable business intelligence solutions that support the entire firm.

This role supports the firm's analytics and reporting capabilities through the development and enhancement of dashboards, executive scorecards, data models, KPI frameworks, and automated reporting solutions that combine internal financial data with market research, benchmarking, and business development insights.

Working with Revenue, Strategic Finance, Business Development, Pricing, Technology, Finance, and business stakeholders, this position translates client, competitor, and financial analysis into meaningful insights that support data-informed decision-making and consistent self-service reporting.

Location

This position can sit in our New York, Short Hills, or Chicago office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analytical support and reporting for strategic planning initiatives for Vertical leads, the Global Finance Committee Head, Practice Group leadership, and Business Development leadership.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to align analytics products with business priorities.
  • Collaborate with the Manager, Strategic Finance & Market Analytics to align recommendations with business priorities.
  • Conduct profitability analysis across clients, sectors, segmentation, matters, and practices.
  • Analyze and highlight growth opportunities and margin risks using financial, market, and benchmarking data.
  • Translate analytical requirements and outputs for strategic business questions.
  • Develop reusable data models that connect financial, operational, revenue, pricing, and market sources.
  • Support the development of KPI definitions, calculation logic, ownership, and governance standards.
  • Automate recurring reporting to improve timeliness, consistency, and efficiency.
  • Support self-service reporting through dashboards, documentation, and user guidance.
  • Maintain reporting quality, metric consistency, and stakeholder confidence in results.

Desired Skills  

Advanced proficiency in Power BI, Excel, data modeling, visualization, SQL, reporting automation, and data-quality management. Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, data models, automated reporting, and executive-ready analysis.

Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to collect, interpret, and synthesize complex financial, operational, market, and business data into meaningful insights.

Excellent written, verbal, and data storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills to work effectively across different teams and business functions. Highly organized with strong attention to details and the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Education   

  • Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

Preferred Education   

  • Master's Degree.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

  • 4 years’ experience in business intelligence, data analytics, financial analytics, or a related field. Experience applying financial, market, benchmarking, or BD data to inform business decisions.

Essential Job Expectations

All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include:

  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences.
  • Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
  • Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
  • Comply with firm policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement combining remote and in-office work. The specific arrangement will be determined at the time of hiring and may be modified at the firm's discretion.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Interested candidates must apply directly online. Application materials sent via email will not be accepted.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position or participate in the selection process. For accommodation requests, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship or support.

We are committed to excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people.

The firm’s expected hiring range for this position is $98,990 - $137,126 per year depending on the candidate’s geographic market location.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits, including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

Any relocation benefits, if any, are provided only where a relocation is required at the firm’s direction and in accordance with applicable policy and law.

Standard Job Description

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security, and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire, and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you! The Senior Metric & Data Analyst will support the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) Program within the Strategic Reentry Programs (SRP) Organization under the Navy Reentry Directorate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Framework Ownership & Optimization – Lead data and metrics development utilizing Tableau, Alteryx, Vemo, etc.; proactively identify gaps and drive iterative improvements.
  • Automation & Self-Service Delivery – Design and implement self-service automations, tools, and data workflows that accelerate metric delivery, reduce manual effort, and support portfolio integration needs.
  • Leadership Staffing Rhythm & Decision Support – Own the regular metrics cadence and executive briefing cycle for Strategic Reentry Programs (SRP) and Fleet Ballistic Missiles (FBM) leadership
  • Seating Strategy & Cross‑Org Communication – Utilize staffing data and cost model projections to develop seating strategies and plans
  • Data Translation & Storytelling – Convert complex data into concise visualizations and narratives; investigate over/underruns and create a Root Cause corrective action (RCCA)

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, data analytics, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Analytical skills with the ability to interpret and work with complex data.
  • Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools for creating dashboards and workbooks.
  • Understanding of data preparation and automation concepts to support metric tracking.
  • Communication skills for conveying data insights to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional settings within a dynamic, priority-driven environment

Desired Skills

  • Greenbelt or Blackbelt certified
  • Active Top Secret/ Secret clearance
  • Experience owning and scaling reporting frameworks (Tableau, Alteryx, Vemo, etc.)
  • Proven design of self-service automations, data pipelines, and tools that accelerate metric delivery and reduce manual effort.
  • Experience supporting senior leadership with regular metrics cadences, executive briefings, and data-driven decision support.
  • Familiarity with earned value management (EVM) techniques and integration with staffing metrics.
  • Experience with SAP data.
  • Proficiency with AWS for data storage, processing, and hosting automated workflows.
  • Understanding of SQL for querying, extracting, and manipulating large datasets

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $95900.00 - $178100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for supporting analytical work efforts for various projects within a Line of Business or business discipline. Key responsibilities include leveraging databases to acquire client and performance data, transforming extracted data into meaningful insights and trends, and delivering those insights to leaders to make complex business decisions. Job expectations include working with business partners to understand, coordinate, and deliver agreed upon priorities while communicating complex data outputs and delivering the appropriate summary and data required.

This role is responsible for supporting analytical initiatives across a variety of projects within a Line of Business or business discipline. Key responsibilities include leveraging databases and analytical tools such as SAS, JavaScript, Alteryx, Python, SQL, Tableau and Power BI to extract, analyze, and transform data into actionable insights, trends, and recommendations.

The position partners closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities, coordinate deliverables, and ensure the successful execution of agreed-upon objectives. Responsibilities also include communicating complex analytical findings in a clear and concise manner, developing meaningful reporting and visualizations, and providing data-driven insights that enable leaders to make informed business decisions. Successful candidates are expected to effectively summarize complex data, translate technical results into business context, and deliver high-quality analytical solutions that support strategic and operational goals.

Responsibilities:

The Business Analytics and Reporting Team within Data, Reporting & Operations Management (DROM) is seeking an experienced Data Analyst and Developer to support the design, development, automation, and maintenance of reporting and dashboard solutions. This role partners closely with the Business Analytics & Enablement team to deliver high-quality analytical products while ensuring adherence to business, team, and enterprise reporting, governance, and data management standards.

The team is committed to developing scalable, automated solutions that address immediate business needs while aligning with long-term strategic objectives. This position is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, identifying potential risks, and supporting the development of mitigation strategies to drive informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Extract, integrate, and analyze data using programming languages and tools such as SAS, JavaScript, Alteryx, Python, SQL, Tableau and Power BI, leveraging both relational and non-relational database technologies across on-premises and cloud-based environments.
  • Connect and consolidate data from multiple sources, applying technical expertise, business knowledge, and process understanding to transform raw data into meaningful metrics, insights, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Perform quantitative analysis on customer, transactional, operational, and performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and actionable recommendations that support business decision-making.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, analysts, and leadership to understand reporting requirements, conduct research, and deliver accurate and meaningful analytical solutions.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, concise, and engaging manner to both technical and non-technical audiences through presentations, reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting and dashboard solutions that provide timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support strategic and operational objectives.
  • Conduct data validation, quality assurance, and reconciliation activities to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of analytical outputs; identify and escalate data issues, inconsistencies, or gaps as appropriate.
  • Support the identification, assessment, and monitoring of data and reporting risks, helping to develop effective mitigation strategies and controls.
  • Adhere to established development, governance, documentation, and quality assurance standards to ensure business continuity, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
  • Contributes to the continuous improvement of reporting processes, automation capabilities, and analytical methodologies to increase efficiency, scalability, and overall business value.

Responsibilities:

  • Supports the extraction of data using a variety of a programming languages, such as SQL, SAS, Python, or Spark/Scala, and applies knowledge of relational and non-relational database systems housed on both on-premise and off-premise (hybrid) platforms
  • Connects provisioned data across multiple sources and performs necessary transformations utilizing both technical, business, and process knowledge to transform data into meaningful values and insights
  • Performs quantitative techniques and analysis on customer, transaction, and performance data with the guidance from other analysts and supervisors, based on questions provided by business partners, and provides actionable insights for business partners to make informed decisions.
  • Follows requirements developed by other analysts and supervisors to perform required research, analytics, and exploration on appropriate and accurate data sources to provide appropriate deliverables
  • Communicates complex subjects in a simple and engaging manner to non-technical and technical business partners using software such as Power Point, Word, Excel, and Tableau
  • Assists with conducting quality comparison checks on analysis output and escalates data inconsistencies, gaps, or issues to leadership
  • Follows quality workflow process and documentation requirements to adhere to standards and provide business continuity

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 year utilizing data tools and techniques to find and deliver data from various sources of record
  • Proven communications skills in describing complex data to inform strategic insights and decisions
  • Bachelor’s Degree in finance, math/statistics, computer science or another quantitative field (for example, engineering, operations management)
  • Coursework in finance, math/statistics and/or computer science
  • Effectively collaborate with team members, customers, and subject matter experts to clarify requirements and complete user acceptance testing
  • Talent for combining business acumen with analytical skills, interpret large amounts of data, synthesize multiple analysis into a coherent message and translate into actionable insights
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project delivery date
  • Proficient in independent work and team projects, executing on-time and with precision
  • Create, review, and monitor requirement documents needed to support repeatability, business continuity, governance and audit requirements
  • Stay current with the latest developments in Bank of America approved software and applications
  • Strong technical knowledge of reporting and analytics tools, including:
  • JavaScript
  • Tableau
  • PowerShell
  • SQL
  • Alteryx
  • Python
  • PowerQuery
  • VBA
  • PySpark
  • SharePoint On-prism/SharePoint Online

Desired Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree or higher in finance, math/statistics, computer science or another quantitative field (for example, engineering, operations management)
  • Knowledge of agile methodology
  • Business understanding of Global Operations

Skills:

  • Business Analytics
  • Data Mining
  • Data and Trend Analysis
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Business Intelligence
  • Data Quality Management
  • Data Visualization
  • Application Development
  • Business Acumen
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Innovative Thinking
  • Quality Assurance

1st shift (United States of America)

40

The Quantitative Data Analyst helps with the interpretation, implementation, analysis and visualization of large amounts of data within the client environment into more readable formats for Client personnel and our partners within the organization cybersecurity environment. The data analyst utilizes various programs and methods to manipulate data to display it in a more readable and concise manner that is desired or required by the client and its stakeholders. Such methods could include through Microsoft Excel spreadsheets, charts, Microsoft PowerBI dashboards, and other analytical methods

  • Collects data from various sources and produces basic to advanced reports and charts based on client inquiries and requirements.
  • Accurately enters required data into one or multiple databases, documents, and spreadsheets for the client for analysis and retention.

descriptionHtml:
Save the Children

For over 100 years, Save the Children has been fighting for the rights of children. The right to a healthy start in life. To have access to education. To be in a safe environment, protected from harm. We work in some of the world’s hardest-to-reach places – over 100 countries, including the U.S. No matter what your role is, when you join Save the Children, you’re creating positive, irreversible change for children, and the future we all share.

The Role

As the Lead Associate, Data Analyst, you’ll be integral to our work in helping vulnerable children achieve a brighter future. You will help to develop and advise on Business Operations and Shared Services (BOSS) dashboards and reports, automate processes, and establish data controls. The position emphasizes the significance of clean information and ensures that underlying data supports reporting needs, is understood, and is used consistently. This position will also support various projects for the BOSS technology portfolio.

Location

Hybrid – Washington DC, Fairfield, CT or Lexington, KY office locations

What You’ll Be Doing (Essential Duties)

  • not inclusive of all role responsibilities. May be subject to change

Build Dashboards, Reports, and Automate Processes (50%)

  • Maintain and enhance existing dashboards by collaborating with business partners to understand reporting needs, prioritize requests, and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Develop and maintain a data dictionary that clearly documents and defines key metrics, data sources, and calculation methodologies to promote consistency and transparency.
  • Partner with the Data Infrastructure team to define reporting requirements and data models to shape self-service analytics.
  • Review and analyze existing reports to ensure alignment in metric definitions, improve data accuracy, and identify opportunities to consolidate or retire redundant reports.
  • Conduct audits of existing reports and distribution lists to verify appropriate access, ensure compliance with data privacy and confidentiality requirements, and support responsible data governance.
  • Maintain existing automations and develop additional process automation required for automated reporting and dashboard updates.

Data Analysis (25%)

  • Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations to support workforce and business decisions.
  • Respond to ad hoc data requests by preparing clear summaries and visualizations that accurately describe the requested data, highlight key takeaways, and support informed decision‑
  • Support data literacy efforts by helping business partners and other employees understand how to interpret, use, and apply data appropriately in compliance with established definitions, privacy standards, and reporting guidelines.

Data Stewardship (25%)

  • Support data stewardship practices by helping to document data ownership, data definitions, and usage standards to promote data quality, consistency, and accountability.
  • Assist in monitoring data quality and integrity by identifying data issues, escalating discrepancies, and partnering with system owners to support remediation efforts.
  • Partner with the Data Governance team to define and enforce BOSS data standards.

Required Qualifications For The Role

  • Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent, plus at least 3 years of relevant experience
  • Foundational experience working with data reporting and visualization through internships, academic projects, or entry‑level professional roles.
  • Basic understanding of data concepts such as data governance, data quality, metrics, and reporting standards.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and explain data clearly to non‑technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and collaborate with cross‑functional teams in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Professional proficiency in MS Office suite, including Microsoft Excel (e.g., formulas, pivot tables, basic data validation) and comfort working with structured datasets
  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications For The Role

  • Experience creating, maintaining, or enhancing dashboards and reports using Power BI (or similar program), including data modeling, basic measures, and report publishing/sharing.
  • Familiarity with HR and IT Operations analytics concepts and common HR metrics (e.g., headcount, turnover, time to fill, retention metrics).
  • Experience or familiarity with HR and IT systems (e.g., HRIS, recruiting, learning, or performance systems) or a demonstrated ability to learn new systems quickly.
  • Experience supporting data governance or stewardship activities such as metric definition, data documentation, or data quality reviews.
  • Ability to translate business questions into reporting requirements and present insights in a clear, user‑friendly manner.

Compensation

Save the Children is offering the following salary ranges for this position, dependent on candidate location:

  • Geo 1 - NY Metro, DC, and other locations with labor costs significantly above national average: Target Salary for this position is $72,250 - $80,750 base salary
  • Geo 2 - Locations around the US National Labor Cost Average: Target Salary for this position is $65,450 - $73,150 base salary
  • Geo 3 - Locations significantly below the US National Labor Cost Average: Target Salary for this position is $59,500 - $66,500 base salary

The salary ranges listed above are for US based candidates. For candidates located outside of the US, salary ranges will be based on the salary scales of the local employer of record. Actual base salary may vary based on, but not limited to, relevant experience, base salary of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location (more information on job structure is available here).

About Us

We are looking to build an inclusive team at Save the Children. We offer a range of outstanding benefits to support this goal:

  • Flexible schedules and time off: Flexible schedules, generous PTO, 11 paid holidays plus 2 floating holidays and hybrid working opportunities
  • Health: Competitive health care, dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Family: A variety of paid leaves: caregiver, parental/adoption, critical child illness and fertility benefits
  • Employee Rewards Program: Annual merit increases and/or additional incentives for eligible employees
  • Retirement: A retirement savings plan with employer contributions (after one year)
  • Wellness: 15 safety and wellness days annually (if hired on or after July 1, safety and wellness days prorated to 8 days), mental health benefits and support through Calm and company-hosted events
  • Employee Assistance Program: free and confidential assessments, short-term counseling, referrals, and follow-up services
  • Learning & Growth: Access to internal and external learning & development opportunities and mentorships

Save the Children is committed to conducting its programs and operations in a manner that is safe for the children it serves and helping protect the children with whom we are in contact. All Save the Children representatives are explicitly prohibited from engaging in any activity that may result in any kind of child abuse.

Save the Children is committed to minimizing safety and security risks for our valued employees, ensuring all are given training, support and information to reduce their risk exposure while maximizing the impact of our programs for children and families. Our shared duty, both agency and individual, is to seek and maintain safe working conditions for all.

If you require disability assistance with the application or recruitment process, please submit a request to applicantsupport@savechildren.org.

descriptionHtml:
Lattice Overview

There is energy here…energy you can feel crackling at any of our international locations. It’s an energy generated by enthusiasm for our work, for our teams, for our results, and for our customers. Lattice is a worldwide community of engineers, designers, and manufacturing operations specialists in partnership with world-class sales, marketing, and support teams, who are developing programmable logic solutions that are changing the industry. Our focus is on R&D, product innovation, and customer service, and to that focus, we bring total commitment and a keenly sharp competitive personality.

Energy feeds on energy. If you flourish in a fast paced, results-oriented environment, if you want to achieve individual success within a “team first” organization, and if you believe you can contribute and succeed in a demanding yet collegial atmosphere, then Lattice may well be just what you’re looking for.

Responsibilities

Job Description:

Data Analytics, AI & Automation (45%)

  • Work with large financial and operational datasets to identify trends, develop insights, and improve visibility into business performance
  • Develop dashboards, analytical tools, and reporting solutions that make complex financial and operational data easier to understand and act upon
  • Explore and implement practical applications of AI and automation within Finance to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive processes, and improve forecasting and reporting
  • Use modern analytical tools to extract, organize, integrate, analyze, and visualize data from multiple sources
  • Improve data quality, consistency, and accessibility across Finance reporting and planning processes
  • Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with more efficient, scalable, and automated solutions

Forecasting, Planning & Consolidation (35%)

  • Coordinate and consolidate forecasts, annual operating plans, and long-range financial plans across the organization
  • Manage forecast submissions and consolidate inputs into a consistent company-wide financial view
  • Analyze forecast changes and actual performance to identify key trends, variances, risks, and opportunities
  • Develop and maintain models and tools that improve forecast accuracy, efficiency, and visibility
  • Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure completeness and accuracy of consolidated forecasts

Financial Analysis & Reporting (20%)

  • Provide ad hoc financial and business analysis to senior management and financial partners
  • Analyze revenue, margin, operating expenses, and other key financial metrics
  • Support recurring management reporting and improve the quality, clarity, and usefulness of financial information
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve Finance processes, analysis, and decision support

Qualifications, Education, & Experience

  • 0–3 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, business analytics, data analytics, or a related field; exceptional recent graduates with strong internship, academic, or project experience are encouraged to apply
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or another analytically rigorous field
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work through complex or ambiguous problems
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and an interest in developing advanced analytical and financial modeling capabilities
  • Demonstrated interest in data analytics, automation, and applied AI
  • Experience or exposure to tools such as SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar technologies is preferred but not required
  • Experience with financial planning systems such as Workday Adaptive Planning and ERP systems such as Oracle is a plus
  • Ability to learn new technologies, systems, and business concepts quickly

Skills & Behaviors

  • Intellectually curious with a strong desire to understand how and why things work
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop practical solutions
  • Comfortable working with large amounts of data and detail while maintaining a clear understanding of the bigger picture
  • Quick learner who enjoys mastering new tools, technologies, and business concepts
  • Naturally curious about how AI, automation, and technology can improve the way Finance works
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and concisely
  • Self-starter with a “can do” attitude and willingness to roll up your sleeves to solve problems
  • Constructively challenges existing processes and looks for better, simpler, and more scalable ways of working
  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions and geographies
  • Adaptable to changing business needs while maintaining focus on key priorities
  • Open, honest, trustworthy, and results oriented

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for variable/ incentive compensation and/ or equity. In addition, this role is eligible for a comprehensive, competitive benefits package which may include healthcare and retirement plans, paid time off, and more!

Additional Information

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

United States of America

Lattice recognizes that employees are its greatest asset and the driving force behind success in a highly competitive, global industry. Lattice continually strives to provide a comprehensive compensation and benefits program to attract, retain, motivate, reward and celebrate the highest caliber employees in the industry.

Lattice is an international, service-driven developer of innovative low cost, low power programmable design solutions. Our global workforce, some 1,000 strong, shares a total commitment to customer success and an unbending will to win. For more information about how our FPGA, CPLD and programmable power management devices help our customers unlock their innovation, visit www.latticesemi.com. You can also follow us via Twitter, Facebook, or RSS. At Lattice, we value the diversity of individuals, ideas, perspectives, insights and values, and what they bring to the workplace. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates.

As an E-Verify employer, we use this system to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires in accordance with federal law. All applicants will be required to complete a Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, upon hire. We do not use E-Verify to pre-screen job candidates and will comply with all E-Verify regulations.

descriptionHtml:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in advancing the organization's regulatory reporting, data quality, and analytical capabilities. This position owns the end-to-end transformation of complex policy, claims, underwriting, and financial data into accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory submissions while driving improvements in data processes, governance, and reporting standards.

As a senior analytical professional, this role combines advanced data analysis, data engineering, insurance domain expertise, and business insight to solve complex data challenges, influence decision-making, and identify opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance. The Senior Data Analyst serves as a trusted partner to business and technical stakeholders and provides mentorship and guidance to analysts across the organization.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design and execute advanced analyses to support regulatory reporting, compliance initiatives, and strategic business decisions.
  • Transform complex business requirements into scalable data solutions, analytical frameworks, and actionable insights.
  • Analyze policy, claims, underwriting, financial, and operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, reconciliations, and datasets to improve performance, scalability, and reusability.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Application teams to design and implement data enrichment, transformation, and integration solutions.
  • Support and enhance data platforms, reporting processes, and analytical assets using modern data technologies and best practices.
  • Own data preparation, validation, and reconciliation activities supporting statutory reporting, regulatory filings, annual statement reporting, premium tax reporting, market conduct examinations, audits, and ad hoc regulatory requests.
  • Develop deep expertise in Property & Casualty insurance operations, regulatory reporting requirements, and statutory accounting principles.
  • Ensure analytical outputs align with regulatory expectations and support sound business decision-making.
  • Translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable data processes and controls.
  • Independently diagnose data quality, integration, and reporting issues across multiple systems and business functions.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective actions that improve data integrity and reporting accuracy.
  • Design analytical approaches for complex or ambiguous business problems where requirements may be incomplete or evolving.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve efficiency, and enhance data accessibility for business stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships with Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, MGA Operations, Applications, and Data Engineering teams.
  • Effectively communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop clear narratives that connect data insights to regulatory, operational, and business outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions, provide data-driven recommendations, and influence prioritization of data and reporting initiatives.
  • Champion data governance practices and contribute to the development of data standards, controls, documentation, and definitions.
  • Establish and enhance data quality monitoring processes within assigned domains.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for analytical methodologies, reporting practices, and regulatory data requirements.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to analysts by reviewing analytical approaches, sharing best practices, and supporting professional development.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and analytical excellence.

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, business analytics, computer science, actuarial science, finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, or related functions within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory reporting, statutory reporting, compliance initiatives, or financial reporting processes.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance operations and data structures across policy, claims, underwriting, accounting, finance, or actuarial functions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale relational databases, data warehouses, and data transformation methodologies.
  • Experience performing complex data analysis, reconciliation, root-cause investigation, and data quality assessments.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and data storytelling skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in quantitative, analytical, or business-related discipline.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and visualization platforms.
  • Experience with data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality programs.
  • Intermediate or advanced Property & Casualty insurance designations (CPCU, AINS, AU, API, or equivalent).
  • Experience partnering with Actuarial teams and supporting actuarial, financial, or regulatory reporting processes.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering concepts.

Key Competencies

  • Technical & Analytical Skills - Designs advanced analyses, metrics, and scalable data solutions while improving performance, quality, and reusability of datasets and reporting assets.
  • Business Acumen & Domain Knowledge - Applies deep Property & Casualty insurance and regulatory expertise to connect analytical work with broader business objectives and outcomes.
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - Independently solves complex, ambiguous problems and develops analytical approaches from the ground up.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling - Translates complex data into clear, compelling narratives that influence business decisions and drive action.
  • Stakeholder Management & Influence - Builds trusted partnerships across functions, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps guide analytical priorities.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - Provides informal leadership through mentoring, knowledge sharing, review of analytical work, and coaching of other analysts.
  • Data Quality & Governance - Improves data quality standards, governance practices, and reporting controls within the domain.
  • Strategic Thinking & Innovation - Connects analytics to broader organizational goals and identifies high-impact opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational effectiveness.

The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.

  • Chicago Pay Range: $128010.00 - $152,184.00
  • Omaha and Richmond Pay Range: $116,382.00 - $138,414.00
  • Los Angeles and New York City Pay Range: $139,638.00 - $166,260.00

Please Note

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

This position owns the end-to-end transformation of complex policy, claims, underwriting, and financial data into accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory submissions while driving improvements in data processes, governance, and reporting standards.

As a senior analytical professional, this role combines advanced data analysis, data engineering, insurance domain expertise, and business insight to solve complex data challenges, influence decision-making, and identify opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance. The Senior Data Analyst serves as a trusted partner to business and technical stakeholders and provides mentorship and guidance to analysts across the organization.

Essential Responsibilities



- Design and execute advanced analyses to support regulatory reporting, compliance initiatives, and strategic business decisions.
- Transform complex business requirements into scalable data solutions, analytical frameworks, and actionable insights.
- Analyze policy, claims, underwriting, financial, and operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
- Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, data models, reconciliations, and datasets to improve performance, scalability, and reusability.
- Partner with Data Engineering and Application teams to design and implement data enrichment, transformation, and integration solutions.
- Support and enhance data platforms, reporting processes, and analytical assets using modern data technologies and best practices.
- Own data preparation, validation, and reconciliation activities supporting statutory reporting, regulatory filings, annual statement reporting, premium tax reporting, market conduct examinations, audits, and ad hoc regulatory requests.
- Develop deep expertise in Property & Casualty insurance operations, regulatory reporting requirements, and statutory accounting principles.
- Ensure analytical outputs align with regulatory expectations and support sound business decision-making.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into sustainable data processes and controls.
- Independently diagnose data quality, integration, and reporting issues across multiple systems and business functions.
- Perform root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective actions that improve data integrity and reporting accuracy.
- Design analytical approaches for complex or ambiguous business problems where requirements may be incomplete or evolving.
- Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve efficiency, and enhance data accessibility for business stakeholders.
- Build strong partnerships with Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, MGA Operations, Applications, and Data Engineering teams.
- Effectively communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Develop clear narratives that connect data insights to regulatory, operational, and business outcomes.
- Challenge assumptions, provide data-driven recommendations, and influence prioritization of data and reporting initiatives.
- Champion data governance practices and contribute to the development of data standards, controls, documentation, and definitions.
- Establish and enhance data quality monitoring processes within assigned domains.
- Serve as a subject matter resource for analytical methodologies, reporting practices, and regulatory data requirements.
- Mentor and provide guidance to analysts by reviewing analytical approaches, sharing best practices, and supporting professional development.
- Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and analytical excellence.

Qualifications & Experience Required



- Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, business analytics, computer science, actuarial science, finance, or a related quantitative field.
- 5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, or related functions within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
- Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory reporting, statutory reporting, compliance initiatives, or financial reporting processes.
- Strong knowledge of insurance operations and data structures across policy, claims, underwriting, accounting, finance, or actuarial functions.
- Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale relational databases, data warehouses, and data transformation methodologies.
- Experience performing complex data analysis, reconciliation, root-cause investigation, and data quality assessments.
- Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
- Strong verbal, written, presentation, and data storytelling skills.

Preferred Qualifications



- Master's degree in quantitative, analytical, or business-related discipline.
- Experience with Snowflake, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and visualization platforms.
- Experience with data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality programs.
- Intermediate or advanced Property & Casualty insurance designations (CPCU, AINS, AU, API, or equivalent).
- Experience partnering with Actuarial teams and supporting actuarial, financial, or regulatory reporting processes.
- Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering concepts.

Key Competencies



- Technical & Analytical Skills - Designs advanced analyses, metrics, and scalable data solutions while improving performance, quality, and reusability of datasets and reporting assets.
- Business Acumen & Domain Knowledge - Applies deep Property & Casualty insurance and regulatory expertise to connect analytical work with broader business objectives and outcomes.
- Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - Independently solves complex, ambiguous problems and develops analytical approaches from the ground up.
- Communication & Data Storytelling - Translates complex data into clear, compelling narratives that influence business decisions and drive action.
- Stakeholder Management & Influence - Builds trusted partnerships across functions, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps guide analytical priorities.
- Leadership & Mentorship - Provides informal leadership through mentoring, knowledge sharing, review of analytical work, and coaching of other analysts.
- Data Quality & Governance - Improves data quality standards, governance practices, and reporting controls within the domain.
- Strategic Thinking & Innovation - Connects analytics to broader organizational goals and identifies high-impact opportunities for process improvement, automation, and operational effectiveness.
