Regulatory Specialty Data and Analytics (RSDA) is a division within the Office of Data, Analytics, and Performance (DAP). RSDA provides analysis, data visualization, and reporting to support Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) agencies in its stakeholders' operational and decision-making needs.

Under the supervision of the RSDA Family Support Services Data Analytics (FSSDA) Manager, the Data Analyst V performs highly complex (senior level) data collection, research, reporting, and analysis to monitor, evaluate, and increase efficiencies for Family Support Services (FSS). Work involves gathering and analyzing requirements, report design and implementation, and ongoing maintenance of existing reports and processes. The analyst will work with other FSSDA staff as well as other HHSC staff to develop back-end tables and logic to drive reporting; create original programming logic and evaluate and/or modify existing programs to take into account changes in requirements; and will review work products developed by other analysts and to interact with agency Program staff, division managers, and/or other analysts to ensure requirements are met and that all work products are appropriately reviewed and validated. The analyst will prepare diagrams and logic flowcharts for detailed coding and for the documentation of programming work and may interact with staff from other agencies and outside entities as required to facilitate data collaboration, obtain required work products, or for consultation. The analyst will participate in system design meetings for new agency initiatives to ensure the agency’s ability to report applicable data. This position will produce concise, comprehensive technical reports presenting findings, identify alternatives, and recommendations for process improvement, and outline solutions to monitor and implement data quality. Works under limited supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

EJF 1 Extracting data from IMPACT, CLASS, PEIRS, IMARC, CAPPS(HR), or other agency databases. Designing, validating, and implementing report methodologies for FSS while documenting processes and procedures for technical and non-technical users. Developing programming code and report design to ensure user requests are properly translated into useful reports. 40%

EJF 2 Preparing data, as necessary, to produce data required for data visualization software products and developing associated dashboards. Participating in data system design meetings for new agency initiatives to provide strategic guidance and ensure the agency’s ability to report relevant data. Interacting routinely with agency program staff, division managers, and other analysts to provide strategic guidance so requirements are met, and work products are appropriately reviewed and validated. 40%

EJF 3 Performing quality assurance tasks to ensure the accuracy of reports created by colleagues within the division for distribution to the agency or the public. Providing suggestions regarding systematic changes that will improve the collection of data and align data infrastructure with business needs. Providing routine updates on the status of projects and initiatives. 20%

Knowledge Of

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):

  • Knowledge of statistics and analyzing data sets; running queries, report writing, and presenting findings; and record keeping, including security procedures for handling, protecting, and distributing confidential data.
  • Understanding of and demonstrated skill in relational databases, data processing practices, and theory.
  • Knowledge of or strong aptitude to learn FSS data.

Skill In

  • Skill in researching and troubleshooting data issues and solving complex problems.
  • Skill in report development and automation.
  • Skill in complex analytic work, identifying trends and concerns, and recommending opportunities for improvement as well as areas of excellence.
  • Skill in using software such as SQL, SQL*Plus, PL/SQL, Tableau, Excel, TOAD, Oracle, SQL Developer, Snowflake, Business Intelligence tools, and/or Python.

Ability To

  • Ability to work hours as needed to meet defined deadlines and support the agency’s mission-critical reporting requirements.
  • Ability to present information to a variety of audiences verbally and in writing and to communicate clearly, concisely, and effectively.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and show initiative.
  • Ability to analyze, consolidate, and interpret complex data, procedures, and systems and to write or revise program code or prepare reports as required.
  • Comprehension of data solutions, reporting methodologies, math, and statistical report design.
  • Ability to creatively solve complex data problems, apply new technology, and perform detailed work accurately under stressful conditions while managing multiple projects and tight deadlines.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

N/A

Initial Screening Criteria

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field. Experience in data analysis, compilation, and reporting work. Experience with Oracle, SQL Developer, Toad, Snowflake, or other database development tools. Experience with Tableau or other data visualization tools. Experience and education may be substituted for one another, up to four years. Experience with data and applications related to development of Family Support Services program reports and visualizations is preferred.

Additional Information

Candidate must also pass fingerprint and criminal background check.

The Role

Join our team delivering innovative reporting solutions within OSG Client Services. We partner with internal business units across Fidelity to provide actionable insights that support day-to-day operations and long-term strategies. In this role, you will translate business objectives into impactful reporting solutions, align with our data visualization strategy, and continuously improve processes to drive efficiency and value.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT ANALYST SENIOR - WEALTH SALES PERFORMANCE AND INCENTIVES

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

The Wealth Management division is seeking a Senior Analyst (Business Intelligence) to support the Sales Performance Analytics and Compensation Incentives Manager. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop deep expertise in financial analytics, sales performance measurement, and incentive compensation plan administration. As a key member of the analytics team, you will work closely with the Manager, assisting with day-to-day operations and gradually expanding responsibilities to support the division during peak periods and manager absences. This role involves both analytical and operational responsibilities: analyzing sales performance across business units, supporting the design and delivery of performance reporting, and directly assisting with incentive compensation plan administration. You will work with the Wealth Management executive leadership team, supporting their decision-making with timely, accurate, and insightful reporting.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

Analytics & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to measure sales performance, productivity, and profitability across business units and client-facing roles
  • Integrate and validate data from multiple systems (CRM, financial platforms, etc.) to create coherent datasets for analysis
  • Produce routine performance reports, scorecards, and ad hoc analyses for division leadership, regional managers, and individual contributors
  • Analyze trends, identify discrepancies, and research root causes; recommend solutions to management
  • Assist in creating and maintaining performance management reporting at division and regional levels
  • Support the Manager in designing new reports and refining existing ones based on stakeholder feedback

Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off? As you embark on a new journey, you’ll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life. The pay range for this role is $49,000- to $82,000, taking into account the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate.

Why you'll love this job

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and data requirements related to contact center operations.
  • Extract, clean, and transform large datasets from various sources, including call recordings and chat logs.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns, trends, and anomalies in customer interactions.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track key contact center metrics, such as call volumes, first contact resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores.
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
  • Stay current with industry trends and best practices in data analytics and contact center technologies.

All you'll need for success

Minimum Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of relevant work experience in analytics

Preferred Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience

  • Master's degree
  • Experience with scripting languages like Python or R
  • Familiarity with Azure Databricks

Skills, Licenses & Certifications

  • Strong project management skills, with experience managing projects across departments
  • Advanced visualization tools knowledge is desirable (Tableau/Power BI)
  • Advanced problem-solving skills, with the ability to logically structure analytical frameworks
  • Excellent leadership and teamwork skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in various situations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

  • Additional Benefits: Other great benefits include our Employee Assistance Program, pet insurance and discounts on hotels, cars, cruises and more

Are you ready to feel a tremendous sense of pride and satisfaction as you do your part to keep the largest airline in the world running smoothly as we care for people on life’s journey? Feel free to be yourself at American.

Position Title: Business Intelligence Administrator

Position Reports To: Manager, IT

Position Summary

The Business Intelligence Administrator is responsible for automating workflows, coordinating with business partners, and designing business tools that will promote data-driven decision making. This role will work with a team to create new workflows for both front and back end operational areas.

Essential Functions

Works with operational teams and Project Controls Team to integrate applications. (Procore, Exaktime, PowerBI, Fieldwire, and others). Assists with MIS Enterprise application development. Researches and analyzes operational improvement, profitability analysis, budget modeling and business development initiatives. (ROI, revenue/cost analysis). Completes ad hoc requests and projects as directed by management. Other duties as assigned.

  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS/IT or 3-5 years equivalent work experience in project management | project controls.
  • Experience with SQL, PowerBI, Application integrations.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to build and configure customized Power BI reports from creation through presentation
  • Experience with SQL server, PowerBI, and API application integration
  • Project Management Experience a plus (PMP)
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Proficient in MS PowerPoint MS Word & Outlook
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Must be a self-motivated and highly analytical person able to work in a dynamic environment
  • Industrial Field experience a plus

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Light work that includes moving objects up to 20 pounds.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.
  • Possible travel requirements to visit off-site locations and remote offices.

Job Title: Business Intelligence Analyst

Location: On Site - Irvine, California, United States

Salary: $105,000-$120,000

Skills: Business Intelligence Analyst, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Data Analytics, Automation, Spreadsheets, Large Data Sets, P&L / Finance / Budgeting, Manufacturing, Supply Chain / Defense / Aerospace


About the Manufacturing Company / The Opportunity:

Join a company in the manufacturing industry where timely, accurate data helps teams improve operations, manage costs, and make informed business decisions. This opportunity places business intelligence at the center of financial and operational planning, turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights. You will partner across the organization to strengthen reporting and help leaders understand performance across the business.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau to support financial and operational decision-making.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries to extract and transform data from multiple databases and systems.
  • Analyze manufacturing, supply chain, revenue, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with operations, finance, and other stakeholders to define reporting requirements and translate them into useful analytics.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, P&L, and three-statement reporting with accurate, well-documented data analysis.
  • Automate recurring reports and spreadsheet-based workflows to improve efficiency and data consistency.
  • Validate datasets, investigate discrepancies, and improve the quality and reliability of business reporting.
  • Maintain and refine BI processes, data models, and documentation as business needs evolve.


Must-Have Skills:

  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to query, extract, and analyze data from relational databases.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI or Tableau.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex datasets and communicate findings clearly to business stakeholders.
  • Strong Excel and spreadsheet skills, including pivot tables and data validation.
  • Understanding of financial and operational metrics, including budgeting, revenue, and P&L reporting.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.


Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or supply chain environments.
  • Knowledge of Python for data analysis, automation, or workflow improvement.
  • Familiarity with Azure or AWS data services.
  • Experience supporting FP&A, forecasting, or three-statement financial modeling.
  • Exposure to Adaptive Planning or similar planning and budgeting platforms.
  • Experience refactoring reporting processes or automating recurring analytics workflows.

descriptionHtml:
Purpose Brands, the parent company of Orangetheory, Anytime Fitness, Waxing the City, and The Bar Method, is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst II, to join its team. This is a great position for someone who is looking to expand their career, and join a company with a fun, fast-paced and inspirational culture.

As part of our Analytics team, this data and analytics professional analyzes business questions, assesses the impact of business initiatives. They think critically, are mathematically savvy, know how to query data, and apply analytical methods to derive insights. They work with our data engineers to augment datasets to enable dashboarding, reports, and operationalizing insights. They partner with business stakeholders to help them make use of analysis results and deploy data-informed decision-making processes.

Purpose/Impact: (Duties & Essential Functions)

Reporting & Analytics

  • Analyze business questions and communicate findings through briefs, presentations, reports or other media. Clarify and document the questions, how findings may be used, and the analysis approach.
  • Conduct impact analyses, leading to a deeper understanding of business performance, the member experience and fitness results. Guidance on approach provided by senior analyst or BI Manager.
  • Develop simple deterministic models that project outcomes based on observed relationships, e.g., break-even projections, simple systems models.
  • Develop reports and dashboards for an entire problem space, such as website performance, lead conversion or studio portfolio analysis. These are product features that are supported and evolved over time as opposed to one-off analyses.
  • Develop internal and external documentation and training on Analytics products, such as dashboards, reports, KPI's, source data collection and transformation, data lineage and suggested use cases.
  • Develop end-user applications with low-code tools to surface actionable analytics insights, collect data or execute analytics driven workflows/actions.
  • Work with data engineers to augment existing datasets with metrics and categorizations that make it easier to answer common business and analysis questions and publish appropriate reports.
  • Build the company knowledge base of data-informed insights, documenting findings and promoting and communicating those findings through appropriate internal channels.

Performance Expectations

  • Able to develop or collaborate with a data engineer on the design (metrics, attributes) of “last mile” datasets for analyzing common questions in a specific business domain.
  • Well versed in most of the functionality our BI platforms offer and able to make efficient use of them.
  • Uses a toolkit of analytic methods, e.g., variance analysis, sampling, establishing correlations, methods of analyzing causality to answer business questions with data.
  • Able to ask questions to fully understand the context and business question asked and how answering it will make a difference. Occasionally still needs help from senior analyst or manager to frame the problem.
  • Chooses or proposes a path of inquiry that is logical and coherent.
  • Follows applicable COE (Center of Excellence) tenets and methodologies when analyzing business questions or developing reports and dashboards.
  • Makes accurate inferences from the data most of the time. Still needs some help from more senior analysts or manager to validate conclusions.
  • Presents findings in an easy-to-understand way for business stakeholders, using COE practices.
  • Shares and documents approach and findings, making sure the rest of the team has visibility and can build on them.
  • Is recognized by business stakeholders as contributing to their decision-making processes or improving their operations.
  • Regularly reviews work with more senior analysts, seeks to learn and incorporates learnings into work products.

Background and Strengths

  • BS/BA in computer science, statistics, mathematics, business administration, economics, or related field with a focus on logic and quantitative analysis.
  • 3-5 years of experience in reporting and analysis. Experience with implementing, maintaining or developing reporting in Power BI, Tableau or comparable platforms is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of statistics (sampling, statistical significance).
  • Proficiency in querying and manipulating data using SQL. Know how to use subqueries, window and analytic functions, regular expressions.
  • Experience with Python, R or similar languages.

Strengths

  • Well organized. Thinks about how to do the work, then acts. Seeks to contextualize the work.
  • Demonstrates understanding of which analytic methods to use to answer certain types of questions.
  • Good interpersonal skills, seeks to understand others’ viewpoints, motivations, ways of thinking.
  • Communicates clearly and knows best practices for presentations.
  • Shows curiosity about the industry and can explain how our brands are differentiated.

Salary Range: $90k - $115k

What’s in it for you?

We offer a competitive salary along with exceptional benefits such as:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
  • Hybrid Work Environment
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Unlimited Time off + Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Friday's between Memorial Day and Labor Day
  • 401(K) Savings Plan Matching at 4%
  • 10 Coaching and Therapy sessions
  • Mental Health Benefits
  • Brand Discounts & Reimbursements
  • In-house workout facilities
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Team Building, Employee Engagement Activities & so much more

WORK SCHEDULE

Purpose Brands LLC, Currently Observe The Following Hybrid Work Model For Employees At Our Boca Raton (FL), Woodbury (MN), And Seattle (WA) Offices

  • Remote optional: Fridays
  • On-site days: Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays

We will work to create a sustainable culture that supports a healthy space for learning and growing, valuing, and empowering every employee, inspiring a diverse franchise network, and uplifting the members and communities we serve.

The New Mexico Department of Health (NMDOH) is committed to improving health outcomes and protecting the health and safety of New Mexicans. Within the Center for Health Protection (formerly ERD), the Emergency Medical Systems (EMS) Bureau provides statewide leadership, regulatory oversight, and system development for emergency medical services, trauma care, and time-sensitive medical emergencies.


The Bureau oversees EMS personnel licensure, agency certification, trauma and time-sensitive conditions systems, EMS funding, statewide clinical data systems, and initiatives supporting the delivery of high-quality emergency medical care. Through collaboration with healthcare providers, emergency responders, hospitals, and other partners, the Bureau works to strengthen emergency medical care throughout New Mexico, including its rural and frontier communities.


Why does the job exist?

  • The EMS Data Analyst position exists to provide advanced data management, analysis, system integration, and technical expertise in support of New Mexico's statewide EMS, Trauma, and Time Sensitive Conditions Systems.

  • Experience with electronic patient care reporting systems, healthcare data standards, data interoperability, or health information exchange.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to identify data quality issues, investigate discrepancies, and develop sustainable technical solutions.
  • The ability to translate complex technical information into clear, meaningful reports and presentations for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound professional judgment, and the ability to work independently while collaborating across multiple programs and disciplines.

  • Familiarity with EMS operations, clinical care, trauma systems, quality improvement, regulatory programs, or public health surveillance is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated initiative, adaptability, organizational skills, and an interest in contributing to statewide program development and continuous system improvement.


Minimum Qualification

High School diploma or equivalent and two (2) years of experience directly related to the position in providing GIS support, research, statistics, computer science, data analysis, accounting, auditing, finance, economics, business, public administration, budgeting, management, and/or systems analysis or related professional certification as determined by the hiring agency. Any combination of education from an accredited college or university in a related field and/or direct experience in this occupation totaling two (2) years may substitute for the required experience.


Employment Requirements

Must possess and maintain a valid Driver's License. Must possess and maintain a current Defensive Driving Course Certificate from the State of New Mexico or must pass and receive Defensive Driving Course Certification within six (6) months of date of hire as a condition of continued employment.


Working Conditions

Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment with extensive computer use, electronic communications, database applications, and virtual meetings. The position requires prolonged periods of data analysis, technical problem-solving, and preparation of written reports and presentations. Occasional in-state travel will be required for meetings, training, system implementation, or coordination with EMS agencies, hospitals, and other partners. Limited out-of-state travel may be required for professional development or national data system coordination.

The position may involve access to confidential medical, personnel, and regulatory information and requires adherence to applicable privacy, security, and confidentiality requirements.

descriptionHtml:
Your Job

Molex's Optical Connectivity Group (OCG) is seeking a Data Analyst to improve data quality, business visibility, and decision quality across our product development organization. This role will help transform data from SAP and other business systems into reliable, actionable insights that support portfolio, financial, resource, and operational decisions.

The Data Analyst will partner with leaders and subject matter experts across engineering, product management, project management, finance, operations, supply chain, and other functions. A key responsibility will be cleaning, standardizing, reconciling, and maintaining existing data so the organization can rely on consistent information when evaluating business performance, capital investments, project execution, and resource priorities.

A successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills with business and financial acumen; investigate the root causes of data and performance issues; establish trusted metrics and repeatable analytical methods; and translate complex information into clear recommendations that improve business results and create value.

Our Team

Molex's Optical Connectivity Group is at the forefront of designing and delivering optical solutions that support data centers, telecommunications infrastructure, and next-generation computing. The Data Analyst will support a global, cross-functional organization focused on innovation, disciplined product development, operational execution, and value creation.

This role will serve as a trusted analytical and data stewardship partner to OCG leaders and functional teams. The analyst will improve how business data is defined, maintained, connected, and used across the organization.

What You Will Do

  • Clean, standardize, reconcile, and validate existing data from SAP and other enterprise software systems to improve accuracy, consistency, and usability
  • Identify data gaps, duplicate records, inconsistent definitions, and other quality issues; investigate root causes and coordinate corrective actions with business and system owners
  • Establish repeatable processes, business rules, and controls that improve ongoing data quality and reduce recurring cleanup work
  • Analyze business, financial, operational, project, portfolio, capital, and resource data to identify trends, risks, performance gaps, and value-creation opportunities
  • Connect information across multiple systems to establish trusted views of business and portfolio performance
  • Develop and maintain common definitions, key performance indicators, calculation methods, and documentation for critical business data
  • Support portfolio prioritization, capital planning, forecasting, resource allocation, project reviews, and other leadership decisions through clear analysis and recommendations
  • Investigate the drivers behind business results and develop insights that move the organization beyond reporting what happened to understanding why it happened and what action should be taken
  • Reduce manual data collection, reconciliation, and reporting through standardization, process improvement, automation, and appropriate use of AI-enabled tools
  • Partner with functional leaders, subject matter experts, system owners, and technical teams to translate business questions into analytical requirements and sustainable solutions
  • Communicate complex findings clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences and influence action through data-driven recommendations


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Experience analyzing business, financial, operational, project, or portfolio data
  • Experience working with SAP or a comparable enterprise resource planning system
  • Experience cleaning, combining, reconciling, validating, and interpreting data from multiple software systems
  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Excel or comparable analytical tools
  • Experience developing and applying business metrics, key performance indicators, and analytical methodologies
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate data discrepancies, determine root causes, and improve data quality
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data analysis into meaningful business insights and recommendations
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and structured problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly and work effectively across multiple business functions
  • Ability to manage ambiguity, define problems, prioritize work, and independently structure analytical assignments


What Will Put You Ahead

  • Bachelor's degree in data analytics, business analytics, finance, engineering, information systems, statistics, mathematics, supply chain, or related discipline
  • Experience supporting product development, engineering, manufacturing, operations, finance, supply chain, or a project management organization
  • Experience with SAP data structures, master data, reporting, or related business processes
  • Experience analyzing project portfolios, resource capacity, capital investments, product development performance, or financial forecasts
  • Experience using SQL or similar tools to extract, manipulate, clean, and validate data
  • Experience with data governance, master data management, data stewardship, or development of data quality controls
  • Experience automating recurring data preparation, reconciliation, or analysis
  • Experience with forecasting, scenario analysis, statistical analysis, or predictive methods
  • Experience using AI-assisted analytical or automation tools
  • Experience presenting insights and recommendations to business leaders


For this role, we anticipate paying $90,000 - $115,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. On Aug. 8, 1950, an adventurous and determined entrepreneur named Harmon Dobson opened up the world’s first Whataburger on Ayers Street in Corpus Christi, Texas. He had a simple goal: to serve a burger so big it took two hands to hold and so good that after one bite customers would say, “What a burger!” He succeeded on both counts and turned that one little burger stand into a legend loved throughout Texas and the South. 

Today, each and every Whataburger is made to order, right when it’s ordered. And they’re still made with 100 percent pure, never-frozen beef and served on a big toasted five-inch bun with all “the extras” to suit your taste. Whataburger isn’t just a fast-food burger chain it is where bold leadership starts — and where potential doesn’t just grow, it heats up. Your Recipe For Impact — What You’ll Do

As an Accounting Data Analyst, you'll transform financial and operational data into insights that help leaders make better business decisions. Supporting Whataburger's growing third-party delivery and franchise businesses, you'll use SQL, analytics, and reporting tools to identify trends, investigate issues, improve processes, and drive financial performance. Your understanding of accounting principles and financial processes will help ensure data accuracy, support period-end close activities, and translate complex business activity into meaningful financial insights that leaders can trust.

Day-to-Day Ingredients — Responsibilities

As an Accounting Data Analyst, you will:

  • Develop SQL queries to analyze financial and operational data
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis to diagnose issues and support resolution
  • Prepare financial analysis and materials for leadership review
  • Support accounting processes, including reconciliations and journal entries
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives
  • Support timely and accurate period- and year-end close processes
  • Maintain accurate, consistent financial data and reporting
  • Improve reporting efficiency and data quality

The Sauce — Pay & Perks

As An Accounting Data Analyst, You Will Receive

  • Competitive Weekly Pay
  • Bonus Program that scales up to 2.5X payout potential based on company results
  • 5 weeks PTO
  • Flex Weeks
  • Paid Corporate Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave*
  • 401(k) match $1/$1 up to 4%
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits*
  • Short-term and Long-term Disability Benefits*
  • Opportunities for Career Development and Growth
  • Whataburger Family Foundation - Scholarship Program (dependents eligible) and Hardship Grant Assistance
  • Discounted Meals for You and a Guest
  • Wireless Service Discounts
  • Computer & Software Discounts
  • Fitness / Gym Discounts
  • Awards and recognition for all you do
  • Retirement Celebration Program

What You Bring To The Table — Required Experience

As an Accounting Data Analyst, you must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 2+ years of financial analysis, accounting or related experience
  • Advanced Excel skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, and data validation
  • Intermediate experience developing SQL queries to extract, join, and analyze data, including aggregate functions and subqueries
  • Ability to research and analyze discrepancies by querying underlying transactional data
  • Experience with variance, trend, and performance analysis
  • Proficiency in financial reporting and data tools
  • Understanding of journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Clear written and verbal communication abilities

Extra Toppings — Desired Experience

As an Accounting Data Analyst, we prefer you to have:

  • Experience supporting third-party delivery or multi-unit operations
  • Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Snowflake, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms
  • Exposure to reporting or process automation
  • Experience partnering cross‑functionally outside of Finance
  • Familiarity with continuous process improvement initiatives

Where & How You’ll Work

This role is based at the San Antonio Home Office, working on‑site Monday through Thursday with remote flexibility on Fridays. In this role, you’ll have strong collaboration with leadership, across cross-functional teams, and with external partners to align capabilities with restaurant realities. The work environment is fast‑paced and requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and strong collaboration skills. Full‑time availability is required, with occasional extended hours based on business needs, along with occasional travel to properties, project sites, and external meetings. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of the San Antonio Home Office.

Job Description

We are seeking a Business Analyst to improve business visibility, streamline reporting, and enable data-driven decision-making. This role will focus on centralizing business intelligence, supporting the Monthly Business Review (MBR) process, and automating recurring reporting and analytics.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Intelligence Centralization: Consolidate data, metrics, and reporting across multiple sources into standardized dashboards and a centralized BI framework, establishing consistent KPI definitions and a reliable source of truth.
  • Monthly Business Review: Own and continuously improve the MBR reporting process, including KPI tracking, trend and variance analysis, executive-ready insights, and coordination with business stakeholders.
  • Reporting Automation: Identify manual and repetitive reporting processes and develop automated solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and timeliness.
  • Analytics & Insights: Analyze business performance, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Partner with business and technical teams to improve data consistency, validate reporting outputs, and maintain standardized reporting definitions.
  • Continuous Improvement: Develop scalable dashboards, self-service reporting, and analytical tools that reduce manual effort and enable teams to make faster, data-informed decisions.


Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of relevant experience
  • Able to identify and resolve process, procedure, and tool gaps to improve overall program success
  • Outstanding proactive communication skills: written, verbal, presentations
  • High ownership with a strong bias for action
  • Experience with cloud services, networking, or SaaS products
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to address complex problems considering various technological and business factors
  • Flexibility to shift with business priorities, and unrivaled attention to detail
  • Self-driven problem solver; able to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, ambiguous, and customer-focused environment
  • Drive a culture of using data insights to help drive decision-making
  • Highly analytical, technically proficient, and able to learn new tools and software quickly


Desired Profile

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, experience with BI/reporting tools and data analysis, proficiency with Excel and SQL, and the ability to translate complex data into concise business insights for both operational and executive audiences.

descriptionHtml:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm, and every member feels valued.

Evaluate, design, code, test, optimize and modify Medica's financial or operations systems solutions and reporting capabilities that support multiple lines of Businesses and IT initiatives. Capture, develop, and document data definitions, business rules, and data quality requirements. Conduct data analysis in support of a variety of analytic solutions. Interpret data, analyze results, and provide insights to determine operational impact, trends, and opportunities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Key Accountabilities

  • Partner with internal business customers to establish and develop relationships, establishing credibility as a key internal resource.
  • Use analytic tools such as Power BI and SQL, and other in-house tools to utilize multiple data sources and environments to produce reports to meet needs of business users.
  • Develop analytical and reporting specifications for enterprise healthcare projects through participation in project teams or meetings with internal customers.
  • Develop and maintain business performance reports for operational business units and produce executive analytic summaries to aid decision-making using various reporting and analytic tools.
  • Research subjects surrounding claims, providers, pricing, benefits, government programs or membership, conduct analysis, interpret data, perform data quality checks, identify threats, and present information to internal customers.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous business and data requirements, independently investigate issues, identify appropriate data driven solutions, and communicate recommendations to business partners.
  • Participate in team activities to identify problems and improve work processes and systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in related field
  • 3 years of work experience beyond degree
  • Advanced SQL, Power BI, data analysis skills

Skills And Abilities

  • Experience with cloud-based technologies such as Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Healthcare insurance industry experience or interest.
  • Demonstrated examples of taking initiative and being curious with data.

This position is an Office role, which requires an employee to work onsite, on average, 3 days per week. We are open to candidates located near one of the following office locations: Minnetonka, MN, or Madison, WI.

The full salary grade for this position is $70,200 - $120,400. While the full salary grade is provided, the typical hiring salary range for this role is expected to be between $70,200 - $105,315. Annual salary range placement will depend on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, education, work experience, applicable certifications and/or licensure, the position's scope and responsibility, internal pay equity and external market salary data.  In addition to compensation, Medica offers a generous total rewards package that includes competitive medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, paid volunteer time off, 401K contributions, caregiver services and many other benefits to support our employees.

The compensation and benefits information is provided as of the date of this posting. Medica’s compensation and benefits are subject to change at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Eligibility to work in the US: Medica does not offer work visa sponsorship for this role. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Employment is contingent on verification of identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer, where all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Overview

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Data Analyst to support program management, data analytics, dashboard development and reporting activities at Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). This role will work with a team of both officers and contractors to interconnect reporting and analytics, tasking responses, and overall information to support the ICE mission. This role will directly support activities with the Harlingen Field Office on-site as they work to integrate processes to make law enforcement initiatives more efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analysis of ICE specific mission data, processes, field operations, strategic planning, or nuanced mission systems.
  • Develop data analytics dashboards, tools and templates to support the efficient collection and analysis of field metrics.
  • Utilize tools such as Power BI, tableau, Excel, and Access to provide visualizations to overall data sets.
  • Support collaboration with multiple stakeholders, such as business, scrum teams, other project managers, to collect and compile information to ensure timely responses to requests and ad hoc assignments.
  • Facilitate the needs, issues, and challenges faced by the clients; perform gap analysis and recommend solutions.
  • Use source data to assess the effectiveness of projects and business processes.
  • Develop, gather and disseminate information and documentation among both business and technical customers.
  • Work with all team members to analyze changes in requirements and recommend the most expedient solutions in a timely manner.
  • Leverage advanced writing skills to translate complicated issues from multiple information sources into a clear point of view to create a compelling, concise, and well-written narrative.
  • Leverage excellent presentation development skills to prepare meeting agendas and synthesize complex information into succinct visualizations using tools such as PowerPoint.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's with 3 + years (or commensurate experience) in dynamic customer delivery environments
  • Clearance Required: Ability to attain and maintain DHS clearance (US citizenship required)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Ability to translate ICE specific mission needs into tactical execution of reports, taskings and overall data analytics.
  • Excellent data analytic and oral communication skills.
  • Strong understanding in project management and data analysis.
  • Ability to lead data analytics development.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in an extremely fast-paced environment.
  • Be flexible to change direction on a moment’s notice while also tracking/executing tasks in progress.
  • Ability to think “outside of the box” while communicating or dealing with a variety of situations.
  • Possess clear understanding of the activities, roles, and responsibilities on large scale IT projects.

Posted Salary Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr.

descriptionHtml:
Description

Who We Are

As the Savannah River Site’s management and operations contractor since 2008, Savannah River Nuclear Solutions (SRNS) makes the world safer. With safety and security in the forefront, SRNS develops innovative approaches to deliver on our environmental commitments and nuclear materials challenges; supplies products and services necessary to maintain the nation’s nuclear deterrent; secures nuclear materials to prevent unwanted proliferation; and transforms nuclear materials into assets and stable waste forms. The SRNS workforce is highly capable, engaged, and adaptable to meet existing and expanding missions. SRNS employees apply superior expertise and innovative solutions to complex and challenging national and global issues. We have the knowledge to address a range of national and international nuclear issues. We make the world safer – and you can, too.

Some Typical Duties And Responsibilities Include

The Financial Reporting Analyst develops, maintains, and improves financial reporting and analytical solutions that support budget planning, forecasting, and oversight of DOE/NNSA programs and projects. This role partners with Budget Analysts and program/project stakeholders to translate reporting needs into accurate, timely, and user-friendly reporting products.

The successful candidate combines strong financial and data-analysis skills with advanced Excel capability, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to explain technical information to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

The ideal candidate brings strong financial reporting and advanced Excel skills, along with a curiosity for data, systems, and process improvement. They are comfortable working with complex data from enterprise financial systems and are motivated to expand their expertise in modern analytics platforms. The successful candidate will be a self-directed and independent learner who is comfortable and eager to explore new tools and build proficiency in enterprise data analytics platforms, such as Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), SAP analytics products, or comparable technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, maintain, and enhance financial reporting solutions supporting budget, forecast, and program/project oversight activities.
  • Extract, transform, validate, and load data from enterprise financial, planning, and reporting systems into Excel-based reports, data models, dashboards, and other analytical products.
  • Ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity, and timeliness of reporting data, source files, and recurring deliverables.
  • Partner with Budget Analysts and program/project customers to gather reporting requirements, define objectives and deliverables, and develop solutions that meet business needs.
  • Support reporting throughout the budget cycle, including recurring monthly reporting and time-sensitive stakeholder requests.
  • Use advanced Excel capabilities—including formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, Power Pivot/Data Model, lookups, charts, and macros—to analyze and present financial data.
  • Communicate reporting methods, data considerations, findings, and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automate recurring activities, and strengthen reporting usability and data quality.
  • Remain current on reporting, analytics, data visualization, and financial-systems best practices.
  • Develop and maintain proficiency in downstream enterprise data analytics tools—including Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), SAP analytics products, or comparable platforms—through self-directed learning, available training, documentation, and collaboration with subject-matter experts.

Job Family

Admin & Business Services

Job Family Description

Administrative and business services professionals provide various office and location support activities. They identify, enhance, and follow specific processes and procedures to maximize the efficiencies of the business to which the support is being provided, and ensure the correct functioning of facilities, office and/or business support services.

Discipline

Business Analysis

Discipline Description

Business Analysts are professionals who analyze business processes, and data across an entire organization to optimize performance, and drive strategic initiatives. They bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions, facilitating organizational change, and maximizing the value of enterprise-wide investments. They may use Six Sigma skills for data analysis and evaluation. They take the results of the analysis and establish improvements and control mechanisms.

Career Level Description

Requires in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in own field/discipline, solving complex problems with minimal guidance and oversight.

Education

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, and five years of relevant experience; or
  • Master’s degree in a related field and two years of relevant experience; or
  • Associate degree and eight years of relevant experience; or
  • High school diploma/equivalency and 12 years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including proficiency with complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, charts, and data analysis tools.
  • Experience extracting, transforming, validating, and analyzing data from financial, ERP, planning, reporting, or other enterprise systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and maintain accurate reports, data models, or analytical solutions utilizing large or complex datasets.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to gather requirements from business stakeholders and translate those requirements into practical reporting solutions.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.

We'd Also Like to See

  • Experience with Power Query, Power Pivot, Excel Data Model, and/or Power BI.
  • Experience with M and/or DAX programing language as they relate to Excel Power Query and Data Model tools.
  • Experience developing or maintaining data models, queries, reports, dashboards, or automated reporting processes.
  • Experience using Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BusinessObjects, or comparable enterprise analytics, reporting, dashboard, or visualization platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently learn unfamiliar financial systems, reporting tools, data structures, and analytics technologies.
  • Working knowledge of ETL concepts and data-validation practices.
  • Experience with, PeopleSoft Financials/PS Query, SAP S/4HANA, or comparable ERP, Deltek Cobra, financial planning, and analytics platforms; SQL. Microsoft 365 applications including Sharepoint, Outlook, Lists, Automate, Notes, etc..
  • Knowledge of database concepts, including data structures, relationships, data integrity, and ERP data architecture.
  • Familiarity with data-visualization best practices.
  • Experience supporting financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, project controls, or program reporting.

Career Band

Professional

Career Band Description

  • Roles in this band apply the knowledge in area of expertise to analyze information; design and develop new approaches, methodologies and processes; and, provide professional advice and guidance to others in accordance with professional quality standards
  • Applies a theoretical knowledge-base to work to achieve goals through own work
  • Characterized by specific functional expertise typically gained through formal education
  • May provide guidance to others as a project manager using technical expertise

Security Clearance Information

SRNS is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug & alcohol test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, criminal records, and employment history, and education verifications. Positions with SRNS may require applicants to obtain and maintain a DOE L or Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. Factors such as pre-employment background review results, dual citizenship status, and unpaid and/or unfiled taxes may impact your ability to obtain a security clearance. This list of factors is not exhaustive; pre-employment information and security clearance requests are reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Clearance Level Required to Perform Job

None

What We Offer

Benefits

Savannah River Nuclear Solutions (SRNS) Benefits team is constantly assessing trends in the benefits area to provide the best possible services to our workforce. We ensure high quality outcomes of each service provider by consistent monitoring and oversight for positive results. We also negotiate cost effective premiums that will meet the needs of our evolving workforce. Your SRNS Health & Welfare benefits provide peace of mind and financial protection for you and your family. Some of the Benefits offered to full service employees include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Critical Illness and Accident Insurance
  • Employer paid life insurance with buy up options
  • Employer paid Short Term and Long Term Disability
  • 401(k) with Employer Match
  • Various wellness programs
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Discounts and other supplemental benefits

SRNS employees are critical to the success of SRNS, all while making the world a safer place. The work that we do every day makes a difference.

Standards of Excellence

The SRNS Vision States That We Will "be The Standard Of Excellence In Nuclear Materials Management By Delivering Knowledge, Innovation And Experience." This Is Underpinned By The Recognition That Everything We Do Relies On Our Employees And How They Demonstrate The SRNS Standards Of Excellence Every Day. Built On The Foundation Of Safety And Security, Each Employee Is Expected To

Model Excellence by demonstrating the highest standards and values in work and promoting them within the organization and to the customer.

Deliver Results by meeting customer expectations to ensure objectives, goals and deadlines are met while being good stewards of resources.

Energize and Recognize Teams through growing organizational strength and recognizing continued excellence.

Build Relationships by developing relationships with coworkers and customers to foster a respectful workplace.

Shape the Future by creating a diverse, innovative and integrated workforce that fosters mission success and company growth.

Note

SRNS is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. SRNS utilizes the Disabled Veteran Enhancement Opportunities program which is aimed at improving employment opportunities for disabled veterans at the Savannah River Site (SRS). The organization utilizes standards set forth by VEVRRA regulations pertaining to veteran recruitment efforts. SRNS is also committed to making our workplace accessible to individuals with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodations, upon request, for individuals to participate in the application and hiring process. To request such an accommodation, you may contact us by phone at 803-952-8207, or by e-mail at hrrecruiting@srs.gov.

This position is not eligible for immigration and/or visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship by Jabil. Applicants requiring sponsorship will not be considered.

Jabil, Inc. is seeking an HR Data Analyst to join our team. This role is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and reporting on HR data to support strategic decision-making and improve HR processes.

Job Responsibilities:**

  • Collect, clean, and analyze HR data from various sources, including HRIS, ATS, and other HR systems.
  • Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to track key HR metrics (e.g., turnover, time-to-hire, diversity).
  • Identify trends and insights from HR data to provide actionable recommendations to HR leadership and business partners.
  • Support HR initiatives and projects by providing data analysis and reporting expertise.
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all HR systems and reports.
  • Collaborate with IT and other departments to improve data collection and reporting capabilities.
  • Develop and deliver presentations on HR data insights to various stakeholders.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive HR information.
  • All other tasks as assigned

Job Qualifications:**

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in HR data analysis or a similar analytical role.
  • Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., Workday, or similar) and advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex data to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of HR processes and best practices.

Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact the Federal Bureau of Investigations internet crime hotline (www.ic3.gov), the Federal Trade Commission identity theft hotline (www.identitytheft.gov) and/or your local police department. Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.

  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Data Analyst

Reports to: Head of Business Intelligence, Finance and Accounting

Location: Atlanta, GA. (Hybrid: Monday, Wednesday, Friday in-office)

About The Role

CharterUP is seeking an early career Data Analyst to join our Finance BI team, someone eager to tackle data challenges and assist in meeting the reporting and analytics needs of teams throughout the organization. This role’s deliverables will have a high impact, with visibility to leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Collect, clean, and organize large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., databases, APIs, spreadsheets) for both one-off data requests and recurring reports.
  • Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that will guide business strategy and decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track key business metrics.

We're seeking someone to join our Wealth Management CFO Support team as an Associate in Finance. The team is dedicated to providing support to Morgan Stanley's Wealth Management segment (MSWM), specifically within Investment Solutions. Members of the Wealth Management Finance team can expect to be involved in accounting, finance and process transformation.

In the Finance division, we act as a partner to business units around the globe by providing management, review, analysis and advisory services of the Firm's financial and capital resources. This is an Associate level position within our Product Controllers Job Family which specializes in ensuring adequacy of controls, profit and loss and balance sheet reporting and reconciliations for a segment / business / product area, as well as management reporting across business segments or cross-functional end-to-end product oversight.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

  • This role can be located in our 1 New York Plaza office or Purchase, New York office. If located in 1 NYP you will be required to work in Purchase once a week at minimum**

To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

What You'll Do In The Role

  • Collaborate with a varied group of colleagues in Finance and across the Firm
  • Responsible for both individual and team deliverables and projects, leveraging knowledge of Finance functional area, tools and/or products
  • Adhere to the Firm?s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls
  • Act as a culture carrier; embody the Firm's values and hold yourself accountable to Firm standards
  • Collaborate with business finance team to identify, interpret data and visually present meaningful business analytics and trends
  • Interact with various stakeholders including lines of business, subject matter experts and senior management.
  • Partner with technology to enhance data, collection and analysis.
  • Leverage business technologies (e.g. SQL, Business objects, DataIKU, Tableau)
  • Manage CCAR business models and automation efforts

What You'll Bring To The Role

  • Working knowledge of Finance functional area, industry and competitive environment
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, and adapt to various audiences
  • Willingness to seek guidance and provide feedback to further develop self and peers
  • Proficient in SQL and PYTHON; Familiarity with PostgreSQL, DATAIKU and Tableau a plus
  • Ability to make creative and effective use of systems and technology (including MS Office Suite)
  • Ability to simplify and articulate technical concepts to others in a meaningful manner.
  • Manage larger, complex projects efficiently and independently.
  • Self-motivated, ability to work independently as well as within a team environment
  • Adaptable and innovative; ability to assess and troubleshoot data issues.
  • At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role
  • B.A./B.S. in relevant field

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $90,000 and $115,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

descriptionHtml:
About Ameren Services (B&CS)

Ameren Services provides administrative support and services to Ameren Corporation and its operating companies, subsidiaries and affiliates. Ameren Services includes a wide range of skill sets and roles, from finance and legal experts to digital and cyber specialists, plus those charged with ensuring environmental compliance and operational safety. Together, we help execute a strategy that enables Ameren to deliver superior long-term value to customers, shareholders and the environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical coverage on date of hire
  • 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan
  • 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire
  • Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave


Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees.

About The Position

The Senior Analyst, Internal Reporting is part of a team that supports Ameren's senior leadership and other internal and external stakeholders in understanding and interpreting Ameren's results of operations. The Internal Reporting team is a trusted business adviser to executive leadership and provides monthly reporting needed to make informed decisions to operate the company. The position participates in a collaborative, cross-functional effort to analyze financial and statistical data to explain income statement variances by line item and the underlying business drivers. The position also performs controls and reconciliations that help ensure costs are accounted for correctly and appropriately recovered. The team is also responsible for preparing and reviewing related disclosures in the SEC filings for Ameren Corporation and its two registrant subsidiaries, as well as filings with other regulatory bodies, internal reporting work products, and presentations. In addition, the position plays a supporting role in cross-functional projects, and interfacing with senior leadership.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Provide insight into business drivers and trends affecting Ameren's results of operations in a manner that demonstrates a high level of business acumen.
  • Perform internal controls and cross-checks to identify errors and misstatement.
  • Identify efforts to continually improve the value of our work products for our internal stakeholders, including External Reporting, the broader Controller's function, and corporate and business line leadership.
  • Support communication of financial results to investors, analysts, and other external stakeholders by providing Ameren's Investor Relations team with insight into the business drivers affecting earnings.
  • Ensure accurate financial statements by evaluating results of operations during the monthly close process and identifying inconsistent and/or incorrect data and initiating corrective actions.
  • Prepare internal financial reports and executive-level presentations.
  • Seek out opportunities for professional training and growth as a part of core responsibilities.
  • Analyze and communicate Ameren's results of operations to leadership and other internal stakeholders.
  • Support investors and analysts by preparing SEC filings (e.g. Form 10Q and Form 10K).
  • Assist with analyses and presentations used for discussion with senior leadership and Ameren's Board of Directors.
  • Perform other ad hoc projects as required.


Qualifications - Senior Analyst, Internal Reporting

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university required, preferably in Accounting or Finance. An advanced degree and/or certification (e.g. MBA, CPA, CFA, PE) is preferred. Three or more years of financial analysis, accounting, or other professional level relevant experience required. Prior experience in financial analysis preferred.

Qualifications - Lead Analyst, Internal Reporting

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university required, preferably in Accounting or Finance. An advanced degree and/or certification (e.g. MBA, CPA, CFA, PE) is preferred. Five or more years of financial analysis, accounting, or other professional level relevant experience required.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • The ability to work and conduct research independently, prioritize tasks, multi-task, and manage changing assignments in a collaborative team environment to meet critical deadlines.
  • Strong problem solving, analytical and communication skills.
  • Must be able to effectively interact with various levels of management and subsidiary business line personnel.
  • A strong customer-service orientation.


Additional Information

Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include candidate testing and/or an individual aptitude or skill-based assessment. Specific details will be provided to qualified candidates.

Compensation Range:

$90,500.00 - $147,700.00

  • This pay range encompasses multiple levels of the role. Career level and compensation depends upon applicant’s credentials.


At Ameren, base salary is one component of a competitive compensation package for employees. Our pay ranges are broad to allow for movement within our organization and to accommodate different skill sets and levels of expertise. We take into consideration a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, and internal equity when determining the base salary offered. Roles are eligible for additional rewards including annual incentive payments based on individual and company performance.

If end date is listed, the posting will come down at 12:00 am on that date:

Monday November 23, 2026

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, military service or status, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other class, trait, or status protected by law.
